Ved at anvende klyngeteknikker, såsom k-means og Ward's algorithm, var de i stand til at identificere homogene sub-regioner og klassificere steder baseret på afstand til kysten og andre faktorer. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskere med at forstå den spatio-temporale variabilitet af nedbør og definere klimazoner, hvilket kan være nyttigt til at studere ekstreme nedbørshændelser og implementere afbødningsforanstaltninger.

title: CT Scan Algorithm Improvements
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve material decomposition and image quality in different types of CT scans. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of the decomposition process by utilizing statistical methods, iterative techniques, noise reduction techniques, and other approaches. By attributing agency to these algorithms, the researchers suggest that they have the potential to significantly enhance the capabilities of CT imaging technology.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre materialedekomponering og billedkvalitet i forskellige typer af CT-scanninger. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af dekomponeringsprocessen ved at anvende statistiske metoder, iterative teknikker, støjreduktionsteknikker og andre tilgange. Ved at tillægge disse algoritmer en handlende rolle foreslår forskerne, at de har potentiale til at forbedre CT-billedteknologiens kapaciteter betydeligt.

title: Predictive Algorithms for Turbines
en: Researchers are using various data-mining algorithms to predict and diagnose abnormalities in wind turbine subsystems. They are also using neural network algorithms to identify bearing faults in wind turbines. Additionally, advanced signal processing and machine learning methods are being used to improve the reliability of offshore wind turbines by detecting abnormal behavior. These algorithms are helping to optimize fault detection methods and improve the overall performance of wind turbines.
da: Forskere bruger forskellige data-mining algoritmer til at forudsige og diagnosticere abnormiteter i vindmølleundersystemer. De bruger også neurale netværksalgoritmer til at identificere leje-fejl i vindmøller. Derudover anvendes avancerede signalbehandlings- og maskinlæringsmetoder til at forbedre pålideligheden af offshore vindmøller ved at opdage unormalt adfærd. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at optimere fejldetekteringsmetoder og forbedre den overordnede ydeevne af vindmøller.

title: Urban algorithms
en: Researchers have been using algorithms to answer various questions about cities and urban areas. For example, they have used spatial clustering algorithms to measure neighborhood change and identify metropolitan areas based on commuting patterns. Algorithms have also been used to analyze inequality in public services, identify megaregions, study segregation, quantify spatial opportunity, and develop databases on urban inequality and amenities. Additionally, algorithms have been used to analyze neighborhood change, predict gentrification, develop neighborhood typologies, and analyze the relationship between urban form metrics and air pollution/access to green space. These algorithms help researchers gain insights into urban areas and address inequalities in urban infrastructure.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at besvare forskellige spørgsmål om byer og byområder. For eksempel har de anvendt spatial clustering algorithms til at måle forandringer i nabolag og identificere metropolområder baseret på pendlemønstre. Algoritmer er også blevet brugt til at analysere ulighed i offentlige tjenester, identificere megaregioner, studere segregering, kvantificere rumlig mulighed og udvikle databaser om urban ulighed og faciliteter. Derudover er algoritmer blevet brugt til at analysere forandringer i nabolag, forudsige gentrifikation, udvikle nabolagstyper og analysere forholdet mellem urbane form metrics og luftforurening/adgang til grønt område. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskere med at få indsigt i byområder og tackle uligheder i byinfrastruktur.

title: Algorithmic Vascular Optimization
en: Researchers are using algorithms to improve various aspects of vascular access in healthcare settings. These algorithms are being used to guide decisions on device selection, timing for replacing catheters, and even the placement of catheters. By implementing these algorithms, healthcare professionals hope to improve patient outcomes and reduce complications associated with vascular access procedures.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af vaskulær adgang i sundhedsvæsenet. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at vejlede beslutninger om enhedsvalg, tidspunkter for udskiftning af katetre og endda placering af katetre. Ved at implementere disse algoritmer håber sundhedsprofessionelle at forbedre patientresultater og reducere komplikationer forbundet med vaskulære adgangsprocedurer.

title: Optimal building design
en: Researchers have explored the use of algorithms in various aspects of sustainable building design. They have developed systems that integrate CAD, simulation tools, and optimization algorithms to aid in optimal building design. Algorithms have also been used to increase energy efficiency through structural modifications and to support building performance assessment and optimization. Additionally, algorithms have been utilized for tasks such as construction scheduling, resolving conflicts between different design factors, and evaluating building circularity.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af ​​algoritmer inden for forskellige aspekter af bæredygtigt bygningsdesign. De har udviklet systemer, der integrerer CAD, simuleringsværktøjer og optimeringsalgoritmer for at hjælpe med optimalt bygningsdesign. Algoritmer er også blevet brugt til at øge energieffektiviteten gennem strukturelle modificeringer og til at støtte vurdering og optimering af bygningens ydeevne. Derudover er algoritmer blevet anvendt til opgaver såsom byggeplanlægning, løsning af konflikter mellem forskellige designfaktorer og evaluering af bygningens cirkularitet.

title: Power filter optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating ways to improve the performance of shunt active power filters under different voltage conditions. They have developed various algorithms that can control the filters and mitigate harmonics, improve power factor correction, and enhance power quality. These algorithms, such as modified reference current calculation methods and adaptive controllers, play a crucial role in optimizing the operation of shunt active power filters.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af shunt aktive power filters under forskellige spændingsforhold. De har udviklet forskellige algoritmer, der kan kontrollere filtrene og reducere harmoniske forvrængninger, forbedre effektfaktor korrektur og forbedre energikvaliteten. Disse algoritmer, såsom modificerede reference strøm beregningsmetoder og adaptive controllere, spiller en afgørende rolle i at optimere driften af shunt aktive power filters.

title: Optic disc segmentation
en: Researchers are exploring ways to accurately and efficiently detect and segment the optic disc, a crucial part of the eye. They are using algorithms such as circular transformation, directional matched filtering, and level sets to achieve fast and reliable localization and segmentation. Other approaches include using morphological operators, contrast enhancement techniques, and statistical region merging to improve the accuracy and robustness of optic disc segmentation. These algorithms aim to automate the process and make it more efficient, ultimately benefiting the diagnosis and treatment of eye diseases.
da: Forskere udforsker måder at nøjagtigt og effektivt opdage og segmentere den optiske skive, en afgørende del af øjet. De bruger algoritmer som circular transformation, directional matched filtering og level sets for at opnå hurtig og pålidelig lokalisering og segmentering. Andre tilgange inkluderer brug af morfologiske operatorer, kontrastforstærkningsteknikker og statistisk region merging for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af optisk skive segmentering. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at automatisere processen og gøre den mere effektiv, hvilket i sidste ende vil komme diagnosen og behandlingen af øjensygdomme til gode.

title: Enhancing Five-Axis Machining
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the performance of five-axis machining, a technique used in manufacturing. They have developed algorithms, such as the Genetic Algorithm and error compensation algorithms, to optimize workpiece setup, minimize kinematics error, enhance tool path accuracy, and control undesired movements. These algorithms attribute agency to the machines, allowing them to perform tasks more efficiently and accurately.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af femaksebearbejdning, en teknik der anvendes i fremstillingsprocesser. De har udviklet algoritmer, såsom Genetic Algorithm og fejlkompensationsalgoritmer, for at optimere opsætningen af emner, minimere kinematikfejl, forbedre værktøjsbanens nøjagtighed og kontrollere uønskede bevægelser. Disse algoritmer giver maskinerne handlefrihed, hvilket gør dem i stand til at udføre opgaver mere effektivt og nøjagtigt.

title: 3D IC Optimization
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to address different research questions related to the design and optimization of 3D integrated circuits (ICs). These algorithms aim to reduce power consumption, optimize clock tree synthesis, improve floorplanning, enhance analytical placement, optimize TSV arrangement, reduce area overhead, optimize performance and energy in NoC architectures, construct low-power clock trees, optimize TSV assignment and selection, and optimize thermal management in 3D ICs. The use of these algorithms offers opportunities for improving the physical design and CAD tools for 3D ICs.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til design og optimering af 3D integrerede kredsløb (ICs). Disse algoritmer har til formål at reducere energiforbruget, optimere clock tree synthesis, forbedre floorplanning, forbedre analytisk placering, optimere TSV-arrangementet, reducere arealoverhead, optimere ydeevne og energi i NoC-arkitekturer, konstruere lavenergiklokker, optimere TSV-tildeling og -valg samt optimere termisk styring i 3D ICs. Brug af disse algoritmer giver muligheder for at forbedre det fysiske design og CAD-værktøjer til 3D ICs.

title: Enhancing KNN
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the performance of the k-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm, a popular classification method in machine learning. They have proposed various modifications and enhancements, such as the local mean-based pseudo nearest neighbor rule and the adaptive hybrid and cluster-based method. These algorithms aim to reduce computational costs, enhance precision, optimize feature selection, and improve overall prediction performance. By incorporating these advancements, scientists hope to achieve more accurate and efficient classification results.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af k-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algoritmen, en populær klassifikationsmetode inden for maskinlæring. De har foreslået forskellige modificeringer og forbedringer, såsom den lokal gennemsnitsbaserede pseudonærmeste nabo regel og den adaptive hybrid- og klyngebaserede metode. Disse algoritmer har til formål at reducere beregningsomkostninger, forbedre præcisionen, optimere funktionsvalg og forbedre den overordnede forudsigelsesydelse. Ved at inkorporere disse fremskridt håber forskerne at opnå mere nøjagtige og effektive klassifikationsresultater.

title: Efficient cloud scheduling
en: Researchers have been investigating the impact of various algorithms on task scheduling in cloud computing. The Load Balancing Ant Colony Optimization (LBACO) algorithm has been found to outperform other algorithms such as FCFS and basic ACO in cloud task scheduling. Similarly, the Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm has been shown to outperform FCFS and Round-Robin algorithms. These findings suggest that these algorithms can improve the efficiency and performance of task scheduling in cloud computing.
da: Forskere har undersøgt indvirkningen af forskellige algoritmer på opgaveplanlægning i cloud computing. Load Balancing Ant Colony Optimization (LBACO) algoritmen har vist sig at være mere effektiv end andre algoritmer som FCFS og grundlæggende ACO i cloud-opgaveplanlægning. Tilsvarende har Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algoritmen vist sig at være bedre end FCFS og Round-Robin-algoritmer. Disse resultater tyder på, at disse algoritmer kan forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af opgaveplanlægning i cloud computing.

title: DOA Estimation Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to improve the accuracy and efficiency of Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation, a technique used in signal processing. These algorithms, such as FOCUSS, norm approximation, weighted-L1-SRACV, and compressed MUSIC, aim to estimate the direction of incoming signals in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) scenarios or with limited snapshots. By utilizing techniques like sparse signal reconstruction, alternating low-rank decomposition, and Khatri-Rao product, these algorithms offer promising advancements in DOA estimation.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimering, en teknik der bruges i signalbehandling. Disse algoritmer, såsom FOCUSS, norm approximation, weighted-L1-SRACV og compressed MUSIC, har til formål at estimere retningen af indkommende signaler i scenarier med lav signal-til-støj-forhold (SNR) eller med begrænsede snapshots. Ved at udnytte teknikker som sparsom signalreconstruction, skiftevis lav-rang dekomposition og Khatri-Rao produkt, tilbyder disse algoritmer lovende fremskridt inden for DOA estimering.

title: Impact localization
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to accurately locate impacts on composite structures. These algorithms, such as Fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors and acoustic emission piezoelectric sensors, are being tested to determine their effectiveness in pinpointing the source of impacts. The goal is to develop real-time monitoring systems that can detect and localize impacts on these structures, which could be crucial for ensuring their structural integrity in various applications, including aerospace.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til nøjagtigt at lokalisere påvirkninger på kompositstrukturer. Disse algoritmer, såsom Fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensorer og akustiske emissions piezoelectric sensorer, bliver testet for at fastslå deres effektivitet i at afdække kilden til påvirkninger. Målet er at udvikle realtids overvågningssystemer, der kan opdage og lokalisere påvirkninger på disse strukturer, hvilket kunne være afgørende for at sikre deres strukturelle integritet i forskellige anvendelser, herunder rumfart.

title: Structural Health Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to optimize the placement of sensors in structural health monitoring. These algorithms, such as genetic algorithms and swarm intelligence algorithms, are used to determine the best locations for sensors to detect and monitor structural damage. By using these optimization methods, researchers aim to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of structural health monitoring systems, ultimately enhancing the safety and reliability of structures like bridges.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at optimere placeringen af sensorer i strukturel sundhedsovervågning. Disse algoritmer, såsom genetiske algoritmer og swarm intelligence-algoritmer, bruges til at bestemme de bedste placeringer for sensorer til at opdage og overvåge strukturel skade. Ved at anvende disse optimeringsmetoder sigter forskerne mod at forbedre effektiviteten og effektiviteten af systemer til strukturel sundhedsovervågning, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer sikkerheden og pålideligheden af strukturer som broer.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Networks
en: Researchers are exploring how to improve the performance of wireless networks using algorithms. They are investigating questions such as how to manage interference between cells, optimize power allocation, achieve distributed frequency allocation, and improve network selection. These challenges are being addressed using reinforcement learning algorithms, which allow the algorithms to learn and adapt to the changing network conditions.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan man kan forbedre ydeevnen af trådløse netværk ved hjælp af algoritmer. De undersøger spørgsmål som, hvordan man kan håndtere interferens mellem celler, optimere strømtildeling, opnå distribueret frekvenstildeling og forbedre netværksvalg. Disse udfordringer bliver adresseret ved hjælp af reinforcement learning-algoritmer, som giver algoritmerne mulighed for at lære og tilpasse sig de skiftende netværksforhold.

title: Contouring control algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the accuracy and performance of contouring control in motion systems. These algorithms include integrated direct/indirect adaptive robust controllers, position domain control methods, real-time contouring error estimation algorithms, and iterative learning cross-coupled control algorithms. By utilizing these algorithms, precise contour following, high-precision contouring, and improved contour accuracy can be achieved in a wide range of applications, including industrial motion stages and multi-axis motion systems.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og ydeevnen af konturkontrol i bevægelsessystemer. Disse algoritmer inkluderer integrerede direkte/indirekte adaptive robuste controllere, positionsdomæne kontrolmetoder, realtidskonturfejlskattingsalgoritmer og iterative læringskrydskoblede kontrolalgoritmer. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer kan præcis konturfølgning, højpræcisionskonturering og forbedret konturnøjagtighed opnås i et bredt spektrum af applikationer, herunder industrielle bevægelsesskafter og multiaksials bevægelsessystemer.

title: Fabric defect detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically neural networks and deep learning techniques, for fabric defect detection and classification in the textile industry. These algorithms are used to develop computer-based inspection systems that can identify and classify defects in woven and knitted fabrics. By using image processing techniques and fusion-based feature extraction, these algorithms improve the accuracy and efficiency of fabric defect detection and classification, leading to automated and real-time inspection processes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt neurale netværk og dyb læringsteknikker, til stoffejldetektion og -klassificering i tekstilindustrien. Disse algoritmer bruges til at udvikle computerbaserede inspektionssystemer, der kan identificere og klassificere fejl i vævede og strikkede stoffer. Ved at anvende billedbehandlingsteknikker og fusion-baseret egenskabsudtræk forbedrer disse algoritmer nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af stoffejldetektion og -klassificering, hvilket fører til automatiserede og realtidsinspektionsprocesser.

title: Ionic Liquids Algorithms
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to predict the solubility of various compounds in ionic liquids. These algorithms, such as quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) models and artificial neural networks (ANNs), are trained to develop predictive models. By combining these machine learning techniques with thermodynamic and structural characteristics, researchers are able to accurately estimate solubility and absorption of gases in ionic liquids.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at forudsige opløseligheden af forskellige forbindelser i ioniske væsker. Disse algoritmer, såsom quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) modeller og artificial neural networks (ANNs), er trænet til at udvikle forudsigelsesmodeller. Ved at kombinere disse maskinlæringsteknikker med termodynamiske og strukturelle egenskaber, er forskerne i stand til præcist at estimere opløselighed og absorption af gasser i ioniske væsker.

title: Shaking table optimization
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the performance of electro-hydraulic shaking tables. These algorithms aim to reduce harmonic distortion, improve control accuracy, eliminate phase delay and amplitude attenuation, cancel acceleration harmonics, estimate harmonics in real-time, and achieve resonant suppression. The algorithms used include LMS adaptive algorithm, adaptive inverse control, inverse frequency response function equalization technique, Kalman filter, normalized least-mean-square adaptive algorithm, unscented Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, particle swarm optimization algorithm, nonlinear adaptive algorithm, water cycle algorithm, multifrequency adaptive notch filter, and multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm. These algorithms play a crucial role in enhancing the capabilities of shaking tables for various applications in engineering and research.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre ydeevnen af elektro-hydrauliske skærevogne. Disse algoritmer har til formål at reducere harmonisk forvrængning, forbedre kontrolpræcision, eliminere fasenforsinkelse og amplitudedæmpning, annullere accelerationsharmonikker, estimere harmonikker i realtid og opnå resonansundertrykkelse. De anvendte algoritmer inkluderer LMS adaptive algorithm, adaptive inverse control, inverse frequency response function equalization technique, Kalman filter, normalized least-mean-square adaptive algorithm, unscented Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, particle swarm optimization algorithm, nonlinear adaptive algorithm, water cycle algorithm, multifrequency adaptive notch filter og multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at forbedre kapaciteterne for skærevogne til forskellige anvendelser inden for ingeniørarbejde og forskning.

title: Algorithmic Bridge Optimization
en: Researchers have been using algorithms to optimize the design of cable-stayed bridges and determine the best distribution of forces in the cables. These algorithms consider various design variables, such as model geometry, deck sections, and control algorithms. By combining techniques like finite element analysis, B-spline curves, and genetic algorithms, researchers are able to achieve efficient and effective design optimization for cable-stayed bridges. These algorithms help engineers find the best solutions for factors like seismic action, deck shape, and cable pre-tension forces, ultimately leading to safer and more efficient bridge designs.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at optimere designet af skråstagsbroer og bestemme den bedste fordeling af kræfterne i kablerne. Disse algoritmer tager højde for forskellige designvariable, såsom modelgeometri, dæksektioner og kontrolalgoritmer. Ved at kombinere teknikker som finite element analysis, B-spline curves og genetiske algoritmer er forskerne i stand til at opnå effektiv og effektiv designoptimering for skråstagsbroer. Disse algoritmer hjælper ingeniører med at finde de bedste løsninger for faktorer som seismisk påvirkning, dækform og kabel præspændingskræfter, hvilket i sidste ende fører til sikrere og mere effektive brodesigns.

title: Islanding detection
en: Researchers have explored various algorithms to detect islanding events in power systems with distributed generation. These algorithms include techniques such as Bayesian passive islanding detection, support vector machines, singular value decomposition, AdaBoost, Hilbert-Huang transform, extreme learning machines, and more. By using these algorithms, researchers aim to accurately identify islanding conditions and improve the overall stability and reliability of distributed generation systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer til at detektere islanding-hændelser i elsystemer med distribueret generation. Disse algoritmer inkluderer teknikker som Bayesian passive islanding detection, support vector machines, singular value decomposition, AdaBoost, Hilbert-Huang transform, extreme learning machines og mere. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer har forskerne til formål nøjagtigt at identificere islanding-forhold og forbedre den overordnede stabilitet og pålidelighed af distribuerede generationssystemer.

title: MRI Muscle Analysis
en: Algorithms are being used to automatically measure and quantify muscle volume in MRI scans of the lower extremities. They are also being used to accurately assess muscle and fat in thigh MRI scans. Additionally, algorithms are being employed to implement quantitative MRI protocols for characterizing healthy human thigh muscles and to segment MRI images and quantify intramuscular adipose tissue and other soft-tissue compartments. These advancements in using algorithms in MRI analysis have the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosing and monitoring muscle-related conditions and diseases.
da: Algoritmer bruges til automatisk at måle og kvantificere muskelvolumen i MRI-scanninger af de nederste ekstremiteter. De anvendes også til nøjagtigt at vurdere muskler og fedt i lår MRI-scanninger. Derudover anvendes algoritmer til at implementere kvantitative MRI-protokoller til karakterisering af raske menneskelige lårmuskler og til at segmentere MRI-billeder og kvantificere intramuskulært fedtvæv og andre blødtværsrum. Disse fremskridt i anvendelsen af algoritmer i MRI-analyse har potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten i diagnosticering og overvågning af muskelrelaterede tilstande og sygdomme.

title: Mechanical Design Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to optimize the design and synthesis of mechanical systems called four-bar linkages. These algorithms are being used to improve various aspects of these mechanisms, such as path generation, topology optimization, and motion synthesis. By attributing agency to algorithms, scientists are able to develop novel approaches and methods for designing and optimizing these mechanical systems, ultimately leading to more efficient and effective solutions.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af algoritmer til at optimere design og syntese af mekaniske systemer kaldet fire-leds forbindelser. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af disse mekanismer, såsom sti-generering, topologi-optimering og bevægelsessyntese. Ved at tilskrive agens til algoritmer er videnskabsfolk i stand til at udvikle nye tilgange og metoder til at designe og optimere disse mekaniske systemer, hvilket i sidste ende fører til mere effektive og effektive løsninger.

title: Target Imaging Algorithms
en: Researchers are investigating various algorithms to improve the imaging of maneuvering targets using ISAR (Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar). These algorithms, such as the Product Generalized Cubic Phase Function Algorithm and the New Radar Imaging Algorithm, aim to enhance the detection and identification of targets in low SNR conditions and with complex motions. By applying these algorithms, scientists hope to achieve high-resolution ISAR imaging and eliminate high-order phase terms, ultimately improving the interpretation and imaging of maneuvering targets.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre afbildningen af manøvrerende mål ved hjælp af ISAR (Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar). Disse algoritmer, såsom Product Generalized Cubic Phase Function Algorithm og New Radar Imaging Algorithm, sigter mod at forbedre detektion og identifikation af mål under lave SNR-forhold og med komplekse bevægelser. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer håber videnskabsfolk at opnå højopløst ISAR-afbildning og eliminere høje ordens faseled, hvilket i sidste ende vil forbedre fortolkningen og afbildningen af manøvrerende mål.

title: Energy-Harvesting Optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating how algorithms can optimize transmission policies in wireless systems that use energy harvesting. These algorithms aim to maximize throughput, minimize transmission completion time, and minimize power consumption. By developing offline and online algorithms, researchers are working towards achieving close-to-optimal utility performance in energy-harvesting networks and optimizing resource allocation for wireless energy harvesting nodes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan optimere transmissionspolitikker i trådløse systemer, der bruger energi-høstning. Disse algoritmer har til formål at maksimere throughput, minimere transmissionens gennemførselstid og minimere strømforbruget. Ved at udvikle offline- og online-algoritmer arbejder forskerne hen imod at opnå en tæt på optimal nytteydelse i energi-høstningsnetværk og optimere ressourceallokering for trådløse energi-høstningsnoder.

title: Automated cervical cancer detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve the detection and classification of cervical cancer from Pap smear images. These algorithms can automate visual screening tasks, segment and classify cervical cells, and even detect cervical dysplasia. By supplementing human visual inspection with these automated methods, the accuracy and efficiency of cervical cancer screening can be significantly improved.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre detektion og klassificering af livmoderhalskræft fra Pap-testbilleder. Disse algoritmer kan automatisere visuelle screeningsopgaver, segmentere og klassificere livmoderhalsceller og endda opdage livmoderhalsdysplasi. Ved at supplere menneskelig visuel inspektion med disse automatiserede metoder kan nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af screening for livmoderhalskræft forbedres markant.

title: Enhancing MEMS Gyroscopes
en: Researchers have been investigating ways to improve the accuracy and performance of MEMS gyroscopes, which are used in various applications. They have found that algorithms, such as adaptive control algorithms and signal processing techniques, play a crucial role in enhancing the capabilities of these gyroscopes. These algorithms enable quick compensation for changes in system dynamics, improve noise reduction, reduce drift error, and enhance overall accuracy. By integrating multiple gyroscopes and using filtering algorithms based on information fusion, researchers have been able to further improve the accuracy and performance of MEMS gyroscopes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre nøjagtigheden og ydeevnen af MEMS gyroskoper, som anvendes i forskellige applikationer. De har fundet, at algoritmer, såsom adaptive kontrolalgoritmer og signalbehandlingsteknikker, spiller en afgørende rolle i at forbedre kapaciteterne for disse gyroskoper. Disse algoritmer muliggør hurtig kompensation for ændringer i systemdynamik, forbedrer støjreduktionen, reducerer driftfejl og forbedrer den overordnede nøjagtighed. Ved at integrere flere gyroskoper og bruge filtreringsalgoritmer baseret på informationsfusion har forskerne været i stand til yderligere at forbedre nøjagtigheden og ydeevnen af MEMS gyroskoper.

title: Algorithmic Resilience in Wireless
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve the performance of wireless networks in the presence of jammers. These algorithms, such as ARES and online learning-based UFH algorithm, aim to optimize anti-jamming communications and defend against smart jammers. Other approaches include using robust cutting-plane algorithms, adaptive frameworks, and probabilistic spectrum sensing to address wireless network jamming and make cognitive radio networks resilient to jamming attacks. These advancements in algorithm design are crucial in enhancing the quality of wireless communication and ensuring the security and reliability of our networks.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre ydeevnen af trådløse netværk i nærværelse af jammer. Disse algoritmer, såsom ARES og online learning-baseret UFH algoritme, har til formål at optimere anti-jamming kommunikation og forsvare sig mod smarte jammeapparater. Andre tilgange inkluderer brugen af robuste cutting-plane algoritmer, adaptive rammer og probabilistisk spektrumssensing for at tackle trådløse netværk jamning og gøre kognitive radio netværk modstandsdygtige over for jammeangreb. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritme design er afgørende for at forbedre kvaliteten af trådløs kommunikation og sikre sikkerheden og pålideligheden af vores netværk.

title: Adaptive game algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can solve complex games involving multiple players and unknown dynamics. These algorithms, implemented using neural networks, are able to learn and adapt online to find optimal solutions. By using data-driven approaches and adaptive dynamic programming, these algorithms can overcome the challenges of limited system models and constrained inputs.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan løse komplekse spil, der involverer flere spillere og ukendte dynamikker. Disse algoritmer, implementeret ved hjælp af neurale netværk, er i stand til at lære og tilpasse sig online for at finde optimale løsninger. Ved at bruge data-drevne tilgange og adaptive dynamiske programmering kan disse algoritmer overvinde udfordringerne ved begrænsede systemmodeller og begrænsede input.

title: Malware classification
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to automatically analyze and classify malware behavior. These algorithms are able to detect patterns and similarities in malware, accurately classify different types of malware, and even detect advanced and variant malware with high accuracy. By using machine learning techniques, researchers are able to improve the speed and accuracy of malware detection and categorization, making it easier to protect against malicious software.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bruges til automatisk at analysere og klassificere malwareadfærd. Disse algoritmer er i stand til at opdage mønstre og ligheder i malware, nøjagtigt klassificere forskellige typer af malware, og endda opdage avanceret og variant malware med høj nøjagtighed. Ved at bruge maskinlæringsteknikker kan forskere forbedre hastigheden og nøjagtigheden af malwaredetektion og -kategorisering, hvilket gør det lettere at beskytte mod skadelig software.

title: Secure OFDM Systems
en: Researchers have been investigating ways to enhance the security of optical OFDM systems. They have explored the use of algorithms such as chaos scrambling, permutation, controlled Logistic map, and multi-dimensional chaos to improve physical layer security and protect against chosen-plaintext attacks. These algorithms provide secure transmission, improve performance, reduce PAPR, and enhance security in OFDM-PONs. Additionally, encryption schemes that combine cellular automata, DNA encoding, and probabilistic shaping have been proposed to further enhance security in CO-OFDM systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre sikkerheden i optiske OFDM-systemer. De har udforsket brugen af algoritmer som chaos scrambling, permutation, controlled Logistic map og multi-dimensional chaos for at forbedre sikkerheden på det fysiske lag og beskytte mod chosen-plaintext attacks. Disse algoritmer muliggør sikker transmission, forbedrer ydeevnen, reducerer PAPR og øger sikkerheden i OFDM-PONs. Derudover er der foreslået krypteringsmetoder, der kombinerer cellulære automater, DNA-enkodning og probabilistic shaping for yderligere at forbedre sikkerheden i CO-OFDM-systemer.

title: Imaging optimization
en: Scientists are using algorithms to answer important questions about medical imaging techniques. They are using Monte-Carlo simulations to determine the best distribution of values for a specific imaging method. Other researchers are exploring how different factors, like diffusion gradient polarity and breathing, affect the quality of images. Algorithms are also being used to eliminate motion effects and separate different effects in the images. These studies are helping to improve the accuracy and reliability of medical imaging for diagnosing and monitoring diseases.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare vigtige spørgsmål om medicinsk billedbehandling. De anvender Monte-Carlo-simuleringer til at bestemme den bedste fordeling af værdier for en specifik billedmetode. Andre forskere undersøger, hvordan forskellige faktorer, som diffusion gradient polaritet og vejrtrækning, påvirker billedkvaliteten. Algoritmer bliver også brugt til at eliminere bevægelseseffekter og adskille forskellige effekter i billederne. Disse undersøgelser hjælper med at forbedre nøjagtigheden og pålideligheden af medicinsk billedbehandling til diagnosticering og overvågning af sygdomme.

title: Vehicle Positioning Algorithms
en: Researchers are investigating various algorithms to improve the accuracy of vehicle positioning in road safety applications and urban environments. These algorithms include DSRC infrastructure, Advanced Shared Pseudorange (ASP) method, weighted least squares double difference (WLS-DD) technique, new tight integration CP method, cooperative positioning algorithm, cooperative map matching and dynamic base station DGPS concept, blending GNSS and V2V communication, DSRC Doppler/IMU/GNSS tightly-coupled CP method, implicit cooperative positioning algorithm, Cooperative Neighboring Vehicle Positioning System (CNVPS), CoVaLID method, V2X enhanced low-cost GNSS cooperative positioning, hybrid cooperative positioning algorithm, cooperative localization method based on V2I communication and distance information, and fusion of GNSS and relative range information. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and reliability of vehicle positioning in different scenarios, such as low GPS coverage environments and VANETs.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af køretøjspositionering i vej sikkerheds applikationer og bymiljøer. Disse algoritmer inkluderer DSRC-infrastruktur, Advanced Shared Pseudorange (ASP) metode, weighted least squares double difference (WLS-DD) teknik, ny tight integration CP metode, cooperative positioning algorithm, cooperative map matching og dynamic base station DGPS koncept, sammensmeltning af GNSS og V2V kommunikation, DSRC Doppler/IMU/GNSS tightly-coupled CP metode, implicit cooperative positioning algorithm, Cooperative Neighboring Vehicle Positioning System (CNVPS), CoVaLID metode, V2X enhanced low-cost GNSS cooperative positioning, hybrid cooperative positioning algorithm, cooperative localization method baseret på V2I kommunikation og afstandsinformation, samt fusion af GNSS og relativ rækkevidde information. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og pålideligheden af køretøjspositionering i forskellige scenarier, såsom områder med lav GPS-dækning og VANETs.

title: Heat Exchanger Algorithms
en: Researchers are using algorithms to optimize the design of heat exchangers, which are devices that transfer heat between fluids. These algorithms, such as genetic algorithms and particle swarm optimization, are being used to find the best configurations of fins and other parameters in order to improve energy efficiency and reduce costs. By harnessing the power of these algorithms, scientists are able to find optimal solutions that may not have been possible through traditional design methods.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at optimere designet af varmevekslere, som er enheder, der overfører varme mellem væsker. Disse algoritmer, såsom genetiske algoritmer og particle swarm optimization, bruges til at finde de bedste konfigurationer af finner og andre parametre for at forbedre energieffektiviteten og reducere omkostningerne. Ved at udnytte kraften fra disse algoritmer er forskerne i stand til at finde optimale løsninger, som måske ikke kunne være opnået gennem traditionelle designmetoder.

title: Machine Learning in Construction
en: Researchers have been exploring how machine learning algorithms can improve various aspects of the construction industry. For example, advanced algorithms like genetic algorithms and artificial neural networks are being used to predict construction project costs and schedule success. Other algorithms, such as decision trees and support vector machines, are being employed to predict the performance of green building projects and the residual value of heavy construction equipment. These machine learning models have the potential to enhance cost estimation, risk assessment, and optimization in construction operations.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan maskinlæringsalgoritmer kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af byggebranchen. For eksempel anvendes avancerede algoritmer som genetiske algoritmer og artificial neural networks til at forudsige omkostningerne ved byggeprojekter og succes med tidsplaner. Andre algoritmer, såsom decision trees og support vector machines, bruges til at forudsige ydeevnen for grønne byggeprojekter og restværdien af tungt byggeudstyr. Disse maskinlæringsmodeller har potentiale til at forbedre omkostningsestimering, risikovurdering og optimering i byggeoperationer.

title: Railway wear prediction
en: Researchers are using algorithms to improve the accuracy of estimating wear on wheel-rail contact in railway systems. They are also developing and validating wear models for predicting wheel and rail profile evolution, as well as evaluating the impact of wheel-rail contact and dynamic forces. Algorithms implemented in MATLAB and SIMPACK are being used to simulate and predict wear and damage in railway vehicles and tracks. These advancements aim to enhance the safety and efficiency of railway systems.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forbedre nøjagtigheden af estimater for slid på kontaktpunkterne mellem hjul og skinner i jernbanesystemer. De udvikler og validerer også slidmodeller til at forudsige udviklingen af hjul- og skinneprofiler, samt vurderer påvirkningen af hjul-skinne-kontakt og dynamiske kræfter. Algoritmer implementeret i MATLAB og SIMPACK bruges til at simulere og forudsige slid og skader i jernbanevogne og spor. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre sikkerheden og effektiviteten i jernbanesystemer.

title: Robotic calibration algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to address the question of how to calibrate the kinematic parameters of industrial robots. These algorithms are designed to optimize measurement configurations, select optimal measurement poses, and improve the accuracy and robustness of calibration. The algorithms utilize techniques such as least squares, iterative algorithms, product-of-exponential formula, quadratic programming, and particle swarm optimization to achieve accurate and efficient calibration of the robots.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at tage fat på spørgsmålet om, hvordan man kalibrerer de kinematiske parametre for industrielle robotter. Disse algoritmer er designet til at optimere målekonfigurationer, vælge optimale målepositioner og forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af kalibreringen. Algoritmerne anvender teknikker såsom least squares, iterative algorithms, product-of-exponential formula, quadratic programming og particle swarm optimization for at opnå en nøjagtig og effektiv kalibrering af robotterne.

title: Optimizing Potential Field Methods
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the traditional artificial potential field method for mobile robot path planning. They have proposed various algorithms, such as the trust region algorithm, new potential functions, and random force based algorithms, to optimize the path planning process. These algorithms aim to address challenges like deadlock, local minima, oscillation, and obstacle avoidance in both known and unknown environments.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre den traditionelle artificial potential field metode til ruteplanlægning for mobile robotter. De har foreslået forskellige algoritmer, såsom trust region algorithm, nye potentialfunktioner og random force based algorithms, for at optimere ruteplanlægningsprocessen. Disse algoritmer har til formål at tackle udfordringer som deadlock, lokale minima, oscillation og forhindringsundgåelse i både kendte og ukendte miljøer.

title: Tactile material recognition
en: Scientists have been exploring the capabilities of machine learning algorithms in distinguishing between different materials based on their surface texture. These algorithms are being used to extract relevant tactile features for object identification, interpret cutaneous information from biomimetic tactile sensors, enhance tactile sensing systems, discriminate surface roughness, recognize materials based on tactile data, and classify surface textures. The integration of machine learning algorithms with various tactile sensors and data processing techniques is enabling accurate material identification and texture recognition.
da: Forskere har undersøgt mulighederne for machine learning-algoritmer til at skelne mellem forskellige materialer baseret på deres overfladetextur. Disse algoritmer bliver anvendt til at udtrække relevante taktile træk til objektidentifikation, fortolke kutan information fra biomimetiske taktile sensorer, forbedre taktile sensorsystemer, diskriminere overflade ruhed, genkende materialer baseret på taktile data og klassificere overfladetexturer. Integrationen af machine learning-algoritmer med forskellige taktile sensorer og databehandlingsteknikker muliggør præcis materialeidentifikation og teksturognerkendelse.

title: Transport Resilience
en: Algorithms are being used to evaluate, analyze, and optimize the resilience and friability of transportation networks. They are also being used to optimize resource allocation in vulnerable transportation networks, quantify capacity uncertainty and assess resilience in urban road networks, and prioritize the restoration of multiple facility, multiple-hazard road networks. Additionally, algorithms are being used to assess and optimize the resilience of urban rail transit networks, plan transportation network recovery based on resilience, and quantify and optimize the resilience of transit infrastructure under systemic risks.
da: Algoritmer bruges til at evaluere, analysere og optimere modstandsdygtigheden og skrøbeligheden af transportnetværk. De bruges også til at optimere ressourcefordelingen i sårbare transportnetværk, kvantificere kapacitetsusikkerhed og vurdere modstandsdygtighed i byvejsnetværk samt prioritere genopretningen af netværk med flere faciliteter og flere risici. Derudover bruges algoritmer til at vurdere og optimere modstandsdygtigheden af bymæssige jernbanetransportnetværk, planlægge genopretning af transportnetværk baseret på modstandsdygtighed og kvantificere og optimere modstandsdygtigheden af transitinfrastruktur under systemiske risici.

title: Hyperspectral target detection
en: A set of scientific abstracts analyzed the use of algorithms to improve target detection in hyperspectral imagery. The algorithms proposed in the studies consistently outperformed existing methods, demonstrating superior detection performance and promising applications for target detection. These findings suggest that algorithms can significantly enhance the accuracy and efficiency of target detection in hyperspectral images.
da: Et sæt af videnskabelige abstracts analyserede brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre målregistrering i hyperspektrale billeder. De algoritmer, der blev foreslået i studierne, overgik konsekvent eksisterende metoder og demonstrerede overlegen registreringsydelse samt lovende anvendelser til målregistrering. Disse resultater tyder på, at algoritmer betydeligt kan forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af målregistrering i hyperspektrale billeder.

title: Optimizing facility location
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to address different challenges in competitive facility location problems. These algorithms, such as heuristic algorithms, branch-and-bound algorithms, Lagrangian relaxation, and evolutionary algorithms, play a crucial role in optimizing market share, solving location and pricing problems, estimating the Pareto front, and finding optimal solutions. By leveraging the power of these algorithms, researchers aim to improve decision-making processes and maximize efficiency in facility location planning.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at tackle forskellige udfordringer i konkurrencedygtige anlægsplaceringproblemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom heuristic algorithms, branch-and-bound algorithms, Lagrangian relaxation, og evolutionary algorithms, spiller en afgørende rolle i optimering af markedsandele, løsning af placering- og prisproblemer, estimering af Pareto-fronten, og find af optimale løsninger. Ved at udnytte kraften fra disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre beslutningsprocesserne og maksimere effektiviteten i planlægning af anlægsplacering.

title: Algorithmic software management
en: Researchers have explored various algorithms to improve software project management and estimation. These algorithms include grey relational analysis, cluster analysis, classification methods, ensemble estimation methods, leave-one-out validation, tabu search, support vector regression, machine learning algorithms, and genetic algorithms. The goal is to achieve better accuracy and stability in software effort estimation, as well as to address the impact of data quality on prediction. These findings highlight the potential of using algorithms to enhance software development processes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre ledelsen og estimeringen af softwareprojekter. Disse algoritmer inkluderer grey relational analysis, cluster analysis, classification methods, ensemble estimation methods, leave-one-out validation, tabu search, support vector regression, machine learning algorithms og genetic algorithms. Målet er at opnå bedre nøjagtighed og stabilitet i estimatet af softwareindsats samt at tage højde for data kvalitetens indvirkning på forudsigelse. Disse resultater fremhæver potentialet ved at anvende algoritmer til at forbedre softwareudviklingsprocesser.

title: Algorithmic Insights into Batteries
en: Researchers are using algorithms to answer various questions about lithium-ion batteries. These questions include determining the equivalent circuit model parameters of the batteries and how they vary with temperature and state of charge, modeling the dynamic electric characteristics of the batteries for state estimation, and comparing different equivalent circuit models for accuracy and robustness. Algorithms are also being used to estimate the electrochemical parameters of the batteries, develop simplified models, estimate the state of charge, and analyze battery degradation and aging. These algorithms help improve the understanding and performance of lithium-ion batteries.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare forskellige spørgsmål om lithium-ion batterier. Disse spørgsmål inkluderer at bestemme de ækvivalente kredsløbsmodelparametre for batterierne og hvordan de varierer med temperatur og ladetilstand, modellere de dynamiske elektriske egenskaber af batterierne til tilstandsestimering, og sammenligne forskellige ækvivalente kredsløbsmodeller for nøjagtighed og robusthed. Algoritmer bruges også til at estimere de elektrokemiske parametre af batterierne, udvikle forenklede modeller, estimere ladetilstanden, og analysere batterinedbrydning og aldring. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at forbedre forståelsen og ydeevnen af lithium-ion batterier.

title: Saliency algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve the detection of salient objects in images. These algorithms are used to calculate saliency measures, enhance key regions, evaluate saliency measures, connect salient edges, segment images, and detect saliency maps. By combining different features and priors, these algorithms aim to achieve higher accuracy, precision, and recall rates in salient object detection.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre detektion af saliente objekter i billeder. Disse algoritmer bruges til at beregne saliency-mål, forbedre nøgleområder, evaluere saliency-mål, forbinde saliente kanter, segmentere billeder og detektere saliency-kort. Ved at kombinere forskellige funktioner og priorer sigter disse algoritmer mod at opnå højere nøjagtighed, præcision og recall-rater i detektion af saliente objekter.

title: Glaucoma diagnosis
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to accurately diagnose and classify glaucoma. They have investigated various features and techniques, such as texture analysis, wavelet features, grayscale features, histogram features, Gabor transformation, and optical coherence tomography (OCT) images. These algorithms, including support vector machines, random forests, and naive Bayes classifiers, have shown potential in detecting glaucoma at different stages. By leveraging machine learning and image analysis, these algorithms could improve the accuracy of glaucoma diagnosis and help in early detection.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af algoritmer til præcist at diagnosticere og klassificere glaukom. De har undersøgt forskellige funktioner og teknikker, såsom teksturanalyse, wavelet-funktioner, gråtoner, histogramfunktioner, Gabor-transformation og optisk kohærens tomografi (OCT) billeder. Disse algoritmer, herunder support vector machines, random forests og naive Bayes-klassifikatorer, har vist potentiale i at opdage glaukom i forskellige stadier. Ved at udnytte machine learning og billedeanalyse kan disse algoritmer forbedre nøjagtigheden af glaukomdiagnosen og hjælpe med tidlig opdagelse.

title: Video surveillance analysis
en: Researchers are using algorithms to automatically detect motion patterns and events in video surveillance, as well as to detect abnormal events without individual object tracking. These algorithms analyze motion information and utilize techniques like semi-unsupervised learning and latent Dirichlet allocation. They are also being used to mine motion patterns in crowded scenes, detect abnormal crowd behavior, analyze crowd behavior using discriminative models, and detect abnormal events in real-time. These algorithms play a crucial role in understanding and monitoring crowd behavior in various environments.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til automatisk at opdage bevægelsesmønstre og begivenheder i videoovervågning, samt til at detectere unormale hændelser uden individuel objektsporing. Disse algoritmer analyserer bevægelsesinformation og bruger teknikker som semi-tilsyneladende læring og latent Dirichlet allocation. De bruges også til at udvinde bevægelsesmønstre i tætpakkede scener, detectere unormalt adfærd blandt mennesker i grupper, analysere menneskemængdeadfærd ved hjælp af diskriminerende modeller, og detectere unormale begivenheder i realtid. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i forståelsen og overvågningen af menneskemængdeadfærd i forskellige miljøer.

title: Rotating Machine Faults
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to identify and diagnose faults in rotating machines, specifically in cracked rotors. These algorithms use vibration signals, controller current of active magnetic bearings, and other data to detect and quantify parameters such as crack depth, stiffness, unbalance, misalignment, and damping. By analyzing the mode shapes, eigen frequencies, and full spectrum of the rotor system, these algorithms provide a comprehensive approach to fault identification and assessment.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at identificere og diagnosticere fejl i roterende maskiner, specifikt i revnede rotorer. Disse algoritmer anvender vibrationssignaler, kontrolstrøm fra aktive magnetiske lejer og andre data til at registrere og kvantificere parametre som revnedybde, stivhed, ubalance, forkert justering og dæmpning. Ved at analysere modeformer, egenfrekvenser og det fulde spektrum af rotorsystemet tilbyder disse algoritmer en omfattende tilgang til fejlfinding og vurdering.

title: Algorithmic Agency in Sensor Networks
en: Researchers have been investigating various algorithms to improve the efficiency and performance of wireless sensor networks. These algorithms aim to address challenges such as prolonging network lifetime, reducing discovery delay, improving energy efficiency, and optimizing neighbor discovery. By dynamically adjusting nodes' behavior, optimizing weight of nodes, reducing processing time, integrating neighbor discovery with link quality estimation, and selecting suitable replacements, these algorithms attribute agency to themselves in achieving these goals. Overall, these algorithms show promise in enhancing the functionality and effectiveness of wireless sensor networks.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af trådløse sensornetværk. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at tackle udfordringer som at forlænge netværkets levetid, reducere opdagelsesforsinkelse, forbedre energieffektiviteten og optimere naboopdagelse. Ved dynamisk at justere noderne opførsel, optimere vægten af noderne, reducere behandlingstid, integrere naboopdagelse med linkkvalitets vurdering og vælge passende erstatninger, tillægger disse algoritmer sig selv beføjelse til at opnå disse mål. Samlet set viser disse algoritmer lovende resultater i at forbedre funktionaliteten og effektiviteten af trådløse sensornetværk.

title: Enhancing Artificial Limbs
en: Researchers are using algorithms to improve the control of artificial limbs based on pattern recognition. They are investigating questions such as the optimal window length for pattern recognition-based control, the difference in performance between different control strategies, and how to achieve simultaneous and proportional control. Algorithms are also being used to develop and test movement recognition and force control algorithms, as well as to improve the robustness and dexterity of myoelectric prostheses. Overall, these studies aim to enhance the functionality and performance of artificial limbs for individuals with limb loss.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forbedre kontrollen af kunstige lemmer baseret på mønstergenkendelse. De undersøger spørgsmål som den optimale vindueslængde for mønstergenkendelsesbaseret kontrol, forskellen i ydeevne mellem forskellige kontrolstrategier, og hvordan man opnår samtidig og proportional kontrol. Algoritmer bruges også til at udvikle og teste bevægelsesgenkendelse og kraftkontrol algoritmer, samt til at forbedre robustheden og fingerfærdigheden af myoelektriske proteser. Samlet set sigter disse studier mod at forbedre funktionaliteten og ydeevnen af kunstige lemmer for personer med lemtab.

title: Automotive algorithm optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating various methods for optimizing different aspects of automotive systems using algorithms. These algorithms are designed to address specific research questions, such as optimizing network parameters, scheduling real-time applications, addressing security and safety constraints, and improving communication reliability. The goal is to improve the performance, efficiency, and reliability of automotive systems while considering various constraints and requirements.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige metoder til at optimere forskellige aspekter af automotive systemer ved hjælp af algoritmer. Disse algoritmer er designet til at adressere specifikke forskningsspørgsmål, såsom optimering af netværksparametre, planlægning af realtidsapplikationer, håndtering af sikkerheds- og tryghedskrav samt forbedring af kommunikationspålidelighed. Målet er at forbedre ydeevnen, effektiviteten og pålideligheden af automotive systemer, mens der tages hensyn til forskellige begrænsninger og krav.

title: State Estimation Algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the accuracy and efficiency of state estimation in distribution systems. These algorithms utilize real-time measurements, synchronized phasor measurements, pseudo-measurements, and even customers' energy bills to estimate the state of the system. By incorporating these algorithms, it is possible to identify unexpected power injections, support coordinated voltage control strategies, monitor low-voltage distribution grids, and analyze power flows in distribution grids. These advancements in state estimation algorithms contribute to the development of smart distribution networks and improve the overall performance and reliability of the grid.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af tilstandsestimation i distributionssystemer. Disse algoritmer anvender realtidsmålinger, synkroniserede phasormålinger, pseudo-målinger og endda kundernes energiregninger til at estimere systemets tilstand. Ved at indarbejde disse algoritmer er det muligt at identificere uventede kraftindsprøjtninger, støtte koordinerede spændingskontrolstrategier, overvåge lavspændings distributionsnet og analysere effektstrømme i distributionsnet. Disse fremskridt inden for tilstandsestimeringsalgoritmer bidrager til udviklingen af smarte distributionsnet og forbedrer den overordnede ydeevne og pålidelighed af nettet.

title: Spatial audio processing
en: Researchers have been exploring how to improve the accuracy of source localization using spherical microphone arrays. They have developed algorithms such as the Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) algorithm to calculate spatial spectra. Additionally, these arrays have been used for speech enhancement in noisy and reverberant environments, with algorithms designed to maximize speech intelligibility while minimizing noise power. Other studies have focused on using optimal array processing methods for room acoustics analysis, achieving noise reduction and dereverberation, localizing mixed far-field and near-field acoustic sources, and localizing wideband acoustic sources using multiple spherical arrays. These advancements in algorithmic techniques are helping to enhance the capabilities of spherical microphone arrays in various applications.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan man kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af kildeplacering ved hjælp af sphærisk mikrofonarrays. De har udviklet algoritmer såsom Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) algoritmen til at beregne rumlige spektre. Derudover er disse arrays blevet brugt til taleenhancement i støjende og efterklangende miljøer, med algoritmer designet til at maksimere taleintelligibilitet samtidig med at minimere støjkraft. Andre studier har fokuseret på at anvende optimale array-behandlingsmetoder til rummets akustikanalyse, opnå støjreduktion og dereverberation, lokalisere blandede langt-felt og nær-felt akustiske kilder samt lokalisere bredbånds akustiske kilder ved hjælp af flere sphæriske arrays. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmiske teknikker hjælper med at forbedre kapaciteterne af sphærisk mikrofonarrays i forskellige anvendelser.

title: Routing Algorithms Efficiency
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the energy efficiency of wireless sensor networks. They have developed algorithms such as EERMA, artificial bee colony, ant colony optimization, and others to optimize routing and clustering in these networks. These algorithms use computational intelligence and swarm intelligence approaches to enhance energy utilization and extend the network lifetime.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre energieffektiviteten af trådløse sensornetværk. De har udviklet algoritmer som EERMA, artificial bee colony, ant colony optimization og andre for at optimere routing og clustering i disse netværk. Disse algoritmer bruger computational intelligence og swarm intelligence tilgange for at forbedre energiforbruget og forlænge netværkets levetid.

title: Algorithmic Flame Analysis
en: Scientists are using algorithms to answer questions about combustion and flame behavior. These algorithms analyze data and calculate parameters such as flame surface density, turbulent flame thickness, and laminar burning velocity. They also enhance images and measure flame height, track flame annihilation events, and analyze flow fields and ignition characteristics. By using these algorithms, researchers are gaining a better understanding of how flames behave and how to improve combustion processes.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare spørgsmål om forbrænding og flammeadfærd. Disse algoritmer analyserer data og beregner parametre såsom flammeoverfladetæthed, turbulent flammediameter og laminær forbrændingshastighed. De forbedrer også billeder og måler flammehøjde, følger flammens annulleringsbegivenheder og analyserer strømningsfelter og tændingskarakteristika. Ved at bruge disse algoritmer får forskerne en bedre forståelse af, hvordan flammer opfører sig, og hvordan man kan forbedre forbrændingsprocesser.

title: Gearbox fault diagnosis
en: Researchers have been investigating various methods for assessing the health and diagnosing faults in gearboxes. These studies have found that algorithms play a crucial role in signal processing, feature extraction, and fault diagnosis. By using algorithms such as adaptive filtering techniques, Hilbert-Huang transform, and time-frequency analysis, researchers are able to extract fault features from vibration measurements and accurately monitor the condition of gearboxes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige metoder til vurdering af sundhedstilstanden og diagnosticering af fejl i gearkasser. Disse studier har fundet, at algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i signalbehandling, funktionsudtrækning og fejldiagnose. Ved at bruge algoritmer som adaptive filtreringsteknikker, Hilbert-Huang transformation og tid-frekvens analyse, er forskerne i stand til at udtrække fejlkarakteristika fra vibrationsmålinger og præcist overvåge tilstanden af gearkasser.

title: Bee-inspired optimization
en: The Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm is a powerful optimization technique that can efficiently solve various problems in power systems. It is proven to be effective in solving optimal power flow (OPF) problems, economic load dispatch (ELD) problems, and other optimization problems. The ABC algorithm provides accurate solutions, improves solution quality, and achieves lower costs and losses compared to other methods.
da: Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algoritmen er en kraftfuld optimeringsteknik, der effektivt kan løse forskellige problemer i elkraftsystemer. Det er bevist, at den er effektiv til at løse optimale kraftflow (OPF) problemer, økonomisk belastningsfordeling (ELD) problemer og andre optimeringsproblemer. ABC algoritmen giver præcise løsninger, forbedrer løsningskvaliteten og opnår lavere omkostninger og tab sammenlignet med andre metoder.

title: Algorithmic Soil Prediction
en: Researchers have investigated the use of various algorithms to accurately predict different soil properties and behaviors. For example, genetic-based neural network (GBNN) models have been found to have higher accuracy in predicting the Soil Water Characteristic Curve (SWCC) compared to genetic programming (GP) models. Similarly, evolutionary polynomial regression (EPR) models have shown better performance in predicting the volume change behavior of soils compared to conventional material models. These findings suggest that algorithms can play a crucial role in improving our understanding and prediction of soil properties and behaviors.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af forskellige algoritmer for nøjagtigt at forudsige forskellige jordegenskaber og -adfærd. For eksempel er det blevet fundet, at genetic-based neural network (GBNN) modeller har en højere nøjagtighed i forudsigelsen af Soil Water Characteristic Curve (SWCC) sammenlignet med genetic programming (GP) modeller. Tilsvarende har evolutionary polynomial regression (EPR) modeller vist bedre ydeevne i forudsigelsen af volumenændringsadfærden hos jorde sammenlignet med konventionelle materialemodeller. Disse fund antyder, at algoritmer kan spille en afgørende rolle i at forbedre vores forståelse og forudsigelse af jordegenskaber og -adfærd.

title: Action recognition algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve human action recognition. These algorithms, such as Nearest Neighbor, AdaBoost, and Support-Vector Machine, aim to integrate multiple features, efficiently represent local descriptors, utilize spatial-temporal interest points, enhance motion-feature representation, and combine global dynamics with local appearance. By utilizing these algorithms, scientists hope to enhance the accuracy and robustness of action recognition systems.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre genkendelsen af menneskelige handlinger. Disse algoritmer, såsom Nearest Neighbor, AdaBoost og Support-Vector Machine, har til formål at integrere flere funktioner, effektivt repræsentere lokale descriptorer, udnytte rum-tidlige interessepunkter, forbedre repræsentationen af bevægelsesfunktioner og kombinere globale dynamikker med lokal udseende. Ved at udnytte disse algoritmer håber forskerne at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af handlingsgenkendelsessystemer.

title: Visual Quality Assessment
en: Researchers are addressing various challenges in evaluating the visual quality of 3D synthesized views. They are using algorithms to identify the impact of artifacts on visual quality, proposing new objective measures, and developing metrics that better align with human judgment. These advancements aim to improve the assessment of multi-scale synthesized view, perceptual quality of synthesized video, and the quality of DIBR-synthesized images and videos. The goal is to refine depth maps, reduce artifacts, measure local and global distortions, and assess quality based on structural and textural distortion, visual saliency, and texture naturalness.
da: Forskere arbejder på forskellige udfordringer i evalueringen af den visuelle kvalitet af 3D-syntetiserede billeder. De bruger algoritmer til at identificere indflydelsen af artefakter på den visuelle kvalitet, foreslår nye objektive målinger og udvikler metrikker, der bedre stemmer overens med menneskelig vurdering. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre vurderingen af multi-scale syntetiserede billeder, den perceptuelle kvalitet af syntetiseret video og kvaliteten af DIBR-syntetiserede billeder og videoer. Målet er at forfine dybdekort, reducere artefakter, måle lokale og globale forvrængninger og vurdere kvalitet baseret på strukturel og teksturel forvrængning, visuel saliens og teksturens naturlighed.

title: Image Retrieval Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve the efficiency and accuracy of content-based medical image retrieval. These algorithms, such as the Cbmir algorithm, BoW representations, and distance metric learning algorithms, are designed to combine different types of information, such as shape, texture, and resolution, to enhance the retrieval process. By using these algorithms, researchers aim to make it easier for medical professionals to find and analyze specific images related to different diseases and conditions.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af indholdsbaseret medicinsk billede retrieval. Disse algoritmer, såsom Cbmir algoritmen, BoW repræsentationer og distance metric learning algoritmer, er designet til at kombinere forskellige typer information, såsom form, tekstur og opløsning, for at forbedre retrieval processen. Ved at bruge disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at gøre det lettere for medicinske fagfolk at finde og analysere specifikke billeder relateret til forskellige sygdomme og tilstande.

title: Efficient EV charging
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve the efficiency and performance of battery charging power converters for electric vehicles. These algorithms enable high efficiency, power loss reduction, and economic utilization of the grid. They also facilitate state-of-charge balancing, fault-tolerant control, and the integration of high-power density chargers into electric vehicles. Additionally, the algorithms improve grid power quality and enable grid-tied charging, PV-tied charging, and regenerative braking.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af batteriopladningskraftomformere til elektriske køretøjer. Disse algoritmer muliggør høj effektivitet, reduktion af energitab og økonomisk udnyttelse af elnettet. De letter også afbalancering af ladetilstand, fejltolerant kontrol og integration af højeffektivitetsladere i elektriske køretøjer. Desuden forbedrer algoritmerne elnettes strømkvalitet og muliggør nettilsluttet opladning, PV-tilsluttet opladning og regenerativ bremsning.

title: Fruit quality prediction
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to determine the internal quality of fruits and detect their soluble solid content. They have used techniques such as visible and near-infrared spectroscopy, hyperspectral imaging, and NIR transmittance spectroscopy, combined with algorithms like partial least squares (PLS), support vector machines (SVM), and genetic algorithms (GA). These methods show promise in accurately predicting the quality attributes of fruits without the need for destructive testing.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at bestemme den indre kvalitet af frugter og opdage deres opløselige faststofindhold. De har anvendt teknikker såsom synlig og nær-infrarød spektroskopi, hyperspektral billeddannelse og NIR transmittans spektroskopi, kombineret med algoritmer som partial least squares (PLS), support vector machines (SVM) og genetic algorithms (GA). Disse metoder viser lovende resultater i nøjagtigt at forudsige kvalitetsattributterne af frugter uden behov for destruktiv testning.

title: Anomaly Detection Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to detect outliers and faulty readings in wireless sensor networks. These algorithms aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of outlier detection, while also distinguishing between errors and important events. Some of the proposed approaches include distributed agglomerative cluster based anomaly detection, knowledge discovery with outlier detection and data clustering, and density-based clustering. These advancements in algorithmic techniques have the potential to enhance the performance and energy efficiency of wireless sensor networks.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer til at opdage outliers og fejlbehæftede aflæsninger i trådløse sensornetværk. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af outlier detection, samtidig med at de adskiller mellem fejl og vigtige begivenheder. Nogle af de foreslåede tilgange inkluderer distributed agglomerative cluster based anomaly detection, knowledge discovery with outlier detection og data clustering, samt density-based clustering. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmiske teknikker har potentiale til at forbedre ydeevnen og energibevarelsen i trådløse sensornetværk.

title: ADC Calibration Algorithms
en: A set of scientific papers explores different methods to calibrate and correct errors in time-interleaved analog-to-digital converters (ADCs). These papers propose various algorithms that can be used to address different types of mismatches, such as frequency response, channel, linear and nonlinear errors, timing, gain, offset, and skew errors. The algorithms mentioned include adaptive calibration filters, least-mean square algorithms, Fast Fourier Transform Algorithm (FFT), Lagrange interpolator, correlation-based algorithms, and many others. These algorithms aim to improve the accuracy and performance of ADCs by reducing errors and ensuring effective calibration.
da: Et sæt af videnskabelige artikler undersøger forskellige metoder til at kalibrere og korrigere fejl i tidsinterleaved analog-til-digital omformere (ADCs). Disse artikler foreslår forskellige algoritmer, der kan anvendes til at håndtere forskellige typer uoverensstemmelser, såsom frekvensrespons, kanaler, lineære og ikke-lineære fejl, timing, forstærkning, offset og skew-fejl. De nævnte algoritmer inkluderer adaptive kalibreringsfiltre, least-mean square algoritmer, Fast Fourier Transform Algorithm (FFT), Lagrange interpolator, korrelationsbaserede algoritmer og mange andre. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og ydeevnen af ADC'er ved at reducere fejl og sikre effektiv kalibrering.

title: Hybrid Energy System Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring various questions related to optimizing energy systems using algorithms. For example, they have developed optimization algorithms to design hybrid photovoltaic and trigeneration power systems, multi-objective optimization models to optimize district heating systems with heat storage tanks, and mixed integer linear programming models to determine the optimal energy production system for industrial areas. These algorithms play a crucial role in finding the most efficient and cost-effective solutions for energy management and can contribute to the development of sustainable and environmentally friendly energy systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige spørgsmål relateret til optimering af energisystemer ved hjælp af algoritmer. For eksempel har de udviklet optimeringsalgoritmer til at designe hybride fotovoltaiske og trigeneration kraftsystemer, multi-objective optimization models til at optimere fjernvarmesystemer med varmeakkumuleringsbeholdere, og mixed integer linear programming models til at bestemme det optimale energiproduktionssystem for industrielle områder. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at finde de mest effektive og omkostningseffektive løsninger til energistyring og kan bidrage til udviklingen af bæredygtige og miljøvenlige energisystemer.

title: Harmonic Reduction Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the performance of multilevel inverters and reduce harmonic distortions. They have been using algorithms, such as genetic algorithms and particle swarm optimization, to optimize the switching angles and minimize total harmonic distortion (THD). These algorithms are able to find the optimal solutions and achieve selective harmonic elimination in multilevel inverters with reduced switches.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af multilevel inverters og reducere harmoniske forvrængninger. De har anvendt algoritmer som genetiske algoritmer og particle swarm optimization til at optimere skifte vinklerne og minimere total harmonisk forvrængning (THD). Disse algoritmer er i stand til at finde de optimale løsninger og opnå selektiv harmonisk eliminering i multilevel inverters med reducerede kontakter.

title: Voice disorder detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to detect and classify voice disorders.
