Convolutional neural networks can achieve state-of-the-art results in fingerprint liveness detection, while deep neural networks show high performance and robustness in classifying low-quality fingerprints. Additionally, convolutional neural networks have been shown to improve the accuracy and robustness of fingerprint classification, and can also be used for fingerprint matching in biometric authentication. These findings highlight the positive impact of algorithms in enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of fingerprint analysis and recognition.
da: Kunstige neurale netværk har vist sig at forbedre genkendelsesraten for fingeraftryksgenkendelsessystemer, især under lavkvalitetsforhold. Convolutional neural networks kan opnå state-of-the-art resultater i fingeraftryksliveness-detektion, mens deep neural networks viser høj ydeevne og robusthed i klassificering af lavkvalitets fingeraftryk. Derudover har convolutional neural networks vist sig at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af fingeraftryksklassificering, og kan også anvendes til fingeraftryksmatching i biometrisk autentificering. Disse resultater fremhæver den positive indflydelse af algoritmer på at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af fingeraftryksanalyse og -genkendelse.

title: Enhancing NOMA Systems
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the performance of grant-free non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) systems. They are investigating various algorithms, such as those based on compressive sensing and adaptive methods, to achieve joint user activity and data detection, multi-user detection, channel estimation, and low-complexity detection in these systems. These algorithms aim to enhance the efficiency and reliability of uplink communication in NOMA systems, which could have implications for applications like massive Internet of Things (IoT) access.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre ydeevnen af grant-free non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) systemer. De undersøger forskellige algoritmer, såsom dem der er baseret på compressive sensing og adaptive metoder, for at opnå fælles brugeraktivitet og datadetektion, multi-user detection, kanalestimering og lavkompleksitetsdetektion i disse systemer. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at forbedre effektiviteten og pålideligheden af uplink kommunikation i NOMA-systemer, hvilket kan have betydning for anvendelser som massiv Internet of Things (IoT) adgang.

title: Deep Learning Optimization
en: Researchers are exploring how convolutional neural networks, temporal-CNN architecture, deep features obtained from pretrained convolutional neural networks, low complexity CNNs, enhanced deep convolutional neural networks, deep neural networks, ViSTRA2, neural video coding, a deep learning accelerator, compound spatiotemporal representation, the BVI-DVC database, FastRWDnet, an additive 3D-CNN model, compressed video analysis, and deep learning techniques can improve various aspects of video quality and compression. These algorithms are being investigated for their potential to enhance spatial resolution, reduce artifacts, improve video coding efficiency, denoise videos, predict inter-frame residuals, and enhance the quality of decoded frames, among other applications. The goal is to leverage the power of artificial intelligence to enhance the viewing experience and optimize video compression standards.
da: Forskere udforsker, hvordan convolutional neural networks, temporal-CNN arkitektur, dybe funktioner opnået fra forudtrænede convolutional neural networks, lav kompleksitet CNNs, forbedrede dybe convolutional neural networks, dybe neurale netværk, ViSTRA2, neural video coding, en deep learning accelerator, compound spatiotemporal representation, BVI-DVC databasen, FastRWDnet, en additiv 3D-CNN model, komprimeret videoanalyse og deep learning teknikker kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af video kvalitet og komprimering. Disse algoritmer undersøges for deres potentiale til at forbedre spatial opløsning, reducere artefakter, forbedre video coding effektivitet, fjerne støj fra videoer, forudsige inter-frame residuals og forbedre kvaliteten af dekodede rammer, blandt andre anvendelser. Målet er at udnytte kraften fra kunstig intelligens til at forbedre seeroplevelsen og optimere video kompressionsstandarder.

title: Light-field enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the capabilities of light-field cameras, which capture more information about a scene than traditional cameras. They are developing algorithms that can estimate depth, remove reflections, handle occlusion, and enhance the quality of images captured by these cameras. These algorithms aim to make light-field cameras more efficient, accurate, and capable of producing high-quality images.
da: Forskere undersøger muligheder for at forbedre kapabiliteterne for lysfeltkameraer, som fanger mere information om en scene end traditionelle kameraer. De udvikler algoritmer, der kan estimere dybde, fjerne refleksioner, håndtere til occlusion og forbedre kvaliteten af de billeder, der fanges af disse kameraer. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at gøre lysfeltkameraer mere effektive, præcise og i stand til at producere høj-kvalitets billeder.

title: Food image analysis
en: Researchers have been exploring the capabilities of algorithms in recognizing and analyzing food images. They have found that deep convolutional neural networks, image processing, computational intelligence, and deep learning algorithms can accurately identify dish types, food ingredients, cooking methods, and even estimate nutrient content and calorie values. These algorithms have the potential to be used in dietary assessment, food category recognition, and other food analysis applications.
da: Forskere har udforsket algoritmers evner til at genkende og analysere madbilleder. De har fundet ud af, at dybe konvolutionsneurale netværk, billedbehandling, computervidenskab og dybe læringsalgoritmer kan identificere retter, madingredienser, tilberedningsmetoder og endda estimere næringsindhold og kalorieindhold med præcision. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at blive brugt i kostvurdering, genkendelse af madkategorier og andre madanalyseapplikationer.

title: FANET algorithm optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating ways to improve the performance of flying ad hoc networks (FANETs) using various algorithms. For example, the predictive OLSR (P-OLSR) algorithm has been found to outperform the traditional OLSR algorithm in routing with frequent network topology changes. Other algorithms, such as particle swarm optimization and fuzzy logic, have been used to optimize topology management and improve routing efficiency in FANETs. These advancements in algorithmic techniques aim to enhance energy efficiency, quality of service, data dissemination, and overall communication in FANETs, particularly in disaster response operations.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af flyvende ad hoc netværk (FANETs) ved hjælp af forskellige algoritmer. For eksempel er den prædiktive OLSR (P-OLSR) algoritme blevet fundet at overgå den traditionelle OLSR algoritme i routing ved hyppige ændringer af netværkstopologien. Andre algoritmer, såsom particle swarm optimization og fuzzy logic, er blevet brugt til at optimere topologimanagement og forbedre routingeffektiviteten i FANETs. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmiske teknikker har til formål at forbedre energieffektivitet, tjenestekvalitet, datadissseminering og den overordnede kommunikation i FANETs, især i katastrofeberedskabsoperationer.

title: Vehicle State Estimation
en: Researchers have been investigating various algorithms to improve the accuracy and robustness of vehicle state estimation. These algorithms, such as the Extended Kalman Filter and the Unscented Kalman Filter, are being used to estimate parameters like sideslip angle, yaw rate, and steering angle. By combining different filters and adapting them to unknown noise conditions, these algorithms aim to provide more accurate and stable vehicle state estimation, even in high-speed driving environments.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af fordonstilstandsevaluering. Disse algoritmer, såsom Extended Kalman Filter og Unscented Kalman Filter, bruges til at estimere parametre som sideslipvinkel, yaw rate og styrevinkel. Ved at kombinere forskellige filtre og tilpasse dem til ukendte støjforhold, har disse algoritmer til formål at give en mere præcis og stabil fordonstilstandsevaluering, selv i højhastighedskørselsmiljøer.

title: RNA-Protein Interactions
en: Scientists have developed various computational methods to accurately predict interactions between long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) and proteins. These methods, such as LPBNI and PLPIHS, utilize algorithms that outperform existing approaches in predicting these interactions. By leveraging the power of machine learning and network analysis, these algorithms provide valuable insights into the functions and associations of lncRNAs, contributing to our understanding of complex biological processes.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige computermetoder til nøjagtigt at forudsige interaktioner mellem lange non-coding RNA (lncRNA) og proteiner. Disse metoder, såsom LPBNI og PLPIHS, anvender algoritmer, der overgår eksisterende tilgange i forudsigelsen af disse interaktioner. Ved at udnytte styrken af maskinlæring og netværksanalyse giver disse algoritmer værdifuld indsigt i funktionerne og forbindelserne af lncRNA'er, hvilket bidrager til vores forståelse af komplekse biologiske processer.

title: Design Reliability Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the efficiency and reliability of algorithms used in design optimization and reliability analysis. They are using techniques such as adaptive chaos control, particle swarm optimization, stability transformation methods, and enhanced chaos control methods. These algorithms aim to overcome numerical instabilities, reduce non-convergence problems, achieve stable estimation of constraints, and enhance the overall performance of the algorithms. The goal is to develop more efficient and robust algorithms for various applications, including structural reliability analysis and design optimization.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre effektiviteten og pålideligheden af algoritmer, der anvendes i designoptimering og pålidelighedsanalyse. De bruger teknikker som adaptive chaos control, particle swarm optimization, stability transformation methods og enhanced chaos control methods. Disse algoritmer har til formål at overvinde numeriske usikkerheder, reducere problemer med ikke-konvergens, opnå stabil estimering af begrænsninger og forbedre den samlede ydeevne af algoritmerne. Målet er at udvikle mere effektive og robuste algoritmer til forskellige anvendelser, herunder strukturel pålidelighedsanalyse og designoptimering.

title: Thyroid cancer prediction
en: Researchers have been using algorithms to develop prediction models and tools for diagnosing and evaluating the risk of thyroid cancer. These algorithms have been used to compare different machine learning algorithms for classifying thyroid nodules as malignant or benign, develop scoring systems and nomograms for accurate classification, and predict the risk of lymph node metastasis. Machine learning algorithms have also been used to integrate clinical data and improve the diagnosis of thyroid nodules, as well as predict the risk of metastasis in patients with papillary thyroid cancer. These advancements in machine learning are helping to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosing and evaluating thyroid nodules.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at udvikle prediktionsmodeller og værktøjer til diagnosticering og vurdering af risikoen for skjoldbruskkirtelkræft. Disse algoritmer er blevet brugt til at sammenligne forskellige machine learning-algoritmer til klassificering af skjoldbruskkirtelnoduler som maligne eller benigne, udvikle scoringssystemer og nomogrammer til præcis klassificering samt forudsige risikoen for lymfeknudemetastase. Machine learning-algoritmer er også blevet anvendt til at integrere kliniske data og forbedre diagnosticeringen af skjoldbruskkirtelnoduler samt forudsige risikoen for metastase hos patienter med papillær skjoldbruskkirtelkræft. Disse fremskridt inden for machine learning bidrager til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af diagnosticeringen og vurderingen af skjoldbruskkirtelnoduler.

title: Deep Learning for Lung Nodules
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of algorithms, specifically deep learning systems and convolutional neural networks, to accurately classify and detect lung nodules in computed tomography (CT) images. These algorithms, such as computer-aided detection (CAD) systems and deep learning architectures, are being developed to automate the diagnosis and classification of lung cancer. By leveraging machine and deep learning techniques, these algorithms have the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of lung nodule detection and classification, ultimately aiding in early diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer.
da: Forskere undersøger kapaciteterne af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning-systemer og convolutional neural networks, til præcist at klassificere og detektere lungeknuder i computertomografi (CT) billeder. Disse algoritmer, såsom computer-aided detection (CAD) systemer og deep learning-arkitekturer, bliver udviklet for at automatisere diagnosen og klassifikation af lungekræft. Ved at udnytte machine og deep learning teknikker har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af detektion og klassifikation af lungeknuder, hvilket i sidste ende kan hjælpe med tidlig diagnose og behandling af lungekræft.

title: Ship collision avoidance
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to address the challenge of collision avoidance in ship navigation. These algorithms serve as a high-level layer of navigation control for autonomous ships, guiding them to avoid obstacles and follow pre-designed tracks. They consider factors such as collision risk, proximity to obstacles, and compliance with international regulations. These algorithms aim to enhance safety and efficiency in ship navigation, providing reliable and automatic collision avoidance systems.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at tackle udfordringen med kollision undgåelse i skibsnavigation. Disse algoritmer fungerer som et højt niveau af navigationskontrol for autonome skibe, der guider dem til at undgå forhindringer og følge foruddesignede ruter. De tager højde for faktorer som kollisionsrisiko, nærhed til forhindringer og overholdelse af internationale regler. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at forbedre sikkerheden og effektiviteten i skibsnavigation, ved at tilbyde pålidelige og automatiske kollision undgåelses systemer.

title: Clutter suppression algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve clutter suppression in airborne radar systems. These algorithms utilize techniques such as sparse representation, sparse recovery, and sparse Bayesian learning to effectively eliminate clutter and enhance target detection. The proposed algorithms outperform existing methods in terms of performance, computational complexity, and robustness, making them promising solutions for clutter suppression in heterogeneous clutter environments.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at forbedre kladdeundertrykkelsen i luftbårne radar-systemer. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker som sparse representation, sparse recovery og sparse Bayesian learning for effektivt at eliminere kladder og forbedre måldetektion. De foreslåede algoritmer overgår eksisterende metoder med hensyn til ydeevne, beregningskompleksitet og robusthed, hvilket gør dem til lovende løsninger for kladdeundertrykkelse i heterogene kladde-miljøer.

title: Box-office prediction
en: Researchers are using machine learning algorithms to predict the box-office performance and profitability of movies. These algorithms analyze data from various sources, including social media content and pre-released metadata, to forecast movie revenues and success. By improving prediction accuracy and developing pre-production forecasting tools, these algorithms are helping the film industry make informed decisions about movie development and marketing strategies.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige billetkontorpræstationen og rentabiliteten af film. Disse algoritmer analyserer data fra forskellige kilder, herunder indhold fra sociale medier og metadata, der er offentliggjort før release, for at forudsige filmindtægter og succes. Ved at forbedre forudsigelsens nøjagtighed og udvikle værktøjer til forudsigelse før produktion hjælper disse algoritmer filmindustrien med at træffe informerede beslutninger om filmudvikling og markedsføringsstrategier.

title: Optimizing mobile crowdsensing
en: Algorithms play a crucial role in optimizing various aspects of mobile crowdsensing, according to a recent analysis of scientific abstracts. These algorithms are used to maximize revenue for application owners, assign tasks efficiently based on different factors, allocate tasks considering data quality and budget constraints, and recruit appropriate participants based on their mobility patterns. The research highlights the importance of algorithms in improving the effectiveness and efficiency of mobile crowdsensing.
da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i optimeringen af forskellige aspekter af mobil crowdsensing, ifølge en nylig analyse af videnskabelige abstracts. Disse algoritmer bruges til at maksimere indtægterne for applikationsejere, til effektivt at tildele opgaver baseret på forskellige faktorer, til at allokere opgaver under hensyntagen til datakvalitet og budgetbegrænsninger samt til at rekruttere passende deltagere baseret på deres mobilitetsmønstre. Forskningen fremhæver vigtigheden af algoritmer i forbedringen af effektiviteten og produktiviteten af mobil crowdsensing.

title: Natural compounds for diabetes
en: Scientists are using algorithms to investigate the potential of natural compounds in treating diabetes. By using techniques such as molecular docking and in silico analysis, researchers are able to study the interactions between these compounds and specific targets related to diabetes. This approach allows them to identify potential molecules that could be developed into antidiabetic drugs.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at undersøge potentialet af naturlige forbindelser i behandlingen af diabetes. Ved at anvende teknikker som molekylær docking og in silico analyse er forskerne i stand til at studere interaktionerne mellem disse forbindelser og specifikke mål relateret til diabetes. Denne tilgang gør det muligt for dem at identificere potentielle molekyler, der kunne udvikles til antidiabetiske lægemidler.

title: MRI-based tumor analysis
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to analyze MRI images and predict important characteristics of brain tumors. These algorithms can classify the molecular characteristics of glioblastoma, predict patient survival and molecular subtype, and even distinguish between different types of brain tumors. By analyzing radiomics features derived from MRI scans, these algorithms are able to make accurate predictions and improve the stratification of patients with glioblastoma.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at analysere MRI-billeder og forudsige vigtige egenskaber ved hjernetumorer. Disse algoritmer kan klassificere de molekylære egenskaber ved glioblastom, forudsige patienternes overlevelse og molekylære subtype og endda skelne mellem forskellige typer hjernetumorer. Ved at analysere radiomics-funktioner afledt fra MRI-scanninger er disse algoritmer i stand til at lave præcise forudsigelser og forbedre stratificeringen af patienter med glioblastom.

title: Pose Estimation
en: Deep learning algorithms have made significant advancements in human pose estimation from monocular images, utilizing techniques such as convolutional neural networks and geometric priors. These algorithms can estimate human motion capture, 3D pose, and spatial relationships between joints. They can also achieve efficient multi-person pose estimation and integrate 2D and 3D pose estimation. Additionally, deep learning methods have been surveyed and reviewed for their effectiveness in 3D human pose estimation.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer har gjort betydelige fremskridt inden for menneskelig pose estimation fra monokulare billeder, ved at udnytte teknikker såsom convolutional neural networks og geometriske priors. Disse algoritmer kan estimere menneskelig bevægelsesmønstre, 3D pose og rumlige relationer mellem led. De kan også opnå effektiv multi-person pose estimation og integrere 2D og 3D pose estimation. Derudover er deep learning-metoder blevet undersøgt og gennemgået for deres effektivitet i 3D menneskelig pose estimation.

title: Liver cancer diagnosis
en: Researchers have developed algorithms that can assist in the diagnosis of liver cancer. These algorithms, such as LI-RADS-CEUS and LI-RADS v2014, use imaging techniques like contrast-enhanced ultrasound and gadoxetic acid-enhanced MRI to categorize and evaluate liver tumors. They have shown promising results in accurately identifying different types of liver cancers and improving diagnostic performance.
da: Forskere har udviklet algoritmer, som kan hjælpe med diagnosen af leverkræft. Disse algoritmer, såsom LI-RADS-CEUS og LI-RADS v2014, bruger billedbehandlingsteknikker som kontrast-forbedret ultralyd og gadoxetinsyre-forbedret MRI til at kategorisere og evaluere levertumorer. De har vist lovende resultater i nøjagtigt at identificere forskellige typer af leverkræft og forbedre diagnostisk præstation.

title: Antibiotic resistance prediction
en: Scientists are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to accurately predict antibiotic resistance in various bacteria. These algorithms automate the interpretation of genetic data and integrate machine learning approaches into diagnostic tools. By incorporating relevant biological and epidemiological knowledge, these algorithms can improve the performance of antibiotic susceptibility testing and enable rapid and accurate determination of resistance.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til præcist at forudsige antibiotikaresistens i forskellige bakterier. Disse algoritmer automatiserer fortolkningen af genetiske data og integrerer machine learning-tilgange i diagnostiske værktøjer. Ved at inkorporere relevant biologisk og epidemiologisk viden kan disse algoritmer forbedre ydeevnen af antibiotikafølsomhedstest og muliggøre hurtig og præcis bestemmelse af resistens.

title: Shoulder Arthroplasty Optimization
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various questions related to shoulder arthroplasty, a surgical procedure for shoulder joint replacement. These algorithms, such as the ACR Appropriateness Criteria and the Nationwide Inpatient Sample, help determine appropriate imaging techniques, assess the impact of insurance status on postoperative complications, compare different types of shoulder arthroplasty, identify suitable candidates for outpatient procedures, and evaluate the influence of comorbidities on patient outcomes. By analyzing large datasets and applying these algorithms, scientists aim to improve the effectiveness and safety of shoulder arthroplasty.
da: Forskere anvender algoritmer til at adressere forskellige spørgsmål relateret til skulder arthroplasti, en kirurgisk procedure til udskiftning af skulderleddet. Disse algoritmer, såsom ACR Appropriateness Criteria og Nationwide Inpatient Sample, hjælper med at bestemme passende billedteknikker, vurdere indflydelsen af forsikringsstatus på postoperative komplikationer, sammenligne forskellige typer skulder arthroplasti, identificere egnede kandidater til ambulatoriske procedurer, og evaluere indflydelsen af komorbiditeter på patientresultater. Ved at analysere store datasæt og anvende disse algoritmer sigter videnskabsfolk mod at forbedre effektiviteten og sikkerheden af skulder arthroplasti.

title: Smart Traffic Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can be used to develop smart traffic modeling systems for cities, monitor traffic volume and vehicle classification accurately, and infer vehicular traffic types. They are also investigating how algorithms can optimize traffic control and data processing, enhance smart city mobility and transportation services, and improve city governance through real-time traffic monitoring. Additionally, algorithms are being incorporated into IoT systems for traffic management, intelligent transportation systems, and adaptive traffic management systems for smart cities. The goal is to address traffic congestion problems and create sustainable traffic management solutions using IoT technologies and data analytics.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at udvikle smarte trafikmodelleringssystemer for byer, overvåge trafikvolumen og klassificering af køretøjer nøjagtigt samt udlede typer af køretøjs trafik. De undersøger også, hvordan algoritmer kan optimere trafikstyring og databehandling, forbedre mobilitet og transporttjenester i smarte byer samt forbedre bystyre gennem realtids trafikovervågning. Derudover bliver algoritmer integreret i IoT-systemer til trafikstyring, intelligente transportsystemer og adaptive trafikstyringssystemer for smarte byer. Målet er at tackle problemer med trafikpropper og skabe bæredygtige trafikstyringsløsninger ved hjælp af IoT-teknologier og dataanalyse.

title: Predictive Algorithms for Cancer
en: Researchers are using algorithms to answer various questions related to cancer treatment. These algorithms are being used to accurately predict tumor mutation load, identify driver mutations, detect genomic alterations and biomarkers, estimate blood tumor mutational burden, and classify patients based on their likelihood of response to immunotherapy. The algorithms are also being used to optimize the calculation of tumor mutational burden and predict treatment response in cancer of unknown primary. These advancements in algorithmic analysis are helping to improve cancer diagnosis and treatment decisions.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare forskellige spørgsmål relateret til kræftbehandling. Disse algoritmer anvendes til præcist at forudsige tumorens mutationsbyrde, identificere driver-mutationer, opdage genomændringer og biomarkører, estimere blodtumorens mutationsbyrde og klassificere patienter baseret på deres sandsynlighed for at reagere på immunterapi. Algoritmerne anvendes også til at optimere beregningen af tumorens mutationsbyrde og forudsige behandlingsrespons ved kræft med ukendt primær sted. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmisk analyse hjælper med at forbedre diagnosen og behandlingsbeslutningerne ved kræft.

title: Enhancing Diabetic Retinopathy Screening
en: Deep learning algorithms have the potential to improve the efficiency of screening for diabetic retinopathy (DR), a condition that can lead to blindness in diabetic patients. These algorithms can accurately detect and diagnose DR in retinal images, aiding in early diagnosis and referral recommendations. They can also classify different grades of DR and contribute to predicting its progression by integrating different retinal imaging modalities. Overall, deep learning techniques, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are widely used and show promising results in the computer-aided diagnosis of DR.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer har potentiale til at forbedre effektiviteten af screening for diabetisk retinopati (DR), en tilstand der kan føre til blindhed hos diabetiske patienter. Disse algoritmer kan nøjagtigt detektere og diagnosticere DR i retinalbilleder, hvilket hjælper med tidlig diagnose og henvisningsanbefalinger. De kan også klassificere forskellige grader af DR og bidrage til at forudsige dens progression ved at integrere forskellige retinalbilledbehandlingsmodaliteter. Overordnet set er deep learning-teknikker, såsom convolutional neural networks (CNNs), meget anvendt og viser lovende resultater i computer-understøttet diagnose af DR.

title: Dengue outbreak forecasting
en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to improve forecasting techniques for dengue outbreaks. These algorithms, such as LASSO-derived models, compound variables and lag times, generalized additive models (GAMs), hierarchical spatial Bayesian models, ensemble penalized regression algorithms (EPRA), random forest, AdaBoost, extra-trees, regularized regressions, artificial neural networks (ANN), Bayes network models, support vector machine (SVM), RBF tree, decision table, naive Bayes, regression and time series models, and machine learning techniques, have been effective in predicting dengue cases and outbreaks in different regions around the world. By analyzing historical records, climate data, social media surveillance, and other external data, these algorithms can accurately forecast dengue risk and help public health officials take proactive measures to prevent outbreaks.
da: Forskere har anvendt machine learning-algoritmer til at forbedre prognoseteknikker for dengueudbrud. Disse algoritmer, såsom LASSO-afledte modeller, sammensatte variable og forsinkelsestider, generalized additive models (GAMs), hierarkiske rumlige Bayesian-modeller, ensemble penalized regression algorithms (EPRA), random forest, AdaBoost, extra-trees, regularized regressions, artificial neural networks (ANN), Bayes network models, support vector machine (SVM), RBF tree, decision table, naive Bayes, regressions- og tidsseriemodeller samt machine learning-teknikker, har vist sig effektive til at forudsige dengue tilfælde og udbrud i forskellige regioner rundt om i verden. Ved at analysere historiske optegnelser, klimadata, overvågning af sociale medier og andre eksterne data kan disse algoritmer præcist forudsige dengue risiko og hjælpe sundhedsmyndighederne med at tage proaktive skridt til at forhindre udbrud.

title: Digital biomarkers
en: Researchers are exploring the use of smartphone sensor data and machine learning algorithms to detect and predict depressive symptoms. These algorithms can analyze data from various sources, such as behavior patterns, movement, and physiological features, to assess the severity of depression and provide personalized interventions. By passively collecting data and using advanced algorithms, these studies aim to improve the screening and management of depression using digital biomarkers.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af smartphone-sensordata og maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at opdage og forudsige depressive symptomer. Disse algoritmer kan analysere data fra forskellige kilder, såsom adfærdsmønstre, bevægelse og fysiologiske træk, for at vurdere sværhedsgraden af depression og tilbyde personligt tilpassede interventioner. Ved passivt at indsamle data og bruge avancerede algoritmer har disse studier til formål at forbedre screening og håndtering af depression ved hjælp af digitale biomarkører.

title: Sepsis prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict the onset of sepsis, a life-threatening condition. These algorithms, such as InSight and the Artificial Intelligence Sepsis Expert, analyze electronic health record data and vital signs to identify patients at risk for sepsis. By detecting sepsis early, these algorithms have the potential to improve patient outcomes and save lives.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af machine learning algoritmer til at forudsige indtræden af sepsis, en livstruende tilstand. Disse algoritmer, såsom InSight og Artificial Intelligence Sepsis Expert, analyserer elektroniske sundhedsdata og vitale tegn for at identificere patienter, der er i risiko for sepsis. Ved tidligt at opdage sepsis har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre patientresultater og redde liv.

title: Predictive Algorithms for Parkinson's
en: Researchers are using algorithms to predict various aspects of Parkinson's disease. They are using machine learning methods, regression-based models, Bayesian inference platforms, and other algorithms to predict factors such as time to initiation of therapy, disease progression, motor dysfunction, and risk of dementia. These algorithms analyze clinical, biological, genetic, and molecular data to provide accurate predictions and potentially accelerate the diagnosis and treatment of Parkinson's disease.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige aspekter af Parkinsons sygdom. De benytter sig af metoder inden for maskinlæring, regressionsbaserede modeller, Bayesian inference-platforme og andre algoritmer til at forudsige faktorer som tid til påbegyndelse af behandling, sygdomsfremskridt, motorisk dysfunktion og risiko for demens. Disse algoritmer analyserer kliniske, biologiske, genetiske og molekylære data for at give nøjagtige forudsigelser og potentielt accelerere diagnosen og behandlingen af Parkinsons sygdom.

title: Crash pattern analysis
en: Researchers have used algorithms to analyze various factors and patterns related to road crashes. These algorithms, such as the association rules method and classification-based association rule mining, help identify characteristics, contributory factors, and crash patterns. By understanding these patterns, researchers can develop countermeasures to improve road safety and reduce the severity of crashes.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at analysere forskellige faktorer og mønstre relateret til vejulykker. Disse algoritmer, såsom association rules method og classification-based association rule mining, hjælper med at identificere karakteristika, bidragende faktorer og kollisionsmønstre. Ved at forstå disse mønstre kan forskere udvikle modforholdsregler for at forbedre vej sikkerheden og reducere alvorligheden af ulykker.

title: Remote sensing AI
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to analyze big data in remote sensing, improving the accuracy and efficiency of image classification. Researchers have proposed various models and methods, such as DenseNet, Siamese CNNs, and ResNet-Inception, to address challenges like over-fitting and lack of depth in scene classification. These algorithms are capable of extracting features from remote sensing data, enabling rapid and accurate analysis for a range of applications.
da: Deep learning algoritmer bliver brugt til at analysere big data i fjernovervågning, hvilket forbedrer nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af billedklassifikation. Forskere har foreslået forskellige modeller og metoder, såsom DenseNet, Siamese CNNs, og ResNet-Inception, for at tackle udfordringer som overfitting og mangel på dybde i sceneklassifikation. Disse algoritmer er i stand til at udtrække funktioner fra fjernovervågningsdata, hvilket muliggør hurtig og præcis analyse til en række anvendelser.

title: Fracture treatment optimization
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various questions related to the treatment of fractures in the shoulder and upper arm. These algorithms are being used to assess adherence to standardized treatment protocols, identify predictors of surgery and treatment failure rates, evaluate different treatment methods and their outcomes, and propose evidence-based management algorithms. By analyzing data and comparing results, researchers hope to improve the treatment of these fractures and reduce the need for reoperations.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at tackle forskellige spørgsmål relateret til behandlingen af brud i skulderen og overarmen. Disse algoritmer bruges til at vurdere overholdelsen af standardiserede behandlingsprotokoller, identificere forudsigere for kirurgi og behandlingsfejl, evaluere forskellige behandlingsmetoder og deres resultater samt foreslå evidensbaserede styringsalgoritmer. Ved at analysere data og sammenligne resultater håber forskere at forbedre behandlingen af disse brud og reducere behovet for reoperationer.

title: Jet Substructure
en: Deep neural networks are being used to classify jet substructure in high-energy physics, and they are proving to be as good as or even better than traditional approaches. Machine learning methods are also being applied to improve jet charge extraction and quark-gluon jet classification. These algorithms are helping scientists gain a better understanding of particle physics and are improving the observation of phenomena like the Higgs boson.
da: Dybe neurale netværk bruges til at klassificere jet substructure i højenergifysik, og de viser sig at være lige så gode som eller endda bedre end traditionelle metoder. Maskinlæringsmetoder anvendes også til at forbedre jet ladningsudtrækning og kvark-gluon jetklassificering. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskere med at få en bedre forståelse af partikel fysik og forbedrer observationen af fænomener som Higgs bosonen.

title: Rapid disease diagnosis
en: Scientists are exploring the use of advanced algorithms to diagnose various diseases quickly and accurately. These algorithms, such as pattern recognition algorithms, deep learning models, and convolutional neural networks, are being combined with spectroscopy techniques like Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy and Raman spectroscopy. By analyzing the data from these spectroscopy techniques, the algorithms can detect and classify diseases like brain tumors, abnormal thyroid function, hepatitis B, prostate cancer bone metastases, thyroid dysfunction, gastric cancer, lung cancer, glioma, breast cancer, liver cancer, echinococcosis, ductal carcinoma in situ, and prostate cancer. This research shows promising potential for the development of non-invasive and rapid diagnostic tools in the future.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af avancerede algoritmer til hurtigt og præcist at diagnosticere forskellige sygdomme. Disse algoritmer, såsom pattern recognition algorithms, deep learning models og convolutional neural networks, bliver kombineret med spektroskopiteknikker som Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy og Raman spectroscopy. Ved at analysere dataene fra disse spektroskopiteknikker kan algoritmerne opdage og klassificere sygdomme som hjernetumorer, abnorm thyroideafunktion, hepatitis B, prostata kræft knoglemetastaser, thyroideafunktion-nedsættelse, mavekræft, lungekræft, gliom, brystkræft, leverkræft, echinokokose, ductal carcinoma in situ og prostatakræft. Denne forskning viser lovende potentiale for udviklingen af ikke-invasiv og hurtig diagnostiske værktøjer i fremtiden.

title: Automated cardiac MRI analysis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, such as deep learning and neural networks, to automatically segment and analyze cardiac MRI images. These algorithms have the potential to accurately identify and measure different structures of the heart, such as the left ventricle and myocardium, without the need for manual annotation. By combining these advanced algorithms with other techniques, such as deformable models and region constrained dynamic programming, scientists aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of cardiac MRI analysis.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, såsom deep learning og neural networks, til automatisk at segmentere og analysere hjerte-MRI-billeder. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til nøjagtigt at identificere og måle forskellige strukturer i hjertet, såsom venstre ventrikel og myocardium, uden behov for manuel annotation. Ved at kombinere disse avancerede algoritmer med andre teknikker, såsom deformable models og region constrained dynamic programming, sigter forskerne mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af hjerte-MRI-analysen.

title: Astro-ML
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to study various aspects of galaxy formation and evolution. These algorithms are proving to be promising and efficient tools for understanding small-scale structure formation, accurately inferring galaxy star formation histories, estimating cosmological parameters, predicting gas shape profiles, and emulating galaxy formation models. The Cosmology and Astrophysics with Machine-learning Simulations (CAMELS) project is a suite of cosmological simulations designed to train machine-learning algorithms. The project has also released a large amount of data for public use. Overall, machine learning is playing a crucial role in advancing our understanding of the universe.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bliver brugt til at studere forskellige aspekter af galaksernes dannelse og evolution. Disse algoritmer viser sig at være lovende og effektive værktøjer til at forstå dannelsen af småskala strukturer, nøjagtigt udlede galaksernes stjernedannelseshistorier, estimere kosmologiske parametre, forudsige gasformprofiler og emulere galaksedannelsesmodeller. CAMELS-projektet (Cosmology and Astrophysics with Machine-learning Simulations) er en suite af kosmologiske simulationer designet til at træne maskinlæringsalgoritmer. Projektet har også offentliggjort en stor mængde data til offentlig brug. Samlet set spiller maskinlæring en afgørende rolle i fremme af vores forståelse af universet.

title: Enhancing medical image fusion
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve medical image fusion methods for better contrast and detail information. They are using algorithms such as the normalized coefficient value motivated pulse-coupled neural network and the Gauss-Laplace filter to achieve this. Additionally, convolutional neural networks, Laplacian pyramids, and deep learning technology are being utilized to enhance the quality of medical image fusion.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre metoderne til medicinsk billedfusion for bedre kontrast og detaljerede oplysninger. De bruger algoritmer såsom det normaliserede koefficientværdi-motiverede puls-koblede neurale netværk og Gauss-Laplace-filteret for at opnå dette. Derudover anvendes konvolutionelle neurale netværk, Laplace-pyramider og deep learning-teknologi for at forbedre kvaliteten af medicinsk billedfusion.

title: Deep learning in histopathology
en: Researchers are exploring how deep learning algorithms can be used to analyze digital pathology images, improve the accuracy and efficiency of histopathological diagnosis, detect invasive breast cancer, discriminate between different types of cancer, and prevent overfitting in convolutional neural networks. They are also investigating how pre-analytical variables affect the accuracy of deep learning in histopathology, how Bayesian deep learning can improve histopathological image classification, and how automatic classification algorithms can assist in breast cancer histology analysis. Additionally, they are studying how deep learning can aid in the histopathological diagnosis of gastric cancer, improve histopathological image analysis for prostate cancer, and assess histopathological images for breast cancer grading. Open-source software is being developed to aid in histological image pre-processing and augmentation. Overall, deep learning algorithms are being used to enhance the analysis and classification of histopathological images, leading to more accurate and efficient diagnoses.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep learning-algoritmer kan anvendes til at analysere digitale patologibilleder, forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af histopatologiske diagnoser, opdage invasiv brystkræft, skelne mellem forskellige typer af kræft og forhindre overfitting i convolutional neural networks. De undersøger også, hvordan præ-analytiske variabler påvirker nøjagtigheden af deep learning i histopatologi, hvordan Bayesian deep learning kan forbedre klassificeringen af histopatologiske billeder, og hvordan automatiske klassificeringsalgoritmer kan hjælpe i analysen af brystkræft histologi. Derudover studerer de, hvordan deep learning kan hjælpe i den histopatologiske diagnose af mavekræft, forbedre analysen af histopatologiske billeder for prostatakræft og vurdere histopatologiske billeder til klassificering af brystkræft. Open-source software udvikles for at hjælpe med præ-behandling og augmentation af histologiske billeder. Samlet set anvendes deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre analysen og klassificeringen af histopatologiske billeder, hvilket fører til mere nøjagtige og effektive diagnoser.

title: Wildlife drone revolution
en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and artificial intelligence (AI) have the potential to revolutionize wildlife monitoring and conservation by providing a cost-effective and accurate method for surveying wildlife populations. Machine learning-based classification of drones shows promise for drone detection and classification, but there is a need for standardized specifications and reference datasets. Real-time object detection applied on drones can be used for various tasks such as monitoring forest fires, detecting maturity of crops, and identifying rubbish in rivers.
da: Ubesættede luftfartøjer (UAVs) og kunstig intelligens (AI) har potentiale til at revolutionere overvågning og bevarelse af vildt ved at tilbyde en omkostningseffektiv og præcis metode til kortlægning af dyrelivspopulationer. Klassificering af droner baseret på maskinlæring viser lovende resultater for detektion og klassificering af droner, men der er behov for standardiserede specifikationer og reference-datasæt. Realtidsobjektdetektion anvendt på droner kan bruges til forskellige opgaver såsom overvågning af skovbrande, detektion af modning af afgrøder og identifikation af affald i floder.

title: Air-based handwriting
en: Researchers have been exploring the possibility of recognizing handwriting and gestures in the air using various technologies and algorithms. They have used devices like WIMU, radars, ultrasonic transceivers, and millimeter-wave radar, along with machine learning algorithms such as LSTM, CNN, and deep convolutional neural networks. These advancements could lead to the development of wearable real-time character recognition systems and interactive response systems that allow us to write and input text without physical contact.
da: Forskere har udforsket muligheden for at genkende håndskrift og gestus i luften ved hjælp af forskellige teknologier og algoritmer. De har anvendt enheder som WIMU, radars, ultralyds-transceivere og millimeter-bølge radar, sammen med maskinlæringsalgoritmer såsom LSTM, CNN og dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværk. Disse fremskridt kan føre til udviklingen af bærbare realtids tegngenkendelsessystemer og interaktive responsystemer, der gør det muligt for os at skrive og indtaste tekst uden fysisk kontakt.

title: Algorithmic policing
en: Researchers have explored various questions related to the use of algorithms in policing. They have investigated the impact of big data analytics on criminological research and policy, the challenges and issues in the application of predictive policing software, and the assumptions, evaluation, and accountability problems in algorithmic prediction. They have also examined the benefits and drawbacks of predictive policing, the potential for discrimination and bias, and the moral behavior of police officers influenced by predictive policing. The goal is to understand how algorithms can be used effectively and ethically in law enforcement.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige spørgsmål relateret til brugen af algoritmer i politiarbejde. De har undersøgt effekten af big data analytics på kriminologisk forskning og politik, de udfordringer og problemer der er i anvendelsen af predictive policing software, samt antagelser, evaluering og ansvarlighedsproblemer i algoritmisk forudsigelse. De har også set på fordele og ulemper ved predictive policing, potentialet for diskrimination og bias, samt den moralske adfærd hos politibetjente påvirket af predictive policing. Målsetningen er at forstå, hvordan algoritmer kan anvendes effektivt og etisk i retshåndhævelse.

title: Visual Tracking Advancements
en: Researchers have been exploring various ways to improve the accuracy and robustness of visual tracking algorithms. They have investigated the use of collaboration between generative and discriminative models, single convolutional neural networks, deep architectures, convolutional features selection, deep convolutional neural networks combined with kernelized correlation filters, dual model learning, fully convolutional networks with multi-layer feature fusion, spatial-temporal context hierarchical response fusion, dense connection based networks, deep feature fusion, long-short term multi-model based tracking methods, Siamese visual tracking with deep features, improved hierarchical convolutional features, mutual learning between cohort multiscale feature-fusion networks, residual networks, Siamese trackers based on deep features, Siamese networks with depthwise overparameterized convolutional layers, learning enhanced feature responses, and noise-suppressing algorithms. These algorithms aim to enhance the precision, accuracy, and robustness of visual object tracking.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige måder at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af visuelle tracking-algoritmer. De har undersøgt brugen af samarbejde mellem generative og diskriminerende modeller, enkelt konvolutionsneurale netværk, dybe arkitektur, selektion af konvolutionelle funktioner, dybe konvolutionsneurale netværk kombineret med kernelized correlation filters, dual model learning, fuldt konvolutionsnetværk med flerlagets funktionsfusion, rum-tidlig kontekst hierarkisk responsfusion, tætte forbindelsesbaserede netværk, dyb funktionsfusion, lang-kortvarig multi-model baseret trackingmetoder, Siamese visuel tracking med dybe funktioner, forbedrede hierarkiske konvolutionsfunktioner, gensidig læring mellem kohort multiskala funktions-fusionsnetværk, residualnetværk, Siamese trackere baseret på dybe funktioner, Siamese netværk med depthwise overparameterizerede konvolutionslag, læring af forbedrede funktionsresponser, og støjundertrykkende algoritmer. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre præcisionen, nøjagtigheden og robustheden af visuel objekt tracking.

title: Enhanced radar tracking
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve target tracking in radar systems. These algorithms optimize resource allocation, power allocation, and antenna selection to enhance tracking performance. By using these algorithms, radar systems can accurately estimate target state, improve velocity estimation accuracy, optimize target detection performance, and achieve effective tracking performance even in challenging scenarios such as low-angle tracking and self-defense blanket jamming.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at forbedre sporing af mål i radarsystemer. Disse algoritmer optimerer ressourceallokering, strømfordeling og valg af antenne for at forbedre sporingsydelsen. Ved at bruge disse algoritmer kan radarsystemer nøjagtigt estimere måltilstand, forbedre hastighedsestimeringens nøjagtighed, optimere præstationen for måldetektion og opnå effektiv sporingsydelse selv i udfordrende scenarier såsom lavvinklet tracking og selvforsvars blankettjamning.

title: Algorithmic fairness
en: Algorithms play a significant role in mediating various aspects of our lives, including social processes, business transactions, governmental decisions, and human interactions. While algorithms have the potential to lead to fairer decisions, they also raise concerns about discrimination, information asymmetry, and opacity. To ensure accountability, transparency, and fairness in algorithmic decision-making, principles such as public reason, responsible data management, and international human rights law need to be considered.
da: Algoritmer spiller en betydelig rolle i formidlingen af forskellige aspekter af vores liv, herunder sociale processer, forretningstransaktioner, statslige beslutninger og menneskelige interaktioner. Mens algoritmer har potentiale til at føre til mere retfærdige beslutninger, rejser de også bekymringer om diskrimination, informationsasymmetri og uigennemsigtighed. For at sikre ansvarlighed, gennemsigtighed og retfærdighed i algoritmisk beslutningstagning skal principper såsom offentlig ræsonnering, ansvarlig datastyring og international menneskerettighedslov overvejes.

title: Data Transfer Optimization Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the efficiency of data center networks by using algorithms. They have developed various algorithms to minimize the completion time of data transfers, optimize the cost-performance tradeoff, reduce job completion time, and achieve high link utilization. These algorithms aim to improve the overall performance and reduce the time it takes to complete tasks in data centers.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre effektiviteten af datacenter-netværk ved at bruge algoritmer. De har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at minimere tiden for dataoverførsler, optimere forholdet mellem omkostninger og ydeevne, reducere jobkompletteringstid og opnå høj udnyttelse af forbindelser. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre den samlede ydeevne og reducere den tid, det tager at fuldføre opgaver i datacentre.

title: Deep Action Recognition
en: Researchers have been exploring advancements in human action recognition using deep learning techniques. They have developed algorithms such as deep convolutional neural networks and region-sequence based six-stream CNN features to improve the accuracy and discrimination of action recognition. These algorithms utilize deep spatial features, handcrafted spatiotemporal features, and data augmentation methods to enhance the recognition of human actions in various applications, including video surveillance.
da: Forskere har udforsket fremskridt inden for menneskelig handlingsgenkendelse ved hjælp af dyb læringsteknikker. De har udviklet algoritmer såsom dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværk og regions-sekvens baserede seks-strøm CNN-funktioner for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og differentieringen af handlingsgenkendelse. Disse algoritmer udnytter dybe rumlige funktioner, håndlavede spatiotemporale funktioner og dataaugmenteringsmetoder for at forbedre genkendelsen af menneskelige handlinger i forskellige applikationer, herunder videoovervågning.

title: Machine Learning for DNS
en: Researchers are using machine learning algorithms to detect different types of botnets and malicious domain names. They are training these algorithms to analyze DNS traffic and identify patterns that indicate the presence of botnets or algorithmically generated domains. Additionally, probabilistic approaches and statistical features are being used to detect hard-to-detect families of domain generation algorithms. These advancements in algorithmic detection aim to improve cybersecurity and protect against malicious online activities.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at opdage forskellige typer af botnets og ondsindede domænenavne. De træner disse algoritmer til at analysere DNS-trafik og identificere mønstre, der indikerer tilstedeværelsen af botnets eller algoritmisk genererede domæner. Derudover anvendes probabilistiske metoder og statistiske egenskaber til at opdage svære at opdage familier af domænegenerationsalgoritmer. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmisk detektion har til formål at forbedre cybersikkerheden og beskytte mod ondsindede online aktiviteter.

title: AI in Law
en: Researchers are exploring the future of AI in law and how it can be rethought to ensure fair trials and the administration of justice. They are also investigating the ethical and legal aspects of AI, as well as the challenges and implications of AI in different legal systems. The impact of AI on criminal law, legal culture, and the rule of law is being examined, along with the role and functions of AI and its integration in the legal fraternity. These studies aim to understand the benefits and challenges of AI and develop guidelines and regulations to ensure transparency, fairness, and legal certainty in the use of AI in the justice sector.
da: Forskere udforsker fremtiden for AI i retssystemet og hvordan det kan omformes for at sikre retfærdige rettergangsforløb og administration af retfærdighed. De undersøger også de etiske og juridiske aspekter af AI, samt udfordringerne og konsekvenserne af AI i forskellige retssystemer. Indflydelsen af AI på strafferet, retlig kultur og retsstatsprincippet bliver undersøgt, sammen med AI's rolle og funktioner samt dens integration i den juristerende kreds. Disse studier har til formål at forstå fordelene og udfordringerne ved AI og udvikle retningslinjer og bestemmelser for at sikre gennemsigtighed, retfærdighed og juridisk sikkerhed i brugen af AI i retsektoren.

title: Enhanced Detection Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve the accuracy and efficiency of pedestrian detection. Deep learning algorithms, hierarchical convolutional features, ensemble of boosted decision models, and region-based convolutional neural network (R-CNN) approaches are among the proposed solutions. Other approaches include self-adaptive scale pedestrian detection, deep residual network (DRN), two-stream UDN, optimized Mask R-CNN, thermal imaging and convolutional neural networks, multi-scale pedestrian detection algorithm, deep dilated feature extraction, YOLOv2 model improvements, deep model based on parts, efficient pedestrian detection network, YOLOv5s-FCC model, multi-level feature fusion, PF_YOLOv4 algorithm, and Three ResNet Blocks. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy, speed, and performance of pedestrian detection in various scenarios, such as nighttime, traffic environments, and small object detection.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af fodgængerregistrering. Deep learning-algoritmer, hierarkiske konvolutionelle egenskaber, ensemble af boostede beslutningsmodeller og region-based convolutional neural network (R-CNN) tilgange er blandt de foreslåede løsninger. Andre tilgange inkluderer selv-adaptiv skala fodgængerregistrering, deep residual network (DRN), two-stream UDN, optimeret Mask R-CNN, termisk imaging og convolutional neural networks, multi-scale fodgængerregistreringsalgoritme, deep dilated feature extraction, YOLOv2 model forbedringer, deep model baseret på dele, effektiv fodgængerregistreringsnetværk, YOLOv5s-FCC model, multi-level feature fusion, PF_YOLOv4 algoritmen og Three ResNet Blocks. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden, hastigheden og ydeevnen af fodgængerregistrering i forskellige scenarier, såsom natte- og trafikmiljøer samt registrering af små objekter.

title: Bug prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the effectiveness of machine learning algorithms in various aspects of software development. They have investigated how these algorithms can be used to predict software bugs, identify high-impact bug reports, assess bug severity, classify bug reports, and detect bug-inducing commits. The studies have shown that ensemble-based machine learning, imbalanced learning strategies, and various supervised machine learning algorithms can be effective in addressing these challenges. By leveraging machine learning techniques, developers can improve software efficiency and enhance the overall quality of software projects.
da: Forskere har undersøgt effektiviteten af maskinlæringsalgoritmer i forskellige aspekter af softwareudvikling. De har undersøgt, hvordan disse algoritmer kan bruges til at forudsige softwarefejl, identificere højtydende fejloplysninger, vurdere fejlens sværhedsgrad, klassificere fejloplysninger og opdage fejlinducerende commits. Studierne har vist, at ensemble-baseret maskinlæring, ubalancerede læringsstrategier og forskellige overvågede maskinlæringsalgoritmer kan være effektive til at tackle disse udfordringer. Ved at udnytte maskinlæringsteknikker kan udviklere forbedre softwareeffektiviteten og øge den overordnede kvalitet af softwareprojekter.

title: Algorithmic Echo Chambers
en: Algorithms play a significant role in shaping our online experiences, particularly on platforms like YouTube and Facebook. Research has shown that algorithms on YouTube narrow our information worlds and contribute to the formation of echo chambers. They also impact the popularity of videos and can even steer users towards controversial or extremist content. Additionally, algorithms on YouTube have been found to contribute to the spread of misinformation and may contribute to polarization. It's important to be aware of the agency of algorithms and how they shape our online experiences.
da: Algoritmer spiller en væsentlig rolle i at forme vores online oplevelser, især på platforme som YouTube og Facebook. Forskning har vist, at algoritmerne på YouTube indsnævrer vores informationsverdener og bidrager til dannelsen af ekkokamre. De påvirker også populariteten af videoer og kan endda styre brugere mod kontroversielt eller ekstremt indhold. Desuden er det blevet konstateret, at algoritmerne på YouTube bidrager til spredningen af misinformation og kan medvirke til polarisering. Det er vigtigt at være opmærksom på algoritmernes agens og hvordan de former vores online oplevelser.

title: Text recognition
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the detection and recognition of text in natural scenes. These algorithms use advanced techniques such as convolutional neural networks, region proposal mechanisms, deep learning frameworks, and feature fusion. By leveraging these algorithms, the researchers aim to achieve more accurate and efficient text reading in real-world environments.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre opdagelsen og genkendelsen af tekst i naturlige scener. Disse algoritmer bruger avancerede teknikker såsom convolutional neural networks, region proposal mechanisms, deep learning frameworks og feature fusion. Ved at udnytte disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at opnå mere præcis og effektiv tekstlæsning i virkelige miljøer.

title: Enhancing density peaks
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the performance of density peaks clustering algorithms for high-dimensional data sets. They have introduced techniques such as k-nearest neighbors and principal component analysis into the algorithm to enhance its clustering capabilities. Additionally, researchers have focused on improving the assignment process by incorporating k-nearest neighbors into the distance computation and assignment process. These advancements aim to make density peaks clustering more effective and accurate in identifying clusters within data sets.
da: Forskere har udforsket måder at forbedre ydeevnen af density peaks clustering-algoritmer til højdimensionaledata sæt. De har introduceret teknikker som k-nearest neighbors og principal component analysis i algoritmen for at forbedre dens clusteringkapaciteter. Desuden har forskere fokuseret på at forbedre tildelingsprocessen ved at inkorporere k-nearest neighbors i afstandsberegningen og tildelingsprocessen. Disse fremskridt har til formål at gøre density peaks clustering mere effektiv og præcis i identificeringen af kluster inden for datasæt.

title: Brain tumor segmentation
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of various algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Fully Convolutional Networks, and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN), to automatically segment brain tumors in MRI images. They have also investigated the effectiveness of techniques like Deep Cascaded Neural Networks, Deep Multi-Task Learning Frameworks, and Nonparametric Localization and Enhancement Methods with U-net. These algorithms and techniques aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of brain tumor segmentation, ultimately aiding in the diagnosis and treatment of patients.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af forskellige algoritmer, såsom Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Fully Convolutional Networks og Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN), til automatisk at segmentere hjernetumorer i MR-billeder. De har også undersøgt effektiviteten af teknikker som Deep Cascaded Neural Networks, Deep Multi-Task Learning Frameworks og Nonparametric Localization and Enhancement Methods med U-net. Disse algoritmer og teknikker har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af hjernetumor segmentering, hvilket i sidste ende hjælper med diagnosen og behandlingen af patienter.

title: Deep Medical Learning
en: Pre-trained deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that are fine-tuned have been found to perform just as well, if not better, than CNNs trained from scratch in medical image analysis. Deep learning algorithms offer exciting possibilities for automating medical image analysis and improving visual diagnosis in medicine. Machine learning and deep learning techniques have been successfully applied to various aspects of medical image analysis, including classification, segmentation, and detection, and have the potential to revolutionize healthcare.
da: Forudtrænede dybe konvolutionsneuralnetværk (CNNs), der er finjusteret, har vist sig at præstere lige så godt, hvis ikke bedre, end CNNs, der er trænet fra bunden i medicinsk billedanalyse. Deep learning-algoritmer tilbyder spændende muligheder for at automatisere medicinsk billedanalyse og forbedre visuel diagnose i medicin. Machine learning og deep learning teknikker er med succes anvendt på forskellige aspekter af medicinsk billedanalyse, herunder klassifikation, segmentering og detektion, og har potentiale til at revolutionere sundhedssektoren.

title: Deep Learning for MIMO
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can optimize various aspects of wireless communication systems. For example, neural networks can be used to manage interference and power control in small cell networks, while deep learning algorithms can optimize coverage, capacity, and resource allocation in massive MIMO systems. These algorithms are being developed to improve the efficiency and performance of wireless networks.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan optimere forskellige aspekter af trådløse kommunikationssystemer. For eksempel kan neurale netværk anvendes til at håndtere interferens og effektkontrol i små cellenetværk, mens deep learning-algoritmer kan optimere dækning, kapacitet og ressourcefordeling i massive MIMO-systemer. Disse algoritmer udvikles for at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af trådløse netværk.

title: Ethical algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the role of algorithms in ethical decision-making and moral agency. They have found that algorithms can integrate diverse assessments and factors in ethical decision-making, implement a version of the 'ideal observer' to consider human principles and values, and provide ethical explanations for both artificial and human agents. However, current AI architectures are unable to meet the conditions of moral agency, and algorithms are attributed with difficulties in meeting the requirements of autonomous moral agents. Additionally, algorithms are perceived as more likely to make utilitarian choices than human beings in moral dilemmas.
da: Forskere har undersøgt algoritmernes rolle i etisk beslutningstagning og moralsk agens. De har fundet, at algoritmer kan integrere forskellige vurderinger og faktorer i etisk beslutningstagning, implementere en version af den 'ideelle observatør' for at overveje menneskelige principper og værdier, og give etiske forklaringer for både kunstige og menneskelige agenter. Dog er nuværende AI-arkitekturer ikke i stand til at opfylde betingelserne for moral agens, og algoritmer tilskrives vanskeligheder med at imødekomme kravene fra autonome moralske agenter. Desuden opfattes algoritmer som mere tilbøjelige til at træffe utilitaristiske valg end mennesker i moralske dilemmaer.

title: Aspect-based sentiment analysis
en: Researchers have been investigating the current state-of-the-art in aspect-level sentiment analysis, using algorithms to categorize solutions based on aspect detection and sentiment analysis. They have also explored how algorithms can extract aspects from opinions and compare different methodologies. Additionally, algorithms have been used for unsupervised aspect category based sentiment classification, emotion detection, and implicit aspect identification in sentiment analysis.
da: Forskere har undersøgt den nuværende state-of-the-art inden for aspekt-niveau sentimentanalyse ved at bruge algoritmer til at kategorisere løsninger baseret på aspektdetektion og sentimentanalyse. De har også udforsket, hvordan algoritmer kan udtrække aspekter fra meninger og sammenligne forskellige metodologier. Derudover er algoritmer blevet brugt til usuperviseret aspektkategori-baseret sentimentklassifikation, følelsesdetektion og implicit aspektidentifikation i sentimentanalyse.

title: Neuromorphic Computing
en: Recent advances in artificial neural network research and their connection to intelligent systems are explored, comparing artificial models with biologically-feasible spiking neurons. Neuromorphic circuits are investigated as classifiers of complex real-world stimuli with low energy consumption, utilizing algorithms to enable practical implementation. The current state of neuromorphic computing based on spiking neural networks is surveyed, with algorithms playing a crucial role in building digital or analog computer systems that emulate the biological brain.
da: Nyere fremskridt inden for forskning i kunstige neurale netværk og deres forbindelse til intelligente systemer undersøges, idet der sammenlignes kunstige modeller med biologisk mulige spiking neuroner. Neuromorphic circuits undersøges som klassifikatorer af komplekse stimuli fra den virkelige verden med lavt energiforbrug, ved at udnytte algoritmer til at muliggøre praktisk implementering. Den nuværende tilstand af neuromorphic computing baseret på spiking neurale netværk bliver kortlagt, hvor algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i opbygningen af digitale eller analoge computersystemer, der efterligner den biologiske hjerne.

title: Autoencoder Advancements
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms called autoencoders to improve feature representation and extraction in machine learning. These algorithms, such as stacked sparse denoising autoencoders and extreme learning machines, have shown promising results in reducing data complexity, improving classification performance, and enhancing feature discrimination. By integrating different models and techniques, researchers are developing more efficient and reliable methods for unsupervised feature learning and selection. These advancements have the potential to enhance various applications, including image classification and high-dimensional data analysis.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer kaldet autoencoders for at forbedre funktionsrepræsentation og -udtrækning i maskinlæring. Disse algoritmer, såsom stacked sparse denoising autoencoders og extreme learning machines, har vist lovende resultater i at reducere datakompleksitet, forbedre klassificeringsydelse og styrke funktionsdiskrimination. Ved at integrere forskellige modeller og teknikker udvikler forskerne mere effektive og pålidelige metoder til usupervised funktionslæring og -valg. Disse fremskridt har potentiale til at forbedre forskellige applikationer, herunder billedeklassificering og analyse af højdimensionelle data.

title: Physics-inspired Modeling
en: Physics-inspired neural networks are being used to improve the modeling of electronic devices, incorporating fundamental device physics for accurate and efficient models. Artificial neural networks are also being used to accurately model advanced transistors, reproducing their characteristics with high accuracy. Machine learning algorithms are optimizing the network architecture of semiconductor device models, resulting in lower error and faster training compared to traditional models. These advancements in machine learning are enabling more accurate and efficient simulations of electronic devices, reducing design iterations and improving overall performance.
da: Fysik-inspirerede neurale netværk bruges til at forbedre modelleringen af elektroniske enheder ved at integrere grundlæggende enhedsfysik for at opnå præcise og effektive modeller. Kunstige neurale netværk anvendes også til nøjagtigt at modellere avancerede transistorer og reproducere deres karakteristika med høj præcision. Maskinlæringsalgoritmer optimerer netværksarkitekturen af halvleder enhedsmodeller, hvilket resulterer i lavere fejl og hurtigere træning sammenlignet med traditionelle modeller. Disse fremskridt inden for maskinlæring muliggør mere præcise og effektive simulationer af elektroniske enheder, mindsker designiterationer og forbedrer den overordnede ydeevne.

title: Pronunciation algorithms
en: Researchers have been investigating how algorithms can be used to improve English language learning and pronunciation. These algorithms are being used to develop speech training software that can provide effective feedback and correct pronunciation. Additionally, algorithms are being used to design automatic English pronunciation grading systems and speech recognition technology to enhance spoken English language learning.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at forbedre engelsk sprogindlæring og udtale. Disse algoritmer bruges til at udvikle tale-træningssoftware, der kan give effektiv feedback og rette udtale. Derudover anvendes algoritmer til at designe automatiske bedømmelsessystemer for engelsk udtale og talegenkendelsesteknologi for at forbedre den talte engelsk sprogindlæring.

title: Optimizing NFV Efficiency
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to address different research questions related to optimizing resource allocation, finding feasible paths and virtual function placement, selecting and chaining VNF instances, avoiding link overloads, optimizing deployment of service function chains, efficiently allocating service demands, making optimal scheduling decisions, achieving efficient use of resources, deploying service chains by exploiting correlations, efficiently routing traffic and placing VNFs, provisioning virtual network function service chains, solving joint optimization of service chain graph design and mapping, minimizing maximum load of links and nodes, placing virtual network functions in cloud computing environments, achieving end-to-end delay guaranteed service function chain deployment, optimizing joint design and mapping of service chains, and controlling service function chainings across geo-distributed datacenters. These algorithms aim to improve the performance and efficiency of network function virtualization (NFV) systems.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at adressere forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til optimering af ressourceallokering, finde mulige stier og placering af virtuelle funktioner, vælge og kæde VNF-instanser sammen, undgå linkoverbelastninger, optimere implementering af servicefunktionskæder, effektivt allokere serviceressourcer, træffe optimale planlægningsbeslutninger, opnå effektiv ressourceudnyttelse, implementere servicekæder ved at udnytte korrelationer, effektivt styre trafik og placere VNFs, provisionere virtuelle netværksfunktionsservicekæder, løse fælles optimering af design af servicekædeskemaer og kortlægning, minimere den maksimale belastning af links og noder, placere virtuelle netværksfunktioner i cloud computing-miljøer, opnå end-to-end forsinkelsesgaranteret servicefunktionskædeimplementering, optimere fælles design og kortlægning af servicekæder samt kontrollere servicefunktionskædning på tværs af geo-distribuerede datacentre. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre ydeevnen og effektiviteten af network function virtualization (NFV) systemer.

title: UAV tracking algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can improve the accuracy of vehicle detection and tracking from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). One method proposed is self-learning tracking and detection (SLTD), which allows the algorithm to continuously learn and improve its performance. Another algorithm called the MHT algorithm has been used to track targets in UAV aerial image sequences. Hybrid classifier-based methods and online learning-based trackers have also been developed to enhance visual object tracking for UAVs. These algorithms aim to make tracking more efficient and effective in various applications. Additionally, researchers have investigated the integration of 3D environment and the use of local feature matching and density clustering to improve UAV object tracking. The resolution of videos has also been found to affect the performance of visual tracking for UAVs, and algorithms have been developed to address this issue. Furthermore, computer vision algorithms have been utilized for anti-UAV detection and tracking. Overall, these studies highlight the potential of algorithms to enhance tracking capabilities and improve the monitoring and surveillance capabilities of UAVs.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af køretøjsdetektion og -tracking fra ubemandede fly (UAV'er). En foreslået metode er self-learning tracking and detection (SLTD), som gør det muligt for algoritmen at lære kontinuerligt og forbedre sin ydeevne. En anden algoritme kaldet MHT algoritmen er blevet brugt til at spore mål i UAV-aerialbilledsekvenser. Hybrid klassifikatorbaserede metoder og online learning-baserede trackere er også blevet udviklet for at forbedre visuel objekttracking for UAV'er. Disse algoritmer har til formål at gøre tracking mere effektiv og effektiv i forskellige applikationer. Derudover har forskere undersøgt integrationen af 3D-miljøer og brugen af lokal funktionsmatchning og tæthedsklyngedannelser for at forbedre UAV-objekttracking. Opløsningen af videoer er også blevet fundet at påvirke ydeevnen af visuel tracking for UAV'er, og algoritmer er blevet udviklet for at adressere dette problem. Desuden er computer vision algoritmer blevet anvendt til anti-UAV detektion og tracking. Overordnet set fremhæver disse studier potentialet af algoritmer til at forbedre trackingmulighederne og forbedre overvågnings- og kontrolkapaciteterne for UAV'er.

title: Deep Learning in Stock Prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of artificial neural networks and deep learning algorithms to predict stock market trends and improve forecasting accuracy. These algorithms, such as the Deep Neural Network (DNN) method and the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model, are being used to develop comprehensive deep learning systems and hybrid models that can accurately predict short-term stock market price trends. Additionally, sentiment analysis of financial news articles coupled with machine learning techniques is being used to improve stock price prediction accuracy.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af kunstige neurale netværk og deep learning-algoritmer til at forudsige børsmarkedets tendenser og forbedre forudsigelsesnøjagtigheden. Disse algoritmer, såsom Deep Neural Network (DNN) metoden og Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) modellen, bliver brugt til at udvikle omfattende deep learning-systemer og hybride modeller, der kan forudsige kortsigtede trends i børsmarkedets priser nøjagtigt. Derudover bliver sentimentanalyse af finansnyhedsartikler kombineret med machine learning-teknikker brugt til at forbedre nøjagtigheden af aktieprædiktionsmodeller.
