These algorithms offer advantages such as lower computational burden, faster convergence speed, and improved estimation accuracy. They utilize techniques like filtering, hierarchical approaches, and iterative estimation to achieve better performance in identifying and estimating the parameters and states of bilinear systems.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at tackle udfordringen med at estimere parametre og tilstande i bilineære systemer. Disse algoritmer tilbyder fordele som lavere beregningsbyrde, hurtigere konvergenshastighed og forbedret estimationsnøjagtighed. De anvender teknikker som filtrering, hierarkiske tilgange og iterativ estimering for at opnå bedre ydeevne i identifikationen og estimeringen af parametre og tilstande i bilineære systemer.

title: Algorithmic epidemiology
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various research questions related to the spread and control of infectious diseases, particularly COVID-19. These algorithms are being used to estimate contact patterns, visualize outbreak parameters, estimate exposure risks, identify individuals for testing based on contact tracing data, and implement digital contact tracing and surveillance systems. They are also being used to analyze mobility data, detect outbreak locations, optimize testing and quarantining strategies, and develop frameworks for modeling diseases and evaluating interventions. Overall, algorithms are playing a crucial role in understanding and combating the spread of COVID-19.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at adressere forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til spredningen og kontrollen af infektiøse sygdomme, især COVID-19. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at estimere kontaktmønstre, visualisere udbrudparametre, estimere eksponeringsrisici, identificere personer til test baseret på kontaktsporingsdata, samt implementere digitale kontaktsporings- og overvågningssystemer. De anvendes også til at analysere mobilitetsdata, opdage udbrudslokationer, optimere test- og karantænestrategier og udvikle rammer for modellering af sygdomme og evaluering af interventioner. Generelt spiller algoritmer en afgørende rolle i forståelsen og bekæmpelsen af spredningen af COVID-19.

title: Particle AI
en: Scientists are exploring the potential of algorithms, specifically convolutional neural networks and deep learning models, to improve various aspects of particle physics research. These algorithms are being used to identify particles, reconstruct their properties, enhance event selection, and improve simulation and reconstruction techniques. The results show that these machine learning approaches can achieve high accuracy and efficiency, surpassing traditional methods and speeding up the analysis process.
da: Forskere undersøger potentialet i algoritmer, specifikt convolutional neural networks og deep learning models, for at forbedre forskellige aspekter af partikeleksperimenter. Disse algoritmer bruges til at identificere partikler, rekonstruere deres egenskaber, forbedre udvælgelsen af hændelser og forbedre simulerings- og rekonstruktionsteknikker. Resultaterne viser, at disse machine learning-tilgange kan opnå høj nøjagtighed og effektivitet, hvilket overgår traditionelle metoder og fremskynder analyseprocessen.

title: Handwritten character recognition
en: Researchers have been exploring how different algorithms can improve the recognition of handwritten characters. They have investigated the use of neural network technology, character recognition technology, convolutional neural networks, deep learning technology, machine learning techniques, artificial intelligence neural networks, image processing, deep residual networks, and optimized models like LeNet-5 and ShuffleNet. These algorithms have shown promise in enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of recognizing various handwritten scripts, including Chinese, Tifinagh, Hindi, Bangla-Meitei Mayek, Kurdish, Tamil, and Devanagari characters.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan forskellige algoritmer kan forbedre genkendelsen af håndskrevne tegn. De har undersøgt brugen af neural netværksteknologi, character recognition technology, convolutional neural networks, deep learning technology, machine learning techniques, artificial intelligence neural networks, billedbehandling, deep residual networks og optimerede modeller som LeNet-5 og ShuffleNet. Disse algoritmer har vist sig lovende til at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af genkendelse af forskellige håndskrevne skrifter, herunder kinesiske, Tifinagh, hindi, Bangla-Meitei Mayek, kurdiske, tamil og Devanagari tegn.

title: Teaching evaluation algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can be used to evaluate and improve teaching quality in higher education. They have been using data mining technology and machine learning algorithms to analyze factors such as teachers' personal characteristics, teaching operations, and learner behavior. By applying these algorithms, they aim to develop intelligent teaching evaluation systems that can enhance the effectiveness of classroom teaching and online education.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at evaluere og forbedre undervisningskvaliteten i den videregående uddannelse. De har anvendt dataminingteknologi og machine learning-algoritmer til at analysere faktorer såsom lærerens personlige egenskaber, undervisningsoperationer og lærernes adfærd. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer har de til hensigt at udvikle intelligente undervisningsevalueringssystemer, der kan forbedre effektiviteten af klasseundervisning og online uddannelse.

title: EEG Signal Analysis Algorithms
en: Researchers have been using algorithms to address various research questions related to driver fatigue detection using EEG signals. These algorithms compare and analyze different features and classifiers to effectively detect driver fatigue. They also utilize techniques such as independent component analysis, Bayesian neural network, feature fusion, extreme learning machine, and support vector machine classification to classify driver fatigue based on EEG signals. Additionally, algorithms are used to analyze functional brain networks, extract features for driver fatigue state recognition, and detect different levels of driver fatigue.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at adressere forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til førertræthed detektering ved hjælp af EEG-signaler. Disse algoritmer sammenligner og analyserer forskellige funktioner og klassifikatorer for effektivt at detektere førertræthed. De benytter også teknikker såsom independent component analysis, Bayesian neural network, feature fusion, extreme learning machine, og support vector machine classification til at klassificere førertræthed baseret på EEG-signaler. Derudover anvendes algoritmer til at analysere funktionelle hjerne-netværk, udtrække funktioner til genkendelse af førertræthedstilstande og detektere forskellige niveauer af førertræthed.

title: 3D Point Cloud Compression
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to address the challenge of compressing 3D point cloud data while minimizing distortion and preserving important information. These algorithms utilize techniques such as mean-shift clustering, RANSAC algorithm, 2D DCT transform, region growing segmentation, polynomial equations, sampling-based compression, CNN-based up-sampling, motion estimation and compensation, quadric surface representation, occupancy images, fast coding unit algorithms, and more. By employing these algorithms, researchers aim to achieve efficient compression of point cloud data for storage and transmission, improve compression performances, reduce complexity, and optimize block size selection, among other objectives.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer til at tackle udfordringen med at komprimere 3D point cloud-data, samtidig med at de minimerer forvrængning og bevarer vigtig information. Disse algoritmer udnytter teknikker såsom mean-shift clustering, RANSAC algorithm, 2D DCT transform, region growing segmentation, polynomial equations, sampling-based compression, CNN-based up-sampling, motion estimation and compensation, quadric surface representation, occupancy images, fast coding unit algorithms, og mere. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at opnå effektiv kompression af point cloud-data til opbevaring og transmission, forbedre kompressionspræstationer, reducere kompleksitet og optimere blokstørrelsesvalg, blandt andre mål.

title: Enhanced speech quality
en: Specialized deep neural network-based speech enhancement systems can greatly improve the quality and intelligibility of speech. These systems use novel objective functions and perceptually motivated non-linear frequency scales to enhance the over-smoothed output features of DNN-based speech enhancement algorithms. Additionally, combining DNN with spectral phase estimation and using a hybrid approach with harmonic regeneration noise reduction can further enhance speech quality and intelligibility.
da: Specialized deep neural network-baserede tale forbedringssystemer kan i høj grad forbedre kvaliteten og forståeligheden af tale. Disse systemer anvender nye objektive funktioner og perceptuelt motiverede ikke-lineære frekvensskalaer for at forbedre de overglattede outputfunktioner af DNN-baserede tale forbedringsalgoritmer. Derudover kan en kombination af DNN med spektral faseestimering og brugen af en hybrid tilgang med harmonisk regenerering støjreduktion yderligere forbedre tale kvalitet og forståelighed.

title: Bearing fault diagnosis
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the accuracy and efficiency of bearing fault diagnosis. They have found that algorithms such as Deep Belief Networks, Support Vector Machines, Genetic Algorithms, and Locally Linear Embedding can be used to successfully discriminate and detect bearing fault conditions. By combining these algorithms with techniques like adaptive models, hierarchical severity diagnosis frameworks, and optimized self-adaptive networks, the accuracy of fault diagnosis can be significantly improved.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af fejldiagnose af lejer. De har fundet, at algoritmer som Deep Belief Networks, Support Vector Machines, Genetic Algorithms og Locally Linear Embedding kan anvendes til effektivt at skelne og registrere fejlforhold i lejer. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med teknikker som adaptive modeller, hierarkiske alvorlighedsdiagnose-rammer og optimerede selvadaptive netværk kan nøjagtigheden af fejldiagnosen forbedres betydeligt.

title: AI in Network Management
en: Researchers are exploring how machine learning algorithms can optimize various aspects of wireless communication networks. They are investigating the architecture and workflow of intelligent radio access networks, as well as how machine learning can improve network planning, management, and decision making in 5G and beyond networks. Additionally, they are studying how artificial intelligence and machine learning can contribute to the development of optimal management solutions and energy-saving methods in wireless networks.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan machine learning-algoritmer kan optimere forskellige aspekter af trådløse kommunikationsnetværk. De forsker i arkitekturen og arbejdsgangen i intelligente radio adgangsnetværk samt hvordan machine learning kan forbedre netværksplanlægning, styring og beslutningstagning i 5G-netværk og videre. Derudover studerer de, hvordan artificial intelligence og machine learning kan bidrage til udviklingen af optimale ledelsesløsninger og energibesparende metoder i trådløse netværk.

title: Intelligent fault diagnosis
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms for intelligent fault diagnosis in machinery. They have found that deep learning techniques, such as deep sparse autoencoders and stacked denoising autoencoders, can extract meaningful features from data and accurately identify fault severity. These algorithms can improve fault diagnosis accuracy and classify various types of faults in rotating machinery, without the need for labeled data.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til intelligent fejldiagnose i maskiner. De har fundet ud af, at dybe læringsteknikker, såsom deep sparse autoencoders og stacked denoising autoencoders, kan udtrække meningsfulde funktioner fra data og nøjagtigt identificere fejlniveauer. Disse algoritmer kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af fejldiagnose og klassificere forskellige typer af fejl i roterende maskiner uden behov for mærkede data.

title: Smart Agriculture
en: Researchers are exploring how modern smart technologies can be used to remotely manage and automate agricultural activities. They are leveraging artificial intelligence and analytics to analyze operational data and provide new insights for improved decision making in agriculture. Additionally, they are integrating IoT technology with other technologies to enhance agriculture practices and operations. These advancements aim to revolutionize farming processes, optimize resources, and improve crop management in smart agriculture.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan moderne smarte teknologier kan bruges til at styre og automatisere landbrugsaktiviteter på afstand. De udnytter artificial intelligence og analytics til at analysere driftsdata og give nye indsigter for forbedret beslutningstagning i landbruget. Derudover integrerer de IoT technology med andre teknologier for at forbedre landbrugspraksis og operationer. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at revolutionere landbrugsprocesser, optimere ressourcer og forbedre afgrødeledelse i smart agriculture.

title: Deep Modulation Recognition
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to improve automatic modulation classification in wireless communication systems. These algorithms, such as deep neural networks and convolutional neural networks, are designed to recognize and classify different types of digitally modulated signals. By leveraging the power of deep learning, these algorithms can extract hidden features and improve the accuracy of modulation recognition, which is crucial for applications like Internet of Things (IoT) and wireless communication.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer for at forbedre automatisk moduleringklassificering i trådløse kommunikasjonssystemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep neural networks og convolutional neural networks, er designet til at genkende og klassificere forskellige typer af digitelt modulerede signaler. Ved at udnytte kraften fra deep learning kan disse algoritmer udtrække skjulte funktioner og forbedre nøjagtigheden af moduleringgenkendelse, hvilket er afgørende for applikationer som Internet of Things (IoT) og trådløs kommunikation.

title: Steganalysis advancements
en: Researchers are exploring the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep learning techniques to improve steganalysis, which is the detection of hidden data in digital images. These algorithms are being investigated for their ability to extract discriminative features and improve detection accuracy for various types of steganography. The shift from traditional machine learning to deep learning approaches is also being examined in the field of digital image steganalysis.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af convolutional neural networks (CNNs) og deep learning teknikker for at forbedre steganalyse, som er opdagelsen af skjulte data i digitale billeder. Disse algoritmer bliver undersøgt for deres evne til at udtrække diskriminerende funktioner og forbedre detektionsnøjagtigheden for forskellige typer af steganografi. Overgangen fra traditionel maskinlæring til deep learning tilgange bliver også undersøgt inden for området for digital billedsteganalyse.

title: Algorithmic game theory
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can be used to solve complex problems in game theory. These algorithms are designed to seek the Nash equilibrium, which is a stable state where no player has an incentive to change their strategy. By developing distributed algorithms and continuous-time methods, scientists aim to find solutions for various types of games with different constraints and conditions.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan anvendes til at løse komplekse problemer inden for spilteori. Disse algoritmer er designet til at søge efter Nash-ligevægt, som er en stabil tilstand, hvor ingen spiller har incitament til at ændre sin strategi. Ved at udvikle distribuerede algoritmer og metoder i kontinuert tid sigter forskerne mod at finde løsninger for forskellige typer af spil med forskellige begrænsninger og betingelser.

title: MRI Reconstruction Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to improve the reconstruction of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) from undersampled data. These algorithms include convolutional sparse coding in the gradient domain, generative adversarial networks with cyclic loss, deep de-aliasing generative adversarial networks, deep cascade of convolutional neural networks, adaptive tight frame in the gradient domain, deep generative adversarial neural networks, multi-scale dilated residual convolution network, deep frequency-division network, efficient and light-weight MR reconstruction network, deep convolutional neural network architecture for CS-MRI, dual domain dense network, deep Gaussian denoisers, deartifacting module, transformer-based deep learning model, high-throughput fast iterative shrinkage thresholding network, and gradient-enhanced fusion network. These algorithms aim to enhance the quality and efficiency of MRI reconstruction, leading to improved medical imaging.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre rekonstruktionen af magnetisk resonansbillede (MRI) fra undersamplede data. Disse algoritmer inkluderer convolutional sparse coding i gradientdomænet, generative adversarial networks med cyklisk tab, deep de-aliasing generative adversarial networks, deep cascade of convolutional neural networks, adaptive tight frame i gradientdomænet, deep generative adversarial neural networks, multi-scale dilated residual convolution network, deep frequency-division network, efficient and light-weight MR reconstruction network, deep convolutional neural network architecture for CS-MRI, dual domain dense network, deep Gaussian denoisers, deartifacting module, transformer-based deep learning model, high-throughput fast iterative shrinkage thresholding network, og gradient-enhanced fusion network. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre kvaliteten og effektiviteten af MRI-rekonstruktion, hvilket fører til forbedret medicinsk billeddannelse.

title: 3D model retrieval
en: Researchers are exploring various methods to improve the retrieval of 3D models. They are using algorithms to develop unified frameworks, compute matching affinity, map spaces for metric learning, leverage 2D images for feature mapping, and extract visual features for classification. These algorithms are being used to enhance the performance of 3D model retrieval and classification, and to address challenges such as multi-modality, non-rigid models, and monocular image-based retrieval.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige metoder til at forbedre hentningen af 3D-modeller. De bruger algoritmer til at udvikle enhedlige rammer, beregne matchende affinitet, kortlægge rum til metrisk læring, udnytte 2D-billeder til funktionskortlægning og udtrække visuelle funktioner til klassificering. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forbedre ydeevnen af 3D model retrieval og klassificering, samt til at tackle udfordringer som multi-modality, non-rigid models og monocular image-based retrieval.

title: Optimizing Wireless Charging
en: Researchers are using algorithms to optimize the charging strategies and energy efficiency in wireless rechargeable sensor networks. These algorithms help maximize the charging utility of sensors, minimize charging tour length, optimize clustering methods, select charging nodes, plan charging paths, and schedule charging time. By using these algorithms, researchers aim to prolong network lifetime, improve charging efficiency, and enhance energy efficiency in these networks.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at optimere opladningsstrategierne og energieffektiviteten i trådløse genopladelige sensornetværk. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at maksimere opladningsnytten af sensorer, minimere længden af opladningsture, optimere klustermetoder, vælge opladningsnoder, planlægge opladningsveje og tidsplanlægge opladningstid. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer har forskere til hensigt at forlænge netværkets levetid, forbedre opladningseffektiviteten og øge energieffektiviteten i disse netværk.

title: Quadrotor control
en: Researchers have been exploring different algorithms to improve the control and stability of quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). These algorithms, such as adaptive sliding mode controllers and non-singular terminal sliding mode controllers, are designed to address specific challenges like attitude tracking, trajectory tracking, and disturbance rejection. By using these advanced algorithms, researchers aim to enhance the performance and robustness of quadrotor UAVs, making them more reliable and capable of handling external disturbances and uncertainties.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre kontrollen og stabiliteten af quadrotor ubemandede luftfartøjer (UAVs). Disse algoritmer, såsom adaptive sliding mode controllers og non-singular terminal sliding mode controllers, er designet til at tackle specifikke udfordringer som attitude tracking, trajectory tracking og disturbance rejection. Ved at bruge disse avancerede algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre ydeevnen og robustheden af quadrotor UAVs, hvilket gør dem mere pålidelige og i stand til at håndtere eksterne forstyrrelser og usikkerheder.

title: mmWave optimization
en: Researchers are using algorithms to design and optimize various aspects of millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication systems. These algorithms are being used to develop hybrid beamforming and precoding techniques, which improve the performance and efficiency of multi-user massive MIMO systems over mmWave channels. By utilizing algorithms, researchers are able to design low-complexity hybrid precoders and beamformers, integrate mmWave with hybrid precoding for 5G communication, and optimize transceiver design in full-duplex multi-user massive MIMO systems.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at designe og optimere forskellige aspekter af millimeter-wave (mmWave) kommunikationssystemer. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at udvikle hybrid beamforming og precoding teknikker, som forbedrer ydeevnen og effektiviteten af multi-user massive MIMO systemer over mmWave kanaler. Ved at udnytte algoritmer er forskere i stand til at designe lavkompleksitets hybrid precoders og beamformers, integrere mmWave med hybrid precoding til 5G kommunikation og optimere transceiver design i fullduplex multi-user massive MIMO systemer.

title: Fashion AI
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms in the field of fashion. They have developed systems that can automatically compose fashion outfits, retrieve aesthetically similar fashion items, classify fashion product features, analyze fashion trends, and even assist fashion designers in decision-making. These algorithms use techniques such as deep learning, computer vision, and machine learning to analyze fashion data and provide valuable insights to the fashion industry.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af kunstig intelligens (AI) algoritmer inden for mode. De har udviklet systemer, der automatisk kan sammensætte modeoutfits, hente æstetisk lignende modegenstande, klassificere modeprodukters funktioner, analysere modetrends og endda assistere modedesignere i beslutningstagning. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker som deep learning, computer vision og machine learning til at analysere modedata og give værdifulde indsigter til modeindustrien.

title: Travel mode prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the effectiveness of various machine learning algorithms in modeling travel mode choice. These algorithms, such as extreme gradient boosting, random forest, and interpretable machine learning techniques, are being used to predict and analyze travel mode choice behavior. By considering behavioral theory and using household travel survey data, machine learning algorithms are enhancing the accuracy of travel mode choice prediction.
da: Forskere har undersøgt effektiviteten af forskellige maskinlæringsalgoritmer i modelleringen af valg af rejseform. Disse algoritmer, såsom extreme gradient boosting, random forest og interpretable machine learning teknikker, bliver brugt til at forudsige og analysere adfærd ved valg af rejseform. Ved at tage højde for adfærdsteori og anvende data fra husstanders rejseundersøgelser, forbedrer maskinlæringsalgoritmerne nøjagtigheden af forudsigelsen af rejseformvalg.

title: Decentralized Control Algorithms
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to address different research questions in the field of robotics. These algorithms, such as the PLPE neural network, adaptive dynamic programming (ADP), and recurrent neural network (RNN), are used to achieve decentralized control, fault tolerance, and optimal performance for modular and reconfigurable robot manipulators. By implementing these algorithms, scientists aim to improve the effectiveness, accuracy, and adaptability of robots in uncertain and complex environments.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål inden for robotik. Disse algoritmer, såsom PLPE neural network, adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) og recurrent neural network (RNN), bruges til at opnå decentraliseret kontrol, fejltolerance og optimal ydeevne for modulære og rekonfigurerbare robot manipulators. Ved at implementere disse algoritmer har forskerne til formål at forbedre effektiviteten, nøjagtigheden og tilpasningsevnen af robotter i usikre og komplekse miljøer.

title: Polyp detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve the detection of polyps during colonoscopy. They have found that convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the most effective method for detecting polyps, with high sensitivity and specificity. These algorithms can assist endoscopists in real-time, accurately localizing and classifying polyps, ultimately improving the detection and diagnosis of colorectal lesions.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre detektion af polypper under koloskopi. De har fundet ud af, at convolutional neural networks (CNNs) er den mest effektive metode til at opdage polypper, med høj følsomhed og specificitet. Disse algoritmer kan assistere endoskoper i realtid ved præcist at lokalisere og klassificere polypper, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer detektionen og diagnosen af kolorektale læsioner.

title: Deep Learning Traffic Predictions
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to accurately predict traffic flows in the short-term. These algorithms capture the complex patterns and dependencies in traffic data, allowing for more accurate predictions. Additionally, deep learning models show promise in improving the accuracy of traffic flow prediction, especially when combined with other deep learning methods. Overall, deep learning-based techniques are proving to be effective in predicting road traffic and have the potential to greatly improve traffic management and planning.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer bliver brugt til nøjagtigt at forudsige trafikstrømme på kort sigt. Disse algoritmer fanger de komplekse mønstre og afhængigheder i trafikdata, hvilket muliggør mere præcise forudsigelser. Derudover viser deep learning-modeller lovende resultater i at forbedre nøjagtigheden af trafikstrømsforudsigelser, især når de kombineres med andre deep learning-metoder. Samlet set viser deep learning-baserede teknikker sig at være effektive til at forudsige vejtrafik og har potentiale til i høj grad at forbedre trafikstyring og planlægning.

title: Adaptive Consensus Strategies
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various research questions related to achieving consensus in multi-agent systems. These algorithms are designed to enable adaptive, distributed, and data-driven approaches for achieving bipartite consensus, tracking consensus, and output consensus in nonlinear and heterogeneous systems. The use of algorithms allows for the development of control protocols and strategies that can handle uncertainties, disturbances, and switching topologies, ultimately leading to efficient and effective coordination among multiple agents.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til at opnå konsensus i multi-agent systemer. Disse algoritmer er designet til at muliggøre adaptive, distribuerede og datadrevne tilgange til at opnå bipartit konsensus, spore konsensus og output konsensus i ikke-lineære og heterogene systemer. Brugen af algoritmer muliggør udviklingen af kontrolprotokoller og strategier, der kan håndtere usikkerheder, forstyrrelser og skiftende topologier, hvilket i sidste ende fører til effektiv og målrettet koordinering blandt flere agenter.

title: Video anomaly detection
en: Researchers have been exploring various machine learning techniques for anomaly detection in video surveillance. They have investigated advancements in anomaly detection in surveillance videos, as well as the use of deep learning approaches and spatiotemporal representation learning for video-based anomalous activity detection. Additionally, they have developed models such as 2D CNN and stacked LSTM with deep active learning-based models, novel two-stream structures, and optimization-enabled deep convolutional neural networks for advanced video anomaly detection in smart city management and traffic surveillance. These studies aim to develop efficient and robust deep learning-based methods for anomaly detection in video surveillance.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige maskinlæringsteknikker til anomalidetektion i videoovervågning. De har indgået i fremskridt inden for anomalidetektion i overvågningsvideoer samt brugen af deep learning-tilgange og spatiotemporalt repræsentationslæring til detektion af atypisk aktivitet i video. Desuden har de udviklet modeller som 2D CNN og stakkede LSTM med dybe aktive læringsbaserede modeller, nye to-strøms strukturer og optimeringsmuligheder i dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværk til avanceret videoanomalidetektion i smart city management og trafikovervågning. Disse studier har til formål at udvikle effektive og robuste dyb læringsbaserede metoder til anomalidetektion i videoovervågning.

title: Smart Farming
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of wireless sensors and deep learning algorithms in agricultural monitoring systems to optimize routing allocation and develop classification models for continuous monitoring of soil temperature and humidity. Additionally, machine learning and deep learning algorithms have been evaluated for crop yield prediction in agriculture using crop yield data and remote sensing data. These algorithms have shown superior performance in terms of accuracy and can address challenges such as uncertain rainfall, crop disease prediction, and labor shortage in agriculture.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af trådløse sensorer og deep learning-algoritmer i landbrugsovervågningssystemer for at optimere rutetildeling og udvikle klassifikationsmodeller til kontinuerlig overvågning af jordtemperatur og fugtighed. Derudover er machine learning- og deep learning-algoritmer blevet evalueret til forudsigelse af afgrødeudbytte i landbruget ved hjælp af afgrødeudbyttedata og fjernmåldata. Disse algoritmer har vist en overlegen præstation med hensyn til nøjagtighed og kan tackle udfordringer som usikker nedbør, forudsigelse af afgrødesygdomme og arbejdsstyrkemangel i landbruget.

title: AI Radiology
en: AI algorithms can be used in radiology to improve outcomes and reduce costs by finding patterns in data beyond human abilities and providing interpretations for precision healthcare. Machine learning can augment and improve the quality of care provided by radiologists, demonstrating their value and enhancing patient outcomes. These algorithms can also be used for risk assessment, detection, diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy response in medical imaging, improving performance and efficiency in radiology practices.
da: AI-algoritmer kan anvendes i radiologi for at forbedre resultaterne og reducere omkostningerne ved at finde mønstre i data udover menneskelige evner og give fortolkninger til præcisionssundhedspleje. Maskinlæring kan forstærke og forbedre kvaliteten af den pleje, der gives af radiologer, hvilket demonstrerer deres værdi og forbedrer patientresultaterne. Disse algoritmer kan også anvendes til risikovurdering, detektion, diagnose, prognose og terapirespons i medicinsk billeddannelse, hvilket forbedrer ydeevnen og effektiviteten i radiologiske praksisser.

title: AI-aided CT diagnosis
en: Researchers have been investigating the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms in detecting critical findings in head CT scans. These algorithms have shown promise in accurately detecting and classifying intracranial hemorrhages, fractures, and other abnormalities. By improving the diagnostic accuracy and reducing the time to diagnosis, AI algorithms have the potential to assist radiologists and improve patient outcomes in various clinical settings.
da: Forskere har undersøgt kapaciteterne af kunstig intelligens (AI) algoritmer i at detektere kritiske fund i hoved-CT-scanninger. Disse algoritmer har vist sig lovende i nøjagtigt at detektere og klassificere intrakranielle blødninger, frakturer og andre unormaliteter. Ved at forbedre den diagnostiske nøjagtighed og reducere tiden til diagnose har AI-algoritmer potentialet til at hjælpe radiologer og forbedre patientresultater i forskellige kliniske sammenhænge.

title: Lung Cancer Prognostic Algorithms
en: Researchers have been using algorithms to analyze medical imaging data in order to predict various outcomes in lung cancer patients. These algorithms, such as support vector machines and logistic regression models, are trained to assess the performance of radiomics features in predicting prognosis, tumor differentiation, clinical outcomes, and even response to immunotherapy. By combining radiomic features with clinical factors, these algorithms can provide valuable insights into the diagnosis and treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at analysere medicinske billeddata for at forudsige forskellige udfald hos lungekræftpatienter. Disse algoritmer, såsom support vector machines og logistic regression models, er trænet til at vurdere ydelsen af radiomics-funktioner i forudsigelsen af prognose, tumor differentiation, kliniske udfald og endda respons på immunterapi. Ved at kombinere radiomiske funktioner med kliniske faktorer kan disse algoritmer give værdifulde indsigter i diagnosen og behandlingen af ikke-småcellet lungekræft.

title: Fetal AI Advancements
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to automate various aspects of fetal health assessment. These algorithms, based on deep learning and machine learning techniques, can automatically verify the acquisition of fetal diagnostic planes, estimate fetal biometry from ultrasound images, assess fetal health in the first trimester, improve the classification of ultrasound images, identify standard planes in fetal brain ultrasound scans, detect fetal abnormalities, predict fetal biometry, estimate gestational age, and estimate placental and fetal volumes from MRI scans. These advancements in artificial intelligence have the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of fetal health monitoring.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at automatisere forskellige aspekter af vurderingen af føtal sundhed. Disse algoritmer, baseret på deep learning og machine learning teknikker, kan automatisk verificere erhvervelsen af føtale diagnostiske planer, estimere føtal biometri fra ultralydsbilleder, vurdere føtal sundhed i første trimester, forbedre klassificeringen af ultralydsbilleder, identificere standardplaner i føtal hjernen ultralydsscanninger, opdage føtale abnormiteter, forudsige føtal biometri, estimere gestationsalder og estimere placentale og føtale volumener fra MRI-scanninger. Disse fremskridt inden for kunstig intelligens har potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af føtal sundhedsovervågning.

title: Deep Learning Vessel Detection
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to accurately segment retinal vessels in medical images. These algorithms, based on neural networks and deep learning models, have shown superior performance compared to traditional methods. They do not rely on hand-crafted features and can achieve improved accuracy and robustness in vessel segmentation, especially for thin blood vessels.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til præcist at segmentere retinal kar i medicinske billeder. Disse algoritmer, baseret på neural netværk og deep learning-modeller, har vist overlegen præstation sammenlignet med traditionelle metoder. De er ikke afhængige af håndlavede funktioner og kan opnå forbedret nøjagtighed og robusthed i kar-segmentering, især for tynde blodkar.

title: Fracture detection
en: Deep learning algorithms have shown promising results in analyzing orthopedic trauma radiographs, performing at a human level in diagnosing fractures. These algorithms can improve fracture detection by clinicians, delivering the expertise of senior medical specialists to generalists and enhancing patient care. Additionally, deep learning technology has gained momentum in fracture detection, with algorithms approaching the performance level of human subspecialists in detecting various types of fractures.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i analysen af ortopædisk traume-røntgenbilleder og præsterer på menneskeligt niveau i diagnosticeringen af frakturer. Disse algoritmer kan forbedre frakturdetektionen hos klinikere, ved at overføre ekspertisen fra erfarne medicinske specialister til generalister og dermed forbedre patientplejen. Derudover har deep learning-teknologi fået moment i frakturdetektion, hvor algoritmer nærmer sig præstationsniveauet hos menneskelige subspecialister i detektion af forskellige typer frakturer.

title: Cervical cancer diagnosis
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to improve the diagnosis of cervical cancer. These algorithms can directly classify cervical cells based on deep features, automate the identification and classification of cervical cells, and assist in the fast screening and diagnosis of cervical lesions. By utilizing deep learning techniques, these algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of cervical cancer diagnosis, potentially leading to earlier detection and improved patient outcomes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer for at forbedre diagnosen af livmoderhalskræft. Disse algoritmer kan direkte klassificere cervikale celler baseret på dybe træk, automatisere identifikationen og klassificeringen af cervikale celler samt hjælpe med hurtig screening og diagnose af cervikale læsioner. Ved at udnytte deep learning-teknikker sigter disse algoritmer mod at øge nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af livmoderhalskræftdiagnose, hvilket potentielt kan føre til tidligere opdagelse og forbedrede patientresultater.

title: Motor function prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict and assess motor function in stroke patients. By combining various biomarkers and using machine learning techniques, these algorithms can accurately predict outcomes such as upper limb function, motor impairment, motor function improvement, clinical outcomes during rehabilitation, and even the long-term outcome and quality of life of stroke patients. Additionally, machine learning algorithms have been used to develop shorter forms of assessment scales, making the process more efficient and accessible.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige og vurdere motorfunktion hos patienter, der har lidt af slagtilfælde. Ved at kombinere forskellige biomarkører og anvende maskinlæringsteknikker kan disse algoritmer præcist forudsige udfald såsom funktion i overkrogen, motorisk impairment, forbedring af motorfunktion, kliniske udfald under rehabilitering, og endda det langsigtede udfald og livskvalitet for slagtilfældepatienter. Derudover er maskinlæringsalgoritmer blevet brugt til at udvikle kortere former for vurderingsskalaer, hvilket gør processen mere effektiv og tilgængelig.

title: Surgical AI
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms in various aspects of minimally invasive surgery. These algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks and deep learning networks, are being used to track surgical instruments, assist in navigation, estimate pose and depth, improve instrument delineation, and more. The goal is to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of surgical procedures by leveraging the capabilities of these advanced algorithms.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-algoritmer i forskellige aspekter af minimalt invasiv kirurgi. Disse algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks og deep learning networks, bruges til at spore kirurgiske instrumenter, assistere i navigation, estimere position og dybde, forbedre instrumentdelineation og mere. Målet er at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af kirurgiske procedurer ved at udnytte kapaciteterne i disse avancerede algoritmer.

title: Sleep algorithm evaluation
en: Researchers have been investigating the accuracy and validity of various algorithms used in wearable devices for measuring sleep stages. These algorithms, such as the automated sleep stage estimation algorithm, the S+ algorithm, Fitbit's proprietary interpretative algorithm, and machine learning methods, are being compared to gold standard methods like polysomnography. The goal is to determine how well these algorithms can detect and classify sleep stages, providing users with valuable insights into their sleep patterns.
da: Forskere har undersøgt nøjagtigheden og gyldigheden af forskellige algoritmer, der anvendes i bærbare enheder til at måle søvnstadier. Disse algoritmer, såsom den automatiserede søvnstadie estimationsalgoritme, S+ algoritmen, Fitbits proprietære fortolkningsalgoritme og metoder indenfor machine learning, bliver sammenlignet med guldstandardmetoder som polysomnografi. Målet er at bestemme, hvor godt disse algoritmer kan opdage og klassificere søvnstadier, hvilket giver brugerne værdifulde indsigter i deres søvnmønstre.

title: Automated organ segmentation
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to automatically segment and identify organs in medical images such as CT scans. These algorithms, such as pixel-to-label deep learning and convolutional neural networks, are designed to accurately detect and segment anatomical structures. By utilizing these advanced algorithms, researchers aim to improve the efficiency and accuracy of organ segmentation, which can have significant implications for medical diagnosis and treatment planning.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til automatisk at segmentere og identificere organer i medicinske billeder som CT-scanninger. Disse algoritmer, såsom pixel-to-label deep learning og convolutional neural networks, er designet til præcist at detektere og segmentere anatomiske strukturer. Ved at udnytte disse avancerede algoritmer ønsker forskerne at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af organsegmentering, hvilket kan have betydelige konsekvenser for medicinsk diagnose og behandlingsplanlægning.

title: Environmental Risk Score
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to improve the construction of an Environmental Risk Score for cardiovascular disease. Various machine learning models, such as logistic regression and decision trees, are being compared to predict hypercholesterolemia associated with exposure to lead, mercury, and cadmium. Additionally, machine learning models are being used to explore the associations between heavy metal exposure and health conditions like kidney function, osteoarthritis, diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular diseases.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bruges til at forbedre konstruktionen af en Miljørisikoscore for hjerte-kar-sygdomme. Forskellige maskinlæringsmodeller, såsom logistisk regression og beslutningstræer, sammenlignes for at forudsige hyperkolesterolæmi forbundet med eksponering for bly, kviksølv og cadmium. Derudover anvendes maskinlæringsmodeller til at udforske sammenhængene mellem eksponering for tungmetaller og sundhedstilstande som nyrefunktion, slidgigt, diabetes, hypertension og hjerte-kar-sygdomme.

title: AI-enhanced breast cancer diagnosis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning frameworks, generic deep learning software, deep convolutional neural networks, and other artificial intelligence tools to diagnose and classify breast cancer using ultrasound images. These algorithms are being developed to mimic human decision-making and improve the accuracy of breast lesion diagnosis. Machine learning techniques and computer-aided detection systems are also being used to enhance breast cancer detection and establish risk stratification systems.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning frameworks, generisk deep learning software, deep convolutional neural networks og andre kunstige intelligens-værktøjer til at diagnosticere og klassificere brystkræft ved hjælp af ultralydsbilleder. Disse algoritmer udvikles til at efterligne menneskelig beslutningstagning og forbedre nøjagtigheden af brystlesionsdiagnose. Maskinlæringsteknikker og computerassisterede detektionssystemer anvendes også til at forbedre brystkræftdetektion og etablere risikostratiseringssystemer.

title: Radiation therapy automation
en: Machine learning algorithms can accurately predict and classify various quality assurance outcomes in radiation therapy. These algorithms can be used to automate treatment planning, detect errors, and improve the prediction and classification of specific quality assurance parameters. They have the potential to streamline the quality assurance process and enhance the accuracy and efficiency of radiation therapy treatments.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer kan præcist forudsige og klassificere forskellige kvalitetssikringsresultater inden for strålebehandling. Disse algoritmer kan bruges til at automatisere behandlingsplanlægning, opdage fejl og forbedre forudsigelsen og klassificeringen af specifikke kvalitetssikringsparametre. De har potentiale til at strømline kvalitetssikringsprocessen og forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af strålebehandlingsbehandlinger.

title: Nanofluid Efficiency
en: Scientists have been studying the effects of using nanofluids in solar thermal electric power plants. They are using algorithms like Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations and Finite Volume Method (FVM) to understand how different factors, such as the shape of the collector and the type of nanofluid, impact the efficiency and performance of the solar collectors. By analyzing these factors, researchers hope to improve the design and effectiveness of solar collectors, making them more efficient and sustainable.
da: Forskere har studeret effekterne af at bruge nanofluid i soltermiske kraftværker. De bruger algoritmer som Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simuleringer og Finite Volume Method (FVM) for at forstå, hvordan forskellige faktorer, såsom formen på kollektoren og typen af nanofluid, påvirker effektiviteten og ydelsen af solkollektorerne. Ved at analysere disse faktorer håber forskerne at forbedre designet og effektiviteten af solkollektorerne, hvilket gør dem mere effektive og bæredygtige.

title: Deep Learning Nodule Classification
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve the diagnosis of thyroid nodules in ultrasound images. They are investigating whether deep learning approaches, such as convolutional neural networks, can accurately classify and predict the nature of these nodules. The goal is to develop computer-aided diagnosis systems that can assist radiologists in making more objective and reliable diagnoses, potentially reducing the need for unnecessary procedures like fine needle aspiration.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre diagnosen af skjoldbruskkirtelnoduler i ultralydsbilleder. De undersøger, om deep learning-tilgange, såsom convolutional neural networks, kan klassificere og forudsige arten af disse noduler nøjagtigt. Målet er at udvikle computer-assisterede diagnosesystemer, der kan hjælpe radiologer med at foretage mere objektive og pålidelige diagnoser, hvilket potentielt kan reducere behovet for unødvendige procedurer som fin-nålsaspiration.

title: Muscle analysis algorithms
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of algorithms to accurately analyze and measure muscle tissue on computed tomography (CT) scans. These algorithms, based on deep learning and machine learning techniques, have shown promising results in segmenting and quantifying different muscle groups. The automated systems are able to provide accurate measurements and assessments, which can help in diagnosing conditions related to muscle composition and overall body composition.
da: Forskere har undersøgt anvendelsen af algoritmer til præcist at analysere og måle muskelvæv på computertomografi (CT) scanninger. Disse algoritmer, baseret på deep learning og machine learning teknikker, har vist lovende resultater i segmentering og kvantificering af forskellige muskelgrupper. De automatiserede systemer er i stand til at levere nøjagtige målinger og vurderinger, hvilket kan hjælpe med at diagnosticere tilstande relateret til muskelkomposition og den samlede kroppens sammensætning.

title: Suicide risk prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to predict suicide attempts in individuals with schizophrenia, as well as to advance suicide prediction in general. These algorithms offer a promising method for incorporating clinical features and accurately detecting suicide risk. They can also be used to identify individuals at risk for suicide attempts among adolescents and in Native American communities. Machine learning approaches have the potential to improve the prediction of future suicidal behavior, support early identification of individuals at risk, and classify suicidal thoughts and behaviors. These algorithms can also identify risk factors for suicidal ideation and attempt in specific populations, such as the Korean population and Brazilians with common mental disorders. Overall, machine learning models show good prediction performance in identifying suicide risk and can be a valuable tool in suicide prevention.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bliver brugt til at forudsige selvmordsforsøg hos individer med skizofreni, samt til at fremme selvmordsforudsigelse generelt. Disse algoritmer tilbyder en lovende metode til at inkorporere kliniske træk og nøjagtigt detektere selvmordsrisiko. De kan også bruges til at identificere individer, der er i risiko for selvmordsforsøg blandt unge og i Native American-samfund. Maskinlæringsmetoder har potentiale til at forbedre forudsigelsen af fremtidig selvmordsmæssig adfærd, støtte tidlig identifikation af risikopersoner og klassificere selvmordstanker og -adfærd. Disse algoritmer kan også identificere risikofaktorer for selvmordstanker og -forsøg i specifikke befolkninger, såsom den koreanske befolkning og brasilianere med almindelige mentale lidelser. Samlet set viser maskinlæringsmodeller god forudsigelsespræstation i at identificere selvmordsrisiko og kan være et værdifuldt værktøj i selvmordsforebyggelse.

title: Single-photon 3D Imaging
en: Scientists are exploring the capabilities of single-photon imaging technology for achieving high-precision 3D imaging over long distances. They are using various algorithms, such as total variation restoration optimization, modified total variation regularization, and bespoke algorithms for restoration of multilayered 3D images, to reconstruct depth and intensity profiles from single-photon detection data. These algorithms enable real-time 3D reconstruction of dynamic scenes, even in low-light conditions and through atmospheric obscurants, making single-photon imaging a promising tool for a wide range of applications.
da: Forskere undersøger mulighederne for single-photon imaging teknologi til at opnå højpræcisions 3D-billeder over lange afstande. De anvender forskellige algoritmer, såsom total variation restoration optimization, modified total variation regularization og skræddersyede algoritmer til restaurering af multilayered 3D billeder, for at rekonstruere dybde- og intensitetsprofiler fra single-photon detection data. Disse algoritmer muliggør realtids 3D-rekonstruktion af dynamiske scener, selv under lavbelysningsforhold og gennem atmosfæriske obscurants, hvilket gør single-photon imaging til et lovende værktøj til en bred vifte af anvendelser.

title: Fracture prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to improve the prediction of hip fractures and other related conditions. These algorithms, such as machine learning principles, classification and regression trees, and supervised machine learning, are being used to analyze various types of data, including MRI scans, administrative claims data, and electronic health records. By harnessing the power of these algorithms, scientists hope to develop more accurate fracture prediction models and improve clinical detection of conditions like osteoporosis and low bone mineral density.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af machine learning-algoritmer for at forbedre forudsigelsen af hoftefrakturer og andre relaterede tilstande. Disse algoritmer, såsom machine learning-principper, klassifikations- og regressionstræer og supervised machine learning, bruges til at analysere forskellige typer data, herunder MRI-scanninger, administrative kravdata og elektroniske sundhedsoptegnelser. Ved at udnytte kraften i disse algoritmer håber videnskabsfolk at udvikle mere præcise frakturforudsigelsesmodeller og forbedre klinisk opdagelse af tilstande som osteoporose og lav knoglemineraltethed.

title: Gas sensor algorithms
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve the performance of gas sensors. These algorithms, such as pattern recognition, data processing, and machine learning, are being used to help gas sensors differentiate between different types of hazardous gases, detect and identify gas mixtures, and predict gas concentrations. By combining gas sensors with these algorithms, researchers hope to enhance the selectivity and accuracy of gas detection, making it easier to monitor and trace various gas species.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer for at forbedre performancen af gas sensorer. Disse algoritmer, såsom pattern recognition, data processing og machine learning, anvendes til at hjælpe gas sensorer med at differentiere mellem forskellige typer af farlige gasser, opdage og identificere gaskombinationer og forudsige gaskoncentrationer. Ved at kombinere gas sensorer med disse algoritmer håber forskerne at forbedre selektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af gasdetektion, hvilket gør det lettere at overvåge og spore forskellige gaskomponenter.

title: Radar Vital Signs
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of radar technology to monitor vital signs such as heart rate and respiration without physical contact. Algorithms have been developed to separate and extract these signals from radar measurements, even in the presence of interference from body movements. Different radar-based approaches, including impulse radar and frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar, have been explored, and various signal processing techniques have been employed to accurately detect and track vital signs. These advancements in radar technology and algorithm development offer the potential for non-contact and robust monitoring of human vital signs in real-time.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af radar teknologi til at overvåge vitale tegn såsom hjerterytme og respiration uden fysisk kontakt. Algoritmer er blevet udviklet til at adskille og udtrække disse signaler fra radar målinger, selv i nærvær af interferens fra kropsbevægelser. Forskellige radar-baserede tilgange, herunder impulse radar og frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar, er blevet udforsket, og forskellige signalbehandlings teknikker er blevet anvendt for præcist at detektere og spore vitale tegn. Disse fremskridt inden for radar teknologi og algoritmeudvikling tilbyder potentiale for non-kontakt og robust overvågning af menneskelige vitale tegn i realtid.

title: Deep Segmentation
en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are being used to accurately segment organs-at-risk in medical images, showing similar or better performance compared to other algorithms and commercial software. Automated quality assurance systems based on deep active learning can improve the accuracy of organ contouring for lung cancer, providing consistent and objective evaluations. Deep learning-based auto-segmentation is feasible and accurate for multiple organs and clinical target volumes in breast cancer, offering more consistent and robust performance compared to existing solutions. These advancements in algorithmic segmentation have the potential to improve the efficiency, consistency, and safety of radiotherapy planning and treatment.
da: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) bruges til præcist at segmentere organer i risiko i medicinske billeder, hvilket viser lignende eller bedre præstation sammenlignet med andre algoritmer og kommerciel software. Automatiserede kvalitetssikringssystemer baseret på deep active learning kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af organkonturering ved lungekræft og give konsistente og objektive evalueringer. Deep learning-baseret auto-segmentering er gennemførlig og præcis for flere organer og kliniske målvolumener ved brystkræft, hvilket tilbyder en mere konsistent og robust præstation sammenlignet med eksisterende løsninger. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmisk segmentering har potentiale til at forbedre effektiviteten, konsistensen og sikkerheden ved planlægning og behandling af strålebehandling.

title: VTE risk prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to predict the risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in various medical scenarios. These algorithms, such as support vector machines, random forest, and logistic regression, are being employed to develop risk prediction models for cancer patients, COVID-19 patients, critically ill patients, and those undergoing surgery. By analyzing different predictors and using optimization techniques, these algorithms aim to outperform existing scoring systems and improve the accuracy of VTE risk prediction.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer anvendes til at forudsige risikoen for venøs tromboembolisme (VTE) i forskellige medicinske scenarier. Disse algoritmer, såsom support vector machines, random forest og logistic regression, anvendes til at udvikle risikoprediktionsmodeller for kræftpatienter, COVID-19 patienter, kritisk syge patienter og personer, der gennemgår operation. Ved at analysere forskellige prediktorer og anvende optimeringsteknikker har disse algoritmer til formål at overgå eksisterende scoringssystemer og forbedre nøjagtigheden af VTE risikoprediktion.

title: Battery life prediction
en: Scientists have been exploring various algorithms to accurately predict the remaining useful life of lithium-ion batteries. These algorithms include particle learning framework, exponential model and particle filter, artificial neural network, auto-regression and particle filter, Wiener process and unscented particle filter, grey model and particle filtering, hybrid algorithm of particle filter and extended unbiased finite impulse response filter, extended Kalman particle filter, electrochemical model in the particle filter framework, smooth particle filter-based likelihood approximation method, Dempster-Shafer theory and support vector regression-particle filter, non-parametric aging model and particle filter algorithm, and improved particle filtering algorithm. These algorithms aim to estimate the state-of-health and predict the remaining useful life of lithium-ion batteries, which could have significant implications for battery performance and longevity.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige algoritmer for nøjagtigt at forudsige den resterende nyttige levetid for lithium-ion batterier. Disse algoritmer omfatter particle learning framework, exponential model og particle filter, artificial neural network, auto-regression og particle filter, Wiener process og unscented particle filter, grey model og particle filtering, hybrid algorithm of particle filter og extended unbiased finite impulse response filter, extended Kalman particle filter, elektro-kemisk model i particle filter rammeværket, smooth particle filter-baseret likelihood approximation metode, Dempster-Shafer teori og support vector regression-particle filter, non-parametric aging model og particle filter algoritme, samt improved particle filtering algorithm. Disse algoritmer har til formål at estimere tilstand-for-sundhed og forudsige den resterende nyttige levetid for lithium-ion batterier, hvilket kan have betydelige konsekvenser for batteriets ydeevne og levetid.

title: Transfusion prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of predictive modeling and machine learning algorithms to improve blood transfusion practices in various medical procedures. These algorithms are being used to predict the need for transfusion in elective surgery, hospitalized patients, knee arthroplasty, pelvic fracture patients, liver transplantation surgery, cardiac surgery, and more. By analyzing preoperative and intraoperative data, these algorithms can identify risks of postoperative complications and predict the need for transfusion, potentially improving patient outcomes and reducing the need for unnecessary transfusions.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af predictive modeling og machine learning algoritmer for at forbedre blodtransfusionspraksis i forskellige medicinske procedurer. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forudsige behovet for transfusion ved elektiv kirurgi, indlagte patienter, knæartroplasti, bækkenfrakturpatienter, levertransplantationskirurgi, hjertekirurgi og mere. Ved at analysere præoperative og intraoperative data kan disse algoritmer identificere risici for postoperative komplikationer og forudsige behovet for transfusion, hvilket potentielt kan forbedre patientresultater og reducere behovet for unødvendige transfusioner.

title: Sensor calibration
en: Researchers have been investigating how to calibrate low-cost sensors for accurate air quality monitoring. They have been using various algorithms, such as linear regression, support vector regression, random forest, and neural networks, to improve the performance of these sensors. By applying machine learning techniques, they aim to enhance the accuracy and reliability of low-cost air quality sensors, which could have significant implications for monitoring and addressing air pollution.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan man kan kalibrere lavpris sensorer til nøjagtig overvågning af luftkvalitet. De har anvendt forskellige algoritmer såsom linear regression, support vector regression, random forest og neural networks for at forbedre præstationen af disse sensorer. Ved at anvende machine learning teknikker sigter de mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og pålideligheden af lavpris luftkvalitetssensorer, hvilket kan have betydelige implikationer for overvågning og håndtering af luftforurening.

title: Flood risk prediction
en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to address various research questions related to flood susceptibility and risk assessment. These algorithms, such as random-forest models, boosted-tree models, and support vector machines, are being used to create flood-susceptibility maps, predict flood damage, and assess flood-risk areas in different regions around the world. By incorporating machine learning models with remote sensing and geographic information systems, researchers are able to investigate the effects of changing climates and land uses on flood probability.
da: Forskere har anvendt machine learning-algoritmer til at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til flodsusceptibilitet og risikovurdering. Disse algoritmer, såsom random-forest models, boosted-tree models og support vector machines, bruges til at skabe flodsusceptibilitetskort, forudsige flodskader og vurdere flodrisikoområder i forskellige regioner rundt om i verden. Ved at kombinere machine learning-modeller med remote sensing og geographic information systems kan forskere undersøge virkningerne af ændrede klimaforhold og arealanvendelser på flodens sandsynlighed.

title: Landslide prediction
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict and map landslide susceptibility in various regions. They have found that machine learning techniques, such as Random Forest and Support Vector Machine, are effective in improving the accuracy of these maps. These algorithms can analyze different factors like slope units and dynamic parameters to assess the likelihood of landslides. Overall, the research suggests that machine learning algorithms can be valuable tools for predicting and mapping landslide susceptibility in different areas around the world.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige og kortlægge skrøbelighed over for skred i forskellige regioner. De har fundet, at maskinlæringsteknikker, såsom Random Forest og Support Vector Machine, er effektive til at forbedre nøjagtigheden af disse kort. Disse algoritmer kan analysere forskellige faktorer som skråningsenheder og dynamiske parametre for at vurdere sandsynligheden for skred. Samlet set antyder forskningen, at maskinlæringsalgoritmer kan være værdifulde værktøjer til at forudsige og kortlægge skrøbelighed over for skred i forskellige områder rundt om i verden.

title: Efficient 3D SAR Imaging
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the efficiency and accuracy of 3D imaging in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) systems. These algorithms utilize advanced techniques such as 2D and 3D range migration, sparsely sampled aperture data, NUFFT technology, and FFT-based reconstruction. By applying these algorithms, researchers have achieved high-resolution imaging, reduced computational load, improved imaging quality, and real-time operation in SAR systems. These advancements have the potential to enhance applications such as mmWave imaging, near-field imaging, and MIMO-SAR imaging.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af 3D-billeddannelse i syntetiske aperturradar (SAR) systemer. Disse algoritmer udnytter avancerede teknikker som 2D og 3D rækkevidde migration, sparsamt sampled aperture data, NUFFT teknologi og FFT-baseret rekonstruktion. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer har forskere opnået højtopløselig billeddannelse, reduceret beregningsbelastning, forbedret billedkvalitet og realtidsoperation i SAR systemer. Disse fremskridt har potentiale til at forbedre applikationer såsom mmWave imaging, nærfelt imaging og MIMO-SAR imaging.

title: Battery Material Optimization
en: Scientists are using algorithms to answer important questions about the properties and behavior of materials used in batteries. For example, they are using evolutionary algorithms and density functional theory to determine stable compositions of lithium-tin compounds at different pressures. Simulated annealing algorithms are being used to determine the arrangement of transition metal atoms in cathode materials. By combining experimental and theoretical approaches, scientists are investigating the mechanism of sodiation and desodiation in black P anodes for sodium-ion batteries. These algorithms are helping researchers understand and design better battery materials.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare vigtige spørgsmål om egenskaberne og adfærden af materialer, der anvendes i batterier. For eksempel bruger de evolutionære algoritmer og density functional theory til at bestemme stabile sammensætninger af lithium-tin forbindelser ved forskellige tryk. Simulated annealing-algoritmer bliver brugt til at bestemme arrangementet af overgangsmetallers atomer i katodematerialer. Ved at kombinere eksperimentelle og teoretiske tilgange undersøger forskerne mekanismen for sodiation og desodiation i sorte P-anoder til natrium-ionbatterier. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskere med at forstå og designe bedre batterimaterialer.

title: Carbon stock estimation
en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to accurately estimate aboveground carbon stock in forests. These algorithms, such as support vector machines, boosted regression trees, and random forests, are able to analyze multi-temporal satellite data and provide accurate estimates of carbon stock. By combining different data sources and using various algorithms, researchers are improving their ability to estimate forest aboveground biomass in different regions around the world.
da: Forskere har anvendt maskinlæringsalgoritmer til nøjagtigt at estimere overjordisk kulstoflager i skove. Disse algoritmer, såsom supportvektormaskiner, boosted regression trees og random forests, er i stand til at analysere multi-temporal satellitdata og give præcise estimater af kulstoflager. Ved at kombinere forskellige datakilder og anvende forskellige algoritmer forbedrer forskerne deres evne til at estimere overjordisk biomasse i skove i forskellige regioner verden over.

title: Digital heritage analysis
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can be used to advance social impact assessment, analyze cultural ecosystem services, and identify current topics and trends in digital heritage. They are using machine learning, image digitization, data aggregation and visualization techniques, as well as Google's Cloud Vision algorithm, artificial intelligence, and computer vision algorithms. However, they are also investigating the biases and potential threats introduced by machine learning and artificial intelligence in cultural heritage datasets.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at fremme social impact assessment, analysere kulturelle økosystemtjenester og identificere aktuelle emner og trends inden for digital arv. De anvender machine learning, billedigitalisering, dataaggregering og visualiseringsteknikker, samt Google's Cloud Vision algoritme, artificial intelligence og computer vision algoritmer. Dog undersøger de også de biases og potentielle trusler, der introduceres af machine learning og artificial intelligence i databaser om kulturarv.

title: Single-cell clustering
en: Scientists are using algorithms to analyze single-cell RNA sequencing data and improve our understanding of cell types. These algorithms, such as SAIC, PCA-based algorithms, and hybrid clustering algorithms, help identify distinct clusters of cells based on their gene expression patterns. By comparing the performance of different clustering methods and exploring the impact of data preprocessing, researchers are finding effective ways to accurately cluster and identify cell types from single-cell data.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at analysere enkeltcelle RNA-sekventeringsdata og forbedre vores forståelse af celletype. Disse algoritmer, såsom SAIC, PCA-baserede algoritmer og hybride klusteringsalgoritmer, hjælper med at identificere distinkte klynger af celler baseret på deres genudtryksmønstre. Ved at sammenligne ydeevnen af forskellige klusteringsmetoder og undersøge indvirkningen af databehandling finder forskere effektive måder at præcist klustre og identificere celletype ud fra enkeltcelledata.

title: Precipitation prediction
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to accurately predict precipitation, forecast monthly rainfall, and predict summer precipitation in various regions. These algorithms leverage multiple meteorological data sets, identify optimal inputs, and improve the performance of precipitation nowcasting. They can also outperform existing statistical approaches for downscaling rainfall and accurately forecast monsoon rainfall. Additionally, deep learning models can reconstruct streamflow and floods, detect anthropogenic fingerprints in precipitation, and enhance summer precipitation forecasts.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer bliver brugt til nøjagtigt at forudsige nedbør, forudsige månedlig nedbør og forudsige sommernedbør i forskellige regioner. Disse algoritmer udnytter flere meteorologiske datasæt, identificerer optimale input og forbedrer præstationen af nedbør-nu-prognoser. De kan også overgå eksisterende statistiske tilgange til nedskaleret nedbør og nøjagtigt forudsige monsunregn. Derudover kan deep learning-modeller rekonstruere vandløb og oversvømmelser, opdage antropogene fingeraftryk i nedbør og forbedre prognoser for sommernedbør.

title: Hyperspectral anomaly detection
en: Researchers have explored various algorithms to improve the detection of anomalies in hyperspectral imagery. These algorithms include stacked denoising autoencoders, spectral-spatial stacked autoencoders, spectral constraint adversarial autoencoders, discriminative reconstruction with spectral learning, and more. By utilizing these algorithms, scientists aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of anomaly detection in hyperspectral data.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre detektion af anomalier i hyperspektrale billeder. Disse algoritmer omfatter stacked denoising autoencoders, spectral-spatial stacked autoencoders, spectral constraint adversarial autoencoders, discriminative reconstruction with spectral learning og mere. Ved at bruge disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af anomali detection i hyperspektrale data.

title: Hyperspectral image denoising
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to denoise and restore hyperspectral images. These algorithms use techniques such as low-rank tensor recovery, total variation regularization, nonlocal low-rank approximation, and tensor decomposition. The proposed methods have been found to effectively remove different types of noise and outperform existing denoising algorithms, providing better image quality and preserving structural information.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at fjerne støj og genskabe hyperspektrale billeder. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker såsom low-rank tensor recovery, total variation regularization, nonlocal low-rank approximation og tensor decomposition. De foreslåede metoder har vist sig at fjerne forskellige typer støj effektivt og overgå eksisterende denoising-algoritmer, hvilket giver bedre billedkvalitet og bevarer strukturel information.

title: Algorithmic Enhancements in Farming
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve various aspects of agricultural practices. For example, a PID electronic control system can enhance the quality and efficiency of conventional planters by controlling seed plate rotation speed. Similarly, an automatic variable-rate orchard sprayer adjusts flow rate and air flow based on the canopy's characteristics to improve application conditions. Other algorithms, such as machine vision and fuzzy PID control, are being used to detect weeds, regulate sowing depth, and improve the performance of different agricultural machines. These advancements aim to enhance precision, reduce environmental impact, and optimize agricultural production.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af landbrugspraksis. For eksempel kan et PID elektronisk kontrolsystem forbedre kvaliteten og effektiviteten af konventionelle såmaskiner ved at kontrollere frøpladens rotationshastighed. Ligeledes justerer en automatisk variabel hastigheds sprøjte til frugthaven flowhastigheden og luftstrømmen baseret på baldakins karakteristika for at forbedre applikationsbetingelserne. Andre algoritmer, såsom machine vision og fuzzy PID control, anvendes til at opdage ukrudt, regulere sådybden og forbedre ydeevnen af forskellige landbrugsmaskiner. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at forbedre præcisionen, reducere miljøpåvirkningen og optimere landbrugsproduktionen.

title: Optimizing Video Streaming
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve video streaming on mobile devices. They are investigating the use of mobile edge computing (MEC) to enhance adaptive bitrate video delivery, optimize caching placement for high quality streaming, and improve wireless adaptive video streaming. These algorithms aim to maximize video quality, reduce network traffic, and optimize the user experience.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre video streaming på mobile enheder. De undersøger brugen af mobile edge computing (MEC) for at forbedre adaptiv bitrate video levering, optimere cache placering for streaming af høj kvalitet og forbedre trådløs adaptiv video streaming. Disse algoritmer har til formål at maksimere videokvaliteten, reducere netværkstrafikken og optimere brugeroplevelsen.

title: Enhancing remote sensing images
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms to improve the quality of remote sensing images. These algorithms, such as Deep CNNs, Convolutional generator models, and Generative adversarial networks, aim to enhance the resolution, visual quality, and edge details of the images. Other algorithms, like Unsupervised super-resolution methods and GAN-based algorithms, address specific challenges in remote sensing image super-resolution. These advancements in algorithmic techniques have the potential to greatly enhance the accuracy and clarity of satellite remote sensing images.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre kvaliteten af fjernmålingsbilleder. Disse algoritmer, såsom Deep CNNs, Convolutional generator models og Generative adversarial networks, har til formål at forbedre opløsningen, den visuelle kvalitet og kantdetaljerne i billederne. Andre algoritmer, som Unsupervised super-resolution methods og GAN-baserede algoritmer, adresserer specifikke udfordringer i superopløsning af fjernmålingsbilleder. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmiske teknikker har potentiale til i høj grad at forbedre nøjagtigheden og klarheden af satellitfjernmålingsbilleder.

title: Cloud detection enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring how deep learning algorithms can improve cloud detection in remote sensing images. They are developing methods such as deep learning-based cloud detection, multiple convolutional neural networks for multilevel cloud detection, and cloud segmentation CNN for cloud classification. These algorithms aim to enhance cloud detection and improve the accuracy of cloud identification in satellite imagery.
