da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep learning-algoritmer kan forbedre cloud detection i fjernmåling billeder. De udvikler metoder såsom deep learning-baseret cloud detection, multiple convolutional neural networks til multilevel cloud detection, og cloud segmentation CNN til cloud classification. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre cloud detection og øge nøjagtigheden af cloud identification i satellitbilleder.

title: Urban heat islands
en: Researchers have used algorithms and satellite data to investigate the distribution and changes of urban heat islands in various cities around the world. By analyzing land use changes, vegetation, and temperature patterns, they have been able to understand the impact of urbanization on land surface temperature. These studies provide valuable insights into how cities can mitigate the effects of heat islands and create more sustainable urban environments.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer og satellitdata til at undersøge fordelingen og ændringerne af byområder med varmeøer i forskellige byer verden over. Ved at analysere ændringer i arealanvendelse, vegetation og temperaturmønstre har de været i stand til at forstå indvirkningen af urbanisering på overfladetemperaturen. Disse studier giver værdifuld indsigt i, hvordan byer kan afbøde virkningerne af varmeøer og skabe mere bæredygtige bymiljøer.

title: Microstructural Trends
en: Scientists are using image representations and machine learning techniques to explore microstructural trends in ultrahigh carbon steel. They are also using a two-stage machine learning approach with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to characterize microstructural features in titanium alloys. Data-driven models such as ridge regression, XGBoost, and a custom 3D CNN are being used to predict mechanical properties of additively manufactured metals. Unsupervised machine learning techniques, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and superpixel algorithm, are being explored for microstructure segmentation without labeled images. Deep learning methods, such as Electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD)-trained deep learning (DL) method, are being used for microstructure classification and quantification in complex steel microstructures. Various CNN models including ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception, and MobileNet are being tested for microstructure classification. A U-Net convolutional neural network is being used for microstructure segmentation in pearlitic-ferritic steel. Data mining methods are being employed for microstructural image segmentation in low-carbon steel. Deep learning algorithms are being used to estimate the prior austenite structure in martensitic steel. The performance of CNN-based steel classification is being studied under different imaging conditions. Machine learning techniques, including classical methods and convolutional neural networks (CNN), are being compared for classifying heat treatments in low-carbon steels. A deep learning algorithm with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) UNET machine learning architecture is being trained for phase segmentation of steel microstructures. Machine learning is being used to enhance data augmentation and predict impact toughness in cast austenitic steel. Finally, deep learning is being explored to detect martensite bands in dual-phase steels using a Faster Region-Based-Convolutional Neural Network (Faster R-CNN).
da: Forskere bruger billedrepræsentationer og maskinlæringsteknikker til at udforske mikrostrukturelle tendenser i ultrahøj kulstofstål. De anvender også en to-trins maskinlæringstilgang med et Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) til at karakterisere mikrostrukturelle træk i titaniumlegeringer. Data-drevne modeller som ridge regression, XGBoost og et brugerdefineret 3D CNN bliver brugt til at forudsige mekaniske egenskaber ved additivt fremstillede metaller. Usupervised machine learning teknikker, såsom Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) og superpixel algoritmen, bliver udforsket til mikrostruktursegmentation uden mærkede billeder. Deep learning metoder, såsom Electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD)-uddannet deep learning (DL) metode, bliver brugt til mikrostrukturklassifikation og kvantificering i komplekse stålmikrostrukturer. Forskellige CNN-modeller, herunder ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception og MobileNet, bliver testet til mikrostrukturklassifikation. Et U-Net convolutional neural network bliver brugt til mikrostruktursegmentation i perlitisk-ferritisk stål. Data mining metoder anvendes til mikrostrukturel billedsegmentation i lavkulstofstål. Deep learning algoritmer bruges til at estimere den forudgående austenitstruktur i martensitisk stål. Ydelsen af CNN-baseret stålklassifikation studeres under forskellige billedbehandlingsbetingelser. Maskinlæringsteknikker, inklusive klassiske metoder og convolutional neural networks (CNN), bliver sammenlignet for at klassificere varmebehandlinger i lavkulstofstål. En deep learning algoritme med en Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) UNET maskinlæringsarkitektur bliver trænet til fasesegmentering af stålets mikrostrukturer. Maskinlæring anvendes til at forbedre dataforøgelse og forudsige slagsejhed i støbt austenitisk stål. Endelig bliver deep learning udforsket for at detektere martensitbånd i dual-phase stål ved hjælp af en Faster Region-Based-Convolutional Neural Network (Faster R-CNN).

title: Road extraction
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve road detection and extraction from different types of images, such as aerial and remote sensing imagery. These algorithms, based on deep learning models and innovative network architectures, aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of road extraction tasks. By utilizing techniques like cascaded end-to-end convolutional neural networks, refined deep residual convolutional neural networks, and multi-scale fusion-based frameworks, these algorithms offer promising solutions for automatic road extraction.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer til at forbedre vejdetektion og udtrækning fra forskellige typer billeder, såsom luft- og fjernmåling billeder. Disse algoritmer, baseret på deep learning-modeller og innovative netværksarkitekturer, har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af vejudtrækningsopgaver. Ved at udnytte teknikker som kaskaderede end-to-end convolutionsneuralnetværk, raffinerede dybe residuale convolutionsneuralnetværk og multi-scale fusion-baserede rammer, tilbyder disse algoritmer lovende løsninger til automatisk vejudtrækning.

title: AI-Driven Sports Management
en: Researchers are exploring how data mining algorithms and computer technology can be used to improve sports performance management, evaluate athletes' abilities, and analyze sports training. They are also investigating the role of artificial intelligence and machine learning in sports research and prediction. By applying big data analysis techniques and using algorithms, such as neural networks and association rules, researchers aim to enhance sports predictions and develop intelligent sport management systems.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan data mining-algoritmer og computerteknologi kan anvendes til at forbedre sportspræstationsstyring, evaluere atleters evner og analysere sportsuddannelse. De undersøger også rollen af artificial intelligence og machine learning i sportsforskning og forudsigelse. Ved at anvende big data-analyseteknikker og bruge algoritmer, såsom neurale netværk og associationsregler, sigter forskerne mod at forbedre sportsforudsigelser og udvikle intelligente sportsstyringssystemer.

title: Algorithmic Addiction
en: Researchers are exploring the potential of algorithms to improve the prediction and treatment outcomes of substance use disorders. They are using various machine learning models, decision tree classifiers, and super learning methodologies to predict successful treatment, classify individuals with alcohol use disorder, and identify predictors of treatment goal change. These algorithms have the potential to outperform addiction therapists and clinical psychologists in predicting treatment outcomes and can be used to analyze alcohol consumption data and screen for alcohol use disorder.
da: Forskere undersøger potentialet af algoritmer til at forbedre forudsigelsen og behandlingsresultaterne for stofmisbrugsforstyrrelser. De bruger forskellige maskinlæringsmodeller, beslutningstræklassificatorer og super læringsmetoder til at forudsige succesfuld behandling, klassificere individer med alkoholmisbrugsforstyrrelse og identificere forudsigere for ændring af behandlingsmål. Disse algoritmer har potentialet til at overgå afhængighedsterapeuter og kliniske psykologer i forudsigelsen af behandlingsresultater og kan bruges til at analysere data om alkoholforbrug og screene for alkoholmisbrugsforstyrrelse.

title: Sustainability analysis
en: Scientists have used various algorithms to investigate important questions about carbon emissions, energy consumption, and economic growth. These algorithms, such as sensitivity analysis and machine learning methods, help researchers understand the impact of different factors on the environment and well-being. By analyzing data and running simulations, scientists can gain insights into the drivers of emissions and explore potential solutions for a more sustainable future.
da: Forskere har brugt forskellige algoritmer til at undersøge vigtige spørgsmål om kulstofemissioner, energiforbrug og økonomisk vækst. Disse algoritmer, såsom sensitivity analysis og machine learning methods, hjælper forskere med at forstå indvirkningen af forskellige faktorer på miljøet og velfærden. Ved at analysere data og køre simulationer kan forskere få indsigt i driverne for emissioner og undersøge potentielle løsninger for en mere bæredygtig fremtid.

title: Algorithmic Wildfire Prediction
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to study and predict wildfires in various ecosystems around the world. They have been asking questions like what factors contribute to high-severity fires, how to improve the accuracy of wildfire mapping, and what environmental variables control fire severity. Algorithms such as Random Forest classifiers and machine learning models have been used to analyze data and make predictions. These studies aim to better understand and manage wildfires to protect ecosystems and communities.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at studere og forudsige skovbrande i forskellige økosystemer verden over. De har stillet spørgsmål som, hvilke faktorer der bidrager til brande med høj sværhedsgrad, hvordan man kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af brande kortlægning, og hvilke miljøvariabler der styrer brandsværhedsgraden. Algoritmer som Random Forest klassifikatorer og machine learning modeller er blevet brugt til at analysere data og lave forudsigelser. Disse studier har til formål at opnå en bedre forståelse af og forvaltning af skovbrande for at beskytte økosystemer og samfund.

title: Immunotherapy prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms have been used in various studies to address research questions related to predicting response to immune checkpoint blockade therapy in cancer. These algorithms analyze genomic and clinical data to identify biomarkers, develop scoring schemes, and build predictive models. By integrating different features and data, these algorithms aim to improve the accuracy of predicting the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors and personalize treatment for patients with different types of cancer.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer er blevet brugt i forskellige studier til at adressere forskningsspørgsmål relateret til at forudsige respons på immuncheckpoint-hæmmende terapi i kræft. Disse algoritmer analyserer genomiske og kliniske data for at identificere biomarkører, udvikle scoringsskemaer og bygge forudsigende modeller. Ved at integrere forskellige funktioner og data har disse algoritmer til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden af at forudsige effektiviteten af immuncheckpoint-hæmmere og tilpasse behandlingen til patienter med forskellige typer kræft.

title: Land-use analysis
en: Researchers have used machine-learning algorithms to map and estimate land change in West Africa, analyze spatiotemporal patterns and processes of land use/land cover change in Southwest China, and incorporate density into land use/cover change patterns in Greece. They have also used algorithms to evaluate forest land conversion in Bangladesh, map land use/cover changes in Brazil and Central Asia, detect landscape changes in Brazil's Tietê-Jacaré watershed, and derive land cover and forest mask products in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. Algorithms have been employed to assess land-use changes in Vietnam, China, Gambia, Morocco, Iran, Ghana, Nepal, and North Korea, as well as to understand local traditional living changes and monitor landscape pattern changes in Pyongyang, North Korea.
da: Forskere har brugt machine-learning algoritmer til at kortlægge og estimere landforandringer i Vestafrika, analysere spatiotemporale mønstre og processer for landbrug/landdækningsforandringer i Sydvestkina og inkorporere tæthed i landbrug/dækningsforandringsmønstre i Grækenland. De har også anvendt algoritmer til at evaluere skovland omdannelse i Bangladesh, kortlægge landbrug/dækningsforandringer i Brasilien og Centralasien, registrere landskabsforandringer i Brasils Tietê-Jacaré vandløb og udlede landdæknings- og skovmaskeprodukter i Tjernobyls eksklusionszone. Algoritmer er blevet brugt til at vurdere landbrugsforandringer i Vietnam, Kina, Gambia, Marokko, Iran, Ghana, Nepal og Nordkorea samt til at forstå lokale traditionelle leveforandringer og overvåge landskabsmønsterforandringer i Pyongyang, Nordkorea.

title: Codebook optimization
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to optimize the design of codebooks in sparse code multiple access (SCMA) systems. These algorithms improve the quality of initial information, convergence reliability, and maximize mutual information in SCMA. They also minimize the upper bound of pair-wise error probability (PEP), achieve near-optimal designs for SCMA codebooks, and improve the convergence reliability of detected layers. Additionally, algorithms have been developed to combine the advantages of probabilistic shaping and geometric shaping in SCMA codebook optimization. These advancements aim to enhance the performance and efficiency of SCMA systems in different channel environments.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer til at optimere designet af codebooks i sparse code multiple access (SCMA) systemer. Disse algoritmer forbedrer kvaliteten af den indledende information, konvergenspålideligheden og maksimerer den gensidige information i SCMA. De minimerer også den øvre grænse for parvis fejl sandsynlighed (PEP), opnår næsten optimale designs for SCMA codebooks og forbedrer konvergenspålideligheden af de detekterede lag. Derudover er der udviklet algoritmer til at kombinere fordelene ved probabilistisk shaping og geometrisk shaping i SCMA codebook-optimering. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre ydeevnen og effektiviteten af SCMA-systemer i forskellige kanalmiljøer.

title: Robotic healthcare ethics
en: Researchers have explored various questions regarding the role of algorithms and robots in healthcare. They have investigated whether autonomous robots will replace nurses, the challenges of maximizing the benefits of robotics in healthcare, and the impact of artificial intelligence on nursing and caregiving professions. They have also examined the ethical concerns surrounding care robots and the preferences people have for how robots should act in ethically difficult situations. Overall, the research aims to understand the potential and ethical implications of integrating algorithms and robots into healthcare.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige spørgsmål vedrørende algoritmers og robotters rolle i sundhedspleje. De har undersøgt, om autonome robotter vil erstatte sygeplejersker, udfordringerne ved at maksimere fordelene ved robotteknologi i sundhedspleje og indflydelsen af artificial intelligence på sygepleje- og omsorgsfag. De har også undersøgt de etiske bekymringer omkring plejerobotter og de præferencer, folk har for, hvordan robotter skal handle i etisk vanskelige situationer. Samlet set sigter forskningen mod at forstå potentialet og de etiske implikationer ved at integrere algoritmer og robotter i sundhedspleje.

title: Activity Recognition
en: Researchers have been conducting studies to compare the performance of different machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms for human activity recognition (HAR) using accelerometer data. They have also been analyzing the effectiveness of ML classification models and convolutional neural network (CNN) models for smartphone sensor-based activity recognition. Additionally, investigations have been done to evaluate the efficiency of artificial neural networks (ANNs) in HAR compared to CNNs and other ML techniques.
da: Forskere har udført studier for at sammenligne præstationen af forskellige machine learning (ML) og deep learning (DL) algoritmer til menneskelig aktivitetsgenkendelse (HAR) ved hjælp af accelerometerdata. De har også analyseret effektiviteten af ML klassifikationsmodeller og convolutional neural network (CNN) modeller til aktivitetsgenkendelse baseret på smartphonesensorer. Derudover er der foretaget undersøgelser for at evaluere effektiviteten af kunstige neurale netværk (ANNs) i HAR sammenlignet med CNNs og andre ML teknikker.

title: Emerging Tech Algorithms
en: Algorithms play a crucial role in various emerging technologies in healthcare systems. They are used for tasks such as data analytics, early detection of diseases, data processing, anomaly detection, disease prediction, personalized treatment, monitoring, diagnosing, and predicting health conditions. Algorithms also contribute to the security and privacy of healthcare systems by monitoring patient data, encryption, individualized access control, secure data transmission, authentication, and recovery. Overall, algorithms are essential in leveraging the potential of technologies like IoT, AI, and big data to enhance healthcare services and improve patient outcomes.
da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i forskellige nye teknologier inden for sundhedssystemer. De bruges til opgaver som dataanalyse, tidlig påvisning af sygdomme, databehandling, anomaliopdagelse, sygdomsprognoser, personlig behandling, overvågning, diagnosticering og forudsigelse af sundhedstilstande. Algoritmer bidrager også til sikkerheden og privatlivet i sundhedssystemer ved at overvåge patientdata, kryptering, individualiseret adgangskontrol, sikker datatransmission, autentifikation og genopretning. Samlet set er algoritmer essentielle for at udnytte potentialet i teknologier som IoT, AI og big data for at forbedre sundhedsydelser og forbedre patientresultater.

title: Imaging enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep generative networks and convolutional neural networks to improve various imaging techniques. These algorithms are being used to predict structure and phase in real space, extend the depth-of-field in holographic imaging, improve the performance of tomographic phase microscopy, enhance the spatial resolution of phase extraction, and more. By implementing these deep learning frameworks, researchers aim to improve the speed, accuracy, and quality of imaging processes in fields such as microscopy and holography.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep generative networks og convolutional neural networks for at forbedre forskellige imaging teknikker. Disse algoritmer bruges til at forudsige struktur og fase i det reelle rum, udvide dybdeskarpheden i holografisk imaging, forbedre ydeevnen af tomografisk fase mikroskopi, øge den rumlige opløsning af faseudvinding og mere. Ved at implementere disse deep learning rammer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre hastigheden, nøjagtigheden og kvaliteten af imaging processer inden for områder som mikroskopi og holografi.

title: Neuroimaging-based Alzheimer's diagnosis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of machine learning and deep learning algorithms to diagnose Alzheimer's disease based on MRI and PET brain images. These algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep neural networks (DNNs), are being developed to accurately classify Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and normal control subjects. The goal is to create a deep learning-based system that can automatically diagnose Alzheimer's disease at different stages using neuroimaging data.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af machine learning og deep learning algoritmer til at diagnosticere Alzheimers sygdom baseret på MRI og PET hjernebilleder. Disse algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks (CNNs) og deep neural networks (DNNs), udvikles for præcist at klassificere Alzheimers sygdom, mild kognitiv svækkelse og normale kontrolpersoner. Målet er at skabe et deep learning-baseret system, der automatisk kan diagnosticere Alzheimers sygdom i forskellige stadier ved hjælp af neuroimaging data.

title: Smart irrigation
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms and IoT technology to optimize water usage in agriculture. These algorithms, based on machine learning and artificial intelligence, analyze data from sensors and weather forecasts to predict irrigation requirements. By automating irrigation decisions, these smart systems aim to improve water-resource utilization, increase crop yield, and conserve water in precision farming.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer og IoT-teknologi til at optimere vandforbruget i landbruget. Disse algoritmer, baseret på maskinlæring og artificial intelligence, analyserer data fra sensorer og vejrudsigter for at forudsige behovet for bevandning. Ved at automatisere bevandningsbeslutninger sigter disse smarte systemer mod at forbedre udnyttelsen af vandressourcer, øge afgrødeudbyttet og bevare vand i præcisionslandbrug.

title: Deep Learning for Knee Osteoarthritis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to accurately diagnose and stage knee osteoarthritis from plain radiographs. These algorithms, such as Deep Siamese Convolutional Neural Networks and DenseNet neural network architectures, are trained with image data and clinical information to improve diagnostic performance. Additionally, deep learning models are being developed to automate the classification, detection, and prediction of knee osteoarthritis severity, using various deep learning approaches and models.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til præcist at diagnosticere og stadieinddele knæ osteoartrit ud fra almindelige røntgenbilleder. Disse algoritmer, såsom Deep Siamese Convolutional Neural Networks og DenseNet neural netværksarkitekturer, trænes med billeddata og klinisk information for at forbedre diagnostisk præstation. Derudover udvikles der deep learning-modeller til at automatisere klassificeringen, opdagelsen og forudsigelsen af alvorligheden af knæ osteoartrit ved hjælp af forskellige deep learning-tilgange og modeller.

title: Emerging Technologies in Education
en: Emerging learning technologies such as adaptive learning technologies, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality can be used to enhance learning in higher education. Humanities education needs to be prioritized in the context of Industry 4.0, and policies should be framed in the context of human-technology convergence. Medical education should be transformed by embedding students in the work environment, adopting academic healthcare systems, and integrating research and innovation into the learning experience. The Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) is impacting education through smart communication systems, artificial intelligence, robotics, and virtual reality, and curriculum development needs to keep pace with technological advances. Micro-teaching is being evaluated in the digital era to determine its relevance and the competencies needed by prospective teachers. Engineering students need to develop soft skills in addition to technical knowledge to meet the demands of Industry 4.0. Institutions of higher education can build curricula that prepare students for Industry 4.0 by incorporating artificial intelligence and interactive design. Technologies such as virtual and augmented reality, 3D printing, drones, and robots are transforming engineering education. Interdisciplinarity is emerging in engineering fields and influencing management practice. The ethical dimensions of emerging technologies, such as big data and artificial intelligence, need to be considered in engineering education. Engineering education should adapt to the changes brought by Industry 5.0 by focusing on skill-oriented, project-based learning and practical concepts. The curriculum in Nigerian higher education can be made more responsive to the 4IR through the use of an itinerant curriculum. Learning curve modelling has applications in Industry 4.0, particularly in relation to technologies such as big data and IoT. Engineering education needs a paradigm shift to focus on skill development, sustainability, resilience, and human-centric design in the era of Industry 5.0. Heutagogy, a self-determined learning approach, can be implemented in universities. Factors such as technological optimism and ease of use influence the acceptance of Industry 4.0 technologies by students from rural areas. Healthcare professionals and students can be trained in digital health in the context of Industry 5.0 by incorporating enabling technologies. Learning is facilitated in an era of uncertainty in Singapore through the enhancement of adaptive capacity, lifelong learning, and a paradigm of inspiration and readiness for paradigm shifts.
da: Fremvoksende læringsteknologier såsom adaptive learning technologies, artificial intelligence og virtual reality kan bruges til at forbedre læring i videregående uddannelser. Humanistisk uddannelse bør prioriteres i konteksten af Industry 4.0, og politikker bør formuleres i forbindelse med menneske-teknologi konvergens. Medicinsk uddannelse bør transformeres ved at inddrage studerende i arbejdsmiljøet, adoptere akademiske sundhedssystemer og integrere forskning og innovation i læringsoplevelsen. Den Fjerde Industrielle Revolution (4IR) påvirker uddannelse gennem smarte kommunikationssystemer, artificial intelligence, robotics og virtual reality, og læseplansudvikling skal følge med teknologiske fremskridt. Micro-teaching evalueres i den digitale æra for at fastslå dets relevans og de kompetencer, der er nødvendige for kommende lærere. Ingeniørstuderende skal udvikle bløde færdigheder ud over teknisk viden for at imødekomme kravene fra Industry 4.0. Institutioner for videregående uddannelse kan bygge læseplaner, der forbereder studerende til Industry 4.0 ved at integrere artificial intelligence og interaktiv design. Teknologier såsom virtual og augmented reality, 3D-print, droner og robotter transformerer ingeniøruddannelsen. Interdisciplinaritet er ved at emerge inden for ingeniørfelter og påvirker ledelsespraksis. De etiske dimensioner af fremvoksende teknologier, såsom big data og artificial intelligence, skal tages i betragtning i ingeniøruddannelsen. Ingeniøruddannelsen bør tilpasse sig de ændringer, som Industry 5.0 bringer, ved at fokusere på færdighedsorienteret, projektbaseret læring og praktiske koncepter. Læseplanen i nigeriansk videregående uddannelse kan gøres mere responsiv over for 4IR gennem brug af en itinerant læseplan. Modeller til læringskurver har anvendelser inden for Industry 4.0, især i relation til teknologier såsom big data og IoT. Ingeniøruddannelsen har brug for et paradigmeskifte for at fokusere på færdighedsudvikling, bæredygtighed, modstandsdygtighed og menneskecentreret design i æraen af Industry 5.0. Heutagogy, en selvbestemt læringsmetode, kan implementeres på universiteter. Faktorer såsom teknologisk optimisme og brugervenlighed påvirker accepten af Industry 4.0 teknologier blandt studerende fra landdistrikter. Sundhedsprofessionelle og studerende kan trænes i digital sundhed i konteksten af Industry 5.0 ved at inkorporere muliggørende teknologier. Læring faciliteres i en usikker æra i Singapore gennem forbedring af adaptiv kapacitet, livslang læring og et paradigme for inspiration og parathed til paradigmeskift.

title: Traumatic Brain Injury Prognosis
en: Machine learning models are being used to predict various outcomes in patients with traumatic brain injury. These models have shown promise in determining mortality, predicting survival, and assessing the risk of prolonged mechanical ventilation. They have also been used to support in-hospital triage and predict functional outcomes in pediatric patients. Machine learning algorithms have demonstrated their potential in accurately predicting the outcomes of traumatic brain injury treatment.
da: Maskinlæringsmodeller anvendes til at forudsige forskellige udfald hos patienter med traumatisk hjerneskade. Disse modeller har vist lovende tegn i at bestemme dødelighed, forudsige overlevelse og vurdere risikoen for forlænget mekanisk ventilation. De er også blevet brugt til at støtte triage på hospitalet og forudsige funktionelle udfald hos pædiatriske patienter. Maskinlæringsalgoritmer har demonstreret deres potentiale i nøjagtigt at forudsige udfaldene af behandling af traumatisk hjerneskade.

title: Historical Pollution Prediction
en: Algorithms are being used to accurately predict historical air pollution levels in various regions around the world. These algorithms can estimate concentrations of harmful particles like PM2.5 and PM10, and identify long-term trends. They are also capable of estimating pollution levels at different temporal scales and in data-poor regions, using satellite data and machine learning models.
da: Algoritmer anvendes til nøjagtigt at forudsige historiske luftforureningsniveauer i forskellige regioner rundt om i verden. Disse algoritmer kan estimere koncentrationer af skadelige partikler som PM2.5 og PM10 og identificere langsigtede tendenser. De er også i stand til at estimere forureningsniveauer på forskellige tidsmæssige skalaer og i datafattige regioner ved hjælp af satellitdata og machine learning-modeller.

title: Lung vessel analysis
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to assist physicians in diagnosing and treating various conditions related to the blood vessels in the lungs. These algorithms can accurately classify vessels into arteries and veins, detect pulmonary embolism, evaluate disease extent, and assist in assessing vascular remodeling. They have shown excellent performance in detecting and segmenting pulmonary embolisms, improving patient care, and reducing misdiagnosis. These algorithms are proving to be valuable tools in the field of pulmonary research and can aid healthcare workers in providing more efficient and accurate diagnoses.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer anvendes til at hjælpe læger med at diagnosticere og behandle forskellige tilstande relateret til blodkarrene i lungerne. Disse algoritmer kan nøjagtigt klassificere kar i arterier og vener, opdage lungeemboli, evaluere sygdommens omfang og hjælpe med vurdering af vaskulær omdannelse. De har vist fremragende ydeevne i at opdage og segmentere lungeemboli, forbedre patientpleje og reducere fejldiagnoser. Disse algoritmer viser sig at være værdifulde værktøjer inden for lungeforskning og kan hjælpe sundhedspersonale med at give mere effektive og nøjagtige diagnoser.

title: Image captioning
en: Researchers have been exploring various approaches and techniques to advance image captioning research. They have developed algorithms such as dual LSTMs with adaptive attention models, improved NIC algorithms using Inception-ResNet-v2 and LSTMP networks, and attention-based deep learning models. These algorithms aim to improve image caption generation by integrating textual cues, using multi-head attention transformers, two-tier LSTM models, and multi-branch CNN and Bi-LSTM models. The research also includes surveys and reviews on deep learning-based image captioning methods and the impact of attention mechanisms on image captioning.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige tilgange og teknikker for at fremme forskningen inden for billedtekstning. De har udviklet algoritmer såsom dual LSTMs med adaptive opmærksomhedsmodeller, forbedrede NIC-algoritmer ved hjælp af Inception-ResNet-v2 og LSTMP-netværk samt opmærksomhedsbaserede dybe læringsmodeller. Disse algoritmer sigter mod at forbedre genereringen af billedtekster ved at integrere tekstuelle signaler, bruge multi-head attention transformere, to-niveau LSTM-modeller og multi-branch CNN og Bi-LSTM-modeller. Forskningen omfatter også undersøgelser og anmeldelser af dybt læringsbaserede metoder til billedtekstning samt indflydelsen af opmærksomhedsmekanismer på billedtekstning.

title: Radiograph analysis
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to aid in the interpretation of chest radiographs, detecting abnormalities and assessing their stability over time. These algorithms have shown promising results, outperforming physicians in the discrimination of major thoracic diseases and achieving radiologist-level performance on certain pathologies. They have also been effective in identifying clinically relevant abnormalities in emergency department chest radiographs and detecting lung cancers with comparable performance to radiologists. Overall, these algorithms have the potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficacy in radiology.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer bliver brugt til at hjælpe med fortolkningen af ​​brystradiografier, ved at opdage abnormiteter og vurdere deres stabilitet over tid. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater, der overgår læger i diskriminationen af ​​store thorakale sygdomme og opnår radiolog-niveau præstation på visse patologier. De har også været effektive til at identificere klinisk relevante abnormiteter i brystradiografier fra skadestuer og til at opdage lungekræft med sammenlignelig præstation med radiologer. Overordnet set har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre diagnostisk nøjagtighed og arbejdsgangseffektivitet i radiologi.

title: Bike-sharing demand prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to accurately predict and forecast demand in bike-sharing systems. They have been using various techniques such as deep learning, graph convolutional networks, and artificial intelligence models to improve the accuracy of these predictions. These algorithms analyze spatial, temporal, and global effects, as well as utilize graph structural information and machine learning techniques to understand usage patterns and optimize bike relocation in these systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til præcist at forudsige og forudsige efterspørgslen i cykeldelingssystemer. De har anvendt forskellige teknikker såsom deep learning, graph convolutional networks og artificial intelligence-modeller for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af disse forudsigelser. Disse algoritmer analyserer rumlige, tidsmæssige og globale effekter samt udnytter grafstrukturelle oplysninger og machine learning-teknikker til at forstå brugs-mønstre og optimere cykelrelokalisering i disse systemer.

title: Dental caries detection
en: Deep learning algorithms, specifically deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown promise in detecting and diagnosing dental caries and other dental diseases. These algorithms have been found to be more accurate than individual dentists in detecting caries lesions on radiographs, and they can classify teeth as healthy, decayed, root-canaled, and restored using panoramic radiographic images. Additionally, deep learning methods can accurately detect and segment caries lesions on dental radiographs, providing a reliable diagnostic tool for dentists.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer, specifikt dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværk (CNNs), har vist lovende resultater i opdagelse og diagnose af tandcaries og andre tandrelaterede sygdomme. Disse algoritmer har vist sig at være mere nøjagtige end individuelle tandlæger i at opdage carieslæsioner på røntgenbilleder, og de kan klassificere tænder som sunde, rådne, rodbehandlede og restaurerede ved hjælp af panoramiske røntgenbilleder. Derudover kan deep learning-metoder nøjagtigt opdage og segmentere carieslæsioner på tandrøntgenbilleder, hvilket giver et pålideligt diagnostisk værktøj for tandlæger.

title: Stroke outcome prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms have been tested in various studies to determine their ability to predict outcomes and functional independence in patients with acute ischemic stroke. The results show that while machine learning algorithms can improve outcome prediction and accurately predict clinical outcomes, they do not always outperform traditional scoring methods or logistic regression models. However, machine learning models have shown good performance in predicting the clinical outcome of stroke and can provide valuable insights for clinicians.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer er blevet testet i forskellige studier for at bestemme deres evne til at forudsige resultater og funktionel uafhængighed hos patienter med akut iskæmisk slagtilfælde. Resultaterne viser, at mens maskinlæringsalgoritmer kan forbedre forudsigelsen af resultater og præcist forudsige kliniske resultater, overgår de ikke altid traditionelle scoringsmetoder eller logistiske regressionsmodeller. Dog har maskinlæringsmodeller vist god præstation i forudsigelsen af det kliniske resultat af slagtilfælde og kan give værdifuld indsigt for klinikere.

title: Genetic modification prediction
en: Scientists have developed various machine learning algorithms to accurately predict different types of modifications in genetic material. These algorithms, such as M6APred-EL and M6AMRFS, use ensemble learning and machine learning techniques to identify specific sites within genomic sequences. By improving the identification and prediction of these modifications, machine learning can greatly contribute to our understanding of genetic processes in multiple species.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige machine learning-algoritmer til nøjagtigt at forudsige forskellige typer af modificeringer i genetisk materiale. Disse algoritmer, såsom M6APred-EL og M6AMRFS, bruger ensemble learning og machine learning-teknikker til at identificere specifikke steder inden for genomiske sekvenser. Ved at forbedre identificeringen og forudsigelsen af disse modificeringer kan machine learning i høj grad bidrage til vores forståelse af genetiske processer i flere arter.

title: Pain prediction
en: Scientists are using algorithms to understand and diagnose chronic pain. By analyzing brain activity and connectivity patterns, machine learning algorithms can identify different characteristics of pain and even predict treatment responses. These algorithms are helping researchers uncover the brain dysfunctions associated with chronic pain and develop personalized approaches to managing it.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forstå og diagnosticere kronisk smerte. Ved at analysere hjerneaktivitet og forbindelsesmønstre kan maskinlæringsalgoritmer identificere forskellige karakteristika ved smerte og endda forudsige behandlingsrespons. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskerne med at afdække de hjernefunktioner, der er knyttet til kronisk smerte, og udvikle personlige tilgange til at håndtere det.

title: Deep Learning Seizure Detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning models, to improve the detection and prediction of epileptic seizures. These algorithms are able to automatically extract features from EEG recordings and accurately classify different types of seizures. By combining different network structures and input modalities, these algorithms have shown promising results in automating the process of seizure identification, potentially assisting epileptologists in their work.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning-modeller, for at forbedre detektion og forudsigelse af epileptiske anfald. Disse algoritmer er i stand til automatisk at udtrække funktioner fra EEG-optagelser og nøjagtigt klassificere forskellige typer af anfald. Ved at kombinere forskellige netværksstrukturer og inputmodaliteter har disse algoritmer vist lovende resultater i automatiseringen af processen med anfaldsidentifikation, hvilket potentielt kan assistere epileptologer i deres arbejde.

title: EV Energy Optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating how algorithms can optimize energy consumption in electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs). They have developed various algorithms, such as optimization models, hybrid intelligent algorithms, Lagrangian relaxation algorithms, and dynamic programming algorithms, to address questions like how traffic signal control affects EV energy consumption, what the optimal path for EVs is under limited battery level, and how to implement eco-driving control for EVs and PHEVs. These algorithms aim to minimize energy consumption and maximize fuel efficiency, contributing to a more sustainable and eco-friendly transportation system.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan optimere energiforbruget i elektriske køretøjer (EVs) og hybride elektriske køretøjer (HEVs). De har udviklet forskellige algoritmer, såsom optimeringsmodeller, hybride intelligente algoritmer, Lagrangian relaxation algorithms og dynamiske programmeringsalgoritmer, for at adressere spørgsmål som hvordan trafiksignalstyring påvirker energiforbruget for EVs, hvad den optimale rute for EVs er under begrænsede batteriniveauer, og hvordan man implementerer eco-driving control for EVs og PHEVs. Disse algoritmer har til formål at minimere energiforbruget og maksimere brændstofeffektiviteten, hvilket bidrager til et mere bæredygtigt og miljøvenligt transportsystem.

title: Deep Learning Prostate Segmentation
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of deep learning algorithms to accurately segment the prostate and other organs in medical images. These algorithms, such as the U-Net structure and convolutional neural networks, are being used to automatically identify and segment different regions of the prostate on MRI and CT scans. By leveraging the power of deep learning, these algorithms have the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of prostate segmentation, aiding in diagnosis and treatment planning for prostate cancer.
da: Forskere udforsker mulighederne for deep learning-algoritmer til nøjagtigt at segmentere prostata og andre organer i medicinske billeder. Disse algoritmer, såsom U-Net-strukturen og convolutional neural networks, anvendes til automatisk at identificere og segmentere forskellige områder af prostata på MRI og CT-scanninger. Ved at udnytte kraften fra deep learning har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af prostata segmentering, hvilket hjælper med diagnose og behandlingsplanlægning for prostatakræft.

title: Credit risk assessment
en: Researchers have explored various questions related to credit scoring and loan default prediction using machine learning algorithms. They have investigated the effectiveness of ensemble models, such as bagging, boosting, and random forests, in improving credit scoring models. Additionally, they have examined the performance of different algorithms, including LightGBM, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest, in predicting loan default risk. These studies highlight the potential of machine learning techniques in accurately assessing credit risk and making informed decisions in the banking and finance industry.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige spørgsmål relateret til kreditvurdering og forudsigelse af lånedefault ved hjælp af machine learning-algoritmer. De har undersøgt effektiviteten af ensemblemodeller, såsom bagging, boosting og random forests, i forbedringen af kreditvurderingsmodeller. Derudover har de vurderet præstationen af forskellige algoritmer, herunder LightGBM, XGBoost, Logistic Regression og Random Forest, i forudsigelsen af lånedefault-risiko. Disse studier fremhæver potentialet af machine learning-teknikker til præcist at vurdere kreditrisiko og træffe informerede beslutninger i bank- og finanssektoren.

title: Automated Wildlife Classification
en: Deep learning algorithms can automatically identify, count, and describe wild animals in camera-trap images, reducing the need for manual data extraction. Convolutional neural networks can detect animals of interest in video-based biodiversity monitoring, saving time in scoring images. Machine learning models can automatically classify wildlife species in camera trap images, reducing the burden of manual image classification. Computer vision algorithms can aid in the detection and classification of animals and humans in camera trap images. These algorithms can improve the efficiency and accuracy of wildlife monitoring and species identification, making it easier to study and protect animals in their natural habitats.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer kan automatisk identificere, tælle og beskrive vilde dyr i billeder fra kamerafælder, hvilket reducerer behovet for manuel dataudtrækning. Convolutional neural networks kan opdage dyrearter af interesse i video-baseret biodiversitetsmonitorering, hvilket sparer tid i scoring af billeder. Maskinlæringsmodeller kan automatisk klassificere dyrearter i billeder fra kamerafælder, hvilket mindsker byrden ved manuel billedeklassificering. Computer vision-algoritmer kan hjælpe med at opdage og klassificere dyr og mennesker i billeder fra kamerafælder. Disse algoritmer kan forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af vildtmonitorering og artsidentifikation, hvilket gør det lettere at studere og beskytte dyr i deres naturlige levesteder.

title: Adversarial Defense
en: Researchers are exploring ways to develop training methods that can withstand attacks on neural networks and identify their vulnerabilities. They are also investigating the use of deep neural rejection mechanisms and robust detection approaches to detect and defend against adversarial examples. Additionally, studies are being conducted to understand the causes of errors in adversarial examples and how they relate to high bias and overfitting. Adversarial training is being used to train models that are robust to multiple types of attacks, but its effectiveness is limited for certain methods. Techniques such as ManiGen and AdvGuard are being developed to generate and resist adversarial examples, respectively. The challenges and defenses against adversarial examples in the real physical world are also being explored. Visual analysis methods are being used to explain the misclassification of adversarial examples. Adversarial Noise Propagation is being employed to train robust deep neural networks against various types of noise. The relationship between generalization and robustness to adversarial examples is being investigated, and a common backbone structure for detection methods is being identified. Recent developments in adversarial attack and defense methods for classification are being reviewed. Novel defense methods, such as using zero-cross-entropy loss and logit balancing loss, are being explored to improve the adversarial robustness of deep neural networks. Efficient methods for adversarial robustness in deep neural networks are also being developed. Techniques like AccelAT and ARGAN are being used to accelerate adversarial training and improve the accuracy of deep neural network models, respectively. The TENET hybrid network architecture is being used to enhance adversarial defense, and dual adversarial attacks are being studied to fool both humans and classifiers. Self-adaptive logit balancing methods are being developed to improve adversarial robustness without adversarial training. Finally, researchers are exploring the trade-off between standard natural accuracy and robustness in deep neural networks.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at udvikle træningsmetoder, der kan modstå angreb på neurale netværk og identificere deres sårbarheder. De undersøger også brugen af deep neural rejection mechanisms og robuste detektionsmetoder til at opdage og forsvare sig mod advarselsprøver. Derudover gennemføres der studier for at forstå årsagerne til fejl i advarselsprøver og hvordan de relaterer sig til høj bias og overfitting. Adversarial training anvendes til at træne modeller, der er robuste over for flere typer angreb, men dens effektivitet er begrænset for visse metoder. Teknikker som ManiGen og AdvGuard udvikles til henholdsvis at generere og modstå advarselsprøver. Udfordringerne og forsvarene mod advarselsprøver i den virkelige fysiske verden undersøges også. Visuelle analysemetoder anvendes til at forklare fejlagtig klassifikation af advarselsprøver. Adversarial Noise Propagation benyttes til at træne robuste deep neural networks mod forskellige typer støj. Forholdet mellem generalisering og robusthed over for advarselsprøver undersøges, og en fælles rygradstruktur for detektionsmetoder identificeres. Nyeste udviklinger inden for angrebs- og forsvarsmetoder mod advarselsprøver til klassifikation gennemgås. Nye forsvarsmetoder, såsom brugen af zero-cross-entropy loss og logit balancing loss, udforskes for at forbedre den adversarial robusthed af deep neural networks. Effektive metoder til adversarial robusthed i deep neural networks udvikles også. Teknikker som AccelAT og ARGAN anvendes til henholdsvis at accelerere adversarial træning og forbedre nøjagtigheden af deep neural network-modeller. TENET hybrid netværksarkitekturen bruges til at forbedre modstandsdygtigheden mod angreb, og dual adversarial attacks studeres for at narre både mennesker og klassifikatorer. Selv-adaptive logit balancing metoder udvikles for at forbedre den adversarial robusthed uden adversarial træning. Endelig udforsker forskere forholdet mellem standard naturlig nøjagtighed og robusthed i deep neural networks.

title: Sparse-view CT reconstruction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms, such as deep learning-based methods, multi-level wavelet convolutional neural networks, and end-to-end deep networks, to improve the reconstruction of sparse-view CT images. They are also comparing the performance of different deep learning-based image reconstruction methods for low-dose and sparse-angle CT. These algorithms aim to enhance the quality of CT images by reconstructing them directly from sparse sinograms or by reducing artifacts and improving image quality.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer, såsom dyb læringsbaserede metoder, multi-level wavelet konvolutionsneurale netværk og end-to-end dybe netværk, for at forbedre rekonstruktionen af sparsivisende CT-billeder. De sammenligner også præstationen af forskellige dyb læringsbaserede billedrekonstruktionsmetoder til lavdosis og sparsivvinkel CT. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre kvaliteten af CT-billeder ved at rekonstruere dem direkte fra sparsomme sinogrammer eller ved at reducere artefakter og forbedre billedkvaliteten.

title: Emotional AI Conversations
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can generate emotional and controllable responses in human-machine conversations. They have developed models and frameworks that incorporate emotion recognition, retrieval methods, reinforcement learning, and generative adversarial networks to improve the emotional accuracy, fluency, and consistency of the generated responses. These advancements aim to create more meaningful and customizable interactions between humans and AI systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan generere følelsesmæssige og kontrollerbare svar i menneske-maskine samtaler. De har udviklet modeller og rammer, der inkorporerer emotion recognition, retrieval methods, reinforcement learning og generative adversarial networks for at forbedre den følelsesmæssige nøjagtighed, flydendehed og konsistens i de genererede svar. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at skabe mere meningsfulde og tilpasselige interaktioner mellem mennesker og AI-systemer.

title: Network Embedding Algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to address different research questions in network embedding, a technique used to learn low-dimensional representations of complex networks. For example, the algorithm named 'CARE' is introduced to handle different types of networks including weighted, directed, and complex. Another algorithm called Sim2vec is designed to encode more comprehensive node similarities in network embedding. These algorithms aim to improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of network embedding methods.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at adressere forskellige forskningsspørgsmål inden for netværksindlejring, en teknik der anvendes til at lære lav-dimensionale repræsentationer af komplekse netværk. For eksempel introduceres algoritmen ved navn 'CARE' for at håndtere forskellige typer af netværk, herunder vægtede, rettede og komplekse. En anden algoritme kaldet Sim2vec er designet til at kode mere omfattende nodesimilariteter i netværksindlejring. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre skalerbarheden, nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af metoder til netværksindlejring.

title: Injury prevention
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of learning algorithms and machine learning techniques to predict and prevent injuries in athletes. These algorithms have been used to identify athletes at high risk for muscle injuries, predict injuries based on training load data, and assess injury risk factors in various sports. By analyzing data and identifying patterns, these algorithms can help athletes and coaches make informed decisions to reduce the risk of injuries.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af læringsalgoritmer og machine learning-teknikker til at forudsige og forebygge skader hos atleter. Disse algoritmer er blevet brugt til at identificere atleter med høj risiko for muskelskader, forudsige skader baseret på træningsbelastningsdata og vurdere risikofaktorer for skader inden for forskellige sportsgrene. Ved at analysere data og identificere mønstre kan disse algoritmer hjælpe atleter og trænere med at træffe informerede beslutninger for at reducere risikoen for skader.

title: Stroke Diagnosis Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the capabilities of automated algorithms in accurately detecting and analyzing various aspects of acute ischemic stroke. These algorithms, such as ATLAS, CNN algorithms like U-Net and DenseNet, DeepSymNet, and various other automated methods, use machine learning and deep learning techniques to segment lesions, evaluate large vessel occlusion, detect infarction, predict final infarct volume, estimate ischemic core volume, and improve the diagnosis of stroke. By training on databases of human-labeled stroke lesions and utilizing non-contrast CT scans, diffusion-weighted imaging, CT angiography, and CT perfusion data, these algorithms aim to provide objective, quick, and accurate assessments of stroke-related parameters.
da: Forskere har undersøgt mulighederne for automatiserede algoritmer til præcist at opdage og analysere forskellige aspekter af akut iskæmisk slagtilfælde. Disse algoritmer, såsom ATLAS, CNN-algoritmer som U-Net og DenseNet, DeepSymNet og forskellige andre automatiserede metoder, bruger maskinlæring og dyb læringsteknikker til at segmentere læsioner, evaluere store karokklusioner, opdage infarkter, forudsige den endelige infarktmængde, estimere det iskæmiske kernevolumen og forbedre diagnosen af slagtilfælde. Ved at træne på databaser af menneskeligt mærkede slagtilfældeslæsioner og udnytte ikke-kontrast CT-scanninger, diffusion-vægtet billeddannelse, CT-angiografi og CT-perfusionsdata sigter disse algoritmer mod at give objektive, hurtige og præcise vurderinger af slagtilfælde-relaterede parametre.

title: Sleep classification
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of various algorithms, such as deep learning, convolutional neural networks, and transfer learning, to classify sleep stages and detect sleep disorders. These algorithms are being applied to different types of data, including electrocardiogram signals, EEG signals, and multi-domain data. The goal is to develop automated systems that can accurately classify sleep stages and assist in diagnosing sleep disorders, potentially improving the efficiency and accuracy of sleep studies.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af forskellige algoritmer, såsom deep learning, convolutional neural networks og transfer learning, til at klassificere søvnfaser og opdage søvnforstyrrelser. Disse algoritmer anvendes på forskellige typer data, herunder elektrokardiogram-signaler, EEG-signaler og multi-domain data. Målet er at udvikle automatiserede systemer, der præcist kan klassificere søvnfaser og hjælpe med at diagnosticere søvnforstyrrelser, hvilket potentielt kan forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af søvnstudier.

title: Distributed Optimization Algorithms
en: Researchers have developed novel algorithms to solve various distributed optimization problems in multi-agent systems. These algorithms address a range of constraints and communication time-delays, and provide sufficient conditions for convergence to the optimizer. The proposed algorithms aim to optimize resource allocation, control input constraints, and deal with hybrid linear constraints, among other challenges.
da: Forskere har udviklet nye algoritmer til at løse forskellige distribuerede optimeringsproblemer i multi-agent systemer. Disse algoritmer adresserer en række begrænsninger og kommunikationsforsinkelse og giver tilstrækkelige betingelser for konvergens til optimereren. De foreslåede algoritmer har til formål at optimere ressourceallokering, kontrollere inputbegrænsninger og håndtere hybride lineære begrænsninger blandt andre udfordringer.

title: Spatial Co-location Mining
en: Researchers are developing algorithms to address various challenges in the field of spatial co-location pattern mining. These algorithms aim to achieve lossless condensed representation and discovery of patterns, reduce redundancy, improve accuracy and effectiveness, efficiently mine patterns from massive datasets, and consider factors like influence and coupling relations. The goal is to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of mining spatial co-location patterns, which can have applications in fields like urban planning and transportation.
da: Forskere udvikler algoritmer for at tackle forskellige udfordringer inden for området for spatial co-location pattern mining. Disse algoritmer har til formål at opnå tabsfri kondenseret repræsentation og opdagelse af mønstre, reducere redundans, forbedre nøjagtighed og effektivitet, effektivt udvinde mønstre fra massive datasæt og tage hensyn til faktorer som indflydelse og koblingsforhold. Målet er at forbedre effektiviteten og effektiviteten af udvinding af spatial co-location mønstre, som kan have anvendelser inden for områder som byplanlægning og transport.

title: Parallel Deep Learning
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to parallelize and implement various algorithms in order to improve the efficiency and speed of deep learning tasks. These algorithms include the Bayesian ARTMAP neural network, stochastic gradient descent, deep neural network training, and convolutional neural networks. By implementing these algorithms in parallel and distributed computing environments, researchers aim to accelerate the training process and improve the scalability and performance of deep learning models.
da: Forskere har udforsket måder at parallelisere og implementere forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre effektiviteten og hastigheden af dyb læringsopgaver. Disse algoritmer inkluderer den Bayesian ARTMAP neural network, stochastic gradient descent, deep neural network training og convolutional neural networks. Ved at implementere disse algoritmer i parallelle og distribuerede computermiljøer sigter forskerne mod at accelerere træningsprocessen og forbedre skalerbarheden og ydeevnen af dyb læringsmodeller.

title: Cyberbullying detection
en: Algorithms play a crucial role in detecting and preventing cyberbullying on social media platforms. They are used to develop prediction models, detect abusive behavior, and categorize the severity of cyberbullying. However, there are challenges and limitations in the accuracy and uniformity of these algorithms, and researchers are exploring different approaches, such as machine learning and natural language processing, to improve cyberbullying detection. Additionally, algorithms are also being used to detect cyber harassment and hate speech in multiple languages, and to incorporate context into the classification of cyberbullying.
da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at opdage og forebygge cybermobning på sociale medieplatforme. De bruges til at udvikle forudsigelsesmodeller, opdage misbrugsadfærd og kategorisere alvoren af cybermobning. Der er dog udfordringer og begrænsninger i nøjagtigheden og ensartetheden af disse algoritmer, og forskere undersøger forskellige tilgange, såsom machine learning og natural language processing, for at forbedre detektionen af cybermobning. Derudover bliver algoritmer også brugt til at opdage cyberchikane og hadetale på flere sprog og til at inkorporere kontekst i klassifikationen af cybermobning.

title: Algorithms in Risk Management
en: Algorithms are playing a significant role in reshaping the financial industry and risk management practices. They are being used to streamline risk management processes, construct credit profiles, and detect fraud. However, there are also risks associated with the use of algorithms, such as cybersecurity threats and potential harm to consumers. Researchers are exploring ways to regulate and address these challenges, while also recognizing the opportunities that algorithms bring, such as improved regulatory compliance and public value creation.
da: Algoritmer spiller en væsentlig rolle i omlægningen af den finansielle industri og risikostyringspraksisser. De bliver brugt til at strømline risikostyringsprocesser, konstruere kreditprofiler og opdage svindel. Dog er der også risici forbundet med brugen af algoritmer, såsom cybersikkerhedstrusler og potentiel skade på forbrugerne. Forskere undersøger måder at regulere og håndtere disse udfordringer på, mens de også anerkender de muligheder, som algoritmer bringer, såsom forbedret overholdelse af regulativer og skabelse af offentlig værdi.

title: Algorithmic justice
en: Machine learning algorithms have the potential to improve human decision-making in bail decisions, reducing crime rates and racial disparities. However, commercial risk assessment software may not be more accurate or fair than predictions made by individuals with little or no criminal justice expertise. Algorithm-driven risk assessment tools in criminal justice can create standardized decision-making and anticipate behavior, but they also raise concerns about the protection of Fourth Amendment rights and the introduction of value into the legal process. Overall, the use of algorithms in criminal justice has the power to transform decision-making processes and public policy, but it also presents challenges in terms of policy, individual rights, and discriminatory outcomes.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer har potentialet til at forbedre menneskelig beslutningstagning i bailsager, reducere kriminalitetsrater og racemæssige forskelle. Dog kan kommerciel risikovurderingssoftware muligvis ikke være mere præcis eller retfærdig end forudsigelser foretaget af personer med lidt eller ingen ekspertise inden for strafferettens område. Algoritmestyrende risikovurderingsværktøjer i strafferetten kan skabe standardiseret beslutningstagning og forudse adfærd, men de rejser også bekymringer om beskyttelsen af Fourth Amendment-rettigheder og introduktionen af værdier i den juridiske proces. Samlet set har brugen af algoritmer i strafferetten magten til at transformere beslutningstagning processer og offentlig politik, men det præsenterer også udfordringer med hensyn til politik, individuelle rettigheder og diskriminerende resultater.

title: Soil contamination analysis
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to investigate the contamination of soil by trace metals in various regions of China. These algorithms, such as geographic information systems and multivariate statistical models, help identify the characteristics and potential sources of contamination. By analyzing data and using machine learning techniques, researchers can pinpoint the spatial distribution and anthropogenic sources of toxic elements in soil, as well as assess the risks and potential health impacts associated with heavy metal pollution. These algorithms play a crucial role in understanding and managing soil pollution for the protection of both the environment and human health.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at undersøge forureningen af jord med spor-metaller i forskellige regioner i Kina. Disse algoritmer, såsom geographic information systems og multivariate statistical models, hjælper med at identificere karakteristika og potentielle kilder til forurening. Ved at analysere data og bruge machine learning-teknikker kan forskerne præcist bestemme den rumlige fordeling og de antropogene kilder til toksiske elementer i jorden, samt vurdere risiciene og de potentielle sundhedseffekter, der er forbundet med forurening af tungmetaller. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i forståelsen og håndteringen af jordforurening for at beskytte både miljøet og menneskers sundhed.

title: Plant disease diagnosis
en: Scientists have been exploring the use of deep learning models and convolutional neural networks to accurately detect and diagnose plant diseases using leaf images. These algorithms have been developed and implemented to identify and classify various plant diseases, including those in rice, potato, cotton, apple, and tomato crops. By using these advanced algorithms, researchers aim to improve the objectivity and efficiency of plant disease recognition, ultimately helping farmers in agriculture.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-modeller og convolutional neural networks til præcist at opdage og diagnosticere plantesygdomme ved hjælp af bladebilleder. Disse algoritmer er blevet udviklet og implementeret for at identificere og klassificere forskellige plantesygdomme, herunder dem i ris-, kartoffel-, bomulds-, æble- og tomatafgrøder. Ved at bruge disse avancerede algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre objektiviteten og effektiviteten af plantesygdomsgenkendelse, hvilket i sidste ende hjælper landmænd i landbruget.

title: Algorithmic Damage Detection
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms, such as 1D CNNs, deep convolutional neural networks, and machine learning, to improve the detection and identification of structural damage in buildings and bridges. These algorithms aim to extract high-level features, suppress noise, and accurately classify the severity of damage using raw time-series data or vibration responses. By combining different algorithms and techniques, scientists hope to develop more efficient and accurate methods for monitoring and maintaining the structural health of infrastructure.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af forskellige algoritmer, såsom 1D CNNs, deep convolutional neural networks og machine learning, for at forbedre detektion og identifikation af strukturelle skader i bygninger og broer. Disse algoritmer har til formål at udtrække højniveaufunktioner, undertrykke støj og præcist klassificere skadens alvorlighed ved hjælp af råt tidsserie-data eller vibrationsrespons. Ved at kombinere forskellige algoritmer og teknikker håber forskerne at udvikle mere effektive og præcise metoder til overvågning og vedligeholdelse af den strukturelle sundhed i infrastrukturen.

title: Immersive Education
en: Researchers have explored various ways in which virtual reality, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence can be applied in education. These technologies have the potential to revolutionize teaching and learning by creating immersive and interactive experiences. By harnessing the power of algorithms, these technologies can enhance online learning, bridge the gap between virtual and physical delivery, increase motivation among students, and provide innovative solutions for collaborative education.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige måder, hvorpå virtual reality, augmented reality og artificial intelligence kan anvendes i uddannelse. Disse teknologier har potentiale til at revolutionere undervisning og læring ved at skabe immersive og interaktive oplevelser. Ved at udnytte kraften fra algoritmer kan disse teknologier forbedre online læring, bygge bro mellem virtuel og fysisk levering, øge motivationen blandt studerende og levere innovative løsninger til samarbejdende uddannelse.

title: Smart waste management
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve waste management and recycling. They are investigating whether deep learning algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks (CNN), can accurately classify different types of waste for recycling. These algorithms, combined with cutting-edge techniques and technologies like the Internet of Things (IoT), have the potential to optimize waste management systems and improve sustainability.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre affaldshåndtering og genbrug. De undersøger, om deep learning-algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks (CNN), kan klassificere forskellige typer affald præcist til genbrug. Disse algoritmer, kombineret med avancerede teknikker og teknologier som Internet of Things (IoT), har potentiale til at optimere affaldshåndteringssystemer og forbedre bæredygtighed.

title: Workforce Algorithm Impact
en: Algorithms are playing a significant role in shaping the future of work and the economy. They are causing disruptions in skills and employment, transforming the economy through automation, and potentially decreasing tasks for human workers. While algorithms have the potential to create productivity increases and opportunities, they also pose risks of further inequality. Governments and organized labor are paying attention to these changes and preparing to address the challenges they bring.
da: Algoritmer spiller en væsentlig rolle i at forme fremtiden for arbejde og økonomi. De forårsager forstyrrelser i færdigheder og beskæftigelse, transformerende økonomien gennem automation og potentielt mindsker opgaver for menneskelige arbejdstagere. Selvom algoritmer har potentiale til at skabe produktivitetsstigninger og muligheder, medfører de også risici for yderligere ulighed. Regeringer og organiseret arbejdskraft følger nøje med i disse ændringer og forbereder sig på at tackle de udfordringer, de medfører.

title: Algorithmic labor control
en: Algorithms play a significant role in controlling work on online labor platforms, as they are used to assign, monitor, and evaluate tasks. These algorithms also have the power to clarify work away from individuals with unsatisfactory ratings. However, the agency of algorithms is not absolute, as workers can disrupt algorithmic power and resist algorithmic control through specific organizing modes and collective solidarities.
da: Algoritmer spiller en væsentlig rolle i kontrol af arbejde på online arbejdsplatforme, da de bruges til at tildele, overvåge og evaluere opgaver. Disse algoritmer har også magten til at fjerne arbejde fra personer med utilfredsstillende vurderinger. Dog er algoritmernes magt ikke absolut, da arbejdere kan forstyrre den algoritmiske magt og modsætte sig algoritmisk kontrol gennem specifikke organiseringsmetoder og kollektiv solidaritet.

title: Optimizing Logistics
en: Researchers have explored various ways in which algorithms can be used to improve logistics and supply chain management. These algorithms, powered by artificial intelligence and big data analysis, can optimize processes, enhance efficiency, and make better decisions. They can also enable the integration of technologies like the Internet of Things and digital intelligence into logistics systems, leading to improved transportation, warehousing, and delivery. Overall, algorithms play a crucial role in leveraging new technologies and promoting digitalization and automation in the logistics sector.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige måder, hvorpå algoritmer kan bruges til at forbedre logistik og forsyningskædeledelse. Disse algoritmer, drevet af artificial intelligence og big data-analyse, kan optimere processer, forbedre effektiviteten og træffe bedre beslutninger. De kan også muliggøre integrationen af teknologier som Internet of Things og digital intelligence i logistiksystemer, hvilket fører til forbedret transport, lagerføring og levering. Samlet set spiller algoritmer en afgørende rolle i udnyttelsen af nye teknologier og fremme af digitalisering og automatisering i logistiksektoren.

title: Malaria parasite detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of various deep learning algorithms, such as CNN-based models, customized CNN models, and stacked CNN architectures, to improve the detection and classification of malaria parasites in blood smear images. These algorithms, along with transfer learning and object detection techniques, have shown promise in automating the detection process and accurately identifying malaria parasites. Additionally, the integration of smartphones with microscopes and the use of image segmentation methods have been investigated as potential tools for improving malaria parasite detection.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af forskellige deep learning-algoritmer, såsom CNN-baserede modeller, tilpassede CNN-modeller og stablede CNN-arkitekturer, for at improve detektion og klassifikation af malaria parasitter i blodudstrygninger. Disse algoritmer, sammen med transfer learning og objektdetektionsteknikker, har vist lovende resultater i automatiseringen af detektionsprocessen og nøjagtig identifikation af malaria parasitter. Derudover er integrationen af smartphones med mikroskoper og brugen af billedsegmenteringsmetoder blevet undersøgt som potentielle værktøjer til at forbedre malaria parasitdetektionen.

title: AI-Personal Assistants
en: Researchers have been exploring various factors that influence the adoption and use of intelligent personal assistants (IPAs) like Siri and Alexa. They are investigating the role of factors such as trust, anthropomorphism, empathy, and personal traits in shaping users' attitudes and intentions towards these AI-powered assistants. Additionally, studies are examining the impact of AI on consumer behavior, customer engagement, and the online shopping experience, as well as the relationship between consumers and virtual agents. These findings aim to enhance our understanding of how algorithms and AI technologies shape our interactions and decision-making processes.
da: Forskere har været i gang med at undersøge forskellige faktorer, der påvirker vedtagelsen og brugen af intelligente personlige assistenter (IPAs) som Siri og Alexa. De undersøger rollen af faktorer som tillid, antropomorfisme, empati og personlige træk i formningen af brugernes holdninger og intentioner over for disse AI-drevne assistenter. Derudover undersøger studier virkningen af AI på forbrugeradfærd, kundedeltagelse og den online shoppingoplevelse, samt forholdet mellem forbrugere og virtuelle agenter. Disse fund har til formål at forbedre vores forståelse af, hvordan algoritmer og AI-teknologier former vores interaktioner og beslutningsprocesser.

title: Algorithms in Drone Logistics
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to solve different problems related to the use of drones in delivery services. These algorithms aim to minimize operational costs, optimize routing, and solve complex scheduling problems. By using mixed-integer programming models, branch-and-cut algorithms, and heuristic approaches, these algorithms offer efficient solutions for integrating drones into last-mile delivery systems.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer til at løse forskellige problemer relateret til brugen af droner i leveringsservices. Disse algoritmer har til formål at minimere driftsomkostninger, optimere ruteplanlægning og løse komplekse planlægningsproblemer. Ved at anvende mixed-integer programming modeller, branch-and-cut algoritmer og heuristiske tilgange tilbyder disse algoritmer effektive løsninger til at integrere droner i sidste-mile leveringssystemer.

title: Artificial Art Analysis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Deep Learning, to analyze and classify art images. They are investigating whether these algorithms can be fine-tuned for tasks such as art-related image classification, predicting aesthetic evaluation and sentiment, improving style classification, and even art authentication. The goal is to leverage the power of machine learning to enhance our understanding and appreciation of art.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af algoritmer, specifikt Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) og Deep Learning, til at analysere og klassificere kunstbilleder. De undersøger, om disse algoritmer kan fintunes til opgaver såsom kunstrelateret billedeklassificering, forudsigelse af æstetisk vurdering og følelser, forbedring af stilklassificering og endda kunstautentificering. Målet er at udnytte kraften fra maskinlæring til at forbedre vores forståelse og værdsættelse af kunst.

title: Tool wear prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to monitor and predict tool wear in milling operations. They are investigating various deep learning and machine learning approaches, such as convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and hybrid methods. These algorithms can analyze force signals and other data to indicate different stages of tool wear, enabling real-time monitoring and prediction for more efficient and intelligent machining processes.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at overvåge og forudsige værktøjslide i fræsningsoperationer. De undersøger forskellige dyb læring og maskinlæring tilgange, såsom convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks og hybridmetoder. Disse algoritmer kan analysere kraftsignaler og andre data for at indikere forskellige stadier af værktøjslide, hvilket muliggør realtids overvågning og forudsigelse for mere effektive og intelligente bearbejdningsprocesser.

title: Predictive maintenance
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to predict the remaining useful life of various systems and machinery. These algorithms, such as deep feature representation and long short-term memory neural networks, are being attributed with the ability to estimate how much longer a particular component or equipment will function effectively. By analyzing sensor signals and using techniques like transfer learning and ensemble learning, these algorithms aim to provide valuable insights into the reliability and remaining useful life of industrial equipment.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige den resterende nyttige livstid for forskellige systemer og maskiner.
