Disse algoritmer, såsom deep feature representation og long short-term memory neural networks, tilskrives evnen til at estimere, hvor meget længere en bestemt komponent eller udstyr vil fungere effektivt. Ved at analysere sensorsignaler og bruge teknikker som transfer learning og ensemble learning, har disse algoritmer til formål at give værdifulde indsigter i pålideligheden og den resterende nyttige livstid for industriel udstyr.

title: MEC Optimization
en: Researchers have been investigating how to optimize the performance of mobile edge computing (MEC) systems by using algorithms. These algorithms aim to address various challenges such as computation offloading, energy consumption, latency, and resource allocation. By developing efficient computation offloading algorithms and optimizing different parameters, such as user association, transmit powers, and task offloading partitions, these algorithms can improve the overall efficiency and energy consumption of MEC systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan man kan optimere ydeevnen af mobile edge computing (MEC) systemer ved at bruge algoritmer. Disse algoritmer har til formål at tackle forskellige udfordringer som computation offloading, energiforbrug, latenstid og ressourcefordeling. Ved at udvikle effektive computation offloading-algoritmer og optimere forskellige parametre, såsom brugerassociation, transmissionsstyrker og opgaveaflastningspartitioner, kan disse algoritmer forbedre den samlede effektivitet og energiforbruget af MEC-systemer.

title: Network slicing algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to address the challenges of resource allocation in network slicing, which involves dividing a network into virtual slices for different services. These algorithms aim to optimize resource allocation based on factors like spectrum aggregation, user association, and quality of service requirements. By designing and developing these algorithms, scientists hope to improve network throughput, reduce interference, and ensure fair resource allocation in future wireless networks.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at håndtere udfordringerne ved ressourceallokering i netværksslicing, som involverer opdeling af et netværk i virtuelle slices til forskellige tjenester. Disse algoritmer har til formål at optimere ressourceallokeringen baseret på faktorer som spektrumaggregator, brugertilslutning og krav til kvaliteten af tjenesten. Ved at designe og udvikle disse algoritmer håber forskerne at forbedre netværkets gennemløb, reducere interferens og sikre retfærdig ressourceallokering i fremtidige trådløse netværk.

title: Machine learning optimization
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to improve various aspects of machining processes. They have investigated which algorithms perform best for predicting cutting parameters, tool wear, tool life stages, induced residual stresses, energy consumption, surface roughness, and cutting forces in different types of turning and milling. The algorithms used include support vector regression, polynomial regression, artificial neural networks, random forest, back-propagation neural network, multi-objective particle swarm optimization, Gaussian process regression, and more. These studies aim to optimize machining processes and improve the efficiency and quality of manufacturing.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af maskinlæringsalgoritmer for at forbedre forskellige aspekter af bearbejdningsprocesser. De har undersøgt, hvilke algoritmer der præsterer bedst til at forudsige skæremutationsparametre, værktøjs slid, værktøjs livsfaser, inducerede restspændinger, energiforbrug, overflade ruhed og skærekræfter i forskellige typer drejning og fræsning. De anvendte algoritmer inkluderer support vector regression, polynomial regression, artificial neural networks, random forest, back-propagation neural network, multi-objective particle swarm optimization, Gaussian process regression, og meget mere. Disse studier har til formål at optimere bearbejdningsprocesser og forbedre effektiviteten og kvaliteten af produktionen.

title: Algorithmic ethics
en: Researchers have explored various questions related to the use of facial recognition technology and other algorithms. They have investigated the accuracy of face recognition technology compared to human experts, the ethical implications of using such technology, and the legal norms applicable to its use in law enforcement. They have also examined the impact of artificial intelligence on privacy and security, and the need for regulation to protect individual freedoms and prevent discrimination. Overall, the research highlights the need for careful consideration and regulation of algorithms to ensure their responsible and ethical use.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige spørgsmål relateret til brugen af ansigtsgenkendelsesteknologi og andre algoritmer. De har undersøgt nøjagtigheden af ansigtsgenkendelsesteknologi sammenlignet med menneskelige eksperter, de etiske konsekvenser af at bruge sådan teknologi, og de juridiske normer der gælder for dens anvendelse i retshåndhævelse. De har også undersøgt indvirkningen af artificial intelligence på privatlivets fred og sikkerhed, samt behovet for regulering for at beskytte individuelle friheder og forhindre diskrimination. Samlet set fremhæver forskningen behovet for omhyggelig overvejelse og regulering af algoritmer for at sikre deres ansvarlige og etiske anvendelse.

title: Gesture radar technology
en: Researchers are exploring the use of radar sensors and algorithms to improve hand gesture recognition. These algorithms analyze radar data to extract features and recognize different gestures, allowing for more accurate and robust recognition. By using radar technology, these systems can detect and interpret hand gestures in various environments, such as in vehicles or with multiple targets present.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af radar sensorer og algoritmer til at forbedre håndgesturegenkendelse. Disse algoritmer analyserer radar data for at udtrække funktioner og genkende forskellige gester, hvilket muliggør mere præcis og robust genkendelse. Ved at bruge radar teknologi kan disse systemer opdage og fortolke håndgester i forskellige miljøer, såsom i køretøjer eller med flere mål til stede.

title: Geotechnical prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of various algorithms to improve the accuracy and efficiency of predicting dam deformation, displacement of landslides, and other geotechnical phenomena. These algorithms include support vector machines, double exponential smoothing, kernel extreme learning machines, and more. By combining these algorithms with other methods and optimization techniques, scientists aim to develop prediction models that can accurately forecast these natural events and improve dam health monitoring.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af forudsigelser af dæmning deformation, forskydning af jordskred og andre geotekniske fænomener. Disse algoritmer inkluderer support vector machines, double exponential smoothing, kernel extreme learning machines og mere. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med andre metoder og optimeringsteknikker sigter videnskabsfolk mod at udvikle forudsigelsesmodeller, der præcist kan forudsige disse naturlige begivenheder og forbedre overvågningen af dæmningens sundhed.

title: Secure UAV Communications
en: Researchers are exploring how to optimize secure communication systems using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). They are investigating various algorithms to maximize secrecy rate, energy efficiency, and system performance. These algorithms include joint trajectory design, user scheduling, energy-efficient trajectory planning, cooperative jamming, and resource allocation. The goal is to enhance the security and efficiency of UAV-enabled secure communications while avoiding obstacles and maximizing the overall performance of the system.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan man kan optimere sikre kommunikationssystemer ved hjælp af ubemandede luftfartøjer (UAV'er). De undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at maksimere hemmelighedsniveauet, energieffektiviteten og systemets ydeevne. Disse algoritmer inkluderer fælles baneplanlægning, brugerplanlægning, energieffektiv baneplanlægning, kooperativ jammering og ressourceallokering. Målet er at forbedre sikkerheden og effektiviteten af UAV-understøttede sikre kommunikationer, samtidig med at man undgår forhindringer og maksimerer den samlede ydeevne af systemet.

title: Cloud workload prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict cloud workload and improve resource management in cloud computing. These algorithms, such as deep learning models and neural networks, are being developed to accurately forecast cloud datacenter networks' workload, enhance workload prediction for cloud providers, and improve resource management at cloud data centers. By leveraging machine learning techniques, these algorithms aim to optimize cloud services and address challenges in workload anticipation and resource allocation.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige cloud workload og forbedre ressourcehåndtering i cloud computing. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep learning-modeller og neural networks, udvikles for nøjagtigt at kunne forudsige workload i cloud datacenter netværk, forbedre workload forudsigelse for cloud-udbydere og optimere ressourcehåndtering i cloud datacentre. Ved at udnytte machine learning-teknikker sigter disse algoritmer mod at optimere cloud services og tackle udfordringer i workload anticipation og resource allocation.

title: Next-gen networks
en: Researchers are exploring the future network technologies for the 5G/IoT Era, aiming to achieve a flexible and smart network. They are also addressing the challenges and solutions for 5G mobile services and scenarios, with the goal of overcoming the limitations of previous cellular standards and enabling future IoT. Additionally, researchers are proposing cutting-edge technologies such as AI/ML, quantum communication, and blockchain for the realization of beyond 5G and 6G communications.
da: Forskere udforsker fremtidens netværksteknologier til 5G/IoT-æraen med det mål at opnå et fleksibelt og intelligent netværk. De adresserer også udfordringerne og løsningerne for 5G mobile tjenester og scenarier, med målet om at overvinde begrænsningerne i tidligere mobilstandarder og muliggøre fremtidens IoT. Derudover foreslår forskerne banebrydende teknologier såsom AI/ML, quantum communication og blockchain til realiseringen af beyond 5G og 6G kommunikation.

title: Efficient CNN Acceleration
en: Researchers are exploring how to design hardware architectures that can accelerate deep convolutional neural network models, making them more efficient. They are also investigating ways to map CNN onto embedded FPGAs for fast deployment and high power efficiency. Additionally, they are working on designing FPGA-based accelerators that can efficiently run convolutional neural networks in low density FPGAs, optimizing neural networks for efficient FPGA implementation, and achieving full-stack acceleration of deep CNNs on FPGAs.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan man kan designe hardwarearkitekturer, der kan accelerere dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværksmodeller, hvilket gør dem mere effektive. De undersøger også måder at kortlægge CNN til indbyggede FPGAs for hurtig implementering og høj effektivitet. Derudover arbejder de på at designe FPGA-baserede acceleratorer, der effektivt kan køre konvolutionelle neurale netværk i lavt tætte FPGAs, optimere neurale netværk til effektiv FPGA-implementering og opnå fuldstakacceleration af dybe CNNs på FPGAs.

title: Memristor Neural Networks
en: Researchers are exploring the potential of memristor-based neural networks to achieve high recognition accuracy in practical applications. They are developing learning algorithms and hardware architectures that can improve the efficiency of neuromorphic computing systems. Additionally, they are investigating how fully memristive neural networks with unsupervised learning can perform pattern classification. These advancements in memristor technology have the potential to contribute to energy-efficient neuromorphic computing and efficient brain-like computing networks.
da: Forskere udforsker potentialet af memristor-baserede neurale netværk for at opnå høj genkendelsesnøjagtighed i praktiske anvendelser. De udvikler læringsalgoritmer og hardwarearkitekturer, der kan forbedre effektiviteten af neuromorfe databehandlingssystemer. Derudover undersøger de, hvordan fuldt memristive neurale netværk med usuperviseret læring kan udføre mønstergenkendelse. Disse fremskridt inden for memristor teknologi har potentiale til at bidrage til energieffektiv neuromorf databehandling og effektive hjerne-lignende databehandlingsnetværk.

title: Seismic risk assessment
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to assess the safety and integrity of buildings after earthquakes. These algorithms can predict the structural responses, fragility curves, failure modes, and seismic damage of various types of structures. By analyzing data on response patterns, damage extent, and material properties, machine learning models can quickly and accurately evaluate the seismic risk and vulnerability of buildings, bridges, and other infrastructure. This technology has the potential to enhance post-earthquake assessments and improve our understanding of structural safety.
da: Maskinlæring algoritmer bliver brugt til at vurdere sikkerheden og integriteten af bygninger efter jordskælv. Disse algoritmer kan forudsige de strukturelle reaktioner, skrøbelighedskurver, fejlfunktioner og seismisk skade af forskellige typer strukturer. Ved at analysere data om reaktionsmønstre, skadesomfang og materialeegenskaber kan maskinlæringsmodeller hurtigt og nøjagtigt evaluere den seismiske risiko og sårbarhed af bygninger, broer og anden infrastruktur. Denne teknologi har potentiale til at forbedre vurderinger efter jordskælv og øge vores forståelse af strukturel sikkerhed.

title: Advanced Recognition Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to accurately recognize and identify license plates in various scenarios. These algorithms, based on machine learning and deep learning techniques, are designed to locate license plates, recognize characters, and determine the issuing country. They have shown promising results in improving license plate recognition in complex environments, non-standard environments, and challenging conditions, with high accuracy rates and real-time performance.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til nøjagtigt at genkende og identificere nummerplader i forskellige scenarier. Disse algoritmer, der er baseret på machine learning og deep learning teknikker, er designet til at lokalisere nummerplader, genkende tegn og bestemme udstedelseslandet. De har vist lovende resultater i forbedring af nummerpladegenkendelse i komplekse miljøer, ikke-standardiserede miljøer og udfordrende forhold, med høje nøjagtighedsgrader og realtidsydelse.

title: CapsNet Enhancements
en: Researchers in the field of Machine Learning are constantly working on improving the performance of CapsNet, a type of neural network architecture. They are exploring various algorithms and techniques to enhance CapsNet's ability to classify complex datasets, images with complex backgrounds, and medical images. These advancements include preprocessing modules, mask DR algorithms, diverse enhanced capsule networks, deep tensor capsule networks, and more. The goal is to make CapsNet more efficient, reduce the number of parameters, and address computational burdens, while also improving its speed and complexity.
da: Forskere inden for Machine Learning arbejder konstant på at forbedre ydeevnen af CapsNet, en type neuralt netværksarkitektur. De udforsker forskellige algoritmer og teknikker for at forbedre CapsNets evne til at klassificere komplekse datasæt, billeder med komplekse baggrunde og medicinske billeder. Disse fremskridt inkluderer forbehandlingsmoduler, mask DR-algoritmer, forskellige forbedrede kapselnetværk, dybe tensor kapselnetværk og mere. Målet er at gøre CapsNet mere effektivt, reducere antallet af parametre og tackle computermæssige byrder, samtidig med at hastigheden og kompleksiteten forbedres.

title: Predictive Algorithms for Heart Disease
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to accurately predict and diagnose heart disease. These algorithms, such as Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees, and Random Forests, analyze medical data to develop risk assessment models. By applying data mining and supervised learning techniques, researchers are able to improve the accuracy of heart disease prediction and classification.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bruges til præcist at forudsige og diagnosticere hjerte sygdomme. Disse algoritmer, såsom Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees og Random Forests, analyserer medicinske data for at udvikle risikovurderingsmodeller. Ved at anvende data mining og supervised learning teknikker kan forskere forbedre nøjagtigheden af hjerte sygdoms forudsigelse og klassificering.

title: Advancements in DRL
en: Researchers have been investigating the improvements and challenges in reinforcement learning and deep learning. They have found that algorithms such as deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and convolutional networks have been key in these advancements. Additionally, there has been a focus on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MDRL) and its applications, as well as the development of open-source libraries like ChainerRL. These studies aim to understand the current state of deep reinforcement learning and its potential in various fields.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forbedringerne og udfordringerne inden for reinforcement learning og deep learning. De har fundet, at algoritmer som deep reinforcement learning (DRL) og convolutional networks har været afgørende i disse fremskridt. Derudover har der været fokus på multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MDRL) og dets anvendelser, samt udviklingen af open-source biblioteker som ChainerRL. Disse studier har til formål at forstå den nuværende tilstand af deep reinforcement learning og dens potentiale inden for forskellige områder.

title: Enhancing Robot Navigation
en: Researchers have been exploring how deep reinforcement learning algorithms can improve the navigation and path planning abilities of mobile robots in unknown environments. These algorithms, such as Double Q-network (DDQN) and Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradients (TD3) with Probabilistic Roadmap (PRM), enable the robots to dynamically plan paths, explore unknown areas, avoid obstacles, and follow trajectories. By combining deep learning techniques with reinforcement learning, these algorithms enhance the autonomous navigation capabilities of mobile robots, making them more efficient and adaptable in various scenarios.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer kan forbedre navigationen og ruteplanlægningsmulighederne for mobile robotter i ukendte miljøer. Disse algoritmer, såsom Double Q-network (DDQN) og Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradients (TD3) med Probabilistic Roadmap (PRM), giver robotterne mulighed for dynamisk at planlægge ruter, udforske ukendte områder, undgå forhindringer og følge trajektorier. Ved at kombinere deep learning-teknikker med reinforcement learning forbedrer disse algoritmer de autonome navigationsmuligheder for mobile robotter, hvilket gør dem mere effektive og tilpasselige i forskellige scenarier.

title: Student performance prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict student performance in various educational settings. Commonly used algorithms include decision trees, Bayesian networks, and ensemble methods that combine classification and regression algorithms. These algorithms are employed to develop user-friendly decision support software and machine learning models that can accurately analyze and predict student achievement, identify students at risk of dropping out, and improve the evaluation process of student performance. Additionally, researchers have found that feature selection and reduced feature sets can enhance the performance of machine learning models in predicting student performance.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige studerendes præstationer i forskellige uddannelsesmiljøer. Almindeligt anvendte algoritmer inkluderer decision trees, Bayesian networks og ensemble methods, der kombinerer klassifikations- og regressionsalgoritmer. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at udvikle brugervenlig beslutningsstøttesoftware og machine learning-modeller, der præcist kan analysere og forudsige studerendes præstationer, identificere studerende i risiko for at falde fra og forbedre evalueringsprocessen af studerendes præstationer. Derudover har forskerne fundet, at feature selection og reducerede funktionssæt kan forbedre ydeevnen af machine learning-modeller i forudsigelsen af studerendes præstationer.

title: Autonomous driving optimization
en: Researchers are exploring how deep reinforcement learning algorithms can be used to address the challenges of autonomous driving in complex traffic. These algorithms, such as the deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, are deployed to learn successful strategies for autonomous vehicles. They are also investigating the use of reinforcement learning and inverse reinforcement learning techniques to determine optimal driving strategies and learn expert driving behavior for advanced planning in autonomous vehicles. These algorithms are being used to optimize fuel consumption, guide vehicles through intersections, reduce fuel consumption, and make safe and efficient lane change decisions for autonomous driving.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer kan bruges til at tackle udfordringerne ved autonom kørsel i komplekse trafikforhold. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, anvendes til at lære succesfulde strategier for autonome køretøjer. De undersøger også brugen af reinforcement learning og inverse reinforcement learning teknikker til at bestemme optimale kørestrategier og lære ekspertkøreadfærd til avanceret planlægning i autonome køretøjer. Disse algoritmer bruges til at optimere brændstofforbrug, guide køretøjer gennem kryds, reducere brændstofforbrug og træffe sikre og effektive beslutninger om filskift til autonom kørsel.

title: AI-optimized networks
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep reinforcement learning algorithms to improve routing and control strategies in software-defined networks. These algorithms, such as NetworkAI, DROM, and TIDE, are being developed to dynamically optimize routing, enable scalable routing, and improve quality of service in these networks. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, these algorithms have the potential to enhance the efficiency and performance of software-defined networks.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af dybe forstærkningslæringsalgoritmer til at forbedre routing- og kontrolstrategier i softwaredefinerede netværk. Disse algoritmer, såsom NetworkAI, DROM og TIDE, udvikles til dynamisk at optimere routing, muliggøre skalerbar routing og forbedre kvaliteten af service i disse netværk. Ved at udnytte kraften fra kunstig intelligens har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af softwaredefinerede netværk.

title: Wearable Training Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can be used to improve sports training and monitoring through wearable devices and IoT frameworks. These algorithms are being used to recognize and classify different sports movements, calculate energy consumption during exercise, optimize training systems, and analyze motion parameters. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence and data analysis, these technologies have the potential to enhance athletic performance and provide personalized training for sportspersons.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan anvendes til at forbedre sports træning og overvågning gennem bærbare enheder og IoT-rammer. Disse algoritmer bruges til at genkende og klassificere forskellige sportsbevægelser, beregne energiforbrug under træning, optimere træningssystemer og analysere bevægelsesparametre. Ved at udnytte kraften fra kunstig intelligens og dataanalyse har disse teknologier potentiale til at forbedre atletisk præstation og tilbyde personlig træning til sportsfolk.

title: Time Series Anomaly Algorithms
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve the detection of anomalies in time series data. These algorithms automatically identify anomalous time series, overcome limitations of existing methods, and achieve better results. They utilize deep learning techniques, correlation dependency, and self-supervised contrastive loss to detect anomalies in both univariate and multivariate time series. The proposed algorithms not only improve performance and reduce false anomaly alerts but also enable real-time monitoring and detection of anomalies in large-scale time-series data.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre detektion af anomalier i tidsseriedata. Disse algoritmer identificerer automatisk anomale tidsserier, overvinder begrænsningerne ved eksisterende metoder og opnår bedre resultater. De udnytter deep learning teknikker, korrelationsafhængighed og self-supervised contrastive loss til at opdage anomalier i både univariate og multivariate tidsserier. De foreslåede algoritmer forbedrer ikke kun ydeevnen og reducerer falske anomali advarsler, men muliggør også realtidsmonitorering og detektion af anomalier i storstilede tidsseriedata.

title: Algorithmic forgery detection
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can improve the detection of image forgery. By combining different features and using deep learning approaches, these algorithms have shown better performance and promising results compared to traditional methods. For example, a proposed convolutional neural network (CNN) model achieves high accuracy in detecting copy-move forgery in digital images. These advancements in algorithmic detection techniques are crucial for ensuring the authenticity and integrity of digital images.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre detektion af billedforfalskning. Ved at kombinere forskellige funktioner og anvende deep learning-tilgange har disse algoritmer vist bedre ydeevne og lovende resultater sammenlignet med traditionelle metoder. For eksempel opnår en foreslået convolutional neural network (CNN) model høj nøjagtighed i at detektere copy-move forgery i digitale billeder. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmiske detektionsteknikker er afgørende for at sikre ægtheden og integriteten af digitale billeder.

title: Rock property prediction
en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to predict various properties of rocks, such as their strength and elasticity. These algorithms, including random forest models, support vector machines, and artificial neural networks, are able to accurately estimate variables like shear strength, compressive strength, and elastic modulus. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, researchers are gaining valuable insights into the behavior of rocks, which can have important implications for engineering and construction projects.
da: Forskere har brugt maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige forskellige egenskaber ved bjergarten, såsom deres styrke og elasticitet. Disse algoritmer, herunder random forest-modeller, support vector machines og artificial neural networks, er i stand til nøjagtigt at estimere variabler som skærstyrke, trykstyrke og elasticitetsmodul. Ved at udnytte kraften fra artificial intelligence opnår forskerne værdifuld indsigt i bjergens adfærd, hvilket kan have vigtige implikationer for ingeniør- og byggeprojekter.

title: IoT Network Algorithms
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various challenges in IoT networks. These algorithms are being used to optimize power allocation, user selection, resource allocation, and transmission power control. By leveraging these algorithms, researchers aim to improve energy efficiency, maximize system capacity, ensure throughput fairness, and offer sustainable energy solutions for IoT networks in the future.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at tackle forskellige udfordringer i IoT-netværk. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at optimere energitildeling, brugerudvælgelse, ressourceallokering og transmissionskraftkontrol. Ved at udnytte disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre energieffektiviteten, maksimere systemkapaciteten, sikre retfærdighed i throughput og tilbyde bæredygtige energiløsninger til IoT-netværk i fremtiden.

title: Sign language recognition
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of computer vision algorithms and deep learning models to develop systems that can recognize sign language gestures in real-time. These algorithms are used for hand segmentation, feature extraction, and gesture recognition, allowing for accurate translation of sign language into written or spoken language. The development of these systems aims to assist hearing-impaired individuals in various situations, including emergency situations, and improve communication accessibility.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af computer vision-algoritmer og deep learning-modeller til at udvikle systemer, der kan genkende tegnsprogsgester i realtid. Disse algoritmer bruges til håndsegmentering, feature extraction og gesture recognition, hvilket muliggør præcis oversættelse af tegnsprog til skriftligt eller talt sprog. Udviklingen af disse systemer har til formål at hjælpe hørehæmmede personer i forskellige situationer, herunder nødsituationer, og forbedre kommunikationsadgangen.

title: Ionosphere prediction
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to improve the accuracy of predicting ionospheric total electron content (TEC). These algorithms, such as neural networks and genetic algorithms, are being used to develop hybrid models that combine different methods for forecasting TEC. By implementing these advanced machine learning techniques, researchers hope to enhance our understanding of the ionosphere and improve predictions of TEC in different regions.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forbedre nøjagtigheden af forudsigelse af ionosfærens totale elektronindhold (TEC). Disse algoritmer, såsom neural netværk og genetiske algoritmer, anvendes til at udvikle hybride modeller, der kombinerer forskellige metoder til at forudsige TEC. Ved at implementere disse avancerede maskinlæringsteknikker håber forskerne at øge vores forståelse af ionosfæren og forbedre forudsigelserne af TEC i forskellige regioner.

title: Machine Learning in Optical Transmission
en: Machine learning techniques are being explored and proposed as solutions to improve the estimation and prediction of the quality of transmission in optical networks. These algorithms are regarded as promising approaches for analyzing data, managing networks, and enhancing performance monitoring in optical communication systems. However, there are still obstacles to overcome before widespread adoption of machine learning in practical optical networks can be achieved.
da: Maskinlæringsteknikker undersøges og foreslås som løsninger til at forbedre estimering og forudsigelse af transmissionskvaliteten i optiske netværk. Disse algoritmer betragtes som lovende tilgange til at analysere data, administrere netværk og forbedre ydeevneovervågning i optiske kommunikationssystemer. Der er dog stadig hindringer, der skal overvindes, før udbredt anvendelse af maskinlæring i praktiske optiske netværk kan opnås.

title: Blockchain Revolution
en: Blockchain technology has the potential to revolutionize various fields by enhancing network efficiency and improving security. It can simplify, secure, and make Internet of Things (IoT) applications more cost-efficient. Blockchain also offers solutions to security and privacy concerns in smart applications and industrial IoT frameworks. By integrating blockchain with other technologies like 5G networks, artificial intelligence (AI), and digital twins, we can further enhance security, transparency, and data integrity in IoT ecosystems.
da: Blockchain-teknologi har potentiale til at revolutionere forskellige områder ved at forbedre netværkseffektiviteten og øge sikkerheden. Det kan forenkle, sikre og gøre Internet of Things (IoT)-applikationer mere omkostningseffektive. Blockchain tilbyder også løsninger på sikkerheds- og privatlivsproblemer i smarte applikationer og industrielle IoT-rammer. Ved at integrere blockchain med andre teknologier som 5G-netværk, artificial intelligence (AI) og digitale tvillinger kan vi yderligere forbedre sikkerhed, gennemsigtighed og dataintegritet i IoT-økosystemer.

title: Deep Learning for Gait
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve human identification through gait recognition. They are investigating the effectiveness of deep learning approaches, convolutional neural networks, long short-term memory models, and feature fusion techniques. These algorithms aim to analyze and recognize the unique way individuals walk, potentially enhancing security systems and gait analysis in smart cities.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre menneskelig identifikation gennem ganggenkendelse. De undersøger effektiviteten af dyb læring tilgange, convolutional neural networks, long short-term memory models og feature fusion teknikker. Disse algoritmer har til formål at analysere og genkende den unikke måde, som enkeltpersoner går på, hvilket potentielt kan forbedre sikkerhedssystemer og ganganalyse i smarte byer.

title: Deep Learning in Cardiac Diagnosis
en: Deep neural networks can aid in the diagnosis and prognosis of coronary heart disease, increasing accuracy and reliability. Artificial neural networks (ANN) perform best among other classification algorithms in predicting heart disease. Machine learning and deep learning algorithms can improve the accuracy of heart disease prediction by combining traditional methods and deep learning models. These algorithms can also be used to predict major risk variables for cardiac issues and assist in diagnosing heart disease, ultimately improving health decisions.
da: Dybde neurale netværk kan hjælpe med diagnosen og prognosen af koronarsygdom, hvilket øger nøjagtigheden og pålideligheden. Artificial neural networks (ANN) præsterer bedst blandt andre klassifikationsalgoritmer i forudsigelsen af hjerte sygdom. Maskinlæring og deep learning-algoritmer kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af hjerte sygdomsforudsigelse ved at kombinere traditionelle metoder og deep learning-modeller. Disse algoritmer kan også bruges til at forudsige store risikofaktorer for hjerteproblemer og hjælpe med at diagnosticere hjerte sygdom, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer sundhedsbeslutninger.

title: Malware detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep neural networks and convolutional neural networks (CNN), to automatically detect and classify malware. These algorithms are trained to recognize and classify different types of malware, improving accuracy and efficiency compared to existing models. By utilizing deep learning methods and fine-tuned CNN models, researchers have achieved higher accuracy in malware detection and classification, enhancing cyber security.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep neural networks og convolutional neural networks (CNN), til automatisk at opdage og klassificere malware. Disse algoritmer er trænet til at genkende og klassificere forskellige typer malware, hvilket forbedrer nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten sammenlignet med eksisterende modeller. Ved at benytte deep learning-metoder og fintunede CNN-modeller har forskere opnået højere nøjagtighed i malware-detektion og -klassificering, hvilket styrker cybersikkerheden.

title: Blockchain Consensus
en: Researchers have been investigating various aspects of blockchain technology and its consensus algorithms. They have explored topics such as the categorization of consensus algorithms, improving the security and efficiency of blockchain, achieving consensus in consortium blockchains, optimizing the performance of consortium blockchains, enhancing the reliability of consensus protocols, reducing the overhead of certain algorithms, and improving the scalability and efficiency of consortium blockchains. These studies aim to address the challenges and future developments in blockchain consensus mechanisms.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige aspekter af blockchain-teknologi og dens consensus-algoritmer. De har udforsket emner som kategoriseringen af consensus-algoritmer, forbedring af sikkerheden og effektiviteten af blockchain, opnåelse af consensus i konsortiumblockchains, optimering af ydeevnen for konsortiumblockchains, forbedring af pålideligheden af consensus-protokoller, reduktion af overheadet ved visse algoritmer, samt forbedring af skalerbarheden og effektiviteten af konsortiumblockchains. Disse studier har til formål at tackle udfordringerne og fremtidige udviklinger inden for blockchain consensus-mekanismer.

title: 3D Reconstruction
en: Researchers have been exploring the capabilities of deep learning algorithms in reconstructing 3D shapes and human body models from 2D images. These algorithms have shown impressive performance, outperforming existing computer vision algorithms and enabling the quick creation of digital avatars and human body models for various applications. Surveys have also been conducted to provide an overview of the recent developments in deep learning methods for 3D reconstruction, identifying open problems and future directions in the field.
da: Forskere har undersøgt mulighederne for deep learning algoritmer i at rekonstruere 3D former og menneskekrogsmodeller fra 2D billeder. Disse algoritmer har vist imponerende ydeevne, der overgår eksisterende computer vision algoritmer og muliggør hurtig oprettelse af digitale avatarer og menneskekrogsmodeller til forskellige anvendelser. Der er også blevet gennemført undersøgelser for at give et overblik over de seneste udviklinger inden for deep learning metoder til 3D rekonstruktion, hvor åbne problemer og fremtidige retninger inden for området er blevet identificeret.

title: Algorithmic Optimization in Blockchain
en: Researchers are using algorithms to address various challenges in implementing blockchain technology in mobile edge computing. These algorithms are being used to optimize computation offloading, resource allocation, pricing, and trading in order to maximize efficiency and revenue in mobile blockchain networks. By leveraging the power of algorithms, scientists are working towards creating cost-effective and secure systems that can support the growing demands of blockchain-enabled applications in mobile environments.
da: Forskere anvender algoritmer til at tackle forskellige udfordringer ved implementeringen af blockchain-teknologi i mobile edge computing. Disse algoritmer bruges til at optimere beregningsaflastning, ressourceallokering, prissætning og handel for at maksimere effektiviteten og indtægterne i mobile blockchain-netværk. Ved at udnytte algoritmernes kraft arbejder forskerne hen imod at skabe omkostningseffektive og sikre systemer, der kan understøtte de stigende krav fra blockchain-aktiverede applikationer i mobile miljøer.

title: Deep Learning for Image Enhancement
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve the quality of super-resolution in single images. These algorithms, such as deep neural networks, convolutional neural networks, and deep learning, aim to enhance image resolution and restore details. By using techniques like feature enhancement, attention mechanisms, and multi-scale feature fusion, these algorithms are able to achieve lightweight and high-quality image super-resolution.
da: Forskere har været i gang med at udforske forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre kvaliteten af super-resolution i enkeltbilleder. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep neural networks, convolutional neural networks, og deep learning, sigter mod at forbedre billedopløsningen og genskabe detaljer. Ved at bruge teknikker som feature enhancement, attention mechanisms, og multi-scale feature fusion, er disse algoritmer i stand til at opnå letvægts og høj kvalitets billede super-resolution.

title: Deep Learning for Satellite Communication
en: Researchers are exploring how deep reinforcement learning algorithms can be used to optimize various aspects of satellite communication systems. These algorithms, such as the Deep reinforcement learning-based framework (DRLF) and the Deep-Q-network (DQN) controller, are being applied to tasks like resource allocation, power allocation, and user association. By using these advanced machine learning techniques, scientists hope to improve the efficiency and performance of satellite networks, ultimately enhancing our ability to communicate and access information from space.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep reinforcement learning algoritmer kan anvendes til at optimere forskellige aspekter af satellitkommunikationssystemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom Deep reinforcement learning-based framework (DRLF) og Deep-Q-network (DQN) controlleren, anvendes til opgaver som ressourceallokering, energifordeling og brugerassociation. Ved at bruge disse avancerede maskinlæringsteknikker håber forskerne at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af satellitnetværk, hvilket i sidste ende vil forbedre vores evne til at kommunikere og få adgang til information fra rummet.

title: Supercapacitor optimization
en: Researchers have been using machine learning algorithms to address various research questions related to supercapacitors. These algorithms, such as Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Random Forest Algorithm (RFA), are being used to accurately predict the behavior and performance metrics of supercapacitors. They are also being employed to analyze the effects of different factors, such as surface chemistry and microstructural features, on the performance of supercapacitors. Overall, machine learning is proving to be a valuable tool in the design and optimization of high-performance supercapacitors.
da: Forskere har været i gang med at anvende machine learning algoritmer for at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til superkondensatorer. Disse algoritmer, såsom Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) og Random Forest Algorithm (RFA), bliver brugt til præcist at forudsige adfærd og præstationsmetrikker for superkondensatorer. De bliver også anvendt til at analysere virkningerne af forskellige faktorer, såsom overfladekemik og mikrostrukturelle egenskaber, på præstationen af superkondensatorer. Generelt viser machine learning sig at være et værdifuldt værktøj i design og optimering af højtydende superkondensatorer.

title: Improved Prostate Cancer Diagnosis
en: New research shows that advanced imaging techniques using PET/CT scans and radioligands can greatly improve the accuracy of diagnosing and staging prostate cancer. These algorithms, such as 18F-DCFPyL PET/CT and PSMA-PET/CT, have been found to have better diagnostic performance compared to conventional imaging methods. They can predict progression-free survival, improve staging, and even influence treatment decisions, making them critical tools in the diagnosis and management of prostate cancer.
da: Ny forskning viser, at avancerede billeddannelsesteknikker med brug af PET/CT-scanninger og radioligander kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af diagnosen og stadieinddelingen af prostatakræft betydeligt. Disse algoritmer, såsom 18F-DCFPyL PET/CT og PSMA-PET/CT, har vist sig at have bedre diagnostisk ydeevne sammenlignet med konventionelle billeddannelsesmetoder. De kan forudsige progressionsfri overlevelse, forbedre stadieinddelingen og endda påvirke behandlingsbeslutninger, hvilket gør dem til kritiske værktøjer i diagnosen og håndteringen af prostatakræft.

title: AI in Orthopaedic Surgery
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an increasingly important role in orthopaedic surgery. It improves patient care by aiding in diagnosis, management, research, and systems analysis. AI and machine learning (ML) advancements are being used for clinical diagnosis, predicting post-operative outcomes, and complications in orthopaedic surgery. AI-based computational algorithms can also predict injury risk, interpret advanced imaging, evaluate patient-reported outcomes, and enhance telehealth. AI has extensive potential clinical applications in the surgical setting and is gradually changing surgery through advanced technological development in imaging, navigation, and robotic intervention. It can personalize risk prediction, detect implant specifics, and monitor patient movement and recovery in orthopaedic surgery. However, data quality is crucial for the success of machine learning applications. AI has the potential to augment surgeons by providing decision support, assessing technical skills, and performing tasks in surgery. German surgeons are positively disposed toward AI applications, but there is a deficit in knowledge and implementation in their professional environment. AI is also being investigated to optimize clinical efficiency in various subfields of plastic and reconstructive surgery. While AI has the potential to reduce cognitive load and support human performance in surgery, accurate and reliable systems require surgeon involvement. AI is used for diagnostics, predictive models, rehabilitation monitoring, and surgical training in orthopaedic surgery. However, the state-of-the-art of AI-enabled decision support in surgery is limited by small sample sizes, lack of external validation, and inadequate reporting. Sudanese orthopaedic surgeons are aware of AI applications but have doubts about safety and are interested in utilizing AI in various aspects of surgery. Orthopaedic patients are generally comfortable with AI joining the care team, but their knowledge and experience with AI impact their perspectives. Trauma and emergency surgeons have varying opinions on AI-based tools, with some believing in their potential and others expressing mistrust. Surgeons should consider ethical considerations such as patient safety, autonomy, confidentiality, informed consent, and surgical training in AI-assisted robotic surgery when adopting emerging innovations in AI and robotics.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) spiller en stadig vigtigere rolle i ortopædisk kirurgi. Det forbedrer patientplejen ved at hjælpe med diagnosticering, styring, forskning og systemanalyse. Fremskridt inden for AI og machine learning (ML) anvendes til klinisk diagnose, forudsigelse af post-operative resultater og komplikationer i ortopædisk kirurgi. AI-baserede beregningsalgoritmer kan også forudsige skaderisiko, fortolke avanceret billedbehandling, evaluere patientrapporterede resultater og forbedre telemedicin. AI har omfattende potentielle kliniske anvendelser i det kirurgiske miljø og ændrer gradvist kirurgi gennem avanceret teknologisk udvikling inden for billedbehandling, navigation og robotintervention. Det kan tilpasse risikoprædiktion, registrere implantatspecifikationer og overvåge patienters bevægelse og bedring i ortopædisk kirurgi. Dog er datakvalitet afgørende for succesen af machine learning-applikationer. AI har potentiale til at supplere kirurger ved at tilbyde beslutningsstøtte, vurdere tekniske færdigheder og udføre opgaver i kirurgi. Tyske kirurger er positivt indstillede over for AI-applikationer, men der er et videns- og implementeringsdeficit i deres professionelle miljø. AI undersøgelse også for at optimere klinisk effektivitet inden for forskellige underområder af plastikkirurgi og rekonstruktiv kirurgi. Mens AI har potentiale til at reducere kognitiv belastning og støtte menneskelig præstation i kirurgi, kræver præcise og pålidelige systemer involvering fra kirurger. AI anvendes til diagnoser, prædiktive modeller, rehabiliteringsovervågning og kirurgisk træning i ortopædisk kirurgi. Men den nuværende status for AI-aktiveret beslutningsstøtte i kirurgi er begrænset af små stikprøvestørrelser, mangel på ekstern validering og utilstrækkelig rapportering. Sudanske ortopædkirurger er klar over AI-applikationer, men har tvivl om sikkerhed og er interesserede i at udnytte AI i forskellige aspekter af kirurgi. Ortopædiske patienter er generelt komfortable med, at AI bliver en del af plejeteamet, men deres viden og erfaring med AI påvirker deres perspektiver. Traume- og akutkirurger har forskellige meninger om AI-baserede værktøjer, hvor nogle tror på deres potentiale, mens andre udtrykker mistillid. Kirurger bør overveje etiske overvejelser som patientsikkerhed, autonomi, fortrolighed, informeret samtykke og kirurgisk træning i AI-assisteret robotkirurgi, når de adopterer nye innovationer inden for AI og robotteknologi.

title: Distracted driving detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to detect distracted driving in real-time. These algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and deep convolutional neural networks, are being used to develop systems that can accurately recognize and classify distracted drivers. Some studies even propose hybrid schemes that combine deep learning with handcrafted features to improve detection. By leveraging the power of deep learning, researchers aim to design efficient and effective systems for detecting and addressing driver distraction.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning algoritmer til at opdage distraheret kørsel i realtid. Disse algoritmer, såsom Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) og deep convolutional neural networks, bliver anvendt til at udvikle systemer, der kan nøjagtigt genkende og klassificere distraherede bilister. Nogle studier foreslår endda hybride ordninger, der kombinerer deep learning med håndlavede funktioner for at forbedre detektionen. Ved at udnytte styrken af deep learning sigter forskerne mod at designe effektive og effektive systemer til at opdage og håndtere distraktion hos førere.

title: Urolithiasis prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict various outcomes and conditions related to urolithiasis, or urinary stones. These algorithms, which include decision support models, radiomic models, and artificial intelligence-based classifiers, aim to assist in treatment success prediction, identification of infection stones, and even the need for surgical intervention. By analyzing clinical variables and CT radiomics, combined models are also being developed to predict specific types of urinary stones.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige forskellige resultater og tilstande relateret til urolithiasis, eller urinsten. Disse algoritmer, som inkluderer decision support models, radiomic models og artificial intelligence-baserede klassifikatorer, har til formål at hjælpe med forudsigelse af behandlingssucces, identifikation af infektionssten og endda behovet for kirurgisk intervention. Ved at analysere kliniske variable og CT radiomics udvikles der også kombinerede modeller til at forudsige specifikke typer af urinsten.

title: Carbon price prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to accurately predict carbon prices. They have developed various hybrid models that combine different algorithms to improve the accuracy of predictions. These models include algorithms such as extreme learning machines, ensemble forecasting models, and variational mode decomposition, among others. The goal is to find the most effective combination of algorithms to make reliable predictions about carbon prices.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til præcist at forudsige kuldioxidpriser. De har udviklet forskellige hybridmodeller, der kombinerer forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af forudsigelserne. Disse modeller inkluderer algoritmer som extreme learning machines, ensemble forecasting models og variational mode decomposition, blandt andre. Målet er at finde den mest effektive kombination af algoritmer for at lave pålidelige forudsigelser om kuldioxidpriser.

title: Wind forecasting
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve wind speed and wind power forecasting. They have investigated various approaches, such as deep learning algorithms, error correction strategies, wavelet transformations, and neural networks. These algorithms have shown promise in accurately predicting wind speed and power generation, which can greatly benefit the renewable energy industry.
da: Forskere har undersøgt anvendelsen af algoritmer til at forbedre forudsigelser af vindhastighed og vindkraft. De har undersøgt forskellige tilgange, såsom deep learning-algoritmer, fejlkorrigeringsstrategier, wavelet-transformationer og neurale netværk. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i præcist at forudsige vindhastighed og energiproduktion, hvilket kan være en stor fordel for den vedvarende energisektor.

title: Myopia prediction
en: Researchers are using big data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to address various questions related to myopia in children and adolescents in China. These algorithms are being used to predict the onset of myopia, estimate physiological changes in the eye, identify risk factors, and evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments. By analyzing large amounts of data and using advanced algorithms, scientists hope to gain a better understanding of myopia and develop strategies for prevention and management.
da: Forskere bruger big data, machine learning og artificial intelligence til at tackle forskellige spørgsmål relateret til myopi hos børn og unge i Kina. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forudsige begyndelsen af myopi, estimere fysiologiske ændringer i øjet, identificere risikofaktorer og evaluere effektiviteten af forskellige behandlinger. Ved at analysere store mængder data og bruge avancerede algoritmer håber forskerne at opnå en bedre forståelse af myopi og udvikle strategier til forebyggelse og håndtering.

title: AI-assisted knee diagnosis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to assist clinicians in accurately diagnosing knee injuries using MRI exams. These algorithms, such as deep learning methods, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and deep learning models, are being developed to detect and characterize specific injuries like ACL tears and meniscus tears. The goal is to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis, potentially reducing the need for invasive procedures.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af dyb læring algoritmer til at hjælpe klinikere med nøjagtigt at diagnosticere knæskader ved hjælp af MRI undersøgelser. Disse algoritmer, såsom dybe læringsmetoder, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) og dybe læringsmodeller, udvikles til at opdage og karakterisere specifikke skader som ACL-rivninger og menisk-rivninger. Målet er at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af diagnosen, hvilket potentielt kan reducere behovet for invasive procedurer.

title: Predictive Pituitary Algorithms
en: Machine learning algorithms have shown promise in predicting various outcomes in patients with pituitary adenomas. These algorithms can identify risk factors and build predictive models for early outcomes after surgery, gross-total resection, radiotherapeutic response, regrowth of tumors, remission after surgery, recurrence, hormonal outcomes, and more. By analyzing large and complex datasets, machine learning models can provide valuable insights and aid in making informed decisions for the treatment of pituitary adenomas.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer har vist lovende resultater i at forudsige forskellige udfald hos patienter med hypofysadenomer. Disse algoritmer kan identificere risikofaktorer og opbygge forudsigelsesmodeller for tidlige resultater efter kirurgi, total resektion, radioterapeutisk respons, genvækst af tumorer, remission efter kirurgi, tilbagefald, hormonelle udfald og mere. Ved at analysere store og komplekse datamængder kan maskinlæringsmodeller give værdifuld indsigt og hjælpe med at træffe informerede beslutninger for behandlingen af hypofysadenomer.

title: Arrhythmia classification
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms, such as deep convolutional neural networks, to efficiently and quickly classify cardiac arrhythmias based on long-duration ECG signals. They are also investigating the accuracy of models that use spectrograms as input, combining STFT-based spectrograms with convolutional neural networks. These algorithms have the potential to automate the detection and classification of cardiovascular disease, improving the efficiency and accuracy of arrhythmia classification.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-algoritmer, såsom deep convolutional neural networks, til effektivt og hurtigt at klassificere hjertearytmier baseret på langvarige EKG-signaler. De undersøger også nøjagtigheden af modeller, der bruger spektrogrammer som input, ved at kombinere STFT-baserede spektrogrammer med convolutional neural networks. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at automatisere registreringen og klassificeringen af kardiovaskulære sygdomme, hvilket forbedrer effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af arytm klassificeringen.

title: News algorithms
en: Search engines shape news consumption and news repertoire balance by leading to more diverse and balanced news consumption. Algorithms and platforms play a role in contemporary news selection processes, extending gatekeeping theory. The 2016 Trending Topics controversy impacted Facebook's role in the news ecosystem, emphasizing personalized news and minimizing editorial control. News recommendation engines contribute to filter bubbles and fragmented news audiences by showing a high degree of homogeneity and concentration. People exhibit a general skepticism towards all forms of news selection, including algorithms, when navigating news on social media. Algorithms and automation have diverse applications in journalism but also present challenges. Social media algorithms influence user behavior and can lead to changes in diversity and slant of news sources, shaping diversification and partisan shifts in news consumption. Journalists negotiate the influence of social media algorithms against traditional journalistic values, influencing editorial decision making in news organizations. Algorithmically generated news sources have different effects on political behavior and polarization compared to non-algorithmic sources. Strategic amplification can be used to counter misinformation and polarizing rhetoric in the media ecosystem, requiring responsible and accountable news content and algorithmic systems. Algorithmic curation mechanisms on online platforms can both expand and contract exposure diversity depending on long-term reliance. Google News shows little evidence of news personalization and exhibits high homogeneity in search results, suggesting limited search personalization and news diversity. Journalists have adapted their strategies for sharing news content on social media platforms, incorporating social media logics and algorithms. Users' own choices, rather than algorithmic curation, drive exposure to partisan or unreliable news on Google Search. Preference for journalist gatekeeping fosters trust in traditional and social media news, rather than algorithmic news selection. Algorithmic recommendation systems homogenize exposure to information across platforms, affecting exposure to diverse information. News recommender systems impact journalistic distribution and news consumption.
da: Søgemaskiner former nyhedsforbrug og balancen i nyhedsrepertoiret ved at føre til et mere mangfoldigt og afbalanceret nyhedsforbrug. Algoritmer og platforme spiller en rolle i nutidige nyhedsudvælgelsesprocesser, hvilket udvider gatekeeping-teori. Kontroversen om Trending Topics i 2016 påvirkede Facebooks rolle i nydecosystemet ved at understrege personaliserede nyheder og minimere redaktionel kontrol. Nyhedsrekommendationsmotorer bidrager til filterbobler og fragmenterede nydepublikummer ved at vise en høj grad af homogenitet og koncentration. Folk udviser generel skepsis over for alle former for nyhedsudvælgelse, herunder algoritmer, når de navigerer i nyheder på sociale medier. Algoritmer og automatisering har forskellige anvendelser i journalistik, men præsenterer også udfordringer. Algoritmer til sociale medier påvirker brugeradfærd og kan føre til ændringer i mangfoldighed og vinkel af nyhedskilder, hvilket former diversificering og partiske skift i nyhedsforbruget. Journalister forhandler om indflydelsen fra sociale medie-algoritmer i forhold til traditionelle journalistiske værdier, hvilket påvirker redaktionelle beslutningsprocesser i nyhedsorganisationer. Algoritmisk genererede nyhedskilder har forskellige effekter på politisk adfærd og polarisering sammenlignet med ikke-algoritmiske kilder. Strategisk forstærkning kan anvendes til at modvirke misinformation og polariserende retorik i medieøkosystemet, hvilket kræver ansvarligt og gennemsigtigt nyhedsindhold og algoritmiske systemer. Algoritmiske kurateringsmekanismer på onlineplatforme kan både udvide og mindske eksponeringsmangfoldigheden afhængigt af langvarig afhængighed. Google News viser lidt bevis for nyhedspersonalisering og udviser høj homogenitet i søgeresultater, hvilket antyder begrænset søgningpersonaliseret nyheder og nyhedsmangfoldighed. Journalister har tilpasset deres strategier for at dele nyhedsindhold på sociale medieplatforme og inkorporeret sociale mediers logikker og algoritmer. Brugernes egne valg, snarere end algoritmisk kuratering, driver eksponering for partiske eller upålidelige nyheder på Google Search. Præference for journalistisk gatekeeping fremmer tillid til traditionelle og sociale medienyheder snarere end algoritmisk nyhedsudvælgelse. Algoritmiske anbefalingssystemer homogeniserer eksponering for information på tværs af platforme, hvilket påvirker eksponering for mangfoldig information. Nyhedsrekommandersystemer påvirker journalistisk distribution og nyhedsforbrug.

title: Liver cancer prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict various outcomes in liver cancer. These algorithms, known as radiomics nomograms, are developed using features extracted from medical images and clinical characteristics. They have shown promise in predicting early recurrence, prognosis, microvascular invasion, and other important factors in hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Machine learning and radiomics analysis are being used to develop these algorithms, which could potentially improve the diagnosis and treatment of liver cancer.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige udfald inden for leverkræft. Disse algoritmer, kendt som radiomics nomograms, udvikles ved hjælp af træk udvundet fra medicinske billeder og kliniske karakteristika. De har vist potentiale i at forudsige tidlig tilbagevenden, prognose, mikrovasculær invasion og andre vigtige faktorer i hepatocellulært karcinom og intrahepatisk cholangiokarcinom. Maskinlæring og radiomics-analyse anvendes til at udvikle disse algoritmer, som potentielt kan forbedre diagnosen og behandlingen af leverkræft.

title: Healthcare Predictive Analytics
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to improve healthcare by accurately predicting various outcomes for patients. These algorithms can assess the risk of readmission, adjust the risk of in-hospital mortality, predict long-term mortality, estimate the risk of end-of-life, and provide accurate predictions of in-hospital mortality. They can also help in risk assessment for acute heart failure, myocardial infarction, and COVID-19 patients, as well as predict adverse events and ICU mortality. By utilizing electronic health record data, these algorithms optimize resource allocation, improve risk assessments, and influence care decisions, ultimately enhancing the efficiency and quality of healthcare.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer anvendes til at forbedre sundhedspleje ved nøjagtigt at forudsige forskellige udfald for patienter. Disse algoritmer kan vurdere risikoen for genindlæggelse, justere risikoen for dødelighed under indlæggelse, forudsige langsigtet dødelighed, estimere risikoen for livets afslutning og give præcise forudsigelser af dødelighed under indlæggelse. De kan også hjælpe med risikoassessment for akut hjertesvigt, myokardieinfarkt og COVID-19 patienter samt forudsige bivirkninger og ICU dødelighed. Ved at udnytte data fra elektroniske sundhedsoptegnelser optimerer disse algoritmer ressourcetildeling, forbedrer risikovurderinger og påvirker pleje beslutninger, hvilket i sidste ende øger effektiviteten og kvaliteten af sundhedspleje.

title: Cardiac Amyloidosis Advances
en: Advances in cardiovascular imaging are improving the diagnosis and prognosis of cardiac amyloidosis. Intensive collaboration across disciplines and specialized centers is also enhancing the diagnosis and treatment of this condition. Algorithms are providing guidance for clinical practice, management conformity, and evidence-based recommendations for the evaluation and management of patients with cardiac amyloidosis. They are also aiding in the development of diagnostic algorithms and providing guidelines for diagnosis and treatment. Additionally, algorithms are helping to identify the most accurate multi-modality approach for diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis and improving diagnosis through non-invasive imaging techniques. Overall, algorithms are playing a crucial role in better diagnosing and treating cardiac amyloidosis, leading to more effective and timely management of this condition.
da: Fremskridt inden for kardiovaskulær billeddannelse forbedrer diagnosen og prognosen for kardiak amyloidose. Intensivt samarbejde på tværs af discipliner og specialiserede centre forbedrer også diagnosen og behandlingen af denne tilstand. Algoritmer giver vejledning til klinisk praksis, ledelseskonformitet og evidensbaserede anbefalinger til evaluering og håndtering af patienter med kardiak amyloidose. De hjælper også med udviklingen af diagnostiske algoritmer og giver retningslinjer for diagnose og behandling. Desuden hjælper algoritmer med at identificere den mest præcise multi-modalitets tilgang til at diagnosticere kardiak amyloidose og forbedre diagnosen gennem non-invasive billedteknikker. Samlet set spiller algoritmer en afgørende rolle i bedre diagnose og behandling af kardiak amyloidose, hvilket fører til en mere effektiv og rettidig håndtering af denne tilstand.

title: Cancer biomarker discovery
en: Scientists are using algorithms to answer important questions about adrenocortical carcinoma, a type of cancer. These algorithms analyze data from genes and proteins to identify biomarkers that can help diagnose and predict the progression of the disease. They also study the tumor microenvironment and immune infiltrates to understand how they affect patient prognosis and response to treatment. By using bioinformatics and machine learning methods, researchers hope to develop personalized therapies and improve outcomes for patients with this type of cancer.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at besvare vigtige spørgsmål om adrenokortikal karcinom, en type kræft. Disse algoritmer analyserer data fra gener og proteiner for at identificere biomarkører, der kan hjælpe med at diagnosticere og forudsige sygdommens progression. De undersøger også tumorens mikroenvironment og immuninfiltrater for at forstå, hvordan de påvirker patientens prognose og respons på behandling. Ved at bruge bioinformatik og machine learning-metoder håber forskerne at udvikle personlige terapeutiske tilgange og forbedre resultaterne for patienter med denne type kræft.

title: Automated kidney analysis
en: Scientists are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to improve the analysis of kidney biopsies. These algorithms can accurately identify and classify various features of kidney tissue, such as glomeruli and pathological lesions. By automating and standardizing the analysis process, these algorithms have the potential to provide more accurate diagnoses and prognoses for kidney diseases.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til at forbedre analysen af nyrebiopsier. Disse algoritmer kan præcist identificere og klassificere forskellige træk ved nyrevæv, såsom glomeruli og patologiske læsioner. Ved at automatisere og standardisere analyseprocessen har disse algoritmer potentiale til at give mere præcise diagnoser og prognoser for nyresygdomme.

title: Green space impact
en: Researchers have been using algorithms, such as Google Street View and deep learning techniques, to investigate the impact of green spaces on residents' walking behavior. They have also explored how machine learning models can assess the quality of greenspaces and identify socioeconomic disparities in exposure. By analyzing street view images and utilizing big data, these algorithms are helping researchers understand the relationship between urban landscapes, perceptions, and walkability.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer, såsom Google Street View og deep learning-teknikker, til at undersøge indvirkningen af grønne områder på beboeres gangadfærd. De har også udforsket, hvordan machine learning-modeller kan vurdere kvaliteten af grønne områder og identificere socioøkonomiske forskelle i eksponering. Ved at analysere billeder fra street view og udnytte big data, hjælper disse algoritmer forskerne med at forstå forholdet mellem bylandskaber, opfattelser og gangbarhed.

title: Synthetic medical images
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, such as generative adversarial networks and deep learning, to generate synthetic medical images from different types of scans. These algorithms have the potential to improve image quality, correct imaging issues, and even replace missing sequences in medical imaging. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, scientists aim to enhance medical image processing and analysis, ultimately leading to better diagnosis and treatment of various conditions.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, såsom generative adversarial networks og deep learning, til at generere syntetiske medicinske billeder fra forskellige typer scanninger. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at forbedre billede kvalitet, korrigere billedbehandlingsproblemer og endda erstatte manglende sekvenser i medicinsk billeddannelse. Ved at udnytte kraften fra artificial intelligence sigter forskere mod at forbedre behandlingen og analysen af medicinske billeder, hvilket i sidste ende fører til bedre diagnose og behandling af forskellige tilstande.

title: Power Dynamics in Algorithms
en: Algorithms play a significant role in shaping our online experiences and interactions on social media platforms. They can amplify human actions, exacerbating connections between disparate data points. Tech companies use accusations of manipulating algorithms to maintain their power, while influencers on Instagram are influenced by algorithms but still have some control over their behavior. Algorithms also capture the immediacy of public outrage but fail to capture its complex nature. People perceive algorithms as confining, practical, reductive, intangible, and exploitative. Traces and footprints left behind in digital environments provide insights into algorithmic biases and transparency. QAnon followers manipulate algorithms to spread their content, and algorithms mostly reinforce existing social drivers, requiring further research. Platforms exercise power by writing the rules of visibility and dissemination of content, while algorithmic meta-capital extends power beyond traditional sources. The interplay between humans and algorithms shapes our online experiences and social networks. Algorithmic visibility on social media platforms is uneven, impacting marginalized creators. Chinese fans collectively explore and utilize algorithms to increase their visibility, and algorithmic profiling on Facebook elicits a range of reactions and rationales.
da: Algoritmer spiller en betydelig rolle i at forme vores online oplevelser og interaktioner på sociale medieplatforme. De kan forstærke menneskelige handlinger og forværre forbindelserne mellem disparate datapunkter. Teknologivirksomheder bruger anklager om at manipulere algoritmer for at opretholde deres magt, mens influencere på Instagram er påvirket af algoritmer, men stadig har en vis kontrol over deres adfærd. Algoritmer fanger også øjeblikkeligheden af offentlig harme, men formår ikke at fange dens komplekse natur. Folk opfatter algoritmer som begrænsende, praktiske, reduktive, immaterielle og udnyttende. Spor og fodaftryk, der efterlades i digitale miljøer, giver indsigt i algoritmiske bias og gennemsigtighed. QAnon-følgere manipulerer algoritmer for at sprede deres indhold, og algoritmer forstærker hovedsageligt eksisterende sociale drivkræfter, hvilket kræver videre forskning. Platforme udøver magt ved at skrive reglerne for synlighed og spredning af indhold, mens algoritmisk meta-kapital udvider magten ud over traditionelle kilder. Samspillet mellem mennesker og algoritmer former vores online oplevelser og sociale netværk. Algoritmisk synlighed på sociale medieplatforme er ujævn, hvilket påvirker marginaliserede skabere. Kinesiske fans udforsker kollektivt og udnytter algoritmer for at øge deres synlighed, og algoritmisk profilering på Facebook fremkalder en række reaktioner og rationaler.

title: Ultrasound AI Advancements
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to improve various aspects of ultrasound imaging. These algorithms can analyze ultrasound data in real-time for the detection of prostate cancer and optimize image acquisition, diagnosis, and workflow. They can also mimic clinical image post-processing techniques, improve motion tracking, reduce speckle noise, estimate displacement, denoise images, and enhance image reconstruction, among other applications. These advancements have the potential to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of ultrasound imaging, making it a valuable tool in medical procedures and interventions.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning algoritmer til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af ultralydsbilledebehandling. Disse algoritmer kan analysere ultralydsdata i realtid for at opdage prostatakræft og optimere billedeoptagelse, diagnose og arbejdsgange. De kan også efterligne kliniske billedebehandlingsteknikker, forbedre bevægelsessporing, reducere speckle støj, estimere forskydning, fjerne støj fra billeder og forbedre billede rekonstruktion, blandt andre applikationer. Disse fremskridt har potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af ultralydsbilledebehandling, hvilket gør det til et værdifuldt værktøj i medicinske procedurer og interventioner.

title: Turbulence prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to improve predictions and simulations of turbulent flow in fluid dynamics. These algorithms, such as neural networks and deep learning models, are being used to enhance the accuracy and stability of Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes simulations, as well as to generate realistic turbulent inflow conditions. By incorporating machine learning techniques, scientists hope to overcome the limitations of traditional turbulence models and achieve more precise and reliable results in various applications.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af machine learning-algoritmer for at forbedre forudsigelser og simuleringer af turbulent strømning i fluiddynamik. Disse algoritmer, såsom neurale netværk og deep learning-modeller, bruges til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og stabiliteten af Reynolds-gennemsnitlige Navier-Stokes simuleringer, samt til at generere realistiske turbulente indstrømningsforhold. Ved at inkorporere machine learning-teknikker håber videnskabsfolk at overvinde begrænsningerne i traditionelle turbulensmodeller og opnå mere præcise og pålidelige resultater i forskellige applikationer.

title: Sarcopenia diagnosis
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to advance imaging techniques for diagnosing sarcopenia, a condition characterized by muscle loss in older adults. These algorithms are also being used to select risk factors, develop predictive models, and analyze the interplay among biological mechanisms involved in sarcopenia. Additionally, machine learning models are being used to automatically classify the level of sarcopenia, evaluate its prevalence in specific populations, and predict the five-year survival of metastatic breast cancer patients based on host factors and sarcopenia.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forbedre billedteknikker til diagnosticering af sarcopeni, en tilstand kendetegnet ved muskeltab hos ældre voksne. Disse algoritmer anvendes også til at vælge risikofaktorer, udvikle prædiktive modeller og analysere samspillet mellem de biologiske mekanismer, der er involveret i sarcopeni. Derudover bruges maskinlæringsmodeller til automatisk at klassificere niveauet af sarcopeni, evaluere dens prævalens i specifikke populationer og forudsige femårsoverlevelsen for patienter med metastatisk brystkræft baseret på værtfaktorer og sarcopeni.

title: AI for GI Diagnosis
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of artificial intelligence algorithms, specifically convolutional neural networks, in detecting and diagnosing various gastrointestinal diseases. These algorithms are being tested to determine their accuracy in identifying gastric cancer, differentiating cancerous and non-cancerous lesions, and detecting other types of gastrointestinal lesions. The goal is to improve diagnostic accuracy and potentially outperform human endoscopists in detecting early stages of gastric cancer.
da: Forskere undersøger kapaciteterne af kunstig intelligens algoritmer, specifikt convolutional neural networks, i at opdage og diagnosticere forskellige gastrointestinale sygdomme. Disse algoritmer bliver testet for at bestemme deres nøjagtighed i at identificere mavekræft, skelne mellem kræftfremkaldte og ikke-kræftfremkaldte læsioner, samt opdage andre typer af gastrointestinale læsioner. Målet er at forbedre den diagnostiske nøjagtighed og potentielt overgå menneskelige endoskoper i at opdage tidlige stadier af mavekræft.

title: Wi-Fi localization
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep neural networks and other machine learning algorithms to improve indoor localization in Wi-Fi environments. These algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks and deep learning classifiers, are being tested to see if they can accurately classify locations and improve the accuracy of indoor tracking. The goal is to develop more precise and reliable methods for locating users in indoor spaces, which could have applications in areas like navigation and asset tracking.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af dybe neurale netværk og andre maskinlæringsalgoritmer for at forbedre indendørs lokalisation i Wi-Fi-miljøer.
