Disse algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks og deep learning classifiers, bliver testet for at se, om de kan klassificere placeringer præcist og forbedre nøjagtigheden af indendørs sporing. Målet er at udvikle mere præcise og pålidelige metoder til at lokalisere brugere i indendørs rum, hvilket kunne have anvendelser inden for områder som navigation og aktiver sporing.

title: AI Arms Race
en: The development of lethal artificial intelligence could have a destabilizing effect on international peace and security. Autonomous weapons technologies are advancing rapidly without sufficient public debate or accountability, which raises concerns about their impact. The use of AI in military and civilian applications will shape views on norm setting and arms control, and the integration of algorithmic systems across military functions brings new forms of risk and complicates decision-making.
da: Udviklingen af dødelig kunstig intelligens kan have en destabiliserende effekt på international fred og sikkerhed. Autonome våbenteknologier udvikler sig hurtigt uden tilstrækkelig offentlig debat eller ansvarlighed, hvilket rejser bekymringer om deres indvirkning. Brugen af AI i militære og civile applikationer vil forme synspunkter om normdannelse og våbenkontrol, og integrationen af algoritmiske systemer på tværs af militære funktioner medfører nye former for risiko og komplicerer beslutningstagning.

title: Energy consumption forecasting
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to accurately forecast energy consumption in different regions. These algorithms, such as the particle swarm optimization algorithm and the whale optimization algorithm, are used in novel prediction models like the grey prediction model and the power-driven grey model. By applying these algorithms, scientists aim to improve the accuracy of energy consumption forecasts in countries like China and Japan, as well as predict global renewable energy consumption.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til præcist at forudsige energiforbrug i forskellige regioner. Disse algoritmer, såsom particle swarm optimization algorithm og whale optimization algorithm, anvendes i nye prognosemodeller som grey prediction model og power-driven grey model. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer har videnskabsfolk til hensigt at forbedre nøjagtigheden af energiforbrugsprognoser i lande som Kina og Japan samt forudsige globalt energiforbrug fra vedvarende energikilder.

title: Drilling optimization
en: Scientists are using algorithms to predict various drilling parameters and improve efficiency in the oil and gas industry. They are using techniques such as neural networks, optimization algorithms, and machine learning to accurately predict drilling rate, pore pressure, rate of penetration, and other important factors. These algorithms are able to analyze large amounts of data and make predictions in real-time, helping to optimize drilling operations and reduce costs.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige boreparametre og forbedre effektiviteten i olie- og gasindustrien. De anvender teknikker såsom neurale netværk, optimeringsalgoritmer og machine learning for nøjagtigt at forudsige borehastighed, poretryk, gennembrudshastighed og andre vigtige faktorer. Disse algoritmer er i stand til at analysere store mængder data og lave forudsigelser i realtid, hvilket hjælper med at optimere boreoperationer og reducere omkostningerne.

title: Macular fluid detection
en: Deep learning algorithms can accurately detect and quantify macular fluid in OCT images, improving the diagnosis and treatment of retinal diseases. Machine learning can analyze imaging biomarkers to predict visual acuity outcomes in neovascular AMD, allowing for more personalized treatment plans. Additionally, automated quantification of fluid volumes can improve monitoring and therapy in neovascular AMD, leading to better disease management.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer kan nøjagtigt detektere og kvantificere maculær væske i OCT-billeder, hvilket forbedrer diagnosen og behandlingen af retinale sygdomme. Machine learning kan analysere billedbiomarkører for at forudsige synsskarphedsresultater i neovaskulær AMD, hvilket muliggør mere personlige behandlingsplaner. Derudover kan automatiseret kvantificering af væskevolumener forbedre overvågning og terapi i neovaskulær AMD, hvilket fører til bedre sygdomshåndtering.

title: Solar forecasting
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict solar irradiance and photovoltaic power output based on weather forecasts. These algorithms, such as LSTM-based models, have shown promising results and outperformed conventional statistical models. Deep learning models, like the hybrid CNN-LSTM model, have also been found to improve accuracy in forecasting. Overall, machine learning models have proven to be more accurate than physical models when the right input parameters are selected.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige solens stråling og den fotovoltaiske effekt baseret på vejrudsigter. Disse algoritmer, såsom LSTM-baserede modeller, har vist lovende resultater og overgået konventionelle statistiske modeller. Deep learning-modeller, som den hybrid CNN-LSTM-model, har også vist sig at forbedre nøjagtigheden i forudsigelserne. Samlet set har maskinlæringsmodeller vist sig at være mere nøjagtige end fysiske modeller, når de rette inputparametre er valgt.

title: Environmental Exposures and Health Outcomes
en: Scientists have used various algorithms to investigate the effects of different environmental exposures on various health outcomes in children. These algorithms include linear regressions, classification methods, Bayesian kernel machine regression, exposome-wide association study, deletion-substitution-addition algorithm, agnostic linear regression methods, multi-center prospective cohort study, pilot study, exposome-wide approach, distributed lag nonlinear models, untargeted metabolomics approach, retrospective cohort study, and more. By analyzing large amounts of data, these algorithms help researchers understand the associations between prenatal and early-life exposures and conditions such as birth weight, blood pressure, lung function, gestational diabetes, gut microbiome structure, childhood obesity, neurodevelopment, and more.
da: Forskere har brugt forskellige algoritmer til at undersøge virkningerne af forskellige miljøeksponeringer på forskellige sundhedsudfald hos børn. Disse algoritmer omfatter lineære regressioner, klassifikationsmetoder, Bayesian kernel machine regression, exposome-wide association study, deletion-substitution-addition algorithm, agnostic linear regression methods, multi-center prospective cohort study, pilot study, exposome-wide approach, distributed lag nonlinear models, untargeted metabolomics approach, retrospective cohort study og mere. Ved at analysere store mængder data hjælper disse algoritmer forskere med at forstå sammenhængene mellem prænatale og tidlige livseksponeringer og tilstande som fødselsvægt, blodtryk, lungefunktion, svangerskabsdiabetes, tarmmikrobiomstruktur, barndomsfedme, neurodevelopment og mere.

title: Automated Breast Cancer Detection
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms, specifically deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to assist radiologists in classifying mammography mass lesions and accurately detecting breast cancer on screening mammograms. These computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems show promise in improving the accuracy and efficiency of breast cancer detection. Machine learning algorithms and deep learning models are also being used to assess image grading in breast mammograms and classify breast cancer using various imaging modalities. The goal is to develop fully automated systems that can detect and classify breast tumors, leading to earlier detection and diagnosis of breast cancer.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-algoritmer, specifikt deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), til at hjælpe radiologer med at klassificere mammografiske masseforandringer og nøjagtigt opdage brystkræft på screeningsmammografier. Disse computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systemer viser lovende udsigter til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af brystkræftdetektion. Machine learning-algoritmer og deep learning-modeller bruges også til at vurdere billedegrad i brystmammografier og klassificere brystkræft ved hjælp af forskellige billedmodaliteter. Målet er at udvikle fuldautomatiske systemer, der kan opdage og klassificere brysttumorer, hvilket fører til tidligere opdagelse og diagnose af brystkræft.

title: Enhancing Liver Diagnosis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms, specifically convolutional neural networks (CNNs), to improve the diagnosis and classification of liver diseases. These algorithms are being trained to differentiate liver masses, segment healthy and cancerous liver tissues, classify hepatic lesions, and detect and classify focal liver lesions. By analyzing various medical imaging techniques such as CT scans and MRI, these algorithms have the potential to assist doctors in accurately diagnosing liver diseases and providing appropriate treatment.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-algoritmer, specifikt convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for at forbedre diagnosen og klassificeringen af leversygdomme. Disse algoritmer trænes til at skelne mellem levermasse, segmentere sunde og kræftsyge levervæv, klassificere hepatisk læsioner og opdage samt klassificere fokale leverlæsioner. Ved at analysere forskellige medicinske billedbehandlingsteknikker såsom CT-scanninger og MR-scanninger har disse algoritmer potentiale til at hjælpe læger med at diagnosticere leversygdomme nøjagtigt og give passende behandling.

title: Hydrological machine learning
en: Machine learning models have been found to improve predictions of hydrological low-flow indices in ungaged basins, outperforming baseline models. Satellite-based hydro-climate variables integrated with machine learning techniques have shown comparable performance to process-based modeling in streamflow modeling at various scale watersheds. Hybrid machine learning models have demonstrated higher accuracy in predicting nutrient concentrations and identifying hydrological transport pathways of surface water nutrients.
da: Maskinlæringsmodeller har vist sig at forbedre forudsigelser af hydrologiske lavvandsindekser i ikke-målte oplandsområder og overgår baseline-modeller. Satellitbaserede hydro-klimavariabler integreret med maskinlæringsteknikker har vist sammenlignelig ydeevne med procesbaseret modellering i strømflowmodellering i forskellige skalaoplandsområder. Hybridmaskinlæringsmodeller har vist højere nøjagtighed i forudsigelsen af næringsstofkoncentrationer og identifikationen af hydrologiske transportveje for overfladevand næringsstoffer.

title: Thermal comfort prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to answer a variety of research questions related to personal thermal comfort. These algorithms can predict individuals' thermal preference, develop personalized thermal comfort models, and assess human perception of environmental comfort. They can also enhance personal comfort using physiological and environmental signals measurements, and predict personal thermal comfort based on environmental parameters. Overall, machine learning algorithms are being employed to improve our understanding and prediction of thermal comfort in different settings and for different populations.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bruges til at besvare en række forskningsspørgsmål relateret til personlig termisk komfort. Disse algoritmer kan forudsige individers termiske præferencer, udvikle personligt tilpassede modeller for termisk komfort og vurdere menneskers opfattelse af miljømæssig komfort. De kan også forbedre personlig komfort ved at bruge målinger af fysiologiske og miljømæssige signaler og forudsige personlig termisk komfort baseret på miljøparametre. Generelt anvendes maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forbedre vores forståelse og forudsigelse af termisk komfort i forskellige indstillinger og for forskellige befolkninger.

title: Hybrid vehicle optimization
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep reinforcement learning algorithms to improve energy management in hybrid electric vehicles. These algorithms are being used to optimize fuel economy and enhance the control of powertrain systems. By combining domain knowledge and advanced learning techniques, these algorithms have the potential to significantly improve energy efficiency in hybrid vehicles.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep reinforcement learning algoritmer til at forbedre energistyring i hybrid elektriske køretøjer. Disse algoritmer bruges til at optimere brændstoføkonomi og forbedre styringen af powertrain systemer. Ved at kombinere domæneviden og avancerede læringsteknikker har disse algoritmer potentiale til betydeligt at forbedre energieffektiviteten i hybridkøretøjer.

title: Deep Learning Music Genres
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning techniques, to classify and analyze music genres. These algorithms are able to learn and extract features from music without relying on manual input, improving the accuracy of genre recognition. By using neural networks and other deep learning models, these algorithms are able to classify music based on characteristics such as audio data, spectrogram analysis, and even mathematical models. This research shows the potential for algorithms to enhance music genre analysis and classification in the music industry.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning teknikker, til at klassificere og analysere musikgenrer. Disse algoritmer er i stand til at lære og udtrække egenskaber fra musik uden at bero på manuel indtastning, hvilket forbedrer nøjagtigheden af genregenkendelse. Ved at bruge neurale netværk og andre deep learning modeller er disse algoritmer i stand til at klassificere musik baseret på egenskaber såsom lyddata, spektrogramanalyse og endda matematiske modeller. Denne forskning viser potentialet for algoritmer til at forbedre musikgenreanalyse og -klassifikation i musikindustrien.

title: Rock image analysis
en: Machine learning algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks, can be used to predict geologic and petrophysical properties from images of rocks. These algorithms can identify patterns, reduce analysis time, and minimize bias and inconsistencies. They can also automate tasks like lithofacies identification, carbonate petrography, ichnological analysis, and lithological classification, providing faster and more efficient solutions for geoscientists. Additionally, deep learning techniques can address geological challenges in mineral resource estimation and classify mineral thin sections and other geo-data accurately and quickly.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks, kan anvendes til at forudsige geologiske og petrofysiske egenskaber ud fra billeder af klipper. Disse algoritmer kan identificere mønstre, reducere analysetid og minimere bias og inkonsekvenser. De kan også automatisere opgaver som lithofacies-identifikation, karbonatpetrografi, ichnologisk analyse og litologisk klassifikation, hvilket giver hurtigere og mere effektive løsninger for geovidenskabsfolk. Derudover kan deep learning-teknikker tackle geologiske udfordringer inden for mineralressource-estimering og nøjagtigt og hurtigt klassificere mineraltynde sektioner og andre geo-data.

title: Deep Learning in Retinal Imaging
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to enhance retinal images by reducing noise and synthesizing high-resolution images for diagnostic models. They are also investigating the potential of generative adversarial networks to denoise and super-resolve optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, produce angiography images from fundus photographs, and synthesize realistic OCT images for educational and diagnostic purposes. Additionally, they are using generative adversarial networks to classify retinal images with limited labeled data, predict the therapeutic effect of anti-VEGF therapy for diabetic macular edema, improve retinal image super-resolution, detect and localize retinal pathologies, generate fine-grained lesion synthesis on diabetic retinopathy images, and create deep fakes on retinal images. These advancements in generative adversarial networks and deep learning techniques have the potential to aid in the detection and classification of various retinal conditions, including glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, and other retinal disorders.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre retinalbilleder ved at reducere støj og syntetisere højopløsningsbilleder til diagnostiske modeller. De undersøger også potentialet i generative adversarial networks til at fjerne støj og superopløse optisk koherens tomografi (OCT) billeder, producere angiografibilleder fra fundusfotografier og syntetisere realistiske OCT-billeder til uddannelsesmæssige og diagnostiske formål. Derudover bruger de generative adversarial networks til at klassificere retinalbilleder med begrænsede mærkede data, forudsige den terapeutiske effekt af anti-VEGF terapi for diabetisk makulaødem, forbedre superopløsningen af retinalbilleder, detektere og lokalisere retinale patologier, generere fine detaljerede læsionersynteser på diabetisk retinopati billeder og skabe deep fakes på retinalbilleder. Disse fremskridt inden for generative adversarial networks og deep learning teknikker har potentiale til at hjælpe med at opdage og klassificere forskellige retinale tilstande, herunder glaukom, aldersrelateret makuladegeneration og andre retinale lidelser.

title: Deep Learning in Fluorescence Microscopy
en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to extend the range of observable biological phenomena in fluorescence microscopy, accelerate image deconvolution and fusion in optical microscopy, and improve super-resolution imaging. These algorithms are also facilitating the utilization of deep learning for optical microscopy and enhancing the spatial resolution of biomedical imaging. Additionally, algorithms such as residual channel attention networks and physics-informed neural networks are being employed for denoising, sharpening, and reconstructing microscopy images, while transfer learning enables fast and universal reconstruction of structured illumination microscopy images. Overall, the incorporation of algorithms into microscopy techniques is improving the quality and efficiency of image analysis in scientific research.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer bliver brugt til at udvide spektret af observerbare biologiske fænomener i fluorescensmikroskopi, accelerere billeddekongestion og fusion i optisk mikroskopi samt forbedre superopløsningsbilleder. Disse algoritmer faciliterer også anvendelsen af deep learning til optisk mikroskopi og forbedrer den rumlige opløsning af biomedicinsk billeddannelse. Derudover anvendes algoritmer som residual channel attention networks og physics-informed neural networks til støjreduktion, skarpning og rekonstruktion af mikroskopibilleder, mens transfer learning muliggør hurtig og universel rekonstruktion af billeder fra struktureret belysningsmikroskopi. Samlet set forbedrer inddragelsen af algoritmer i mikroskopiteknikker kvaliteten og effektiviteten af billedanalyse i videnskabelig forskning.

title: Deep Traffic Learning
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning techniques and algorithms to improve various aspects of traffic monitoring and management. These algorithms, such as deep neural networks and convolutional neural networks, are being used for tasks like vehicle detection, tracking, classification, and traffic density estimation. By integrating these algorithms into systems and networks, researchers aim to automate and enhance real-time traffic monitoring, improve accuracy in vehicle detection, and analyze traffic data more efficiently.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-teknikker og -algoritmer for at forbedre forskellige aspekter af trafikovervågning og -styring. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep neural networks og convolutional neural networks, anvendes til opgaver som køretøjsdetektering, sporing, klassificering og estimering af trafikdensitet. Ved at integrere disse algoritmer i systemer og netværk sigter forskerne mod at automatisere og forbedre realtids trafikovervågning, forbedre nøjagtigheden i køretøjsdetektering og analysere trafikdata mere effektivt.

title: GANs for Seismic Analysis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically generative adversarial networks (GANs), to improve various aspects of seismic data analysis. These algorithms are being used to interpolate seismic data, enhance fault detection, improve data resolution, and build accurate velocity models. They are also being applied to seismic inversion, full-waveform inversion, and prestack seismic inversion, providing fast and accurate solutions for geophysical property estimation. Overall, these algorithms offer promising potential for improving seismic data analysis and interpretation in earthquake-related engineering fields.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, specifikt generative adversarial networks (GANs), for at forbedre forskellige aspekter af seismisk dataanalyse. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at interpolere seismiske data, forbedre fejlregistrering, forbedre dataopløsning og opbygge nøjagtige hastighedsmodeller. De anvendes også til seismisk inversion, full-waveform inversion og prestack seismisk inversion, hvilket giver hurtige og præcise løsninger til estimat af geofysiske egenskaber. Samlet set tilbyder disse algoritmer lovende potentiale for at forbedre seismisk dataanalyse og fortolkning inden for ingeniørområder relateret til jordskælv.

title: Machine Learning for Solar Materials
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to accelerate the discovery and design of new materials for solar cells. These algorithms can predict the properties of different materials, such as their bandgap and stability, which are important for efficient solar energy conversion. By combining machine learning with other computational methods, researchers are able to quickly screen and identify promising materials for photovoltaic applications.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at accelerere opdagelsen og designet af nye materialer til solceller. Disse algoritmer kan forudsige egenskaberne ved forskellige materialer, såsom deres bandgab og stabilitet, som er vigtige for effektiv solenergiomdannelse. Ved at kombinere maskinlæring med andre beregningsmetoder er forskere i stand til hurtigt at screene og identificere lovende materialer til fotovoltaiske anvendelser.

title: Deep Weather Learning
en: Scientists are exploring the potential of using deep learning algorithms to improve weather and climate forecasting. These algorithms are being used to emulate the dynamics of general circulation models and develop forecast systems based on neural networks. Machine learning techniques are also being employed to improve various aspects of weather and climate models, such as parameterization, post-processing of ensemble forecasts, and correcting model errors.
da: Forskere udforsker potentialet i at bruge deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre vejr- og klimaforudsigelser. Disse algoritmer bruges til at efterligne dynamikken i general circulation models og udvikle forudsigelsessystemer baseret på neurale netværk. Maskinlæringsteknikker anvendes også til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af vejr- og klimamodeller, såsom parameterisering, post-processering af ensembleforudsigelser og korrektion af modelfejl.

title: Learning-Driven Classification
en: Researchers are exploring various ways to improve the classification of hyperspectral images, which can have applications in fields like remote sensing and medical imaging. They are investigating the use of active learning, transfer learning, deep learning, and few-shot learning algorithms to address challenges such as limited labeled data and small sample sizes. These algorithms, such as active transfer learning networks and convolutional transformer-based few-shot learning, aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of hyperspectral image classification.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige måder at forbedre klassifikationen af hyperspektrale billeder, som kan have anvendelser inden for områder som fjernmåling og medicinsk billeddannelse. De undersøger brugen af active learning, transfer learning, deep learning og few-shot learning algoritmer for at tackle udfordringer som begrænsede mærkede data og små stikprøvestørrelser. Disse algoritmer, såsom active transfer learning networks og convolutional transformer-based few-shot learning, har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af hyperspektral billedeklassifikation.

title: Geological classification
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to classify and predict various geological features in different deposits, such as alteration facies, lithostratigraphic units, and lithofacies. These algorithms, including unsupervised and supervised machine learning techniques, multivariate classification algorithms, and artificial neural networks, are able to analyze geochemical variables, geophysical data, and well logs to accurately identify and classify different rock types and deposit types. By integrating geological features and expert knowledge into machine learning classifiers, these algorithms are improving the effectiveness and accuracy of lithology classification in various geological formations.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer anvendes til at klassificere og forudsige forskellige geologiske træk i forskellige aflejringer, såsom omdannelsesfacier, lithostratigrafiske enheder og lithofacies. Disse algoritmer, herunder unsupervised og supervised maskinlæringsteknikker, multivariat klassifikationsalgoritmer og artificial neural networks, er i stand til at analysere geokemiske variable, geofysiske data og borelogs for nøjagtigt at identificere og klassificere forskellige klippetyper og aflejringstyper. Ved at integrere geologiske træk og ekspertviden i maskinlæringsklassifikatorer forbedrer disse algoritmer effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af lithologisk klassifikation i forskellige geologiske formationer.

title: Crack detection revolution
en: Researchers are developing algorithms that can detect cracks in concrete structures using deep learning and image processing techniques. These algorithms aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of crack detection, which is crucial for maintaining the safety and integrity of concrete infrastructure. By comparing different algorithms and exploring new approaches, scientists hope to develop automated methods that can quickly and reliably identify cracks in concrete surfaces.
da: Forskere udvikler algoritmer, der kan opdage revner i betonstrukturer ved hjælp af deep learning og billedbehandlingsteknikker. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af revnedetektering, hvilket er afgørende for at opretholde sikkerheden og integriteten af betoninfrastruktur. Ved at sammenligne forskellige algoritmer og udforske nye tilgange håber videnskabsfolk at udvikle automatiserede metoder, der hurtigt og pålideligt kan identificere revner i betonoverflader.

title: Semantic Segmentation
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the accuracy and efficiency of semantic segmentation in remote sensing images. They have been using algorithms, such as fully convolutional networks and convolutional neural networks, to develop novel methods for semantic segmentation. These algorithms are able to accurately classify and segment different objects in high-resolution remote sensing images, leading to better analysis and understanding of the data.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af semantisk segmentering i fjernmåling billeder. De har brugt algoritmer, såsom fully convolutional networks og convolutional neural networks, til at udvikle nye metoder til semantisk segmentering. Disse algoritmer er i stand til præcist at klassificere og segmentere forskellige objekter i højtopløselige fjernmåling billeder, hvilket fører til bedre analyse og forståelse af dataene.

title: Deep Learning for Rock Analysis
en: Scientists are using algorithms to improve our understanding of porous materials like rocks. These algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks and deep learning models, can reconstruct high-resolution structures from low-resolution images, estimate material properties, and predict permeability. By utilizing machine learning and data fusion, these algorithms are speeding up the analysis of rock samples and improving the accuracy of calculations. This research is advancing our knowledge of how porous materials behave and can have applications in fields like oil and gas exploration.
da: Forskere anvender algoritmer for at forbedre vores forståelse af porøse materialer som sten. Disse algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks og deep learning models, kan rekonstruere højopløselige strukturer fra lavopløselige billeder, estimere materialeejendomme og forudsige permeabilitet. Ved at anvende machine learning og data fusion accelererer disse algoritmer analysen af stenprøver og forbedrer nøjagtigheden af beregningerne. Denne forskning fremmer vores viden om, hvordan porøse materialer opfører sig, og kan have anvendelser inden for områder som olie- og gasudforskning.

title: Fault detection
en: Scientists are exploring the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to automate the detection and mapping of seismic faults. These algorithms can also perform multitask learning and estimate fault probabilities, strikes, and dips from seismic images. Additionally, researchers are investigating how supervised deep learning and other variations of CNNs can be applied to seismic interpretation and fault detection.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af convolutional neural networks (CNNs) til at automatisere registreringen og kortlægningen af seismiske fejl. Disse algoritmer kan også udføre multitask learning og estimere fejlprocenter, strikes og dips fra seismiske billeder. Derudover undersøger forskerne, hvordan supervised deep learning og andre variationer af CNNs kan anvendes til seismisk fortolkning og fejlregistrering.

title: Point cloud analysis
en: Researchers have been exploring the capabilities of algorithms in processing and analyzing 3D point cloud data. They have developed various neural network architectures that can accurately classify and segment objects in these point clouds. These algorithms have shown promising results, achieving high accuracy and reducing the need for extensive training data.
da: Forskere har undersøgt mulighederne for algoritmer i behandling og analyse af 3D punkt-sky data. De har udviklet forskellige neurale netværksarkitekturer, der kan klassificere og segmentere objekter i disse punkt-skyer præcist. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater ved at opnå høj nøjagtighed og reducere behovet for omfattende træningsdata.

title: Intrusion detection revolution
en: Researchers are investigating the use of deep learning approaches and algorithms for improving the accuracy and efficiency of intrusion detection systems. They are developing models and systems that can detect anomalies and network intrusions more effectively, using techniques such as deep neural networks and hybrid deep learning models. These advancements aim to enhance the security of computer networks by reducing false negatives and detecting various types of attacks, including DDoS attacks.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning-tilgange og algoritmer til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af intrusionsdetekteringssystemer. De udvikler modeller og systemer, der kan opdage anomalier og netværksintrusioner mere effektivt ved at bruge teknikker som dybe neurale netværk og hybride deep learning-modeller. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at forbedre sikkerheden i computer-netværk ved at reducere falske negativer og opdage forskellige typer angreb, inklusive DDoS-angreb.

title: Blockchain for EVs
en: Researchers are exploring how blockchain technology can improve various aspects of electric vehicle (EV) charging and energy trading. They are using algorithms, such as the Iceberg order execution algorithm and the Iterative convex-concave procedure algorithm, to minimize power fluctuation, incentivize EV participation in demand response, optimize charging behaviors, and provide fair charging services. These blockchain-enabled systems aim to ensure secure and coordinated trading, achieve robust and efficient power management, and enable multi-level power transactions for EV charging stations.
da: Forskere udforsker, hvordan blockchain-teknologi kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af opladning af elektriske køretøjer (EV) og energihandel. De bruger algoritmer som Iceberg order execution algorithm og Iterative convex-concave procedure algorithm for at minimere effektvariation, tilskynde EV-deltagelse i efterspørgselsrespons, optimere opladningsadfærd og tilbyde retfærdige opladningstjenester. Disse blockchain-aktiverede systemer sigter mod at sikre sikker og koordineret handel, opnå robust og effektiv effektstyring og muliggøre multi-niveau effekttransaktioner for EV-opladningsstationer.

title: Hate speech detection
en: Researchers have been exploring various ways to detect hate speech on social media platforms like Twitter. They have developed machine learning algorithms specifically designed for hate speech detection. Additionally, they have conducted comparative studies to determine the best feature engineering techniques and machine learning algorithms for this task. They have also investigated the use of pre-trained language models and the challenges in hate speech detection in different languages. Furthermore, researchers have explored the combination of computer vision and natural language processing models for multimodal hate speech detection. Overall, these studies aim to develop effective and generalizable methods to automatically detect hate speech and offensive speech on social media platforms.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige måder at opdage hadetale på sociale medieplatforme som Twitter. De har udviklet machine learning-algoritmer specifikt designet til at opdage hadetale. Derudover har de udført sammenlignende studier for at bestemme de bedste feature engineering teknikker og machine learning-algoritmer til denne opgave. De har også undersøgt brugen af pre-trained language models og udfordringerne ved hadetaleopdagelse på forskellige sprog. Ydermere har forskerne udforsket kombinationen af computer vision og natural language processing modeller til multimodal hadetaleopdagelse. Samlet set har disse studier til formål at udvikle effektive og generaliserbare metoder til automatisk at opdage hadetale og offensiv tale på sociale medieplatforme.

title: Drone optimization
en: Researchers are using algorithms to optimize the deployment and operation of drones in various scenarios. For example, they are using particle swarm optimization and genetic algorithms to determine the best locations for drone-cells in a drone-assisted radio access network and for setting up 5G base stations in dangerous areas. Other algorithms are being used to coordinate communication between sensor nodes and drones, maximize the lifetime of wireless devices, and optimize trajectory and scheduling in mobile relaying systems. These advancements in drone technology have the potential to improve data transmission, energy efficiency, coverage, and capacity in wireless communication systems.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at optimere deployment og drift af droner i forskellige scenarier. For eksempel anvender de particle swarm optimization og genetiske algoritmer til at bestemme de bedste placeringer for drone-celler i et drone-assisteret radioadgangsnetværk og til at opsætte 5G-basesationer i farlige områder. Andre algoritmer bruges til at koordinere kommunikation mellem sensor nodes og droner, maksimere levetiden for trådløse enheder og optimere bane og planlægning i mobile relæsystemer. Disse fremskridt inden for drone teknologi har potentiale til at forbedre datatransmission, energieffektivitet, dækning og kapacitet i trådløse kommunikationssystemer.

title: Deep Learning Recommendations
en: Researchers are exploring how deep learning algorithms can enhance recommendation systems. By combining deep learning with other techniques, these algorithms can capture complex user-item relationships and provide more accurate recommendations. Deep learning is also being used to address challenges such as cold-start items and data sparsity, improving the overall quality of recommendations.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep learning-algoritmer kan forbedre anbefalingssystemer. Ved at kombinere deep learning med andre teknikker kan disse algoritmer fange komplekse bruger-vare-relationer og give mere præcise anbefalinger. Deep learning bruges også til at tackle udfordringer som kolde start-emner og datasparsitet, hvilket forbedrer den overordnede kvalitet af anbefalingerne.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning
en: Researchers have been exploring how deep reinforcement learning algorithms can be used to improve various aspects of cloud computing. These algorithms, such as deep Q-network and deep reinforcement Q-learning, are being applied to tasks like job scheduling, resource management, load balancing, and task scheduling. By using these algorithms, researchers aim to optimize performance, reduce energy costs, and improve the overall efficiency of cloud-based applications.
da: Forskere har undersøgt, hvordan deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer kan bruges til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af cloud computing. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep Q-network og deep reinforcement Q-learning, anvendes til opgaver som jobplanlægning, ressourcehåndtering, belastningsbalancering og opgaveplanlægning. Ved at bruge disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at optimere ydeevnen, reducere energikostnaderne og forbedre den overordnede effektivitet af cloud-baserede applikationer.

title: Slope stability prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict slope stability in various regions. Different algorithms, such as random forest, support vector machine, and Bayesian models, have been proposed and evaluated for their effectiveness in predicting slope failures. Ensemble learning approaches, like stacking and gradient boosting, have also shown promising results. These findings suggest that machine learning can accurately assess slope stability, providing valuable insights for slope management and disaster prevention.
da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige skråningsstabilitet i forskellige regioner. Forskellige algoritmer, såsom random forest, support vector machine og Bayesian-modeller, er blevet foreslået og evalueret for deres effektivitet i at forudsige skråningsfejl. Ensemble learning-tilgange, som stacking og gradient boosting, har også vist lovende resultater. Disse fund tyder på, at machine learning kan vurdere skråningsstabilitet nøjagtigt og give værdifulde indsigter til skråningsforvaltning og katastrofeprævention.

title: Polymer property prediction
en: Scientists are exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to accelerate the discovery and design of new polymers with specific properties. These algorithms can predict the thermal conductivity, glass transition temperature, and other physical properties of polymers based on their molecular structures. By combining machine learning with high-throughput experimentation and simulations, researchers hope to revolutionize the field of polymer science and create new materials for various applications, including biomaterials and nanocomposites.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af machine learning-algoritmer for at fremskynde opdagelsen og designet af nye polymerer med specifikke egenskaber. Disse algoritmer kan forudsige varmeledningsevne, glasovergangstemperatur og andre fysiske egenskaber ved polymerer baseret på deres molekylære strukturer. Ved at kombinere machine learning med højtkapacitets eksperimentering og simulationer håber forskerne at revolutionere feltet for polymervidenskab og skabe nye materialer til forskellige anvendelser, herunder biomaterialer og nanokompositter.

title: Building extraction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to extract buildings from high-resolution remote sensing imagery. These algorithms, which utilize neural networks and guided filtering, have shown promising results in accurately identifying different types of buildings based on size, color, material, and spectral similarity to roads. The proposed methods not only improve the efficiency and accuracy of building extraction, but also provide benchmark datasets for performance evaluation and analysis of deep learning techniques.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at udtrække bygninger fra højopløsnings fjernmåling billeder. Disse algoritmer, som anvender neurale netværk og guidet filtrering, har vist lovende resultater i præcist at identificere forskellige typer bygninger baseret på størrelse, farve, materiale og spektrel lighed med veje. De foreslåede metoder forbedrer ikke kun effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af bygningsekstraktionen, men tilbyder også benchmark-datacéer til ydeevnevurdering og analyse af deep learning-teknikker.

title: Algorithmic Solar Absorber Design
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to design and optimize solar absorbers that can efficiently convert sunlight into usable energy. These algorithms, such as particle swarm optimization and genetic algorithms, are used to find the best materials, thicknesses, and configurations for the absorbers. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, researchers are able to create solar absorbers that are more effective and can operate in a wide range of wavelengths, leading to more efficient solar energy conversion.
da: Forskere har anvendt algoritmer til at designe og optimere solabsorbere, der effektivt kan omdanne sollys til brugbar energi. Disse algoritmer, såsom particle swarm optimization og genetic algorithms, bruges til at finde de bedste materialer, tykkelser og konfigurationer for absorbere. Ved at udnytte kraften i artificial intelligence er forskerne i stand til at skabe solabsorbere, der er mere effektive og kan fungere inden for et bredt spektrum af bølgelængder, hvilket fører til en mere effektiv konversion af solenergi.

title: Deep Learning for Equations
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of deep learning algorithms in solving complex mathematical problems. They are investigating whether these algorithms can solve high-dimensional partial differential equations, forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations, and fully coupled forward-backward stochastic differential equations. Various algorithms, such as the Deep Galerkin Method, Physics-informed neural networks, and Deep learning methods, are being used to tackle these challenges. The goal is to improve the computational performance and accuracy of solving these equations, which have applications in fields like physics and engineering.
da: Forskere undersøger kapaciteterne hos deep learning-algoritmer i at løse komplekse matematiske problemer. De undersøger, om disse algoritmer kan løse højdimensionale partielle differentialligninger, fremad- og bagudproblemer involverende ikke-lineære partielle differentialligninger samt fuldt koblede fremad-bagud stokastiske differentialligninger. Forskellige algoritmer, såsom Deep Galerkin Method, Physics-informed neural networks og Deep learning methods, anvendes til at tackle disse udfordringer. Målet er at forbedre den beregningsmæssige ydeevne og nøjagtighed ved løsning af disse ligninger, som har anvendelser inden for felter som fysik og ingeniørvidenskab.

title: Energy system optimization
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to optimize the performance of various energy systems. These algorithms, such as genetic algorithms and multi-criteria optimization, help analyze and optimize the economic, environmental, and efficiency aspects of these systems. By using these algorithms, researchers are able to find the best configurations and settings for solar, geothermal, and hybrid energy systems, leading to improved power generation, heating, cooling, and even hydrogen and freshwater production.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at optimere ydeevnen af forskellige energisystemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom genetiske algoritmer og multi-criteria optimization, hjælper med at analysere og optimere de økonomiske, miljømæssige og effektivitetsmæssige aspekter af disse systemer. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer er forskerne i stand til at finde de bedste konfigurationer og indstillinger for sol-, geotermiske og hybride energisystemer, hvilket fører til forbedret energiproduktion, opvarmning, afkøling og endda produktion af brint og ferskvand.

title: Quantum finance
en: Researchers are exploring the potential of quantum algorithms in the field of finance. They are investigating whether quantum algorithms can be used for tasks such as pricing financial derivatives, analyzing risk, optimizing investment portfolios, and computing market risk. These algorithms have the potential to provide faster and more efficient solutions compared to classical methods, offering new possibilities for quantitative finance.
da: Forskere udforsker potentialet af kvantealgoritmer inden for finans. De undersøger, om kvantealgoritmer kan bruges til opgaver som prissætning af finansielle derivater, analyse af risiko, optimering af investeringsporteføljer og beregning af markedsrisiko. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at levere hurtigere og mere effektive løsninger sammenlignet med klassiske metoder, hvilket åbner nye muligheder for kvantitativ finans.

title: Quantum Optimization
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of quantum algorithms in solving optimization problems. One algorithm, called the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), is being studied and optimized for its performance on various problems, such as MaxCut. Different strategies and approaches, including classical precomputation subroutines and the multi-angle ansatz, are being investigated to improve the performance of these quantum algorithms.
da: Forskere udforsker kapaciteterne af kvantealgoritmer til at løse optimeringsproblemer. En algoritme, kaldet Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), bliver studeret og optimeret for dens ydeevne på forskellige problemer, såsom MaxCut. Forskellige strategier og tilgange, herunder klassiske præberegnede subroutiner og multi-angle ansatz, bliver undersøgt for at forbedre ydeevnen af disse kvantealgoritmer.

title: Materials prediction
en: Scientists are using advanced algorithms to predict material properties and accelerate materials discovery. These algorithms, such as crystal graph convolutional neural networks and graph neural networks, are able to accurately predict properties of molecules and crystals based on input data like stoichiometry and electron density of states. By harnessing the power of machine learning, researchers are able to make significant advancements in the field of materials chemistry.
da: Forskere bruger avancerede algoritmer til at forudsige materialeegenskaber og fremskynde materialesøgning. Disse algoritmer, såsom crystal graph convolutional neural networks og graph neural networks, er i stand til nøjagtigt at forudsige egenskaberne af molekyler og krystaller baseret på inputdata som stoikiometri og elektron tæthed af tilstande. Ved at udnytte kraften fra machine learning kan forskere gøre betydelige fremskridt inden for området materials kemi.

title: Optical AI
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of machine learning algorithms in improving wavefront sensing, a technique used in optics to measure and correct distortions in light waves. These algorithms, such as deep neural networks and convolutional neural networks, are being used to estimate wavefront aberrations, reconstruct phase and amplitude information, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of adaptive optics systems. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, scientists hope to enhance the performance of optical systems and overcome the limitations of traditional wavefront sensing methods.
da: Forskere undersøger mulighederne for machine learning-algoritmer til at forbedre wavefront sensing, en teknik der anvendes inden for optik til at måle og korrigere distortioner i lysbølger. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep neural networks og convolutional neural networks, bruges til at estimere wavefront-aberrationer, rekonstruere fase- og amplitudinformation og forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af adaptive optics-systemer. Ved at udnytte kraften fra artificial intelligence håber videnskabsfolk at forbedre ydeevnen af optiske systemer og overvinde begrænsningerne ved traditionelle wavefront sensing-metoder.

title: Terahertz wave control
en: Scientists are using algorithms to design advanced materials that can control and absorb terahertz waves. These algorithms, such as genetic optimization and evolutionary algorithms, are being used to optimize the properties of graphene-based structures and achieve high absorption rates at specific frequencies. By harnessing the power of algorithms, researchers are able to create materials with unique properties that could have applications in various fields, including telecommunications and sensing technologies.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at designe avancerede materialer, der kan kontrollere og absorbere terahertz bølger. Disse algoritmer, såsom genetisk optimering og evolutionære algoritmer, bruges til at optimere egenskaberne af graphene-baserede strukturer og opnå høje absorptionsrater ved specifikke frekvenser. Ved at udnytte kraften i algoritmerne er forskerne i stand til at skabe materialer med unikke egenskaber, som kunne have anvendelser inden for forskellige områder, herunder telekommunikation og sensor teknologi.

title: Alloy optimization
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to answer various research questions about high entropy alloys. These algorithms are being used to predict the composition, hardness, and phase selection of these alloys, as well as to screen them for desirable properties. By combining machine learning with experimental data and other computational methods, researchers are able to design and discover new high entropy alloys with optimal properties. These advancements in alloy design are made possible by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and data-driven approaches.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at besvare forskellige forskningsspørgsmål om høj entropi legeringer. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forudsige sammensætning, hårdhed og fasevalg af disse legeringer samt til at screene dem for ønskværdige egenskaber. Ved at kombinere maskinlæring med eksperimentelle data og andre beregningsmetoder er forskerne i stand til at designe og opdage nye høj entropi legeringer med optimale egenskaber. Disse fremskridt inden for legeringsdesign er mulige ved at udnytte kraften fra artificial intelligence og datadrevne tilgange.

title: Renal cancer prediction
en: Researchers are using machine learning algorithms to predict the grade and characteristics of renal cell carcinomas. These algorithms analyze CT and MRI scans to differentiate between different types of renal cell carcinomas, predict the aggressiveness of tumors, and even determine the risk of death within 5 years for patients. By combining radiomics analysis with machine learning, scientists are developing models that can assist in the diagnosis and treatment of renal cell carcinoma.
da: Forskere bruger machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige grad og egenskaber ved nyrecellekarcinomer. Disse algoritmer analyserer CT- og MR-scanninger for at skelne mellem forskellige typer af nyrecellekarcinomer, forudsige tumorenes aggressivitet og endda bestemme risikoen for død inden for 5 år for patienter. Ved at kombinere radiomics-analyse med machine learning udvikler videnskabsmænd modeller, der kan hjælpe med diagnosen og behandlingen af nyrecellekarcinom.

title: Metamaterial optimization
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms to design and optimize mechanical metamaterials. These algorithms, such as topology optimization, stochastic optimization, and genetic algorithms, are being employed to create materials with specific properties, such as tailored buckling properties and extreme isotropy. Additionally, machine learning algorithms are being used to predict and design 2D metamaterial structures with tunable deformation-dependent properties. The combination of these algorithms with advanced modeling techniques is enabling the development of innovative and customizable metamaterials for various applications.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer til at designe og optimere mekaniske metamaterialer. Disse algoritmer, såsom topology optimization, stochastic optimization og genetic algorithms, anvendes til at skabe materialer med specifikke egenskaber, såsom skræddersyede buckling-egenskaber og ekstrem isotropi. Derudover anvendes machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige og designe 2D metamateriale strukturer med justerbare deformation-afhængige egenskaber. Kombinationen af disse algoritmer med avancerede modelleringsmetoder muliggør udviklingen af innovative og tilpassede metamaterialer til forskellige anvendelser.

title: Algorithms in Prostate Diagnosis
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used in various studies to improve the diagnosis and prediction of prostate cancer. These algorithms are being employed to develop models that can accurately identify patients requiring specific procedures, evaluate the efficacy of different techniques, and predict the likelihood of recurrence or progression. By incorporating machine learning methods and analyzing large amounts of data, researchers aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer anvendes i forskellige studier for at forbedre diagnosen og forudsigelsen af prostatakræft. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at udvikle modeller, der nøjagtigt kan identificere patienter, der kræver specifikke procedurer, evaluere effektiviteten af forskellige teknikker og forudsige sandsynligheden for tilbagefald eller progression. Ved at inkorporere maskinlæringsmetoder og analysere store mængder data, har forskere til hensigt at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af diagnosen og behandlingen af prostatakræft.

title: AI in Radiology
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize the field of radiology, but there are important ethical considerations that need to be addressed. Radiologists should evaluate the value of AI tools and consider the clinical need for their implementation. While AI has the potential to disrupt the radiology workforce, it can also improve various steps of the imaging process and quality improvement in radiology. However, there is a gap between the promises and applications of AI in diagnostic radiology, with current applications being narrow in terms of tasks, modality, and region. Despite this, radiologists have a mostly positive attitude towards AI implementation, and it is believed that AI will support radiologists and attract medical students to the specialty by transforming the field of radiology.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) har potentiale til at revolutionere området inden for radiologi, men der er vigtige etiske overvejelser, der skal tages hensyn til. Radiologer bør vurdere værdien af AI-værktøjer og overveje det kliniske behov for deres implementering. Mens AI har potentiale til at forstyrre radiologisk arbejdskraft, kan det også forbedre forskellige trin i billeddanningsprocessen og kvalitetforbedring inden for radiologi. Der er dog et gab mellem løfterne og anvendelserne af AI i diagnostisk radiologi, idet de nuværende anvendelser er snævre med hensyn til opgaver, modalitet og region. På trods af dette har radiologer en overvejende positiv indstilling til implementeringen af AI, og det menes, at AI vil støtte radiologer og tiltrække medicinstuderende til specialet ved at transformere området inden for radiologi.

title: Predicting Prostate Aggressiveness
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms and machine learning to predict the aggressiveness of prostate cancer. By analyzing MRI scans and using radiomics-based models, machine learning algorithms can differentiate between different types of prostate cancer and assess their aggressiveness. These algorithms can also improve the detection of prostate cancer in lesions and predict important factors such as the Gleason score.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer og maskinlæring til at forudsige aggressiviteten af prostatakræft. Ved at analysere MR-scanninger og anvende radiomics-baserede modeller kan maskinlæringsalgoritmer skelne mellem forskellige typer prostatakræft og vurdere deres aggressivitet. Disse algoritmer kan også forbedre detektion af prostatakræft i læsioner og forudsige vigtige faktorer som Gleason-scoren.

title: Cardiac strain assessment
en: Scientists are investigating whether left atrial strain, a measure of the heart's ability to contract and relax, can be used to diagnose and assess various heart conditions. They are exploring the potential of incorporating left atrial strain into diagnostic algorithms to classify left ventricular diastolic dysfunction grade, estimate left ventricular filling pressures, and identify heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. These algorithms could provide non-invasive and accurate methods for evaluating heart health and guiding treatment decisions.
da: Forskere undersøger, om venstre atrial strain, et mål for hjertets evne til at trække sig sammen og slappe af, kan bruges til at diagnosticere og vurdere forskellige hjerteforhold. De udforsker potentialet for at integrere venstre atrial strain i diagnostiske algoritmer til at klassificere graden af venstre ventrikulær diastolisk dysfunktion, estimere venstre ventrikulære fyldningstryk og identificere hjertesvigt med bevaret ejektionsfraktion. Disse algoritmer kunne give non-invasive og præcise metoder til at evaluere hjertehelse og vejlede behandlingsbeslutninger.

title: Surgical AI Advancements
en: AI algorithms have the ability to accurately identify operative steps in laparoscopic surgeries, recognize surgical phases, actions, and tools, detect surgical workflow and techniques, and locate critical events in surgical videos. They can also identify operative phases, safe and dangerous zones of dissection, anatomical landmarks, and key anatomical structures during various surgical procedures. Furthermore, AI systems can minimize adverse events, improve patient safety, guide safe surgeries, assess the critical view of safety, and enhance laparoscopic control level during surgery.
da: AI-algoritmer har evnen til nøjagtigt at identificere operative trin i laparaskopiske operationer, genkende kirurgiske faser, handlinger og værktøjer, opdage kirurgisk arbejdsforløb og teknikker samt lokalisere kritiske begivenheder i kirurgiske videoer. De kan også identificere operative faser, sikre og farlige dissektionszoner, anatomiske markører og nøgleanatomiske strukturer under forskellige kirurgiske procedurer. Desuden kan AI-systemer minimere bivirkninger, forbedre patientsikkerheden, lede sikre operationer, vurdere det kritiske sikkerhedsperspektiv og forbedre det laparaskopiske kontrolniveau under operationen.

title: Gestational diabetes prediction
en: Researchers are using machine learning algorithms to predict and analyze the risk of gestational diabetes in pregnant women. These algorithms are being compared to conventional methods like logistic regressions to determine their effectiveness. Additionally, machine learning models are being used to identify risk factors and predict the need for pharmacological treatment in women with gestational diabetes. The goal is to develop non-invasive predictive models that can guide interventions and prevent the progression of gestational diabetes to type 2 diabetes.
da: Forskere anvender machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige og analysere risikoen for svangerskabsdiabetes hos gravide kvinder. Disse algoritmer bliver sammenlignet med konventionelle metoder som logistisk regression for at vurdere deres effektivitet. Derudover anvendes machine learning-modeller til at identificere risikofaktorer og forudsige behovet for farmakologisk behandling hos kvinder med svangerskabsdiabetes. Målet er at udvikle ikke-invasive forudsigende modeller, der kan guide interventioner og forhindre udviklingen af svangerskabsdiabetes til type 2 diabetes.

title: Synthetic CT Imaging
en: Researchers are using algorithms, specifically deep learning approaches, generative adversarial networks, and convolutional neural networks, to generate synthetic CT images from MRI or CBCT data. These algorithms are being evaluated for their accuracy and effectiveness in various applications, such as brain radiotherapy, liver treatment planning, and adaptive radiation therapy. The goal is to improve the quality and efficiency of treatment planning and delivery in radiation therapy, ultimately benefiting patients with more precise and personalized care.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer, specifikt dybe læringsmetoder, generative adversarial networks og convolutional neural networks, til at generere syntetiske CT-billeder ud fra MRI- eller CBCT-data. Disse algoritmer bliver evalueret for deres nøjagtighed og effektivitet i forskellige applikationer, såsom hjerne-radioterapi, leverbehandlingsplanlægning og adaptiv strålebehandling. Målet er at forbedre kvaliteten og effektiviteten af behandlingsplanlægning og -levering i strålebehandling, hvilket i sidste ende vil gavne patienter med mere præcis og personlig pleje.

title: Medical Imaging Advancements
en: Researchers are exploring the capabilities of algorithms in various medical imaging applications. They are investigating whether deep learning algorithms can reconstruct cardiac MRI data from limited measurements, train neural networks for model fitting in diffusion-weighted MRI, improve dynamic parallel MRI reconstruction, and estimate parameters in intravoxel incoherent motion modeling. These algorithms are being developed to enhance image quality, accelerate reconstruction, and improve parameter estimation in medical imaging.
da: Forskere undersøger kapabiliteterne af algoritmer i forskellige medicinsk billeddannelsesapplikationer. De undersøger, om deep learning algoritmer kan rekonstruere hjerte-MRI-data fra begrænsede målinger, træne neurale netværk til modeltilpasning i diffusion-vægts-MRI, forbedre dynamisk parallel MRI-rekonstruktion og estimere parametre i intravoxel incoherent motion modelling. Disse algoritmer udvikles for at forbedre billedkvaliteten, fremskynde rekonstruktionen og forbedre parameterestimeringen i medicinsk billeddannelse.

title: 3D Printing Process Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can optimize various aspects of 3D printing processes. They are using machine learning methods, such as experimental sampling, data clustering, and classification, to determine the optimal operating process window in aerosol jet 3D printing. Other algorithms, like response surface methodology–genetic algorithm (RSM–GA) and artificial neural network (ANN), are being used to optimize significant process parameters and improve surface roughness in different types of 3D printing. These algorithms are helping to enhance the overall printing quality, dimensional accuracy, mechanical properties, and producibility of 3D printed parts.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan optimere forskellige aspekter af 3D-printprocesser. De bruger maskinlæringsmetoder, såsom eksperimentel sampling, dataklyngedannelse og klassifikation, for at bestemme det optimale driftsprocesvindue i aerosol jet 3D-printning. Andre algoritmer, som response surface methodology–genetic algorithm (RSM–GA) og artificial neural network (ANN), bliver anvendt til at optimere væsentlige procesparametre og forbedre overfladeruhed i forskellige typer 3D-printning. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at forbedre den overordnede printkvalitet, dimensionel nøjagtighed, mekaniske egenskaber og produktionsmuligheder for 3D-printede dele.

title: Battery Acceleration
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to address various research questions in battery research. These algorithms are being used to predict voltages and generate candidate electrode materials for metal-ion batteries, analyze the factors affecting the performance of lithium-sulfur batteries, screen and predict properties of solid electrolytes and anode coatings for all-solid-state batteries, study the correlations between dopant features and discharge capacity of cathode materials, and much more. Machine learning is proving to be a valuable tool in accelerating the discovery and design of battery materials.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål inden for batteriforskning. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at forudsige spændinger og generere kandidatematerialer til elektroder til metal-ion batterier, analysere de faktorer, der påvirker ydeevnen af lithium-svovlbatterier, screene og forudsige egenskaberne af faste eller elektrolytter og anod belægninger til alle faste tilstandsbatterier, studere korrelationerne mellem dopantfunktioner og afladningskapacitet af katodematerialer, og meget mere. Maskinlæring viser sig at være et værdifuldt værktøj til at fremskynde opdagelsen og designet af batterimaterialer.

title: Aneurysm detection
en: Researchers have been investigating the capabilities of algorithms in assessing and detecting various types of aneurysms. These algorithms, such as computer-assisted detection systems, radiomic models, deep learning algorithms, and machine learning algorithms, are being attributed agency in accurately predicting rupture risk, differentiating between different types of aneurysms, detecting and localizing aneurysms, and assessing aneurysm growth status. The combination of deep learning, morphological characteristics, and radiomic features is also being explored to provide advanced warning of aortic dissection. These studies highlight the potential of algorithms in improving the diagnosis and management of aneurysms.
da: Forskere har undersøgt algoritmers evner til at vurdere og opdage forskellige typer af aneurysmer. Disse algoritmer, såsom computer-assisted detection systems, radiomic models, deep learning algorithms og machine learning algorithms, tildeles evnen til nøjagtigt at forudsige brudrisiko, differentiere mellem forskellige typer aneurysmer, opdage og lokalisere aneurysmer samt vurdere aneurysmes vækststatus. Kombinationen af deep learning, morfologiske karakteristika og radiomic features undersøges også for at give avanceret advarsel om aortic dissection. Disse studier fremhæver potentialet for algoritmer i at forbedre diagnosen og håndteringen af aneurysmer.

title: Digital Health Revolution
en: Algorithms are powerful tools that can predict medical outcomes and play a role in the adoption of person-centered care and consumer health technologies in digital medicine and health. They are also involved in the deployment of data-driven management and artificial intelligence in improving the health system. Digital health technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, can transform clinical trials and lower their cost. These advancements empower patients, redefine well-being, and have implications for clinical pharmacists. However, ethical considerations related to beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, justice, and explicability arise from the use of algorithms in digital health. Overall, digital technologies are transforming healthcare delivery systems, impacting health, medicine, and care, but also raising concerns about safety, reliability, and equity.
da: Algoritmer er kraftfulde værktøjer, der kan forudsige medicinske resultater og spille en rolle i adoptionen af personcentreret pleje og forbrugerhelseteknologier i digital medicin og sundhed. De er også involveret i implementeringen af datadrevet ledelse og artificial intelligence i forbedringen af sundhedssystemet. Digitale sundhedsteknologier, herunder artificial intelligence og machine learning algoritmer, kan transformere kliniske forsøg og sænke deres omkostninger. Disse fremskridt styrker patienterne, omdefinerer velvære og har konsekvenser for kliniske farmaceuter. Dog opstår der etiske overvejelser relateret til velgørenhed, undgåelse af skade, autonomi, retfærdighed og forklarlighed fra brugen af algoritmer i digital sundhed. Samlet set transformerede digitale teknologier sundhedsleveringssystemer, påvirker sundhed, medicin og pleje, men rejser også bekymringer om sikkerhed, pålidelighed og lighed.

title: AI-enhanced mammography
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to improve breast cancer detection in mammography. These algorithms provide decision support and markers for abnormalities, improving the diagnostic performance of radiologists without increasing false-positive recalls. The AI systems have shown comparable accuracy to human radiologists and have the potential to be used as independent readers in clinical trials.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af kunstig intelligens (AI) algoritmer til at forbedre brystkræftdetektion i mammografi. Disse algoritmer giver beslutningsstøtte og markører for abnormiteter, hvilket forbedrer diagnostisk ydeevne for radiologer uden at øge falske-positive tilkald. AI-systemerne har vist sammenlignelig nøjagtighed med menneskelige radiologer og har potentiale til at blive brugt som uafhængige læsere i kliniske forsøg.

title: AI Skin Diagnosis
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning algorithms to improve the diagnosis of various skin diseases, including skin cancer. These algorithms, such as AI models and machine learning algorithms, have shown promise in accurately detecting and diagnosing nonmelanoma skin cancer, melanoma, and other skin conditions. The involvement of dermatologists in developing these AI tools is also being explored to ensure their effectiveness and reliability. Additionally, AI has the potential to support clinicians in diagnosing a wide range of skin diseases and improve the accuracy of nonexpert physicians in diagnosing skin neoplasms. Overall, AI-based tools and applications have the potential to enhance the diagnosis and treatment of skin diseases, especially in populations with diverse skin types and colors.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af artificial intelligence (AI) og machine learning algorithms for at forbedre diagnosen af forskellige hudsygdomme, herunder hudkræft. Disse algoritmer, såsom AI-modeller og machine learning algorithms, har vist sig lovende i præcist at opdage og diagnosticere nonmelanoma hudkræft, melanom og andre hudtilstande. Involveringen af dermatologer i udviklingen af disse AI-værktøjer bliver også udforsket for at sikre deres effektivitet og pålidelighed. Derudover har AI potentialet til at støtte klinikere i at diagnosticere et bredt spektrum af hudsygdomme og forbedre nøjagtigheden af ikke-ekspertlægers diagnoser af hudneoplasmer. Samlet set har AI-baserede værktøjer og applikationer potentiale til at forbedre diagnosen og behandlingen af hudsygdomme, især i befolkninger med forskellige hudtyper og -farver.

title: Surgical outcome prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict various outcomes in patients undergoing hip and knee replacement surgeries. These algorithms, such as extreme gradient boosting and random forest classifier, have shown promise in providing better performance than traditional linear models. They have been used to predict patient-reported outcomes, complications, length of hospital stay, readmission rates, and other postoperative parameters. However, in some cases, machine learning classifiers did not improve prediction compared to classical statistical risk models. Overall, machine learning methods have the potential to enhance surgical outcome predictions and improve patient care.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige resultater hos patienter, der gennemgår hofte- og knæledsoperationer. Disse algoritmer, såsom extreme gradient boosting og random forest classifier, har vist sig at have potentiale til at yde bedre performance end traditionelle lineære modeller. De er blevet anvendt til at forudsige patient-raporterede resultater, komplikationer, længde af hospitalsophold, genindlæggelsesrater og andre postoperative parametre. Dog viste machine learning klassifikatorer i nogle tilfælde ikke en forbedring i forudsigelserne sammenlignet med klassiske statistiske risikomodeller. Samlet set har machine learning metoder potentiale til at forbedre forudsigelser af kirurgiske resultater og forbedre patientpleje.

title: Autism diagnosis
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to improve the early detection and diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Various algorithms such as k-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine, Random Forests, and logistic regression analysis have been employed to classify ASD data and screen for autism. These machine learning techniques show promise in automating the diagnosis of ASD in different age groups and improving the accuracy of detection in children, adolescents, and toddlers.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af machine learning-algoritmer for at forbedre den tidlige opdagelse og diagnose af Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Forskellige algoritmer såsom k-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine, Random Forests og logistisk regressionsanalyse er blevet anvendt til at klassificere ASD-data og screene for autisme. Disse machine learning-teknikker viser lovende resultater i automatiseringen af diagnosen af ASD i forskellige aldersgrupper og forbedring af nøjagtigheden af opdagelsen hos børn, unge og småbørn.

title: Lane detection
en: Researchers have been exploring how algorithms can improve the accuracy and efficiency of lane detection in smart vehicles. They have developed deep learning approaches, convolutional neural networks, and other network structures to accurately detect lane markings in various road conditions and environments. These algorithms aim to achieve real-time lane extraction and detection, improve segmentation accuracy, and adapt to complex weather conditions, ultimately enhancing the performance of self-driving vehicles.
da: Forskere har udforsket, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af lanesporing i smarte køretøjer. De har udviklet metoder inden for deep learning, convolutional neural networks og andre netværksstrukturer til præcist at detektere lanesignaler under forskellige vejforhold og miljøer. Disse algoritmer har til formål at opnå realtids lanesporing og -detektion, forbedre segmenteringsnøjagtigheden og tilpasse sig komplekse vejrforhold, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer ydeevnen af selvkørende køretøjer.

title: Deep object detection
en: Deep learning algorithms have significantly improved the performance of object detectors, leading to remarkable breakthroughs in generic object detection. These algorithms have also become the mainstream for object detection in remote sensing imagery. Researchers are exploring how deep feature learning and intrinsic prior knowledge can further enhance object detection accuracy. Additionally, there are efforts to develop lightweight and efficient models that can achieve competitive results in terms of both accuracy and speed.
da: Dyb læring algoritmer har betydeligt forbedret ydeevnen for objektdetektorer, hvilket har ført til bemærkelsesværdige gennembrud inden for generisk objektgenkendelse. Disse algoritmer er også blevet mainstream for objektgenkendelse i fjernmåling billeder. Forskere undersøger, hvordan dyb feature learning og indre forudgående viden kan forbedre nøjagtigheden af objektgenkendelse yderligere. Derudover er der bestræbelser på at udvikle letvægts- og effektive modeller, der kan opnå konkurrencedygtige resultater både med hensyn til nøjagtighed og hastighed.

title: Blood Pressure Prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep convolutional neural networks and deep learning models, to predict blood pressure without the need for manual feature extraction and individual calibration. They are also investigating the accuracy of these algorithms in estimating systolic and diastolic blood pressure in real-time using electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram signals. Additionally, hybrid neural network architectures and machine learning algorithms are being studied to effectively estimate blood pressure based on various signals and characteristics.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af algoritmer, specifikt dybe konvolutionelle neurale netværk og dyb læring modeller, til at forudsige blodtryk uden behov for manuel featureekstraktion og individuel kalibrering. De undersøger også nøjagtigheden af disse algoritmer i at estimere systolisk og diastolisk blodtryk i realtid ved hjælp af elektrocardiogram og photoplethysmogram-signaler. Derudover studeres hybride neurale netværksarkitekturer og machine learning-algoritmer for effektivt at estimere blodtryk baseret på forskellige signaler og egenskaber.

title: Re-identification algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to improve person re-identification, which is the task of identifying individuals across different camera views. These algorithms include the Unsupervised Region Attention Network (Uran), Attention-aware adversarial network (AAA-Net), Adaptive Attention-Aware Network, Self-attention model, Self-attention mechanism, and more. By developing and utilizing these algorithms, researchers aim to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of person re-identification systems, ultimately improving security and surveillance applications.
da: Forskere udforsker forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre re-identifikation af personer, hvilket er opgaven med at identificere enkeltpersoner på tværs af forskellige kameravinkler. Disse algoritmer inkluderer Unsupervised Region Attention Network (Uran), Attention-aware adversarial network (AAA-Net), Adaptive Attention-Aware Network, Self-attention model, Self-attention mechanism og mere. Ved at udvikle og anvende disse algoritmer sigter forskerne mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af re-identifikationssystemer, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer sikkerheds- og overvågningsapplikationer.

title: Smart contract security
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to detect vulnerabilities in smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain.
