These algorithms use techniques such as dynamic symbolic execution, machine learning, ensemble learning, and deep learning to identify and classify vulnerabilities. By analyzing the code and transaction data of smart contracts, these algorithms can help prevent Ponzi schemes, classify different types of contracts, detect fraudulent behaviors, and improve overall security in blockchain-based applications.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer til at opdage sårbarheder i smart contracts på Ethereum blockchainen. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker såsom dynamisk symbolsk eksekvering, machine learning, ensemble learning og deep learning til at identificere og klassificere sårbarheder. Ved at analysere koden og transaktionsdataene for smart contracts kan disse algoritmer hjælpe med at forhindre Ponzi-schemer, klassificere forskellige typer kontrakter, opdage svigagtige adfærd og forbedre den generelle sikkerhed i blockchain-baserede applikationer.

title: Enhancing action recognition
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve skeleton-based action recognition using algorithms. They are investigating the use of robust multi-feature learning, enhanced spatial and temporal graph convolutional networks, fusion of spatial and temporal features, graph sparsification, self-attention modules, and more. These algorithms aim to enhance the performance of existing models and overcome limitations, ultimately improving the accuracy of recognizing human actions based on skeletal data.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre skeletbaseret handlingsgenkendelse ved hjælp af algoritmer. De undersøger brugen af robust multi-feature learning, forbedrede spatial og temporal graph convolutional networks, fusion af spatial og temporal features, graph sparsification, self-attention modules og mere. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre præstationen af eksisterende modeller og overvinde begrænsninger, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer nøjagtigheden af at genkende menneskelige handlinger baseret på skeletdata.

title: Noise reduction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms, such as deep convolutional neural networks and denoising convolutional neural networks, to reduce random noise in seismic data. These algorithms aim to improve the signal-to-noise ratio and effectively suppress noise in different areas. Additionally, self-supervised learning methods are being investigated for seismic data reconstruction and denoising.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer, såsom deep convolutional neural networks og denoising convolutional neural networks, for at reducere tilfældig støj i seismiske data. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre forholdet mellem signal og støj og effektivt undertrykke støj i forskellige områder. Derudover undersøges selv-supervised learning metoder til rekonstruktion og denoising af seismiske data.

title: Real-Time Fatigue Algorithms
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to detect driver fatigue in real-time and improve accuracy. These algorithms consider individual driver differences, combine static and dynamic features, and use facial multi-feature fusion for better performance. They achieve high accuracy, speed, and robustness in fatigue detection, outperforming other methods. The proposed algorithms also overcome limitations of comfort, external factors, and real-time performance, achieving good performance in accuracy and speed.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at opdage føretræthed i realtid og forbedre nøjagtigheden. Disse algoritmer tager højde for individuelle forskelle blandt førere, kombinerer statiske og dynamiske funktioner, og anvender ansigtets multi-funktion fusion for bedre ydeevne. De opnår høj nøjagtighed, hastighed og robusthed i føretræthed detektion, og overgår andre metoder. De foreslåede algoritmer overvinder også begrænsninger ved komfort, eksterne faktorer og realtidsydelse, og opnår god præstation i nøjagtighed og hastighed.

title: Dehazing breakthrough
en: Researchers have been exploring the capabilities of deep learning algorithms in improving the quality of hazy images. They have developed various algorithms, such as NIN-DehazeNet, End-to-end trainable neural network, and Multi-scale deep network, that aim to enhance single image dehazing. These algorithms utilize advanced techniques like feature extraction modules, convolutional neural networks, and attention mechanisms to learn the mapping between hazy images and clear images, resulting in improved dehazing performance.
da: Forskere har undersøgt mulighederne for deep learning algoritmer til at forbedre kvaliteten af dystre billeder. De har udviklet forskellige algoritmer, såsom NIN-DehazeNet, End-to-end trainable neural network, og Multi-scale deep network, der har til formål at forbedre dehazing af enkeltbilleder. Disse algoritmer udnytter avancerede teknikker som feature extraction modules, convolutional neural networks, og attention mechanisms til at lære kortlægningen mellem dystre billeder og klare billeder, hvilket resulterer i forbedret dehazing-ydeevne.

title: Rain removal
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to effectively remove rain streaks from single images while preserving important background details. These algorithms include deep cascaded networks, dual-channel attention mechanisms, coarse-to-fine deraining networks, deep residual learning algorithms, recurrent attention dense networks, and more. By incorporating these advanced algorithms, rain-free images can be generated by learning multi-scale context features and using generalized rain pattern absorption attention networks.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til effektivt at fjerne regnstriber fra enkeltbilleder, mens de bevarer vigtige baggrundsdetaljer. Disse algoritmer inkluderer deep cascaded networks, dual-channel attention mechanisms, coarse-to-fine deraining networks, deep residual learning algorithms, recurrent attention dense networks og mere. Ved at inkludere disse avancerede algoritmer kan regnfri billeder genereres ved at lære multi-scale context features og bruge generalized rain pattern absorption attention networks.

title: Optimizing UAV Computing
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the efficiency and energy consumption of UAV-enabled mobile-edge computing systems. Algorithms are being developed to optimize various factors such as offloading times, CPU frequencies, transmit powers, UAV trajectories, and task data allocation. These algorithms aim to minimize delays, energy consumption, and maximize computation efficiency, ultimately enhancing the performance of these systems.
da: Forskere udforsker metoder til at forbedre effektiviteten og energiforbruget af UAV-aktiverede mobile-edge computing-systemer. Algoritmer udvikles for at optimere forskellige faktorer såsom aflæsnings tider, CPU frekvenser, transmissionsstyrker, UAV traektorier og opgave data allocation. Disse algoritmer har til formål at minimere forsinkelser, energiforbrug og maksimere beregningseffektivitet, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer ydeevnen af disse systemer.

title: AI + Edge Computing
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are rapidly incorporating edge computing, which involves processing data closer to where it is generated. This integration has various concepts, backgrounds, and pros and cons. For example, AI and edge computing can be integrated in Internet of Things (IoT) networks to achieve a complementary integration by redesigning AI-related modules of edge computing. Machine learning algorithms are also used to address resource-efficient Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) in 5G networks and IoT, enabling quick near-optimal solutions. Overall, the combination of AI and edge computing has the potential to improve efficiency, effectiveness, privacy, and security in various networks and applications.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) teknologier integrerer hurtigt edge computing, som involverer behandling af data tættere på, hvor de bliver genereret. Denne integration omfatter forskellige begreber, baggrunde samt fordele og ulemper. For eksempel kan AI og edge computing integreres i Internet of Things (IoT) netværk for at opnå en komplementær integration ved at redesigne AI-relaterede moduler af edge computing. Maskinlæringsalgoritmer anvendes også til at adressere ressourceeffektiv Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) i 5G-netværk og IoT, hvilket muliggør hurtige nær-optimale løsninger. Samlet set har kombinationen af AI og edge computing potentiale til at forbedre effektivitet, effektivitet, privatliv og sikkerhed i forskellige netværk og applikationer.

title: Ransomware algorithms
en: Algorithms play a crucial role in detecting and combating cryptographic ransomware. They are used in antivirus and firewall software to detect ransomware, evaluate and compare detection tools, categorize the severity of attacks, and improve the detection rate using machine learning. Algorithms also assist in data recovery, pre-encryption detection, and identification of ransomware attacks. Additionally, they analyze encryption key generation methods, detect ransomware encryption techniques, and neutralize ransomware detection technologies using encoding and format preserving encryption algorithms.
da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at opdage og bekæmpe kryptografisk ransomware. De bruges i antivirus- og firewall-software til at opdage ransomware, evaluere og sammenligne detektionværktøjer, kategorisere angrebens alvorlighed og forbedre detektionsraten ved hjælp af machine learning. Algoritmer hjælper også med datarecovery, forudgående detektion af kryptering og identifikation af ransomware-angreb. Derudover analyserer de metoder til generering af krypteringsnøgler, opdager ransomware-krypteringsteknikker og neutraliserer ransomware-detektionsteknologier ved hjælp af encoding og formatbevarende krypteringsalgoritmer.

title: Deep Modification Prediction
en: Scientists have developed various deep learning models that can accurately predict different types of DNA and RNA modifications. These models, such as 4mCCNN and Deep4mcPred, use convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and other deep learning techniques to analyze DNA and RNA sequences and identify specific modification sites. By leveraging the power of algorithms, these models provide a more efficient and systematic approach to studying and predicting these modifications, which can have important implications for understanding genetic processes and diseases.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige deep learning-modeller, som præcist kan forudsige forskellige typer af DNA- og RNA-modifikationer. Disse modeller, såsom 4mCCNN og Deep4mcPred, bruger convolutional neural networks (CNNs) og andre deep learning-teknikker til at analysere DNA- og RNA-sekvenser og identificere specifikke modificeringssteder. Ved at udnytte kraften i algoritmer giver disse modeller en mere effektiv og systematisk tilgang til at studere og forudsige disse modifikationer, som kan have vigtige implikationer for forståelsen af genetiske processer og sygdomme.

title: Algorithmic trading revolution
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep reinforcement learning algorithms in algorithmic trading and stock market strategies. These algorithms are able to autonomously make trading decisions and optimize trading positions, leading to potential profits in dynamic financial markets. The combination of deep reinforcement learning with other techniques, such as modern portfolio theory, has also shown promise in optimizing stock portfolios. Overall, these algorithms have the potential to automate trading decisions and improve financial trading strategies.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer i algorithmisk handel og aktiemarkedsstrategier. Disse algoritmer er i stand til autonomt at træffe handelsbeslutninger og optimere handelspositioner, hvilket kan føre til potentielle gevinster i dynamiske finansmarkeder. Kombinationen af deep reinforcement learning med andre teknikker, såsom moderne porteføleteori, har også vist sig lovende i optimering af aktieporteføljer. Samlet set har disse algoritmer potentiale til at automatisere handelsbeslutninger og forbedre finansielle handelsstrategier.

title: Optimizing Multi-View Clustering
en: Researchers are exploring various ways to improve the performance of multi-view subspace clustering, which is a technique used to group similar data together. They are using algorithms to optimize models and methods, assign weights to different features, capture local information, and learn consensus and complementary information from multiple views. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy, robustness, efficiency, and effectiveness of multi-view subspace clustering.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige måder at forbedre ydeevnen af multi-view subspace clustering, som er en teknik, der bruges til at gruppere lignende data sammen. De benytter algoritmer til at optimere modeller og metoder, tildele vægte til forskellige funktioner, opfange lokal information og lære konsensus og komplementær information fra flere udsigter. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden, robustheden, effektiviteten og effektiviteten af multi-view subspace clustering.

title: Deep Learning for Tumor Detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning models and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), to classify and detect different types of brain tumors using MRI images. These algorithms, such as the Deep CNN-based approach and the Fine-tuned EfficientNet, have shown promise in accurately diagnosing and classifying brain tumors. By leveraging the power of deep learning and CNNs, these automated methods offer a potentially effective and reliable way to detect brain tumors from MRI images.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning-modeller og convolutional neural networks (CNNs), til at klassificere og opdage forskellige typer af hjernetumorer ved hjælp af MRI-billeder. Disse algoritmer, såsom den Deep CNN-baserede tilgang og Fine-tuned EfficientNet, har vist sig lovende til nøjagtigt at diagnosticere og klassificere hjernetumorer. Ved at udnytte kraften af deep learning og CNNs tilbyder disse automatiserede metoder en potentielt effektiv og pålidelig måde at opdage hjernetumorer fra MRI-billeder.

title: Knowledge Graph Enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve knowledge graph completion using algorithms. One approach is to integrate textual knowledge and network topology, which allows for more accurate completion. Another method involves utilizing both local and global structural information through graph convolutional networks. Additionally, algorithms can leverage the rich information in neighbor nodes and capture different relation patterns for improved completion. These advancements aim to enhance our understanding of knowledge graphs and their applications.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre fuldførelsen af knowledge graph ved hjælp af algoritmer. En tilgang er at integrere tekstuel viden og netværkstopologi, hvilket muliggør en mere præcis fuldførelse. En anden metode involverer at udnytte både lokal og global strukturel information gennem graph convolutional networks. Derudover kan algoritmer udnytte den rige information i naboknuder og indfange forskellige relationsmønstre for en forbedret fuldførelse. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre vores forståelse af knowledge graphs og deres anvendelser.

title: AI-Driven Concrete Strength
en: Researchers are exploring the use of artificial intelligence algorithms to predict the strength of different types of concrete. These algorithms, such as adaptive neuro fuzzy inference and genetic programming, are being used to fine-tune neural networks and optimize support vector regression models. By combining these algorithms with machine learning techniques, scientists hope to improve the accuracy of predicting the compressive strength of concrete and other mechanical properties.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af kunstig intelligens algoritmer til at forudsige styrken af forskellige typer beton. Disse algoritmer, såsom adaptive neuro fuzzy inference og genetic programming, anvendes til at finjustere neurale netværk og optimere support vector regression modeller. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med maskinlæringsteknikker håber forskerne at forbedre nøjagtigheden af forudsigelsen af trykstyrken af beton og andre mekaniske egenskaber.

title: Deep Learning for Air Quality
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to improve the accuracy of air pollution prediction in various cities around the world. These algorithms, such as LSTM, CNN, and GRU, are being used to forecast the concentration of pollutants like PM2.5 and SO2. By integrating big data and considering spatiotemporal correlations, these deep learning models are showing promising results in predicting air quality parameters and enhancing the accuracy of air pollution forecasts.
da: Forskere har undersøgt anvendelsen af deep learning-algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af luftforureningsforudsigelser i forskellige byer rundt om i verden. Disse algoritmer, såsom LSTM, CNN og GRU, anvendes til at forudsige koncentrationen af forurenende stoffer som PM2.5 og SO2. Ved at integrere big data og tage hensyn til spatiotemporale korrelationer viser disse deep learning-modeller lovende resultater i forudsigelsen af luftkvalitetsparametre og forbedring af nøjagtigheden af luftforureningsprognoser.

title: GAN Advancements
en: Recent progress on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) is attributed to the agency of algorithms. Calibrated adversarial algorithms improve generative modelling, the generator of GANs can be inverted, and GANs can be deconstructed and improved. Algorithms also contribute to the understanding and application of GANs, the improvement of classification accuracy in deep learning, and the restoration of latent vectors. Additionally, algorithms play a role in the evolution and effectiveness of loss functions, the development and comparison of different types of GANs, and the optimization strategy for designing GANs.
da: Nylige fremskridt inden for Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) kan tilskrives algoritmernes evner. Kalibrerede modstridende algoritmer forbedrer generativ modellering, generatoren af GANs kan inverteres, og GANs kan dekonstrueres og forbedres. Algoritmer bidrager også til forståelsen og anvendelsen af GANs, forbedringen af klassifikationsnøjagtighed i deep learning, samt restaureringen af latente vektorer. Derudover spiller algoritmer en rolle i udviklingen og effektiviteten af tabsfunktioner, udviklingen og sammenligningen af forskellige typer af GANs, samt optimeringsstrategien for design af GANs.

title: Efficient task offloading
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to optimize task offloading in vehicular edge computing. These algorithms aim to improve network delay, achieve cost-efficiency, enhance performance, satisfy computing-intensive and delay-sensitive tasks, optimize network selection, provide energy-efficient computation offloading, utilize collaborative resources, achieve dynamic task offloading, perform dependency-aware task offloading and service caching, minimize task processing delay, enable mobility-aware multi-hop task offloading, achieve fully distributed task offloading, and optimize task offloading under deterministic demand. These algorithms play a crucial role in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of vehicular edge computing networks.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at optimere opgaveoverførsel i vehicular edge computing. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre netværksforsinkelse, opnå omkostningseffektivitet, forbedre ydeevnen, imødekomme beregningstunge og forsinkelsessensitive opgaver, optimere netværksvalg, tilbyde energieffektiv opgaveoverførsel, udnytte samarbejdende ressourcer, opnå dynamisk opgaveoverførsel, udføre afhængighedsbevidst opgaveoverførsel og service caching, minimere opgavebehandlingsforsinkelse, muliggøre mobilitetsbevidst multi-hop opgaveoverførsel, opnå fuldstændig distribueret opgaveoverførsel og optimere opgaveoverførsel under deterministisk efterspørgsel. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at forbedre effektiviteten og effektiviteten af vehicular edge computing netværk.

title: Secure e-voting
en: Researchers are exploring how blockchain technology can be used to ensure trustworthy and secure electronic voting systems. They are investigating the use of effective hashing techniques, adjustable blockchain methods, homomorphic encryption, and cryptographic methods to enhance the reliability, transparency, and integrity of the voting process. By utilizing blockchain technology, these researchers aim to address issues such as poor anonymity, low efficiency, and the need for statistical analysis in electronic voting systems.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan blockchain-teknologi kan anvendes til at sikre pålidelige og sikre elektroniske afstemningssystemer. De undersøger brugen af effektive hashing-teknikker, justerbare blockchain-metoder, homomorfisk kryptering og kryptografiske metoder for at forbedre pålideligheden, gennemsigtigheden og integriteten af afstemningsprocessen. Ved at udnytte blockchain-teknologi sigter disse forskere mod at tackle problemer såsom dårlig anonymitet, lav effektivitet og behovet for statistisk analyse i elektroniske afstemningssystemer.

title: QoE Optimization
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the quality of experience (QoE) in mobile video streaming. They are using algorithms, such as deep Q-learning and reinforcement learning, to optimize rate adaptation, energy consumption, latency, fairness, and overall QoE. These algorithms are being applied in various contexts, including LTE networks, software-defined mobile networks, edge computing, and 5G networks, to enhance video streaming and communication services.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre kvaliteten af oplevelsen (QoE) i mobil videostreaming. De anvender algoritmer, såsom deep Q-learning og reinforcement learning, til at optimere rateadgang, energiforbrug, latens, retfærdighed og den overordnede QoE. Disse algoritmer anvendes i forskellige kontekster, herunder LTE-netværk, softwaredefinerede mobilnetværk, edge computing og 5G-netværk, for at forbedre videostreaming og kommunikationstjenester.

title: Blockchain + AI
en: Researchers are exploring the potential of using blockchain technology and artificial intelligence (AI) together to address various challenges. Blockchain can automate payments and govern interactions in AI applications, while AI offers insight and decision-making capabilities for machines. By combining machine learning algorithms with blockchain, researchers aim to enhance data provenance, predictive planning, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance in various domains such as e-commerce, healthcare, and financial institutions.
da: Forskere undersøger potentialet for at bruge blockchain-teknologi og kunstig intelligens (AI) sammen for at tackle forskellige udfordringer. Blockchain kan automatisere betalinger og styre interaktioner i AI-applicationer, mens AI tilbyder indsigt og beslutningstagningsevner for maskiner. Ved at kombinere maskinlæringsalgoritmer med blockchain sigter forskerne mod at forbedre dataproveniens, forudsigende planlægning, svindeldetektering og overholdelse af regler i forskellige områder som e-handel, sundhedspleje og finansielle institutioner.

title: Automated cephalometric analysis
en: Researchers are exploring the use of artificial intelligence, deep learning, and convolutional neural networks to automate the identification and analysis of cephalometric landmarks in medical images. They are investigating the accuracy and efficiency of these algorithms compared to human identification, as well as the amount of learning data needed to develop reliable automatic identification. The goal is to create a fully automatic landmark identification model that achieves accuracy comparable to human examiners, potentially revolutionizing cephalometric analysis.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af kunstig intelligens, deep learning og convolutional neural networks til at automatisere identifikationen og analysen af cephalometriske landemærker i medicinske billeder. De undersøger nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af disse algoritmer sammenlignet med menneskelig identifikation, samt mængden af læringsdata, der er nødvendig for at udvikle pålidelig automatisk identifikation. Målet er at skabe en fuldautomatisk landemærkeidentifikationsmodel, der opnår en nøjagtighed, der kan sammenlignes med menneskelige bedømmere, hvilket potentielt kan revolutionere cephalometrisk analyse.

title: Automated cell classification
en: Scientists are exploring how algorithms can improve the identification and classification of white blood cells. They are using deep learning methodologies, convolutional neural networks, machine learning, and other techniques to develop automated systems that can accurately identify and locate different types of white blood cells in blood images. These algorithms have the potential to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of white blood cell classification, aiding in the early detection of diseases.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre identificeringen og klassifikationen af hvide blodlegemer. De bruger deep learning-metodologier, convolutional neural networks, machine learning og andre teknikker til at udvikle automatiserede systemer, der kan identificere og lokalisere forskellige typer af hvide blodlegemer i blodbilleder præcist. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af klassifikationen af hvide blodlegemer, hvilket kan hjælpe med tidlig opdagelse af sygdomme.

title: Kidney disease prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning and machine learning approaches, to predict and diagnose kidney diseases using ultrasound images. These algorithms are being developed to determine kidney function, classify different stages of chronic kidney disease, and detect abnormalities in the kidneys. By integrating computer-extracted features and using convolutional neural networks, these algorithms aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosing kidney diseases through image processing.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning og machine learning tilgange, til at forudsige og diagnosticere nyresygdomme ved hjælp af ultralydsbilleder. Disse algoritmer bliver udviklet for at bestemme nyrefunktionen, klassificere forskellige stadier af kronisk nyresygdom og opdage abnormiteter i nyrerne. Ved at integrere computerudtrukne egenskaber og anvende convolutional neural networks, sigter disse algoritmer mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af diagnosticeringen af nyresygdomme gennem billedebehandling.

title: Microbial impact analysis
en: Scientists are using algorithms to study the impact of microbial factors on animal health and productivity. By analyzing the composition of microbes and metabolites in animals like steers, goats, and cows, researchers are able to identify the specific microbiota responsible for shifts in rumen function, feed efficiency, and even milk microorganisms. These findings can help improve animal nutrition and overall well-being.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at studere indflydelsen af mikrobielle faktorer på dyresundhed og produktivitet. Ved at analysere sammensætningen af mikrober og metabolitter i dyr som okser, geder og køer er forskerne i stand til at identificere den specifikke mikrobiota, der er ansvarlig for ændringer i vomfunktionen, foderets effektivitet og endda mikrobier i mælken. Disse resultater kan hjælpe med at forbedre dyrenes ernæring og generelle trivsel.

title: Deep Prognostic Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve the accuracy of predicting survival and prognosis in cancer patients. These algorithms, such as DeepSurv and DeepBTS, use deep learning techniques to analyze patient data and make predictions about disease progression and recurrence-free survival. By harnessing the power of machine learning, these models aim to provide more accurate prognostic information and potentially improve patient outcomes.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af at forudsige overlevelse og prognose hos kræftpatienter. Disse algoritmer, såsom DeepSurv og DeepBTS, anvender deep learning teknikker til at analysere patientdata og lave forudsigelser om sygdomsforløb og recidivfri overlevelse. Ved at udnytte kraften fra machine learning har disse modeller til formål at levere mere præcis prognostisk information og potentielt forbedre patientresultater.

title: Weed recognition
en: Deep learning algorithms can be used to recognize weed species in the rangeland environment. A combination of fine-tuning pre-trained convolutional networks and traditional machine learning classifiers can improve crop/weed identification. A deep learning-based object detection system can accurately identify weeds using UAS imagery.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer kan bruges til at genkende ukrudtsarter i græsningsmiljøet. En kombination af finjustering af foruddannede convolutional networks og traditionelle maskinlæringsklassificere kan forbedre identifikationen af afgrøder/ukrudt. Et deep learning-baseret objektdetektionssystem kan nøjagtigt identificere ukrudt ved hjælp af UAS-billeder.

title: Crowd counting algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring various algorithms to improve crowd counting in different scenarios. These algorithms aim to estimate density maps at the pixel level, extract discriminative features, integrate global-context and long-range dependency, and address challenges such as scale variation, occlusion, and overcrowding. By utilizing contextual information, enhancing multi-level features, and capturing pan-density information, these algorithms strive to generate high-quality crowd density maps and improve the accuracy of crowd counting.
da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre crowd counting i forskellige scenarier. Disse algoritmer har til formål at estimere densitetskort på pixelniveau, udtrække diskriminerende funktioner, integrere global kontekst og langafstandafhængighed samt tackle udfordringer som skala variation, okklusion og overbefolkning. Ved at udnytte kontekstuel information, forbedre multi-level funktioner og fange pan-density information, stræber disse algoritmer efter at generere høj kvalitet crowd density kort og forbedre nøjagtigheden af crowd counting.

title: Deep EEG Classification
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve the classification of motor imagery EEG signals using deep learning techniques. These algorithms utilize convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and other methods such as continuous wavelet transform, spatial-frequency-temporal 3D CNN models, and attention mechanisms. By combining these algorithms with image processing methods, transfer learning, and data augmentation, they aim to achieve accurate and robust classification of motor imagery EEG signals, which could have implications for brain-computer interfaces and rehabilitation technologies.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre klassifikationen af motorisk forestilling EEG-signaler ved hjælp af deep learning teknikker. Disse algoritmer anvender convolutional neural networks (CNNs) og andre metoder såsom continuous wavelet transform, spatial-frequency-temporal 3D CNN-modeller og attention mechanisms. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med billedbehandlingsmetoder, transfer learning og data augmentation, sigter de mod at opnå præcis og robust klassifikation af motorisk forestilling EEG-signaler, hvilket kunne have implikationer for brain-computer interfaces og rehabiliteringsteknologier.

title: Archaeological AI
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning and convolutional neural networks, to assist in various aspects of archaeology and cultural heritage studies. These algorithms have shown promise in detecting burial mounds, mining pits, engraved patterns on pottery, and even classifying archaeological artifacts. They provide efficient and accurate methods for analysis, classification, and mapping, ultimately streamlining and enhancing archaeological research.
da: Forskere har undersøgt anvendelsen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning og convolutional neural networks, til at hjælpe med forskellige aspekter af arkæologi og kulturarvstudier. Disse algoritmer har vist potentiale i at opdage gravhøje, miner, indgraverede mønstre på keramik og endda klassificere arkæologiske artefakter. De tilbyder effektive og nøjagtige metoder til analyse, klassificering og kortlægning, hvilket i sidste ende effektiviserer og forbedrer arkæologisk forskning.

title: Algorithms in Animal Agriculture
en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to address various research questions in the field of animal agriculture. These algorithms, such as random forest, naive Bayes, and support vector machines, are being employed to predict outcomes like survival to second lactation in cattle, insufficient herbage allowance, lameness in dairy herds, udder health status, and more. By analyzing data from sensors and farm-based records, these algorithms are helping researchers make informed decisions and improve animal health and productivity.
da: Forskere har anvendt machine learning-algoritmer til at tackle forskellige forskningsspørgsmål inden for dyrelandbrug. Disse algoritmer, såsom random forest, naive Bayes og support vector machines, anvendes til at forudsige resultater som overlevelse til anden laktation hos kvæg, utilstrækkelig græsningsmulighed, haltheder i malkekvægsbesætninger, mælkekirtelens sundhedsstatus og mere. Ved at analysere data fra sensorer og gårdbaserede optegnelser hjælper disse algoritmer forskere med at træffe informerede beslutninger og forbedre dyresundhed og produktivitet.

title: Nanophotonics revolution
en: Scientists are exploring the use of deep learning and machine learning algorithms to improve the design and understanding of nanophotonic structures. These algorithms are being used to predict electromagnetic responses, optimize the design of metasurfaces, and reveal the underlying physics of these structures. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, researchers hope to accelerate the design process and uncover new possibilities in the field of nanophotonics.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning og machine learning algoritmer for at forbedre designet og forståelsen af nanophotonic strukturer. Disse algoritmer bliver brugt til at forudsige elektromagnetiske reaktioner, optimere designet af metasurfaces og afsløre den underliggende fysik af disse strukturer. Ved at udnytte kraften fra artificial intelligence håber forskerne at accelerere designprocessen og afdække nye muligheder inden for nanophotonics.

title: Ethical AI in Medicine
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is set to have a significant impact on healthcare professions, leading to more efficient patient management and better quality of care. While AI technologies have the potential to ease the pressure on healthcare staff and improve patient lives, there are concerns about the legal and ethical implications. AI in healthcare enables intelligent decision-making support, optimized processes, personalized treatment plans, and other applications, but there are open issues in automation, data protection, and waste reduction. Overall, the integration of AI in healthcare offers opportunities for improved diagnostics, prevention, treatment, cost efficiency, and equality, but there are challenges related to AI adoption, patient privacy, and ethical problems.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) vil have en betydelig indvirkning på sundhedsprofessioner, hvilket fører til mere effektiv patienthåndtering og en bedre kvalitet af pleje. Selvom AI-teknologier har potentiale til at lette presset på sundhedspersonale og forbedre patienternes liv, er der bekymringer omkring de juridiske og etiske implikationer. AI i sundhedssektoren muliggør intelligent beslutningsstøtte, optimerede processer, personlige behandlingsplaner og andre anvendelser, men der er åbne spørgsmål vedrørende automatisering, databeskyttelse og affaldsreduktion. Samlet set tilbyder integrationen af AI i sundhedssektoren muligheder for forbedret diagnostik, forebyggelse, behandling, omkostningseffektivitet og lighed, men der er udfordringer relateret til AI-implementering, patientfortrolighed og etiske problemer.

title: AI-driven Innovation
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology is driving innovation in business models, acting as a catalyst for change. Researchers are exploring the building blocks and typology of AI, as well as its effects on organizational competencies. They are also investigating how Innovation and Technology Management can adopt and categorize AI for business, and the current business value and contribution of AI in information systems research. Additionally, they are examining the challenges, opportunities, and research agenda for AI in various domains, and the competencies and roles of top management in AI-enabled business model innovation. Overall, the research aims to understand how organizations can leverage AI technologies to gain business value and drive innovation.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) teknologi driver innovation i forretningsmodeller og fungerer som en katalysator for forandring. Forskere undersøger byggestenene og typologien af AI samt dens indvirkning på organisatoriske kompetencer. De undersøger også, hvordan Innovation and Technology Management kan adoptere og kategorisere AI til forretning, samt den nuværende forretningsværdi og bidrag af AI i forskningen om informationssystemer. Derudover ser de på udfordringerne, mulighederne og forskningsagendaen for AI inden for forskellige domæner, samt kompetencerne og rollerne for topledelsen i AI-aktiveret forretningsmodelinnovation. Samlet set har forskningen til formål at forstå, hvordan organisationer kan udnytte AI-teknologier til at opnå forretningsværdi og drive innovation.

title: Crop yield prediction
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to predict crop yields in various regions around the world. By integrating satellite data, climate data, and other sources of information, these algorithms can provide accurate predictions for wheat and rice yields. This research aims to improve agricultural forecasting and help farmers make informed decisions about their crops.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige afgrødeudbytter i forskellige regioner rundt om i verden. Ved at integrere satellitdata, klimadata og andre informationskilder kan disse algoritmer give præcise forudsigelser for hvede- og risudbytter. Denne forskning har til formål at forbedre landbrugsprognoser og hjælpe landmænd med at træffe informerede beslutninger om deres afgrøder.

title: AI-powered healthcare chatbots
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of AI-powered chatbots in healthcare, specifically focusing on their acceptability, target illnesses, and user engagement. These chatbots are designed to tackle a range of health issues, from nutritional and neurological disorders to mental health care and self-diagnosis. The studies also explore the ethical implications and potential benefits of using chatbots in healthcare, including personalized behavioral activation and remote health monitoring. Overall, the research suggests that chatbots have the potential to provide valuable support in various healthcare settings, including rural areas and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af AI-drevne chatbots i sundhedssektoren, med særligt fokus på deres acceptabilitet, målrettede sygdomme og brugerengagement. Disse chatbots er designet til at tackle en række sundhedsproblemer, fra ernærings- og neurologiske lidelser til mental sundhedspleje og selvdiagnose. Undersøgelserne udforsker også de etiske implikationer og potentielle fordele ved at bruge chatbots i sundhedssektoren, herunder personlig adfærdsaktivering og fjernovervågning af sundhed. Generelt antyder forskningen, at chatbots har potentiale til at yde værdifuld støtte i forskellige sundhedsindstillinger, herunder i landdistrikter og under COVID-19-pandemien.

title: Cancer DNA analysis
en: Scientists are exploring the use of algorithms to improve the detection and diagnosis of various types of cancer through the analysis of circulating tumor DNA. By utilizing machine learning models and classifiers, these algorithms can identify specific genetic variations and patterns in the DNA that are indicative of different types of cancer. This research aims to develop more accurate and non-invasive methods for early cancer detection and monitoring.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af algoritmer for at forbedre detektion og diagnosticering af forskellige typer af kræft gennem analysen af cirkulerende tumor DNA. Ved at udnytte machine learning-modeller og klassifikatorer kan disse algoritmer identificere specifikke genetiske variationer og mønstre i DNA'et, som er indicativ for forskellige typer af kræft. Denne forskning har til formål at udvikle mere præcise og ikke-invasive metoder til tidlig kræftdetektion og overvågning.

title: Fruit Detection Algorithms
en: Scientists have been exploring how machine vision and deep learning algorithms can improve the detection and localization of various fruits in different environments. For example, researchers have proposed improved versions of algorithms like Mask-RCNN, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3, and YOLOv4 to enhance fruit detection performance. These algorithms have shown promise in accurately detecting fruits such as strawberries, cherry tomatoes, apples, litchi, citrus fruits, pecans, green fruits, pineapple, and Xiaomila green pepper, among others. The use of these algorithms can greatly benefit tasks like fruit harvesting, yield estimation, and orchard management.
da: Forskere har udforsket, hvordan maskinsyn og dyb læring algoritmer kan forbedre detektion og lokalisering af forskellige frugter i forskellige miljøer. For eksempel har forskere foreslået forbedrede versioner af algoritmer som Mask-RCNN, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3 og YOLOv4 for at øge frugtdetektionspræstationen. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i præcist at detektere frugter såsom jordbær, cherrytomater, æbler, litchi, citrusfrugter, pekannødder, grønne frugter, ananas og Xiaomila grøn peber, blandt andet. Brug af disse algoritmer kan især gavne opgaver som frugthøst, udbytteestimering og frugthaveforvaltning.

title: Animal AI Monitoring
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep learning and machine vision algorithms to improve the accuracy of evaluating the body condition score of dairy cows and detecting the posture of pigs. They are also investigating the potential of convolutional neural networks (CNN) for individual identification and feeding behavior monitoring of dairy cows, as well as for cow rump identification and breed detection. These algorithms have the ability to automatically detect and track animals, making it easier to monitor their health and behavior in livestock farming.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af deep learning og machine vision algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af vurderingen af kroppens tilstandscore for malkekøer og registrering af grisens postur. De undersøger også potentialet ved convolutional neural networks (CNN) til individuel identifikation og overvågning af fodringsadfærd hos malkekøer, samt til identifikation af køers bagende og raceidentifikation. Disse algoritmer har evnen til automatisk at opdage og spore dyr, hvilket gør det lettere at overvåge deres sundhed og adfærd i husdyravl.

title: Diabetic foot algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning methods, to address various challenges related to diabetic foot ulcers. These algorithms can be used for real-time detection and localization of ulcers on mobile devices, classification of foot thermograms, identification of infection and ischaemia in ulcers, early detection of diabetic foot using thermogram images, and more. By leveraging machine learning and deep learning techniques, these algorithms have the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosing and treating diabetic foot complications.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, specifikt dybe læringsmetoder, til at tackle forskellige udfordringer relateret til diabetiske fodsår. Disse algoritmer kan anvendes til realtidsdetektion og lokalisering af sår på mobile enheder, klassificering af fodtermogrammer, identifikation af infektion og iskæmi i sår, tidlig detektion af diabetisk fod ved hjælp af termogrambilleder, og mere. Ved at udnytte maskinlæring og dybe læringsmetoder har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af diagnosen og behandlingen af komplikationer ved diabetisk fod.

title: Deep Learning in Dose Calculation
en: Scientists are exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning and convolutional neural networks, to improve the accuracy and efficiency of radiation therapy dose calculations. These algorithms are being tested to predict dose distributions, transform dose distributions between different spatial resolutions, and even automate treatment planning strategies. The goal is to enhance the precision and speed of radiotherapy treatments, ultimately improving patient outcomes.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer, specifikt deep learning og convolutional neural networks, for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af dosisberegninger i strålebehandling. Disse algoritmer bliver testet for at forudsige dosisfordelinger, transformere dosisfordelinger mellem forskellige rumlige opløsninger, og endda automatisere behandlingsplanlægningsstrategier. Målet er at forbedre præcisionen og hastigheden af strålebehandling, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer patientresultaterne.

title: AI Gender Bias
en: Researchers have explored various questions related to the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and gender. They have found that intersectional strategies can help uncover biases in AI and propose alternative ethical frameworks. Additionally, studies have shown that AI technologies can perpetuate gender stereotypes and biases, but a feminist lens can be used to challenge and mitigate these effects. Overall, there is a need for collaboration between sociology and AI to address biases, ensure human control, and explore the consequences of AI technologies.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige spørgsmål relateret til skæringspunktet mellem artificial intelligence (AI) og køn. De har fundet, at intersectionale strategier kan hjælpe med at afdække bias i AI og foreslå alternative etiske rammer. Derudover har studier vist, at AI-teknologier kan forstærke kønsstereotyper og bias, men en feministik tilgang kan bruges til at udfordre og mindske disse effekter. Generelt er der et behov for samarbejde mellem sociologi og AI for at tackle bias, sikre menneskelig kontrol og udforske konsekvenserne af AI-teknologier.

title: Trustworthy AI
en: The European Commission and its High-level Expert Group on AI are conducting research to understand and build trust in artificial intelligence (AI). They are exploring questions such as how trust can be established in the development and use of AI, the relationship between trust in AI and ethical concerns, and the dimensions of trustworthy AI. Additionally, they are investigating the conflation of trustworthiness and acceptability of risk in AI by the European Union. Overall, these efforts aim to ensure that AI can be trusted and viewed as trustworthy by society.
da: Den Europæiske Kommission og dens Højniveau Ekspertgruppe om AI udfører forskning for at forstå og opbygge tillid til kunstig intelligens (AI). De undersøger spørgsmål som, hvordan tillid kan etableres i udviklingen og brugen af AI, forholdet mellem tillid til AI og etiske bekymringer, samt dimensionerne af troverdig AI. Derudover undersøger de sammenblandingen af troværdighed og acceptabilitet af risiko i AI af Den Europæiske Union. Samlet set har disse indsatser til formål at sikre, at AI kan stole på og betragtes som troverdig af samfundet.

title: Stock ML Revolution
en: Machine learning algorithms have the potential to revolutionize stock selection and asset pricing. These algorithms can uncover hidden patterns and relationships in stock returns, leading to more accurate predictions and improved investment strategies. By capturing nonlinear effects and interactions, machine learning methods outperform traditional linear models and offer significant returns to investors.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer har potentialet til at revolutionere aktievalg og aktivprissætning. Disse algoritmer kan afdække skjulte mønstre og forhold i aktavedrag, hvilket fører til mere præcise forudsigelser og forbedrede investeringsstrategier. Ved at fange nonlineære effekter og interaktioner overgår maskinlæringsmetoder traditionelle lineære modeller og tilbyder betydelige afkast til investorer.

title: UAV Mobility Enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring how unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can optimize their mobility and improve their performance in various applications. They are using algorithms such as Q-learning, deep reinforcement learning, and game theory to enhance the capabilities of UAVs in areas like communication, energy efficiency, and resource allocation. These algorithms help UAVs make intelligent decisions and maximize their effectiveness in different scenarios.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan ubemandede flyvehavner (UAV'er) kan optimere deres mobilitet og forbedre deres ydeevne i forskellige applikationer. De anvender algoritmer såsom Q-learning, deep reinforcement learning og game theory for at forbedre UAV'ernes evner inden for områder som kommunikation, energieffektivitet og ressourceallokering. Disse algoritmer hjælper UAV'er med at træffe intelligente beslutninger og maksimere deres effektivitet i forskellige scenarier.

title: Graph ML advancements
en: Researchers are exploring how graph convolutional networks can be used to learn from complex and diverse graph-structured data. They have also developed a neural network model called Model R that uses deep learning to predict link weights in graph mining. Another algorithm, Loukas's coarsening algorithm, is being used to improve unsupervised graph representation learning. These advancements in algorithms are expanding the capabilities of machine learning on graph data and addressing challenges in graph analysis.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan graph convolutional networks kan bruges til at lære fra komplekse og diverse grafstrukturerede data. De har også udviklet en neuralt netværksmodel kaldet Model R, der bruger deep learning til at forudsige linkvægte i graph mining. En anden algoritme, Loukas's coarsening algorithm, bruges til at forbedre usuperviseret grafrepræsentationslæring. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmer udvider mulighederne for maskinlæring på grafdata og adresserer udfordringer inden for grafanalyse.

title: Deepfake detection
en: Researchers have been investigating the impact of deepfake technology on society and developing algorithms to detect manipulated videos. These algorithms, based on machine learning and deep learning techniques, analyze various features such as facial textural disparities, temporal and spatial features, and the rate of change between frames to identify deepfakes. The goal is to improve the detection of fake videos, especially those shared on social media, and protect individuals from the potential harm caused by the spread of misinformation.
da: Forskere har undersøgt effekten af deepfake-teknologi på samfundet og udviklet algoritmer til at opdage manipulerede videoer. Disse algoritmer, baseret på machine learning og deep learning teknikker, analyserer forskellige karakteristika såsom ansigtets teksturelle forskelle, tidsmæssige og rumlige funktioner samt ændringshastigheden mellem rammer for at identificere deepfakes. Målet er at forbedre detektionen af falske videoer, især dem der deles på sociale medier, og beskytte enkeltpersoner mod den potentielle skade, som spredningen af misinformation kan medføre.

title: Optimizing vehicle networks
en: Researchers are exploring how deep reinforcement learning algorithms can optimize various aspects of vehicle edge computing networks. These algorithms, such as Q-learning and deep reinforcement learning, are being used to improve offloading and resource allocation, construct intelligent offloading systems, make knowledge-driven service offloading decisions, enable collaborative edge computing, and optimize task distribution and offloading in the context of connected autonomous vehicles and the internet of vehicles. The goal is to enhance the efficiency and performance of these networks by leveraging the capabilities of deep reinforcement learning algorithms.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer kan optimere forskellige aspekter af køretøjs edge computing-netværk. Disse algoritmer, såsom Q-learning og deep reinforcement learning, bruges til at forbedre offloading og ressourceallokering, konstruere intelligente offloading-systemer, træffe vidensbaserede offloading-beslutninger, muliggøre samarbejdende edge computing og optimere opgavedistribution og offloading i forbindelse med tilsluttede autonome køretøjer og internettet af køretøjer. Målet er at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af disse netværk ved at udnytte mulighederne i deep reinforcement learning-algoritmerne.

title: Optimizing Drug Flow
en: Researchers are using algorithms to improve drug delivery by studying the flow dynamics of the micro-circulatory system. They are developing novel algorithms to simulate hybrid nanofluid flow and analyzing the features of entropy generation in blood biofluids. These algorithms are helping to optimize heat transportation and minimize entropy generation in order to enhance the effectiveness of drug delivery.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at forbedre lægemiddelafgivelse ved at studere flowdynamikken i det mikrocirkulatoriske system. De udvikler nye algoritmer til at simulere hybrid nanofluid flow og analyserer egenskaberne ved entropi generation i blod biofluider. Disse algoritmer hjælper med at optimere varmeoverførsel og minimere entropi generation for at øge effektiviteten af lægemiddelafgivelsen.

title: Biomass prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict various properties and outcomes related to biomass. These algorithms, such as support vector machines, artificial neural networks, and random forest, are being used to estimate parameters like higher heating value, gasification outcomes, pyrolysis products, and biogas production. By analyzing data and patterns, these algorithms are able to make accurate predictions and optimize biomass-based processes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige forskellige egenskaber og resultater relateret til biomasse. Disse algoritmer, såsom support vector machines, artificial neural networks og random forest, anvendes til at estimere parametre som højere varmeværdi, gasificeringsresultater, pyrolysisprodukter og biogasproduktion. Ved at analysere data og mønstre er disse algoritmer i stand til at lave præcise forudsigelser og optimere biomassebaserede processer.

title: Reliability estimation
en: Researchers are using algorithms to estimate the reliability of various systems under different conditions. These algorithms, such as the maximum likelihood estimate and Bayesian estimation, are being applied to analyze data from censored samples and determine the stress-strength relationship. By using these computational methods, scientists can make inferences about the reliability of complex systems and improve their understanding of how different factors affect their performance.
da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at estimere pålideligheden af forskellige systemer under forskellige forhold. Disse algoritmer, såsom maximum likelihood estimate og Bayesian estimation, anvendes til at analysere data fra censurerede prøver og bestemme stress-styrke forholdet. Ved at anvende disse beregningsmetoder kan forskere drage konklusioner om pålideligheden af komplekse systemer og forbedre deres forståelse af, hvordan forskellige faktorer påvirker deres ydeevne.

title: Autonomous driving algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve various aspects of autonomous driving. They are investigating methods such as multipolicy decision making, reinforcement learning, and deep reinforcement learning to enhance merging in congested traffic, cooperative highway work zone merge control, adaptive decision-making in roundabout scenarios, and more. These algorithms aim to improve safety, efficiency, and decision-making in autonomous vehicles.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af autonom kørsel. De undersøger metoder såsom multipolicy decision making, reinforcement learning og deep reinforcement learning for at forbedre sammenfletning i tætpakket trafik, samarbejdsstyring af sammenfletning i arbejdsområder på motorvejen, adaptiv beslutningstagning i rundkørsels-scenarier og mere. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre sikkerhed, effektivitet og beslutningstagning i autonome køretøjer.

title: Spectrum sensing revolution
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to improve spectrum sensing in cognitive radio systems. These algorithms, such as CNN and RNN, can accurately predict spectrum availability without prior knowledge of primary users. Additionally, techniques like transfer learning and federated learning are being applied to enhance adaptability and simplify the spectrum sensing process. These advancements aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of spectrum sensing in real-time applications.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer for at forbedre spektrumssensing i kognitive radiosystemer. Disse algoritmer, såsom CNN og RNN, kan nøjagtigt forudsige spektrumtilgængelighed uden forudgående kendskab til primære brugere. Derudover anvendes teknikker som transfer learning og federated learning for at forbedre tilpasningsevnen og forenkle spektrumssensing-processen. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af spektrumssensing i realtidsapplikationer.

title: Nanofluid AI Modeling
en: Researchers are using artificial intelligence algorithms to accurately predict the thermal properties of nanofluids. These algorithms, such as artificial neural networks and machine learning techniques, are being used to model and estimate properties like thermal conductivity and dynamic viscosity. By harnessing the power of AI, scientists hope to better understand and optimize the behavior of nanofluids, which could have important applications in fields like energy and materials science.
da: Forskere bruger kunstige intelligens-algoritmer til præcist at forudsige de termiske egenskaber ved nanofluider. Disse algoritmer, såsom kunstige neurale netværk og maskinlæringsteknikker, anvendes til at modellere og estimere egenskaber som varmeledningsevne og dynamisk viskositet. Ved at udnytte kraften fra AI håber videnskabsfolk at få en bedre forståelse af og optimere adfærden af nanofluider, hvilket kan have vigtige anvendelser inden for områder som energi og materialeforskning.

title: Autonomous UAVs
en: Researchers are exploring the use of deep reinforcement learning algorithms to enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to navigate and perform tasks autonomously in complex and unpredictable environments. These algorithms, such as the deep reinforcement learning strategy and the meta twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, provide the UAVs with the ability to track targets, avoid obstacles, and perform intelligent mission planning. By combining artificial intelligence with UAV technology, these advancements aim to improve the effectiveness and safety of UAV operations in various scenarios.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer for at gøre ubemandede luftfartøjer (UAV'er) i stand til at navigere og udføre opgaver autonomt i komplekse og uforudsigelige miljøer. Disse algoritmer, såsom deep reinforcement learning-strategien og meta twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, giver UAV'erne mulighed for at spore mål, undgå forhindringer og udføre intelligent missionsplanlægning. Ved at kombinere kunstig intelligens med UAV-teknologi sigter disse fremskridt mod at forbedre effektiviteten og sikkerheden af UAV-operationer i forskellige scenarier.

title: Fraud Detection Algorithms
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms, specifically deep learning models, to address various challenges in the field of electricity consumption and fraud detection. These algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), are being used to accurately forecast energy consumption, improve fraud detection using unlabeled data, identify electricity theft users, classify home appliances, and more. By leveraging the power of machine learning and deep learning techniques, these algorithms are helping to optimize energy usage and enhance the monitoring of power grids.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer, specifikt dybe læringsmodeller, til at tackle forskellige udfordringer inden for elforbrug og bedrageridetektion. Disse algoritmer, såsom Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) og Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), anvendes til præcist at forudsige energiforbrug, forbedre bedrageridetektion ved hjælp af ulabelerede data, identificere brugere af elektricitetstyveri, klassificere husholdningsapparater og mere. Ved at udnytte kraften fra maskinlæring og dybe læringsteknikker hjælper disse algoritmer med at optimere energiforbruget og forbedre overvågningen af elnet.

title: Flight delay prediction
en: Researchers have been using various machine learning algorithms, such as Support Vector Machines, logistic regression, random forests, and Bayesian modeling, to address questions related to flight delays and ground delay programs. These algorithms are being used to accurately predict flight delays, estimate aircraft arrival times, and improve flight delay predictions by considering factors like weather conditions and aircraft type. By harnessing the power of machine learning and artificial intelligence, researchers aim to enhance the efficiency and punctuality of flights in the United States airport network.
da: Forskere har brugt forskellige maskinlæringsalgoritmer, såsom Support Vector Machines, logistisk regression, random forests og Bayesian modeling, til at tackle spørgsmål relateret til flyforsinkelser og ground delay-programmer. Disse algoritmer bruges til nøjagtigt at forudsige flyforsinkelser, estimere ankomsttider for fly og forbedre forudsigelserne for flyforsinkelser ved at tage hensyn til faktorer som vejrforhold og flytype. Ved at udnytte kraften fra maskinlæring og artificial intelligence sigter forskerne mod at forbedre effektiviteten og punktligheden af flyvninger i det amerikanske lufthavnsnetværk.

title: Machine Learning for Pollution
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to predict air quality and air pollutant concentrations in various cities around the world. Algorithms such as Support Vector Regression, Random Forest Regression, and XGBoost are being employed to build models that can accurately forecast air pollution levels. These models take into account meteorological conditions, traffic data, and other environmental parameters to improve air quality prediction.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer bruges til at forudsige luftkvalitet og koncentrationer af luftforurenende stoffer i forskellige byer rundt om i verden. Algoritmer såsom Support Vector Regression, Random Forest Regression og XGBoost anvendes til at opbygge modeller, der præcist kan forudsige niveauerne af luftforurening. Disse modeller tager højde for meteorologiske forhold, trafikdata og andre miljømæssige parametre for at forbedre forudsigelsen af luftkvaliteten.

title: AI Governance Analysis
en: Researchers have analyzed a set of scientific abstracts to understand the state of artificial intelligence (AI) governance globally. They have explored various research questions, such as the role of government regulation in AI ethics, the challenges and modalities of AI governance, and the perception of AI technology and its governance. The analysis highlights the agency of algorithms in areas like overviewing current AI governance activities, developing frameworks for AI regulation, and identifying incentives for implementing AI governance programs.
da: Forskere har analyseret et sæt af videnskabelige abstracts for at forstå tilstanden af kunstig intelligens (AI) governance globalt. De har udforsket forskellige forskningsspørgsmål, såsom rollen af regeringsregulering i AI-etik, udfordringerne og modaliteterne ved AI-governance samt opfattelsen af AI-teknologi og dens governance. Analysen fremhæver algoritmernes rolle inden for områder som at overvåge nuværende AI-governance aktiviteter, udvikle rammer for AI-regulering og identificere incitamenter til implementering af AI-governance programmer.

title: Phishing AI
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of deep learning algorithms to improve the detection of phishing attacks. They have developed various models, such as Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), to detect phishing URLs and websites. These algorithms show promise in improving accuracy and reducing false positives in phishing detection systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre detektion af phishingangreb. De har udviklet forskellige modeller, såsom Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) og Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), til at detektere phishing-URLs og -websites. Disse algoritmer viser lovende resultater i at forbedre nøjagtigheden og reducere falske positiver i phishingdetektionssystemer.

title: Emotion analysis
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of artificial intelligence algorithms to analyze facial expressions and speech signals in order to understand and improve student emotions and engagement in various learning environments. These algorithms, based on deep learning techniques, can automatically monitor and classify student emotions, providing valuable feedback to teachers and improving the overall teaching experience. By analyzing facial expressions and other cues, these algorithms can help assess instructor behavior, evaluate the quality of online teaching, and even detect engagement in deaf and hard-of-hearing students.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af artificial intelligence-algoritmer til at analysere ansigtsudtryk og tale-signaler for at forstå og forbedre studerendes følelser og engagement i forskellige læringsmiljøer. Disse algoritmer, baseret på deep learning-teknikker, kan automatisk overvåge og klassificere studerendes følelser, hvilket giver værdifuld feedback til lærere og forbedrer den samlede undervisningsoplevelse. Ved at analysere ansigtsudtryk og andre signaler kan disse algoritmer hjælpe med at vurdere underviserens adfærd, evaluere kvaliteten af online undervisning og endda opdage engagement hos døve og hørehæmmede studerende.

title: Fluid Mechanics Optimization
en: Researchers are exploring the potential of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms in controlling and optimizing fluid mechanics problems. By teaching empirical strategies to artificial neural networks through trial and error, these algorithms can effectively control flow, reduce drag, and optimize sensor placement. They are also being used to develop control strategies for various flow configurations, including laminar and turbulent flows, weakly turbulent conditions, and flows with rotational oscillations. Additionally, DRL algorithms are being applied to reduce skin friction drag, suppress perturbations in convectively unstable flows, and achieve turbulent drag reduction in channel flows.
da: Forskere undersøger potentialet i deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algoritmer til at kontrollere og optimere problemer inden for fluidmekanik. Ved at undervise empiriske strategier til kunstige neurale netværk gennem forsøg og fejl kan disse algoritmer effektivt kontrollere strømning, reducere modstand og optimere placeringen af sensorer. De bliver også brugt til at udvikle kontrolstrategier for forskellige strømkonfigurationer, herunder laminar og turbulent strømning, svagt turbulente forhold og strømninger med rotationsoscillationer. Derudover anvendes DRL-algoritmer til at reducere overfladetræk, undertrykke forstyrrelser i konvektivt ustabile strømninger og opnå turbulent modstandsreduktion i kanalstrømninger.

title: Blockchain IoT Security
en: Researchers are exploring how to use blockchain technology and algorithms like deep learning and machine learning to enhance the security of Internet of Things (IoT) networks. These approaches aim to protect IoT devices, secure data sharing, and detect malicious activities in various applications such as healthcare, smart homes, and industrial IoT. By combining blockchain and algorithms, researchers are developing innovative solutions to ensure privacy, integrity, and resilience in IoT systems.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan man kan bruge blockchain-teknologi og algoritmer som deep learning og machine learning til at forbedre sikkerheden i Internet of Things (IoT) netværk. Disse tilgange har til hensigt at beskytte IoT-enheder, sikre datadeling og opdage ondsindede aktiviteter inden for forskellige applikationer såsom sundhedspleje, smarte hjem og industriel IoT. Ved at kombinere blockchain og algoritmer udvikler forskere innovative løsninger for at sikre privatliv, integritet og modstandsdygtighed i IoT-systemer.

title: AI in service
en: Researchers have been investigating various aspects of integrating AI and service robots into service transactions in industries such as hospitality and tourism. They are exploring questions like what factors influence acceptance and experiences of service robots, the impact of robots on service quality, and the dimensions of service quality in human-robot interactions. The studies aim to provide theoretical frameworks, empirical research, and insights into consumer acceptance and behavior towards service robots.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige aspekter af integrationen af AI og serviceløsninger i serviceydelser inden for industrier som hospitality og turisme. De udforsker spørgsmål som hvilke faktorer der påvirker accept og oplevelser med service-robotter, robotters indvirkning på servicekvalitet, og dimensionerne af servicekvalitet i menneske-robot-interaktioner. Studierne sigter mod at levere teoretiske rammer, empirisk forskning og indsigt i forbrugeraccept og -adfærd over for service-robotter.

title: Surrogate-Assisted Evolutionary Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the effectiveness and performance of surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms for various types of optimization problems. They are developing adaptive algorithms that can handle high-dimensional, expensive, irregular, and constrained multi-objective optimization problems. These algorithms use techniques such as adaptive surrogates, data-driven approaches, and model management to enhance the efficiency and reliability of the optimization process.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at forbedre effektiviteten og præstationen af surrogate-assisterede evolutionsalgoritmer til forskellige typer optimeringsproblemer. De udvikler adaptive algoritmer, der kan håndtere højdimensional, dyr, uregelmæssig og begrænset multi-objective optimeringsproblemer. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker såsom adaptive surrogater, data-drevne tilgange og modelhåndtering for at forbedre effektiviteten og pålideligheden af optimeringsprocessen.

title: Smart City Technologies
en: Researchers have explored the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) and big data integration in smart cities for sustainable development, aiming to enhance liveability and economic growth. They have also investigated the integration of technologies like AI, IoT, and data analytics in smart cities to enable effective decision making. Furthermore, the role of disruptive technologies such as IoT, big data, blockchain, and machine learning has been examined in optimizing urban infrastructures and services. These studies highlight the agency of algorithms in shaping the future of smart and sustainable cities.
da: Forskere har udforsket potentialet af artificial intelligence (AI) og big data integration i intelligente byer for bæredygtig udvikling med det mål at forbedre livskvalitet og økonomisk vækst. De har også undersøgt integrationen af teknologier som AI, IoT og data analytics i smarte byer for at muliggøre effektiv beslutningstagning. Desuden er rollen af disruptive technologies som IoT, big data, blockchain og machine learning blevet undersøgt med henblik på at optimere byinfrastruktur og -tjenester. Disse studier fremhæver algoritmers rolle i at forme fremtiden for smarte og bæredygtige byer.

title: Enhanced Software Prediction
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve software defect prediction. They are investigating various approaches, such as combining genetic algorithms and deep neural networks, using feature reduction and neural network classifiers, and applying deep learning techniques. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of predicting software defects, which can help developers identify and fix issues before they cause problems.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre forudsigelsen af softwaredefekter. De efterforsker forskellige tilgange, såsom kombination af genetiske algoritmer og dybe neurale netværk, brug af funktionreduktion og neurale netværksklassificatorer samt anvendelse af deep learning-teknikker. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af forudsigelsen af softwaredefekter, hvilket kan hjælpe udviklere med at identificere og rette problemer, inden de forårsager komplikationer.

title: Blockchain Education
en: Researchers have been exploring the potential of blockchain technology in the field of education. They are investigating how algorithms can be used to enhance various aspects of the education system, such as secure credentialing, decentralized learning management systems, and personalized recommendations. By utilizing blockchain's secure and transparent nature, these algorithms aim to improve the security, integrity, and efficiency of educational processes, ultimately enhancing the student experience and learning outcomes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt potentialet ved blockchain-teknologi inden for uddannelsesområdet. De undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af uddannelsessystemet, såsom sikker credentialing, decentraliserede læringsstyringssystemer og personlige anbefalinger. Ved at udnytte blockchainens sikre og gennemsigtige natur sigter disse algoritmer mod at forbedre sikkerheden, integriteten og effektiviteten af uddannelsesprocesser, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer studentoplevelsen og læringsresultaterne.

title: DDoS detection
en: Researchers have been investigating various algorithms to improve the detection and classification of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. These algorithms include machine learning-based schemes, error-robust multidimensional techniques, Higher Order Singular Value Decomposition (HOSVD), feature selection based machine learning, clustering-based semi-supervised machine learning, cascaded multi-classifier two-phase intrusion detection approach, and more. The goal is to develop more effective and accurate methods to identify and mitigate DDoS attacks, reducing their impact on networks and systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre detektion og klassifikation af Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) angreb. Disse algoritmer inkluderer maskinlæringsbaserede skemaer, fejltolerante multidimensionale teknikker, Higher Order Singular Value Decomposition (HOSVD), funktionselektion baseret maskinlæring, klyngebaseret semi-supervised maskinlæring, kaskade multi-classifier to-fases intrusion detection tilgang, og mere. Målet er at udvikle mere effektive og præcise metoder til at identificere og afbøde DDoS angreb, hvilket reducerer deres indvirkning på netværk og systemer.

title: Automated 3D Modeling
en: Machine learning algorithms, specifically the GAN model, can generate 3D models from architectural plans and sections. Generative adversarial networks can be used for automated structural design of shear wall residential buildings, facilitate the smart rendering of urban master plans, and accelerate environmental performance-driven urban design. Artificial intelligence-aided computation systems can support plural urban design. Deep learning algorithms, agent-based modeling, and graph algorithms can automate architectural layout generation. Conditional Generative Adversarial Network models can automate interior space planning. Generative modeling algorithms, 3D generative adversarial networks, dual Transformer models, and graph neural networks can generate various architectural forms, spatial configurations, and structural topologies. Generative methods, such as evolutionary optimization and deep generative models, are currently trending in generative urban design.
da: Maskinlæringsalgoritmer, specifikt GAN-modellen, kan generere 3D-modeller fra arkitektoniske planer og snit. Generative adversarial networks kan anvendes til automatiseret strukturel design af skjulte vægbo-residentialbygninger, lette den smarte rendering af urbane masterplaner og accelerere miljøpræstationsdrevet bydesign. Kunstig intelligens-støttede beregningssystemer kan understøtte plural urban design. Deep learning-algoritmer, agentbaseret modellering og grafalgoritmer kan automatisere genereringen af arkitektoniske layout. Conditional Generative Adversarial Network-modeller kan automatisere planlægning af indre rum. Generative modelleringsalgoritmer, 3D generative adversarial networks, dual Transformer-modeller og graf-neurale netværk kan generere forskellige arkitektoniske former, rumlige konfigurationer og strukturelle topologier. Generative metoder, såsom evolutionær optimering og deep generative models, er i øjeblikket på trend inden for generativ bydesign.

title: Adaptive Recommendation Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve recommendation systems. They are investigating different approaches, such as user-specific deep reinforcement learning, state representation modeling, and curiosity-driven recommendation strategies. These algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and adaptability of recommendation systems, ultimately improving the user experience.
