By leveraging artificial intelligence, these algorithms have the potential to improve the early detection and diagnosis of oral cancer, providing a rapid, non-invasive, and cost-effective tool for clinicians.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at opdage og klassificere pladecellekarcinom i mundhulen, oral kræft og andre potentielt maligne lidelser. Disse algoritmer, såsom convolutional neural networks (CNNs), har vist lovende resultater i nøjagtigt at identificere og adskille normale og kræftceller i orale fotografier og histopatologiske billeder. Ved at udnytte artificial intelligence har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre tidlig opdagelse og diagnose af oral kræft, hvilket giver et hurtigt, ikke-invasivt og omkostningseffektivt værktøj til klinikere.

title: AI-Enhanced Colonoscopy
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being used to improve the diagnosis and detection of colorectal polyps during colonoscopy procedures. These AI systems assist in real-time detection of polyps, improving the accuracy and effectiveness of the procedure. They have been shown to reduce miss rates, increase adenoma detection, and potentially save costs by optimizing the use of colonoscopy. However, the implementation of AI in colonoscopy still faces challenges that need to be addressed for widespread adoption.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) bruges til at forbedre diagnosen og opdage kolorektale polyper under koloskopiprocedurer. Disse AI-systemer hjælper med realtidsdetektion af polyper, hvilket forbedrer nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af proceduren. De har vist sig at reducere manglende opdagelser, øge adenoma-opdagelsen og potentielt spare omkostninger ved at optimere anvendelsen af koloskopi. Imidlertid står implementeringen af AI i koloskopi stadig over for udfordringer, der skal tackles for at muliggøre bredere anvendelse.

title: Cardiac CT analysis
en: Deep learning algorithms can automatically exclude negative cardiac CT scans and accurately measure coronary artery calcium, providing reliable scores and enabling cardiac risk stratification. These algorithms can adapt to different types of CT examinations and improve performance with additional training data. They can also accurately detect and score vessel-specific coronary and aortic calcium, estimate the amount of coronary artery calcium from unenhanced CT scans, and quantify CAC scores automatically from a single coronary CT angiography scan. Overall, these algorithms offer a reliable and efficient way to identify and quantify coronary artery calcium, with high accuracy and low analysis times.
da: Deep learning-algoritmer kan automatisk udelukke negative cardiac CT-scanninger og præcist måle calcium i koronararterierne, hvilket giver pålidelige scorer og muliggør kardiovaskulær risikostratificering. Disse algoritmer kan tilpasse sig forskellige typer CT-undersøgelser og forbedre ydeevnen med yderligere træningsdata. De kan også præcist opdage og score kar-specifik kalk i koronart arterie og aorta, estimere mængden af calcium i koronarterierne fra ikke-forstærkede CT-scanninger og kvantificere CAC-scorer automatisk fra en enkelt coronary CT angiografi-scanning. Samlet set tilbyder disse algoritmer en pålidelig og effektiv måde at identificere og kvantificere calcium i koronarterierne, med høj nøjagtighed og lave analysetider.

title: Enhancing medical imaging
en: Researchers have been investigating the use of deep learning algorithms to improve the image quality of medical scans, such as low-dose abdominal CT and ultrahigh-resolution CT. These algorithms, which are based on artificial intelligence, have shown promise in enhancing image quality and reducing radiation dose. By comparing them to other reconstruction methods, researchers are able to assess their effectiveness and potential clinical applications.
da: Forskere har undersøgt anvendelsen af deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre billedkvaliteten af medicinske scanninger, såsom lavdosis abdominal CT og ultrahøjopløselig CT. Disse algoritmer, som er baseret på artificial intelligence, har vist lovende resultater i forbedringen af billedkvalitet og reduktion af stråledosis. Ved at sammenligne dem med andre rekonstruktionsmetoder er forskerne i stand til at vurdere deres effektivitet og potentielle kliniske anvendelser.

title: Cancer prediction
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to predict various aspects of cancer, such as the response to chemotherapy, lymph node metastasis, and prognosis. These algorithms analyze different types of data, including medical images and histological slides, to make accurate predictions. By combining deep learning with other techniques like radiomics and clinical features, scientists are developing models and nomograms that can assist in diagnosing and predicting cancer outcomes, ultimately improving patient care.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige aspekter af kræft, såsom respons på kemoterapi, lymfeknudemetastaser og prognose. Disse algoritmer analyserer forskellige typer data, herunder medicinske billeder og histologiske snit, for at lave præcise forudsigelser. Ved at kombinere deep learning med andre teknikker som radiomics og kliniske karakteristika udvikler videnskabsfolk modeller og nomogrammer, der kan hjælpe med at diagnosticere og forudsige kræftresultater, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer patientplejen.

title: Pavement performance prediction
en: Machine learning algorithms can accurately predict various properties and performance measures of asphalt and concrete mixtures, such as the dynamic modulus, Marshall Stability, binder content, and surface layer modulus. These algorithms, including artificial neural networks and ensemble methods, offer a cost-effective and efficient tool for optimizing asphalt mix design and predicting the behavior of pavement materials. By utilizing machine learning techniques, researchers are able to improve prediction models and accurately assess the mechanical performance of different asphalt and concrete mixtures, paving the way for more durable and sustainable road construction.
da: Machine learning algoritmer kan præcist forudsige forskellige egenskaber og præstationsmål for asfalt- og betonblandinger, såsom den dynamiske modulus, Marshall Stability, bindemiddelindhold og overfladelagsmodulus. Disse algoritmer, herunder kunstige neurale netværk og ensemblemetoder, tilbyder et omkostningseffektivt og effektivt værktøj til optimering af asfaltmixdesign og forudsigelse af belægningsmaterialers opførsel. Ved at anvende machine learning teknikker er forskere i stand til at forbedre forudsigelsesmodeller og præcist vurdere den mekaniske ydeevne af forskellige asfalt- og betonblandinger, hvilket baner vej for mere holdbar og bæredygtig vejbygning.

title: Cybersecurity advancements
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve the detection of cyberattacks in various transportation systems. They are using deep learning and other artificial intelligence techniques to develop intrusion detection systems that can effectively identify suspicious network activity and protect against cyber intrusions. These algorithms analyze data from in-vehicle networks, intelligent transportation systems, and connected autonomous vehicles to classify anomalies and detect attacks, ultimately enhancing the security of our transportation networks.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre opdagelsen af cyberangreb i forskellige transportsystemer. De bruger deep learning og andre artificial intelligence teknikker til at udvikle intrusion detection systems, der effektivt kan identificere mistænkelig netværksaktivitet og beskytte mod cyberindtrængen. Disse algoritmer analyserer data fra in-vehicle networks, intelligente transportsystemer og tilkoblede autonome køretøjer for at klassificere anomalier og opdage angreb, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer sikkerheden i vores transportsystemer.

title: Cellular Network Efficiency Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve various aspects of cellular networks, such as power allocation, transmission policies, resource allocation, and energy efficiency. They are using deep reinforcement learning algorithms, machine learning algorithms, and multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms to optimize these processes. These algorithms are designed to make the networks more efficient and effective in handling the increasing demands of 5G and next-generation networks.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af cellulære netværk, såsom strømfordeling, transmissionspolitikker, ressourcefordeling og energieffektivitet. De bruger deep reinforcement learning-algoritmer, machine learning-algoritmer og multi-agent reinforcement learning-algoritmer til at optimere disse processer. Disse algoritmer er designet til at gøre netværkene mere effektive og effektive i håndteringen af de stigende krav fra 5G og next-generation netværk.

title: Multitasking optimization
en: Researchers have been exploring ways to improve the performance of algorithms in multitasking optimization. They have developed various algorithms that can adapt the intensity of cross-task knowledge transfer, select more valuable transferred solutions, and adapt the configuration of crossovers. These algorithms aim to enhance the knowledge transfer between tasks and improve the overall efficacy of multitasking algorithms.
da: Forskere har undersøgt måder at forbedre ydeevnen af algoritmer inden for multitasking optimering. De har udviklet forskellige algoritmer, der kan tilpasse intensiteten af krydsoverførsel af viden, vælge mere værdifulde overførte løsninger og tilpasse konfigurationen af crossover. Disse algoritmer har til formål at forbedre vidensoverførslen mellem opgaver og forbedre den samlede effektivitet af multitasking algoritmer.

title: Performance Analysis Algorithms
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve various aspects of sports performance and analysis. They are using deep learning and neural network algorithms to recognize athletes, analyze human motion, detect objects, and recognize behavior in sports videos. These algorithms are being applied to different sports, such as basketball, football, and volleyball, and are being used in wearable devices and coaching systems.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre forskellige aspekter af sportspræstation og analyse. De bruger deep learning og neural network algoritmer til at genkende atleter, analysere menneskelig bevægelse, detektere objekter og genkende adfærd i sportsvideoer. Disse algoritmer anvendes på forskellige sportsgrene, såsom basketball, fodbold og volleyball, og bruges i wearables og træningssystemer.

title: Dental age estimation
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to estimate dental age. These algorithms have shown promise in accurately predicting dental age based on X-ray images, orthopantomogram images, and other dental parameters. By using artificial intelligence and neural networks, researchers have found that these algorithms can provide more accurate age assessments, especially for specific populations such as children with growth delay.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til at estimere tandalder. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i præcist at forudsige tandalder baseret på røntgenbilleder, orthopantomogram billeder og andre tandparametre. Ved at anvende artificial intelligence og neurale netværk har forskerne fundet, at disse algoritmer kan give mere nøjagtige aldersvurderinger, især for specifikke populationer såsom børn med vækstopbremsning.

title: COVID-19 prognosis
en: Machine learning algorithms are being used to predict various aspects of COVID-19, such as mortality risk, disease severity, and ICU admission. These algorithms, like XGBoost and Random Forest, are showing promising results in accurately predicting these outcomes. By analyzing data from blood tests, clinical characteristics, and inflammatory cytokines, these algorithms can provide valuable insights into the prognosis and survival of COVID-19 patients.
da: Machine learning-algoritmer anvendes til at forudsige forskellige aspekter af COVID-19, såsom dødsrisiko, sygdomsgrad og indlæggelse på ICU. Disse algoritmer, som XGBoost og Random Forest, viser lovende resultater i præcist at forudsige disse udfald. Ved at analysere data fra blodprøver, kliniske karakteristika og inflammatoriske cytokiner kan disse algoritmer give værdifulde indsigter i prognosen og overlevelsen af COVID-19 patienter.

title: Predictive Algorithms in Cancer
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict various aspects of cancer prognosis and treatment outcomes. These algorithms have been successfully used to develop models for predicting the survival status of patients with esophageal cancer, colorectal cancer recurrence, lymph node metastasis in lung adenocarcinoma, and more. By integrating statistical and machine learning algorithms, researchers have achieved higher predictive performance and interpretability in predicting cancer outcomes. These findings highlight the potential of algorithms to assist in personalized cancer treatment and improve patient outcomes.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af machine learning-algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige aspekter af kreftprognose og behandlingsresultater. Disse algoritmer er blevet anvendt med succes til at udvikle modeller til at forudsige overlevelsesstatus for patienter med spiserørskræft, tilbagefald af tyktarmskræft, lymfeknudemetastase i lungeadenokarcinom og mere. Ved at integrere statistiske metoder og machine learning-algoritmer har forskere opnået højere forudsigelsespræstation og fortolkelighed i forudsigelsen af kræftresultater. Disse resultater fremhæver potentialet for algoritmer til at bistå i personliggjort kræftbehandling og forbedre patientresultater.

title: Mask detection
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of deep learning algorithms to detect non-masked faces in public and accurately determine whether a person is wearing a mask. These algorithms, such as ensemble detectors and neural network models like ResNet and YOLO, are being used to develop face mask detection systems that can monitor mask type, position, and adherence to mask protocols. The goal is to create robust and effective algorithms that can be implemented in IoT-based smart healthcare systems and contribute to public health and safety.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at opdage ansigtstræk uden masker i public og præcist fastslå, om en person bærer en maske. Disse algoritmer, såsom ensemble detectors og neurale netværksmodeller som ResNet og YOLO, anvendes til at udvikle systemer til maskedetektion, der kan overvåge masketype, position og overholdelse af maskeregler. Målet er at skabe robuste og effektive algoritmer, der kan implementeres i IoT-baserede smarte sundhedssystemer og bidrage til offentlig sundhed og sikkerhed.

title: Machine Learning Predictions
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of machine learning algorithms to predict various outcomes in patients with acute kidney injury. These algorithms, such as logistic regression, random forest, support vector machine, and extreme gradient boosting, are being used to predict factors like renal replacement therapy-free survival, the risk of rehospitalization, and mortality rates. By analyzing large amounts of data, these algorithms can provide valuable insights and potentially improve patient care in critical situations.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at forudsige forskellige udfald hos patienter med akut nyreskade. Disse algoritmer, såsom logistic regression, random forest, support vector machine og extreme gradient boosting, anvendes til at forudsige faktorer som overlevelse uden behov for nyretransplantation, risikoen for genindlæggelse og dødelighedsrate. Ved at analysere store mængder data kan disse algoritmer give værdifulde indsigter og potentielt forbedre patientpleje i kritiske situationer.

title: Predictive AI
en: Artificial neural networks, powered by algorithms like Levenberg-Marquardt and backpropagation, are being used to accurately predict various heat and fluid flow phenomena in scientific research. These algorithms are able to analyze complex data and make predictions about things like heat generation, entropy production, and fluid behavior. By using artificial intelligence approaches, researchers are gaining valuable insights into the effects of different variables on these phenomena, which can have important applications in fields like engineering and materials science.
da: Kunstige neurale netværk, drevet af algoritmer som Levenberg-Marquardt og backpropagation, bruges til præcist at forudsige forskellige varme- og væskestrømningsfænomener i videnskabelig forskning. Disse algoritmer er i stand til at analysere komplekse data og lave forudsigelser om ting som varmeproduktion, entropiproduktion og væskeadfærd. Ved at anvende kunstig intelligens tilgang får forskere værdifuld indsigt i virkningerne af forskellige variable på disse fænomener, hvilket kan have vigtige anvendelser inden for områder som ingeniørvidenskab og materialeforskning.

title: COVID-19 machine learning
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms to answer important questions about COVID-19. These algorithms are being used to identify gene markers and immune responses associated with the disease, predict COVID-19 development, and distinguish it from other respiratory infections. By analyzing large amounts of data, these intelligent systems are helping researchers develop diagnostic biomarkers and potential drug targets for COVID-19.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at besvare vigtige spørgsmål om COVID-19. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at identificere genmarkører og immunresponser forbundet med sygdommen, forudsige COVID-19 udvikling og adskille den fra andre respiratoriske infektioner. Ved at analysere store mængder data hjælper disse intelligente systemer forskere med at udvikle diagnostiske biomarkører og potentielle lægemiddelmål for COVID-19.

title: Deep Learning for Power Grid Inspections
en: Researchers have proposed various algorithms to improve the detection of defects in transmission line insulators. These algorithms, such as CenterNet, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv7, and YOLOv5, utilize deep learning methods to accurately identify and classify defects in high-resolution aerial images. By enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of defect detection, these algorithms contribute to the development of intelligent systems for maintaining the power grid's reliability.
da: Forskere har foreslået forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre detektion af defekter i transmissionslinjeisolatorer. Disse algoritmer, såsom CenterNet, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv7 og YOLOv5, anvender dyb læring metoder til præcist at identificere og klassificere defekter i højopløsnings luftbilleder. Ved at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af defektdetektion bidrager disse algoritmer til udviklingen af intelligente systemer til at opretholde elnettet pålidelighed.

title: AI and Carbon Emissions
en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has a significant impact on reducing energy intensity and carbon emissions in China's industrial sector, according to a series of studies. The adoption of AI technologies, such as industrial robots, improves energy efficiency and reduces carbon intensity by optimizing factor structures, promoting technological innovation, and upgrading industrial structures. These findings suggest that implementing AI strategies can contribute to carbon neutrality and advance green technology innovation in China.
da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) har en betydelig indvirkning på at reducere energitæthed og CO2-udledninger i Kinas industrisektor, ifølge en række studier. Implementeringen af AI-teknologier, såsom industrielle robotter, forbedrer energieffektiviteten og reducerer kulstofintensiteten ved at optimere faktorkonstruktioner, fremme teknologisk innovation og opgradere industrielle strukturer. Disse fund antyder, at implementeringen af AI-strategier kan bidrage til kulstofneutralitet og fremme grøn teknologisk innovation i Kina.

title: Machine Translation Agency
en: Researchers have explored various aspects of machine translation and its impact on the translation industry. They have investigated how translation students perceive and use machine translation, its effectiveness in legal translation, and its potential for aiding translators through automatic translation programs and dictionaries. Additionally, studies have examined the attitudes and actions of end-users towards machine translation, the incorporation of machine translation literacy into information literacy instruction, and the role of translation technology in enhancing multilingualism and inclusivity in higher education. Ethical issues in translator training programs and the sustainability of translator training in the era of machine translation have also been addressed. Furthermore, researchers have explored the use of machine translation tools in foreign language education, the variations in professional translators' research activities, and the utopian and dystopian visions of artificial intelligence and machine translation. The integration of applied translation in language education to promote critical thinking and digital literacy, as well as EFL students' perceptions and practices of machine translation, have also been investigated.
da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige aspekter af maskinoversættelse og dens indflydelse på oversættelsesindustrien. De har undersøgt, hvordan oversættelsesstuderende opfatter og bruger maskinoversættelse, dens effektivitet inden for juridisk oversættelse, og dens potentiale til at hjælpe oversættere gennem automatiske oversættelsesprogrammer og ordbøger. Derudover har undersøgelser undersøgt holdningerne og handlingerne fra slutbrugere over for maskinoversættelse, indarbejdelsen af maskinoversættelsesfærdigheder i informationskompetenceundervisningen, samt oversættelseteknologiens rolle i at fremme flersprogethed og inklusivitet i videregående uddannelse. Etiske spørgsmål i oversættertræningsprogrammer og bæredygtigheden af oversætteruddannelse i maskinoversættelsens tidsalder er også blevet adresseret. Endvidere har forskere undersøgt brugen af maskinoversættelsesværktøjer i fremmedsprogsundervisning, variationerne i professionelle oversætteres forskningsaktiviteter, samt de utopiske og dystopiske visioner for kunstig intelligens og maskinoversættelse. Integrationen af anvendt oversættelse i sprogundervisning for at fremme kritisk tænkning og digital kompetence, samt EFL-studenters opfattelser og praksis vedrørende maskinoversættelse, er også blevet undersøgt.

title: Enhanced medical imaging
en: Researchers have developed a range of algorithms to improve the accuracy of medical image segmentation when there is limited labeled data available. These algorithms, such as LCC-Net, Self-training, and Uncertainty-aware scheme, use techniques like cross-consistency networks, shape-constrained pseudo label assessment, and uncertainty-aware deep co-training to enhance the segmentation process. By leveraging these algorithms, medical professionals can more effectively analyze and interpret medical images, leading to improved diagnosis and treatment.
da: Forskere har udviklet en række algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden af medicinsk billedsegmentering, når der er begrænsede mærkede data tilgængelige. Disse algoritmer, såsom LCC-Net, Self-training og Uncertainty-aware scheme, anvender teknikker som cross-consistency networks, shape-constrained pseudo label assessment og uncertainty-aware deep co-training for at forbedre segmenteringsprocessen. Ved at udnytte disse algoritmer kan medicinske fagfolk mere effektivt analysere og fortolke medicinske billeder, hvilket fører til forbedret diagnose og behandling.

title: Low-light image enhancement
en: Researchers have been exploring various algorithms to improve the quality of images taken in low-light environments. These algorithms, such as the progressive two-stage image enhancement network and the deep retinex model, use deep learning and Retinex theory to enhance low-light images. They aim to reduce noise, color distortion, and artifacts while balancing local details and global information. These advancements in image enhancement technology offer promising solutions for obtaining clear and visually appealing images even in challenging lighting conditions.
da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre kvaliteten af billeder taget i lavlysforhold. Disse algoritmer, såsom den progressive to-trins billedforbedringsnetværk og deep retinex modellen, anvender deep learning og Retinex teori til at forbedre lavlys billeder. De har til formål at reducere støj, farveforvridning og artefakter samtidig med, at de balancerer lokale detaljer og global information. Disse fremskridt inden for billedforbedringsteknologi tilbyder lovende løsninger til at opnå klare og visuelt tiltalende billeder, selv under udfordrende lysforhold.

title: Edge learning optimization
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can improve the efficiency and performance of distributed learning over wireless edge networks. By enabling edge devices to collaborate and train machine learning models without exchanging raw data, algorithms can optimize the selection of clients and minimize costs while ensuring convergence. Additionally, algorithms can improve client scheduling, resource management, and model personalization in federated learning over wireless networks, addressing challenges such as heterogeneity and resource allocation.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af distribueret læring over trådløse edge-netværk. Ved at muliggøre, at edge-enheder samarbejder og træner maskinlæringsmodeller uden at udveksle rådata, kan algoritmer optimere udvalget af klienter og minimere omkostningerne, samtidig med at de sikrer konvergens. Derudover kan algoritmer forbedre klientplanlægning, ressourceforvaltning og modelpersonalisering i federated learning over trådløse netværk, hvilket adresserer udfordringer som heterogenitet og ressourceallokering.

title: Enhanced X-ray detection
en: Researchers are exploring the use of various algorithms to improve object detection and threat detection in X-ray security images. These algorithms include deep convolutional neural networks, segmentation deep learning models, task-driven cropping schemes, and high-efficiency detectors. By incorporating these algorithms, they aim to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of security inspection, ultimately improving the detection of prohibited items and contraband in X-ray images.
da: Forskere undersøger brugen af forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre objekt- og trusselsdetektion i røntgensikkerhedsbilleder. Disse algoritmer inkluderer deep convolutional neural networks, segmentation deep learning models, task-driven cropping schemes og high-efficiency detectors. Ved at inddrage disse algoritmer har de til formål at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af sikkerhedsinspektion, hvilket i sidste ende forbedrer opdagelsen af forbudte genstande og smuglergods i røntgenbilleder.

title: Pruning for Efficiency
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the efficiency and performance of deep learning models through a process called pruning. These algorithms aim to identify and remove unnecessary components of the models, such as neurons or filters, without sacrificing accuracy. By leveraging techniques like regularization, evolutionary algorithms, reinforcement learning, and additional losses, these algorithms automate the pruning process and achieve significant speedups and compression while maintaining or even improving model accuracy.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til at forbedre effektiviteten og ydeevnen af dybe læringsmodeller gennem en proces kaldet pruning. Disse algoritmer har til formål at identificere og fjerne unødvendige komponenter af modellerne, såsom neuroner eller filtre, uden at ofre nøjagtigheden. Ved at udnytte teknikker som regularisering, evolutionære algoritmer, reinforcement learning og yderligere tab, automatiserer disse algoritmer pruning-processen og opnår betydelige hastighedsforøgelser og kompression, samtidig med at de opretholder eller endda forbedrer modelnøjagtigheden.

title: Enhanced object detection
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve object detection in different scenarios. These algorithms focus on enhancing features, attention and feature fusion, pixel attention mechanism, feature fusion mode, dense sampling and detail enhancement, adaptive feature fusion, learning balance feature, decoupled multi-scale detection, 3D features, multi-scale fusion feature, self-attention combined feature fusion, and feature pyramid network. These algorithms aim to make object detection more accurate and efficient, especially for small objects and in complex scenes.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre objektgenkendelse i forskellige scenarier. Disse algoritmer fokuserer på at forbedre funktioner, opmærksomhed og funktionsfusion, pixelopmærkningsmekanisme, funktionsfusionsmetode, tæt sampling og detaljeforbedring, adaptiv funktionsfusion, læringsbalancefunktion, decoupled multi-scale detection, 3D features, multi-scale fusion feature, self-attention combined feature fusion, og feature pyramid network. Disse algoritmer har til formål at gøre objektgenkendelse mere præcis og effektiv, især for små objekter og i komplekse scener.

title: Helmet detection
en: Researchers are exploring ways to improve the detection efficiency and accuracy of helmet wearing using various algorithms. These algorithms, such as DWCA-YOLOv5, SAS-YOLOv3-tiny, and AT-YOLO deep model, aim to enhance the accuracy of detecting safety helmets in different scenarios, including small objects and objects with obstructions. By replacing manual monitoring with deep learning algorithms like Improved YOLO v3 and YOLOv5, real-time and efficient detection of safety helmet wearing can be achieved. These advancements in algorithmic technology offer potential solutions to improve the accuracy, speed, and availability of safety helmet detection in practical scenarios.
da: Forskere udforsker måder at forbedre detektions effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af hjelmbrug ved hjælp af forskellige algoritmer. Disse algoritmer, såsom DWCA-YOLOv5, SAS-YOLOv3-tiny og AT-YOLO deep model, har til formål at forbedre nøjagtigheden af at detektere sikkerhedshjelme i forskellige scenarier, herunder små objekter og objekter med forhindringer. Ved at erstatte manuel overvågning med dybdelæringsalgoritmer som Improved YOLO v3 og YOLOv5 kan realtid og effektiv detektion af sikkerhedshjelm brug opnås. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmisk teknologi tilbyder potentielle løsninger for at forbedre nøjagtigheden, hastigheden og tilgængeligheden af sikkerhedshjelm detektion i praktiske scenarier.

title: Advanced Algorithms for Traffic Forecasting
en: Researchers are exploring ways to accurately predict traffic speed and flow using algorithms. These algorithms, such as Graph Neural Networks, Dynamic Graph Convolutional Networks, and Multi-channel Graph Convolution and Long Short-Term Memory, are being used to model spatial-temporal dependencies, forecast short-term traffic, and achieve network-level multi-step traffic prediction. By leveraging deep learning models and adaptive fusion techniques, these algorithms aim to improve the accuracy and explainability of traffic flow forecasting.
da: Forskere undersøger måder at præcist forudsige trafik hastighed og flow ved hjælp af algoritmer. Disse algoritmer, såsom Graph Neural Networks, Dynamic Graph Convolutional Networks og Multi-channel Graph Convolution og Long Short-Term Memory, anvendes til at modellere rum-tidsafhængigheder, forudsige kortsigtet trafik og opnå netværksniveau multi-step trafikprognoser. Ved at udnytte dybe læringsmodeller og adaptive fusions teknikker sigter disse algoritmer mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og forklarligheden af trafikflow prognoser.

title: Smart Mobility
en: Algorithms play a crucial role in the development of smart urban mobility systems and intelligent transportation. They contribute to various aspects such as decision-making, perception, planning, and optimization. For example, computer vision algorithms, machine learning predictors, and path planning algorithms are used in autonomous vehicles to improve road safety and reduce crashes. Additionally, big geospatial data analytics and interconnected sensor networks help optimize transportation networks and improve traffic flows. These technologies are essential for creating efficient and sustainable urban transportation systems.
da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i udviklingen af smarte bymobilitetssystemer og intelligent transport. De bidrager til forskellige aspekter såsom beslutningstagning, perception, planlægning og optimering. For eksempel anvendes computer vision algoritmer, machine learning predictors og path planning algoritmer i autonome køretøjer for at forbedre vej sikkerheden og reducere ulykker. Derudover hjælper big geospatial data analytics og sammenkoblede sensornetværk med at optimere transportnetværk og forbedre trafikstrømme. Disse teknologier er essentielle for at skabe effektive og bæredygtige urbane transportsystemer.

title: Acoustic metamaterial optimization
en: Scientists are using various algorithms to optimize the design of acoustic metamaterials, which are materials that can manipulate sound waves. These algorithms, such as genetic algorithms and particle swarm optimization, are being used to improve the performance of acoustic metamaterials in areas like sound absorption and noise attenuation. By applying these algorithms, researchers are able to optimize the structural parameters and arrangement of the materials to achieve desired acoustic properties.
da: Forskere bruger forskellige algoritmer til at optimere designet af akustiske metamaterialer, som er materialer, der kan manipulere lydbølger. Disse algoritmer, såsom genetiske algoritmer og particle swarm optimization, anvendes til at forbedre ydeevnen af akustiske metamaterialer inden for områder som lydeabsorption og støjdæmpning. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer kan forskere optimere de strukturelle parametre og arrangementet af materialerne for at opnå ønskede akustiske egenskaber.

title: Blockchain-enhanced federated learning
en: Researchers are exploring how blockchain technology can improve the efficiency, security, and privacy of federated learning systems. They are investigating various ways to integrate blockchain into the learning process, such as using it to ensure secure trading and sharing of training data, creating decentralized frameworks to address single points of failure, and designing hierarchical systems for secure learning with non-IID data. These advancements aim to enhance the scalability, verifiability, and fairness of federated learning while addressing challenges like malicious nodes and limited bandwidth.
da: Forskere udforsker, hvordan blockchain-teknologi kan forbedre effektiviteten, sikkerheden og privatheden i federated learning-systemer. De undersøger forskellige måder at integrere blockchain i læringsprocessen, såsom at bruge det til at sikre sikker handel og deling af træningsdata, skabe decentrale rammer for at håndtere enkeltpunkter af fejl, og designe hierarkiske systemer for sikker læring med non-IID data. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre skalerbarheden, verificerbarheden og retfærdigheden af federated learning, samtidig med at de adresserer udfordringer som ondsindede noder og begrænset båndbredde.

title: AI-enhanced music education
en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI) in music education. They are investigating how deep learning algorithms can monitor and analyze the quality of musical education teaching, how AI can improve piano teaching by analyzing performance characteristics, and how multimedia technology can enhance traditional piano instruction. These advancements aim to enhance music education and teaching in colleges and schools, simplify music teaching, and develop intelligent music teaching systems.
da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer og kunstig intelligens (AI) i musikuddannelse. De efterforsker, hvordan deep learning-algoritmer kan overvåge og analysere kvaliteten af undervisningen i musikuddannelse, hvordan AI kan forbedre kl undervising ved at analysere præstationskarakteristika, og hvordan multimedieteknologi kan forbedre traditionel kl undervisning. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre musikuddannelse og undervisning på colleges og skoler, forenkle musikundervisning og udvikle intelligente musikundervisningssystemer.

title: CAF Analysis
en: Scientists have been using algorithms to investigate the role of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) in various types of cancer. By analyzing gene expression data and using machine learning techniques, these algorithms can predict prognosis, therapeutic responses, immune infiltration, and even refine cancer classifications. This research aims to better understand the impact of CAFs on tumor microenvironments and improve treatment strategies for cancer patients.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at undersøge rollen af cancer-associerede fibroblaster (CAFs) i forskellige typer af kræft. Ved at analysere genekspressionsdata og anvende maskinlæringsteknikker kan disse algoritmer forudsige prognose, terapeutiske responser, immuninfiltration og endda forfine kræftklassifikationer. Denne forskning har til formål at få en bedre forståelse af CAF'ers indvirkning på tumor-mikromiljøer og forbedre behandlingsstrategier for kræftpatienter.

title: Advanced Algorithms for Drug Interaction
en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve drug discovery and prediction of drug interactions. These algorithms, such as DRHGCN, MUFFIN, and EEG-DTI, use techniques like heterogeneous information fusion, graph convolutional networks, and knowledge graph representation learning to identify potential drugs for diseases and predict drug-target interactions. By incorporating multiple modalities, attention mechanisms, and graph neural networks, these algorithms aim to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of drug repurposing and interaction prediction.
da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre lægemiddelopdagelse og forudsigelse af lægemiddelinteraktioner. Disse algoritmer, såsom DRHGCN, MUFFIN og EEG-DTI, bruger teknikker som heterogen informationsfusion, graph convolutional networks og knowledge graph representation learning til at identificere potentielle lægemidler mod sygdomme og forudsige lægemiddel-mål interaktioner. Ved at inkorporere flere modaliteter, opmærksomhedsmekanismer og graph neural networks sigter disse algoritmer mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af lægemiddelgenbrug og interaktionsforudsigelse.

title: Endometriosis research
en: Scientists are using machine learning algorithms and bioinformatics analysis to understand the molecular markers and mechanisms underlying the development and progression of endometriosis. They are also using algorithms like CIBERSORT and WGCNA to identify macrophage M2-related biomarkers and potential therapeutic agents for endometriosis. Additionally, researchers are using weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning algorithms to explore the relationship between abnormal gene module expression in the eutopic endometrium and the occurrence of endometriosis.
da: Forskere bruger maskinlæringsalgoritmer og bioinformatik-analyse til at forstå de molekylære markører og mekanismer, der ligger til grund for udviklingen og fremskridten af endometriose. De anvender også algoritmer som CIBERSORT og WGCNA til at identificere M2-relaterede biomarkører for makrofager og potentielle terapeutiske stoffer til endometriose. Desuden bruger forskere vægtet gen co-ekspressionsnetværksanalyse og maskinlæringsalgoritmer til at udforske forholdet mellem unormal genmodul-udfoldelse i det eutopiske endometrium og forekomsten af endometriose.

title: Ferroptosis analysis
en: Scientists have used algorithms to investigate the different subtypes of ferroptosis in liver cancer and their clinical significance. They have also developed algorithms to classify and refine treatment decisions based on ferroptosis-related genes. Additionally, algorithms have been used to predict the survival, immune profiles, and drug sensitivity of liver cancer patients based on ferroptosis and other related processes.
da: Forskere har brugt algoritmer til at undersøge de forskellige undertyper af ferroptosis i leverkræft og deres kliniske betydning. De har også udviklet algoritmer til at klassificere og forbedre behandlingsbeslutninger baseret på ferroptosis-relaterede gener. Derudover er algoritmer blevet brugt til at forudsige overlevelse, immunprofiler og lægemiddelfølsomhed hos patienter med leverkræft baseret på ferroptosis og andre relaterede processer.

title: Sensor fusion optimization
en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve the accuracy and performance of various sensor fusion systems. These algorithms are being used to combine measurements from LiDAR, inertial sensors, and visual cameras, enabling better state estimation and navigation in different scenarios. By optimizing the matching accuracy of LiDAR, compensating for motion distortion, and fusing data from multiple sensors, these algorithms aim to enhance the localization and mapping capabilities of autonomous systems.
da: Forskere udforsker brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og ydeevnen af forskellige sensor fusion systemer. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at kombinere målinger fra LiDAR, inertiale sensorer og visuelle kameraer, hvilket muliggør bedre tilstandsestimering og navigation i forskellige scenarier. Ved at optimere matchningsnøjagtigheden af LiDAR, kompensere for bevægelsesforvrængning og fusionere data fra flere sensorer, sigter disse algoritmer mod at forbedre lokaliserings- og kortlægningskapaciteterne for autonome systemer.

title: Algorithmic Environmental Prediction
en: Scientists are exploring the potential of algorithms to improve various aspects of environmental prediction and management. For example, graph neural networks are being used to analyze large hydrology datasets and improve streamflow forecasting. Similarly, deep learning models based on graph convolutional networks are being developed to predict landslide displacements and abnormal pore pressure during petroleum drilling. These algorithms have the potential to enhance our understanding and prediction of natural phenomena, leading to more accurate and timely warnings and better management strategies.
da: Forskere undersøger potentialet af algoritmer til at forbedre forskellige aspekter af miljøforudsigelse og -forvaltning. For eksempel anvendes graph neural networks til at analysere store hydrologidata og forbedre strømflowforudsigelser. På samme måde udvikles deep learning-modeller baseret på graph convolutional networks til at forudsige jordskredsforskydninger og unormal poretryk under olieboring. Disse algoritmer har potentiale til at forbedre vores forståelse og forudsigelse af naturlige fænomener, hvilket fører til mere præcise og rettidige advarsler og bedre forvaltningsstrategier.

title: Virtual Retail Enhancement
en: Researchers are exploring how immersive 3D technologies and spatial computing algorithms can enhance virtual retail experiences. These algorithms, such as cognitive artificial intelligence algorithms and geospatial mapping tools, play a crucial role in creating more engaging and seamless virtual shopping environments. By integrating virtual navigation tools, augmented reality shopping tools, and digital marketplaces in the metaverse, image processing computational and object tracking algorithms contribute to a more immersive and interactive shopping experience. Geospatial mapping and remote sensing technologies, along with spatial cognition and visual perception algorithms, help create frictionless virtual shopping experiences. Data modeling tools, powered by behavioral predictive analytics and customer location tracking tools, optimize customer engagement behaviors and purchasing habits in immersive virtual worlds. Movement and behavior tracking tools, along with spatial computing technology, impact consumer digital engagement in virtual retail environments by using simulation modeling, image recognition tools, and behavioral predictive analytics. Customer data analytics, facilitated by virtual navigation and geospatial mapping tools, computer vision, and simulation optimization algorithms, shape immersive digital and metaverse brand experiences. Machine vision algorithms and sensory data mining techniques enhance customer engagement behaviors in virtual marketplaces by utilizing geospatial mapping tools. Augmented analytics tools and interconnected decision-making processes optimize purchase intentions and customer behavior in the metaverse through the use of computer vision algorithms. Visual and spatial analytics, along with cognitive artificial intelligence techniques, enhance live shopping in the metaverse through immersive digital simulations. Customer behavior analytics and extended reality technologies impact virtual retail in the metaverse by utilizing immersive visualization systems. Smart retailing technologies enhance virtual immersive shopping experiences in metaverse environments through predictive customer analytics and data visualization algorithms. Immersive technologies and location analytics optimize user engagement in virtual retail stores by utilizing data visualization tools. Digital consumer engagement on blockchain-based metaverse platforms impacts retail business analytics, and extended reality technologies and immersive multisensory virtual spaces play a role in this. Finally, immersive technologies and retail business analytics shape customer behavior in the decentralized metaverse through the use of computer vision algorithms.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan immersive 3D-teknologier og spatial computing-algoritmer kan forbedre virtuelle detailoplevelser. Disse algoritmer, såsom cognitive artificial intelligence-algoritmer og geospatial mapping-værktøjer, spiller en afgørende rolle i at skabe mere engagerende og sømløse virtuelle shoppingmiljøer. Ved at integrere virtuelle navigationsværktøjer, augmented reality shopping-værktøjer og digitale markedspladser i metaverset bidrager billedbehandlingscomputational og objekt tracking-algoritmer til en mere immersiv og interaktiv shoppingoplevelse. Geospatial mapping og remote sensing-teknologier, sammen med spatial cognition og visual perception-algoritmer, hjælper med at skabe friktionsfrie virtuelle shoppingoplevelser. Data modeling værktøjer, drevet af behavioral predictive analytics og customer location tracking værktøjer, optimerer kundernes engagement adfærd og købsvaner i immersive virtuelle verdener. Bevægelses- og adfærd tracking-værktøjer, sammen med spatial computing-teknologi, påvirker forbrugerens digitale engagement i virtuelle detailmiljøer ved at anvende simulationsmodeller, billedgenkendelsesværktøjer og behavioral predictive analytics. Kunden data analytics, faciliteret af virtuelle navigations- og geospatial mapping værktøjer, computer vision, og simulationsoptimeringsalgoritmer, former immersive digitale og metaverse brandoplevelser. Machine vision-algoritmer og sensoriske data mining-teknikker forbedrer kundernes engagement adfærd i virtuelle markedspladser ved at anvende geospatial mapping værktøjer. Augmented analytics-værktøjer og sammenkoblede beslutningsprocesser optimerer købsintentioner og kundeadfærd i metaverset gennem brugen af computer vision-algoritmer. Visuelle og spatial analytics, sammen med cognitive artificial intelligence-teknikker, forbedrer live shopping i metaverset gennem immersive digitale simulationer. Kundeadfærd analytics og extended reality-teknologier påvirker virtuel detailhandel i metaverset ved at anvende immersive visualiseringssystemer. Smart retailing-teknologier forbedrer virtuelle immersive shoppingoplevelser i metaverse-miljøer gennem predictive customer analytics og data visualisering-algoritmer. Immersive teknologier og location analytics optimerer brugerengagement i virtuelle detailbutikker ved at anvende data visualiseringsværktøjer. Digitalt forbrugerengagement på blockchain-baserede metaverse-platforme påvirker detailforretningsanalyse, og extended reality-teknologier samt immersive multisensoriske virtuelle rum spiller en rolle i dette. Endelig former immersive teknologier og detailforretningsanalyse kundeadfærd i det decentrale metaverset gennem brug af computer vision-algoritmer.

title: Virtual shopping optimization
en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can enhance the shopping experience in virtual worlds. They are investigating the use of technologies such as 3D modeling, immersive visualization, and object recognition to create realistic and engaging virtual shopping events. These algorithms can analyze customer behavior and predict shopping habits, optimizing consumer purchase behaviors in the virtual world.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre shoppingoplevelsen i virtuelle verdener. De undersøger brugen af teknologier som 3D-modellering, immersiv visualisering og objektgenkendelse for at skabe realistiske og engagerende virtuelle shoppingbegivenheder. Disse algoritmer kan analysere kundeadfærd og forudsige shoppingvaner, hvilket optimerer forbrugeradfærd ved køb i den virtuelle verden.

title: LncRNA Models for Prognosis
en: Scientists have been investigating the role of specific long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in various types of cancer, such as lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. They are using algorithms, such as Cox regression analysis and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) algorithm, to construct signatures or models that can predict the prognosis, immune response, and immunotherapy efficacy for these cancers. These findings could potentially improve the accuracy of prognosis prediction and help guide personalized treatment decisions for cancer patients.
da: Forskere har undersøgt rollen af specifikke lange non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) i forskellige typer kræft, såsom lungeadenokarcinom, hepatocellulært karcinom og kolorektal cancer. De bruger algoritmer, såsom Cox regression analysis og least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) algorithm, til at konstruere signaturer eller modeller, der kan forudsige prognosen, immunresponsen og effekten af immunterapi for disse kræftformer. Disse fund kunne potentielt forbedre nøjagtigheden af prognoseforudsigelser og hjælpe med at guide personlige behandlingsbeslutninger for kræftpatienter.

title: ChatGPT in Clinical Decision-Making
en: Researchers are investigating how well ChatGPT, an AI language model, performs in various medical specialties and clinical scenarios. They are assessing its accuracy and utility in fields such as neurology, ophthalmology, urology, radiology, and pediatric urology. The goal is to determine if ChatGPT can provide reliable and accurate information, assist in clinical decision-making, and compare its performance to other medical knowledge sources like Bard and Google Search.
da: Forskere undersøger, hvor godt ChatGPT, en AI sprogmodel, præsterer inden for forskellige medicinske specialer og kliniske scenarier. De vurderer dens nøjagtighed og nytte i områder som neurologi, oftalmologi, urologi, radiologi og pædiatrisk urologi. Målet er at afgøre, om ChatGPT kan levere pålidelig og præcis information, hjælpe med kliniske beslutninger og sammenligne dens præstation med andre medicinske videnskilder som Bard og Google Search.

title: ChatGPT in Learning
en: Researchers are exploring the potential use of ChatGPT, an AI language model, in education. They are investigating how ChatGPT can be integrated into teaching and learning practices, the strategies for responsible implementation, and the impact on blended learning and educational systems. The studies also examine the challenges, ethical concerns, and the perceptions of educators and students regarding the use of ChatGPT in education. Overall, the research aims to understand the implications, possibilities, and concerns of using ChatGPT as an educational technology.
da: Forskere undersøger den potentielle anvendelse af ChatGPT, en AI sprogmodel, i uddannelsessektoren. De undersøger, hvordan ChatGPT kan integreres i undervisnings- og læringspraksis, strategier for ansvarlig implementering, samt påvirkningen på blended learning og uddannelsessystemer. Studierne ser også på udfordringerne, etiske bekymringer og opfattelserne blandt undervisere og studerende vedrørende brugen af ChatGPT i uddannelsen. Samlet set har forskningen til formål at forstå konsekvenserne, mulighederne og bekymringerne ved at bruge ChatGPT som en uddannelsesteknologi.
